translation: 肖像，半身画像；详细的描述，描绘
original_sentence: Step 3: Arrange the vegetables on the toast to create your portrait.
readingExamples: Step 3: Arrange the vegetables on the toast to create your portrait.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a painting, drawing or photograph of a person, especially of the face and shoulders
(2) n. a detailed description or representation of somebody or something in words, film or music
(3) n. the position in which the height of a page or image is greater than its width

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (用文字、影像等作的)生动描绘，写照
uncommonMeanings.example: The novel offers an unflinching portrait of a nation torn between tradition and modernity — every character a mirror in which the reader glimpses a fragment of himself. （议论文·文学评论）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纵向的(纸张/图片方向，与 landscape 相对)
uncommonMeanings.example: Set the document to portrait orientation before you print the invitation, so that the tall arch of the cathedral fits neatly on the page. （应用文·操作说明）

posExamples.sentence: The moment I lifted the dusty cloth, my grandmother's portrait gazed back at me — the same warm eyes, the same faint smile, and suddenly the empty attic felt crowded with memories I thought I had lost forever. （读后续写·睹物思人）
I am writing to invite you to submit a self-portrait for our school's centenary exhibition, through which every student can leave a lasting mark on the history of our beloved campus. （应用文·邀请信）

Far from being a mere likeness, a great portrait captures the invisible — the sitter's hidden sorrows, quiet dignity and unspoken hopes — which is precisely why a photograph can never fully replace the painter's brush. （议论文·艺术价值）
With a few swift strokes, the street artist produced a portrait so lifelike that the passing tourist gasped, pressing a hand to her mouth as if she had met a long-lost twin. （读后续写·街头速写）

wordForms.noun: portrait (肖像) / portraiture (肖像画艺术) / portraitist (肖像画家) / portrayal (描绘,刻画)
wordForms.other: 构词法·同源家族:portray(v.描绘) → portrayal(n.描绘,刻画) 与 portrait(n.肖像) 同源(拉丁 protrahere '拖出、显露')。★区分:portrait 是名词'画像',portray 是动词'描绘',portrayal 是 portray 的动作名词。作方向术语时 portrait(纵向) 与 landscape(横向) 相对。

collocations.translation: 某人的肖像；对……的描绘/写照
collocations.example: On the wall hung a portrait of the founder, whose steady gaze seemed to watch over every new student. （读后续写·场景）
Van Gogh painted more than thirty self-portraits, each restless brushstroke a confession he could not put into words. （议论文·艺术）
The old master agreed to paint a portrait of the fisherman, saying a lifetime of hardship had carved a face worthy of art. （读后续写·艺术家）
She sat for the portrait every afternoon that summer, and by autumn painter and model had become inseparable friends. （读后续写·情谊）
The faded family portrait on the mantelpiece was the only thing they saved from the fire. （读后续写·亲情）
Dominating the hall was a full-length portrait of the founder, whose steady gaze reminded every visitor of the school's values. （读后续写·场景）
The biography draws a surprisingly unflattering portrait of the hero, reminding us that even great figures have very human flaws. （议论文·人物评价）
No camera could have captured the general in a portrait so telling as the one the artist painted. （读后续写·刻画）

synonyms.example: The film's honest depiction of ordinary courage moved the audience to a long silence before the applause erupted. （议论文·影视评论）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任何形式的描绘(文字/影像/绘画)，比 portrait 更抽象、更书面，不特指人的画像;常搭配 a depiction of sth

synonyms.example: The sculpture bore such a striking likeness to the late poet that visitors instinctively lowered their voices. （读后续写·纪念）
synonyms.usage: 强调与本人的相似度,多用于评价画像/塑像画得像不像,常搭配 bear a likeness to sb;不含'详细描述'义

synonyms.example: The magazine ran a glowing profile of the young inventor, tracing her journey from a garage to the world stage. （应用文·人物专访）
synonyms.usage: 既指侧面轮廓像,也指(报刊上的)人物简介,侧重概括性介绍而非艺术描绘;portrait 更强调完整、艺术性的刻画

advancedExpressions.expression: a portrait of sb｜a self-portrait｜sit for a portrait｜portray sb as ...｜a vivid portrayal of ...
advancedExpressions.example: The documentary portrays the village as a place of quiet dignity — a vivid portrayal that lingers long after the credits roll. （portray sb/sth as... 把……描绘成……;portrayal 为其名词形式）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·生动的描绘
advancedExpressions.expression: paint / draw / offer a vivid (unflinching, honest) portrait of ...(生动地/毫不回避地/真实地描绘……)
advancedExpressions.example: The novel offers an unflinching portrait of a nation torn between tradition and modernity. （portrait 引申为'文字/影像的写照',动词多用 paint/draw/offer）

advancedExpressions.expression: In the portrait hung ..., whose ... seemed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the portrait hung above the cold hearth was her mother, whose gentle eyes seemed to follow the girl across the room, silently urging her not to give up. （介词短语倒装 + whose定语从句 + 拟人化凝视，营造陪伴感）

advancedExpressions.expression: we cordially invite you to have your portrait ...
advancedExpressions.example: To celebrate our school's anniversary, we cordially invite every graduate to have his or her portrait added to the Wall of Memories, so that our shared story may never fade. （invite sb to do 正式邀请句 + so that目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: more than a mere likeness, a portrait is ...
advancedExpressions.example: More than a mere likeness, a portrait is a dialogue across time — a way for the silent dead to keep speaking to the living. （not merely...but 递进 + 破折号点题，提升立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I saw my grandmother's portrait and felt sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As my fingers brushed the dust from my grandmother's portrait, her painted smile bloomed out of the shadows, and a tide of longing rose in my chest — for a voice I would never hear again, for a warmth that now lived only in oil and canvas. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as引导动作定格 + 拟物(smile bloomed) + a tide of longing比喻情感 + for排比补足语渲染怅惘

sentenceUpgrade.original: This book describes society well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What lends this book its enduring power is the honest, unhurried portrait it paints of a society in transition — a portrait in which no character is wholly good, and none beyond redemption. （议论文·文学评论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What引导主语从句强调 + 形容词叠加(honest, unhurried) + 破折号补充 + 平行否定结构(no...none)升华论断

classPractice.question: The artist ____ (portray) the old fisherman with such warmth that the whole village recognised him at once.
classPractice.note: portray 为动词'描绘/刻画',此处叙述过去动作用一般过去时;名词'肖像'才用 portrait。

classPractice.question: 用 portrait / portray / portrayal 填空:①Above the desk hung a ____ of her grandfather. ②The film ____ him as a lonely genius. ③The book gives a moving ____ of rural life.
classPractice.note: portrait名词(画像)、portray动词(描绘)、portrayal为portray的动作名词(描绘、刻画),靠词性与后缀区分。

classPractice.question: 梵高的自画像展现了一颗饱受煎熬的心灵，每一笔都是无声的告白。
classPractice.answer: Van Gogh's self-portraits reveal a soul in turmoil, and every brushstroke is a silent confession.
classPractice.note: self-portrait自画像(连字符);reveal/show + 抽象宾语,brushstroke为可数名词。

original_sentence: The moon and stars in the sky, the natural landscape and the figures in legends all become a vehicle for his imagination.
readingExamples: The moon and stars in the sky, the natural landscape and the figures in legends all become a vehicle for his imagination.
definitionEn:
(1) n. everything you can see when you look across a large area of land, especially in the countryside
(2) n. a painting of a country scene, or the type of art that shows such scenes
(3) n. the particular set of conditions or features that characterise a situation or field of activity
(4) v. to improve the appearance of an area of land by changing its design and planting trees, flowers, etc.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (某领域的)全局，形势，格局(常搭 the political / economic / digital landscape)
uncommonMeanings.example: The rise of artificial intelligence has utterly reshaped the employment landscape, forcing a whole generation to rethink what it means to be irreplaceable. （议论文·科技与社会）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 风景画；风景画这一画种(与 portrait '肖像画' 相对)
uncommonMeanings.example: A truly great landscape does more than record scenery; it makes us feel the wind in the grass and the hush of dusk. （议论文·艺术欣赏）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (纸张/图片)横向的/横向地(与 portrait '纵向' 相对)
uncommonMeanings.example: Print the poster in landscape orientation so that the long mountain range fits across the page. （应用文·操作说明）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对(土地)做景观美化，绿化
uncommonMeanings.example: Over the summer the volunteers landscaped the barren schoolyard, and by autumn the cracked earth was bursting with colour and birdsong. （读后续写·社区改造）

posExamples.sentence: As the train climbed higher, the landscape unfolded like a living scroll — terraced fields stacked upon the hillside, silver streams threading through the valley, and, far off, mountains dissolving into a veil of morning mist. （读后续写·旅途风景）
I am writing to recommend our county's Wetland Park, whose breathtaking landscape of reeds, herons and mirror-still water offers the perfect escape for anyone weary of city noise. （应用文·推荐信）

A truly great landscape painting does more than record scenery; it invites us to slow down and feel the wind in the grass, the hush of dusk, and the quiet grandeur of a world larger than ourselves. （议论文·艺术欣赏）
After the flood, the whole community came together to landscape the riverbank, planting willows whose roots would one day hold the fragile soil in place. （读后续写·灾后重建）

collocations.example: As a landscape painter, he believed patience was his most important brush, for a mountain reveals its true colours only to those willing to wait. （读后续写·艺术家）
Social media has transformed the political landscape, giving ordinary citizens a voice no government can afford to ignore. （议论文·媒体与社会）
The natural landscape of the highlands, unspoiled by roads or wires, made the travellers feel they had stepped into a purer age. （读后续写·旅行）
By dusk the urban landscape had transformed into a sea of glittering lights, each window a tiny story of hopes and fears. （读后续写·城市夜景）
The painting captured the rural landscape at harvest time — golden wheat bowing in the breeze, and farmers' laughter drifting across the fields. （议论文·艺术）

collocations.translation: 在景观中占主导地位，成为地标
collocations.example: For centuries the ancient pagoda had dominated the landscape, a silent witness to the rise and fall of everything around it. （读后续写·历史场景）
They trudged for hours across a desolate landscape where nothing grew, until at last a thin ribbon of green promised water ahead. （读后续写·冒险求生）
The eco-lodge was built from local stone so that it would blend into the landscape rather than scar it. （应用文·环保介绍）
In the changing landscape of modern education, the teacher's role is shifting from a mere lecturer to a lifelong guide. （议论文·教育）

synonyms.example: We pulled over simply to drink in the scenery, and for one still moment no one spoke. （读后续写·旅途）
synonyms.usage: 不可数,泛指某地整体的自然美景,强调观赏性;不像 landscape 那样可指'画作'或'领域格局'

synonyms.example: The scene before us was straight out of a fairy tale: a stone bridge, a lazy stream, and a solitary heron. （读后续写·场景）
synonyms.usage: 可数,指某个具体的、有画面的场景或事件现场,范围比 landscape 小

synonyms.example: The rescue team advanced slowly across the rugged terrain, every step a negotiation between courage and caution. （读后续写·救援）
synonyms.usage: 侧重土地的物理形态(平坦/崎岖/陡峭),多用于地理、军事、探险语境,不含审美意味

synonyms.translation: (尤指从高处望见的)远景，展望
synonyms.example: From the summit a magnificent vista opened before them, and all the exhaustion of the climb melted away. （读后续写·登顶）
synonyms.usage: 尤指从有利位置远眺所见的开阔景致,或比喻'前景、展望',比 landscape 更强调'一眼望去'的纵深感

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·风景与格局(一词多义)
advancedExpressions.expression: a landscape painting(风景画)｜dominate the landscape(成为地标)｜the political / digital landscape(政治/数字格局)｜against the shifting landscape of ...(在……变动的背景下)
advancedExpressions.example: Against the shifting digital landscape, traditional bookshops must reinvent themselves or vanish. （landscape 从'实景'到'抽象格局'的义项跳转，是本词高频考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: landscape(横向) ↔ portrait(纵向):打印/拍摄方向的一对反义术语
advancedExpressions.example: Photograph the wide valley in landscape mode, but switch to portrait mode for the tall waterfall. （landscape/portrait 作方向词时不可数、无冠词，直接修饰 mode/orientation）

advancedExpressions.expression: the landscape unfolded / stretched before sb like ...
advancedExpressions.example: The landscape stretched before them like a canvas freshly painted, so vast and serene that their quarrel of the morning suddenly seemed absurdly small. （明喻 like a canvas + so...that结果状语，以景衬情、化解冲突）

advancedExpressions.expression: nestled in / against a landscape of ..., ... is well worth a visit
advancedExpressions.example: Nestled against a landscape of rolling hills and mirror-clear lakes, our ancient village is well worth a visit for anyone longing to escape the din of the city. （过去分词短语作状语 + be worth doing，画面开篇更吸睛）

advancedExpressions.expression: against the shifting landscape of ..., we must ...
advancedExpressions.example: Against the shifting landscape of a globalised world, we must cultivate not only sharper minds but broader, more compassionate hearts. （against引出时代背景 + not only...but 递进，宏观立意开篇）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The landscape was very beautiful as we drove past.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As our car wound along the coastal road, the landscape rolled past the window like an endless scroll of ink and colour — cliffs plunging into a turquoise sea, gulls wheeling against a spotless sky, and the salt breeze carrying the promise of adventure. （读后续写·旅途环境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as时间状语随镜头推进 + 明喻(scroll of ink and colour) + 三组分词/名词短语并列 + 多感官描写(视觉+嗅觉)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Technology has changed many industries.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Sweeping across every corner of modern life, technology has redrawn the industrial landscape so thoroughly that skills once thought secure for a lifetime may now grow obsolete within a decade. （议论文·科技变革）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词短语开篇(Sweeping across...) + 隐喻(redrawn the landscape) + so...that结果状语强化冲击 + 让步暗示(once thought secure)

classPractice.question: The novel unfolds against the changing political ____ (landscape / scenery) of the 1980s, when everything seemed possible.
classPractice.note: 抽象'格局/形势'只能用landscape(the political landscape);scenery仅指自然风景且不可数,无此引申义。

classPractice.question: After the flood, the whole community came together to ____ (landscape) the riverbank, planting willows to hold the soil.
classPractice.note: 此处作动词'对(土地)做景观美化、绿化',to后接动词原形,landscape动词名词同形。

classPractice.question: 这幅风景画不只是记录景色，它邀请我们放慢脚步。A great ____ ____ does more than record scenery; it invites us to slow down.
classPractice.note: landscape作定语修饰painting,构成'风景画'这一画种,与portrait(肖像画)相对。

original_sentence: As I wandered in the National Gallery, I was amazed to see all the paintings.
readingExamples: As I wandered in the National Gallery, I was amazed to see all the paintings.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to walk around slowly in a relaxed way or without any clear purpose or direction
(2) v. to move away from the place where you should be, or from a group, without intending to
(3) v. (of the mind or thoughts) to stop being directed on something and to move without control to other ideas
(4) v. (of a road or river) to follow a route that is not straight

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (思绪/注意力)走神，开小差；离题(one's mind / attention wanders)
uncommonMeanings.example: Halfway through the lecture his mind began to wander, drifting back to the quiet lake where everything had still seemed possible. （读后续写·心理描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (道路、河流)蜿蜒，曲折而行
uncommonMeanings.example: The little path wandered lazily between the vegetable plots, in no hurry at all to reach the village at the bottom of the hill. （读后续写·田园景致）

posExamples.sentence: Unable to sleep, I slipped out of the tent and wandered along the moonlit shore, letting the cool sand slide between my toes as the waves whispered secrets I could almost understand. （读后续写·夜游海边）
On our arrival, we were free to wander through the old town's winding lanes, where every crumbling wall and sun-bleached door seemed to murmur a story from centuries past. （应用文·游记/研学报告）
For three unforgettable weeks the young graduate wandered the country's dusty back roads, discovering that the kindness of strangers was the truest map he could ever hope to carry. （读后续写·成长旅程）
When students are allowed to let their curiosity wander freely, learning ceases to be a chore and becomes, instead, a joyful voyage of discovery. （议论文·教育理念）

wordForms.noun: wanderer (漫游者,流浪者) / wandering (漫游,游荡)
wordForms.other: ★形近辨析·必考:wander /ˈwɒndə(r)/(v.漫游,走神) ≠ wonder /ˈwʌndə(r)/(v.想知道;惊叹;n.奇迹)。记忆:wandER 有个 a=arm 手臂,人靠腿脚'走'来漫游;wondER 是脑子里'想'。例:I wonder where the path wanders next.(我想知道这条小路接下来通向何处。) 拼写只差一个字母,读音也不同。

idioms.example: However hard she tried to focus on the equations, her attention kept wandering to the empty chair where her best friend used to sit. （读后续写·思念）
He let his eyes wander over the crowded platform, searching face after face, until at last they came to rest on the one he had waited five years to see. （读后续写·重逢）

collocations.translation: 【课件】闲逛，漫步，漫无目的地四处走
collocations.example: She wandered aimlessly around the streets. 她在大街上漫无目的地闲逛。
The child wandered off and got lost. 那个孩子走失了，迷了路。

collocations.translation: 【课件】走神，神志恍惚，（思想）开小差
collocations.example: Try not to let your mind / attention wander during class. 上课时尽量别走神。
His thoughts wandered back to his youth. 他的思绪飘回到自己的青年时代。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（道路等）蜿蜒曲折地穿过／延伸
collocations.example: The road wanders along through the hills. 这条路蜿蜒曲折地穿过山丘。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（眼睛）慢慢地移向，目光游移到
collocations.example: His eyes wandered towards the photographs on the wall. 他的目光慢慢地移向墙上的照片。
With the whole afternoon to spare, we wandered around the flower market, our arms slowly filling with blossoms and our hearts with an easy joy. （读后续写·闲暇时光）
In the chaos of the fair the little boy wandered off, and for ten heart-stopping minutes his mother searched the crowd, calling his name. （读后续写·走失）

collocations.translation: 走神；思绪飘忽，浮想联翩
collocations.example: As the old song played, his mind wandered back across the decades to a summer evening he had never truly left behind. （读后续写·回忆）
Homeless and hungry, he wandered the streets night after night, yet never once let go of the sketchbook that held his only dream. （读后续写·逆境）
After the interview she wandered aimlessly through the park, replaying every awkward pause. （读后续写·焦虑）
In this open-plan library, readers may wander freely from shelf to shelf, stumbling upon books they never knew they wanted. （应用文·场馆介绍）
The shepherd warned the boy never to let the flock wander far from the safety of the valley. （读后续写·叙事）
Quite by accident she wandered into a tiny bookshop, and that single wrong turn would change the whole course of her summer. （读后续写·邂逅）

synonyms.example: As a child he loved to roam the hills behind his home, returning at dusk with muddy shoes and a heart full of small adventures. （读后续写·童年）
synonyms.usage: 范围更大、更自由,常指在广阔天地里无拘无束地游走,比 wander 更有'纵横驰骋'之感

synonyms.example: After dinner the couple strolled along the river, saying little, for after forty years some silences said more than words. （读后续写·温情）
synonyms.usage: 特指从容悠闲的短距离散步,节奏舒缓愉快;wander 更强调'无目的、随处走'甚至'迷失'

synonyms.example: For years he drifted from city to city, never staying long enough to call any place home. （读后续写·漂泊）
synonyms.usage: 含被动、随波逐流、缺乏方向之意,情感色彩比 wander 更消极,也可指思绪/目光的游移

synonyms.example: The river meandered through the meadow in wide, unhurried loops, as if it too wished the afternoon would never end. （读后续写·田园）
synonyms.usage: 尤指河流、道路蜿蜒曲折,也可指人漫无目的地闲逛或谈话离题,比 wander 更书面、更有画面感

advancedExpressions.expression: wander around / about(四处闲逛)｜wander off(走失、偏离)｜one's mind wanders(走神)｜let one's eyes wander(目光游移)
advancedExpressions.example: As the teacher droned on, his eyes wandered to the window and his mind wandered off to the football pitch. （wander 既指身体'漫步',也指注意力'游离',一词两境）

advancedExpressions.expression: wander(v.漫游/走神)｜wonder(v.想知道;n.奇迹)——拼写仅差 a/o，含义读音全不同
advancedExpressions.example: I wonder where these winding lanes wander to. （wonder 后接宾语从句表'想知道';wander 表'蜿蜒/漫游'。切勿写混）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s mind wandered back to ..., where / when ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the room fell silent, her mind wandered back to that rainy afternoon, when a single kind word from a stranger had quietly pulled her back from the edge of despair. （as时间状语 + mind wandered back心理闪回 + when定语从句嵌入关键回忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: participants are welcome to wander at their own pace, ...
advancedExpressions.example: During the open day, visitors are welcome to wander through the exhibition at their own pace, pausing wherever a painting speaks to their heart. （be welcome to do 邀约句 + at one's own pace + wherever状语，凸显轻松自由）

advancedExpressions.expression: a mind allowed to wander is ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: A mind allowed to wander is not a mind wasted but a mind at play, for many of humanity's greatest ideas were born not at the desk but on an aimless afternoon walk. （not...but 对比纠偏 + for引出论据，为'放空'正名）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I walked around the old town and felt happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With no map and no plan, I let myself wander through the labyrinth of the old town, and with every crooked lane and unexpected courtyard, a warm, boyish delight bubbled up inside me — the pure joy of being wonderfully, deliberately lost. （读后续写·旅途心境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with独立结构开篇(no map...) + wander through the labyrinth比喻 + with every...渐进 + 破折号点睛(deliberately lost悖论式收束)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Sometimes it is good to let your mind wander.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being idle, a mind permitted to wander often stumbles upon the very insights that hours of forced concentration fail to yield — which is why the greatest thinkers have always guarded their moments of daydreaming as fiercely as their hours of study. （议论文·思维与创造）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being...让步开篇纠偏 + stumble upon生动动词 + which引导非限定从句延伸论点 + as...as比较结构收束

classPractice.question: 【课件】Some youths are quite addicted to ____ (wander) in the cyber space.
classPractice.note: be addicted to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，故用 wandering；此处指'沉迷于在网络空间里游荡'。

classPractice.question: 【课件】My thoughts wander ____ to the whole thing as if it happened yesterday.
classPractice.note: one's thoughts wander back to sth 表'思绪飘回、回想起'；back 为副词，与 wander 搭配指'往回'。

classPractice.question: Sitting by the window, I began to ____ (wander / wonder) whether my thoughts would ever stop wandering back to that summer.
classPractice.note: 第一空'想知道'用wonder(后接whether从句);句尾'思绪飘回'才用wander。形近易混,靠意义区分。

classPractice.question: However fascinating the topic was, after ten minutes his mind kept ____ (wander) to the game that evening.
classPractice.note: keep doing sth持续做某事,故用现在分词;one's mind wanders意为'走神'。

classPractice.question: 在集市的混乱中，那个小男孩走失了。In the chaos of the fair, the little boy ____ ____ .
classPractice.note: wander off表'走失、走开';叙述过去用一般过去时wandered。

translation: 展览馆，画廊，美术馆，走廊，楼上观众席
original_sentence: As I wandered in the National Gallery, I was amazed to see all the paintings.
readingExamples: As I wandered in the National Gallery, I was amazed to see all the paintings.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a room or building used for showing works of art, sometimes so that they can be sold
(2) n. an area high above the ground at the back or sides of a large room, hall or theatre, where people can sit or stand
(3) n. a long narrow room or passage, especially one used for a particular purpose
(4) n. an underground passage in a mine

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (剧院、议会等的)楼座，顶层楼座；(泛指)观众，旁听者
uncommonMeanings.example: As the young pianist struck the final chord, the whole gallery rose as one, and a thunder of applause rolled down from the highest seats to the very edge of the stage. （读后续写·演出高潮）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (高尔夫、网球等比赛的)观众，看台观众
uncommonMeanings.example: A hush fell over the gallery as the golfer bent over his final putt, knowing a single tap would decide the championship. （读后续写·体育赛事）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (手机/网站上的)图片库，相册
uncommonMeanings.example: Scrolling through the photo gallery on his old phone, he lingered over each faded image. （读后续写·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: The instant I stepped into the sunlit gallery, I stopped breathing — canvas after canvas blazed with colour, and I felt as though I had walked straight into the beating heart of another century. （读后续写·参观画廊）
I am writing to warmly invite you to our school's art gallery, where forty student paintings will be on display next Friday to celebrate the beauty of everyday life. （应用文·邀请信）

A public gallery is far more than a storehouse of beautiful objects; it is a quiet classroom in which strangers of every age learn, without a single word, to look at the world more deeply. （议论文·艺术与社会）
From the shadowy gallery above the hall, the boy watched the debate unfold, his small fists clenched, silently rehearsing the day he too would stand at that podium. （读后续写·励志）

idioms.translation: 哗众取宠，迎合大众口味
idioms.example: A leader of true conviction speaks his conscience even to a hostile crowd, rather than playing to the gallery for a moment's cheap applause. （议论文·品格）

collocations.example: That rainy afternoon in the art gallery changed everything for her; before a single small painting, she finally understood what she was born to do. （读后续写·顿悟）
No trip to the capital would be complete without a morning in the National Gallery, whose halls hold treasures that belong to all humankind. （应用文·旅行推荐）

collocations.translation: 画廊；(手机/网站上的)图片库
collocations.example: Scrolling through the photo gallery on his old phone, he lingered over each faded image, reluctant to let a memory slip away. （读后续写·怀旧）
The exhibition at the gallery drew record crowds, proving that even in an age of screens, people still hunger for beauty they can stand before. （议论文·艺术）

collocations.translation: 肖像陈列室；一系列人物
collocations.example: The novel gives us a whole gallery of unforgettable characters, each so vivid that the reader half expects to meet them on the street. （议论文·文学评论）
As we strolled through the gallery in comfortable silence, the paintings seemed to say all the things we had never learned how to say. （读后续写·情谊）
Her prize-winning photograph is now on display in the city gallery, a small triumph that took ten years of stubborn hope to achieve. （读后续写·励志）

collocations.translation: 射击场；(警方的)罪犯照片档案
collocations.example: The detective spread the rogues' gallery across the desk, studying each hardened face until one pair of eyes made his heart skip a beat. （读后续写·悬疑）

synonyms.example: The natural history museum was so vast that even after four hours we had barely scratched the surface. （读后续写·参观）
synonyms.usage: 泛指收藏、陈列历史、科学、艺术等各类藏品的机构,范围比 gallery 广;gallery 通常专指展示美术作品的场所

synonyms.example: The photography exhibition ran for only a week, yet its haunting images stayed with visitors long after the doors closed. （议论文·艺术影响）
synonyms.usage: 指(临时的)展览活动本身,是'事件';gallery 是举办展览的'场所/建筑',二者常搭配 an exhibition at a gallery

synonyms.example: In the cramped attic studio, paint-splattered and cold, the young artist created works the grandest galleries would one day fight to own. （读后续写·艺术家）
synonyms.usage: 指艺术家创作作品的工作室/画室,是'生产地';gallery 是作品完成后公开'展示'的地方

advancedExpressions.expression: an art gallery(美术馆)｜the National Gallery(国家美术馆)｜on display in the gallery(在馆内展出)｜play to the gallery(哗众取宠)
advancedExpressions.example: Some artists paint honestly for the ages; others merely play to the gallery for instant applause. （gallery 从'画廊'到'看台观众'的一词多义，构成 play to the gallery 这一习语）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·展示场所辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: gallery(展美术品的场所) / museum(综合博物馆) / exhibition(展览活动) / studio(创作画室)——场所与活动、创作与展示之别
advancedExpressions.example: From his tiny studio the paintings travelled to a grand gallery, and finally to a nationwide exhibition. （四词各司其职:创作→收藏展示→临时活动，写作按语境择用）

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment sb. stepped into the gallery, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment she stepped into the gallery, the noise of the world fell away, and for the first time in months she felt a small, stubborn flicker of hope. （the moment引导时间状语 + fell away动态 + 破折号补出情感转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: we sincerely invite you to visit our gallery, where ...
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of the Art Club, we sincerely invite you to visit our gallery next weekend, where the fruits of a whole term's hard work will be waiting to inspire you. （On behalf of正式开头 + where非限定从句延伸活动亮点）

advancedExpressions.expression: a gallery is not merely ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: A gallery is not merely a place to hang paintings, but a shared space where a hurried society is gently reminded to stop, to look, and to feel again. （not merely...but 递进定义 + 三动词排比 stop, look, feel 强化感染力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I went to the gallery and saw many beautiful paintings.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As I wandered deeper into the hushed gallery, painting after painting reached out and seized me — a storm at sea here, a mother's tender smile there — until I lost all track of time, held captive by beauty I had no words to describe. （读后续写·参观体验）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as引导进程 + painting after painting拟人(reached out and seized) + here...there空间铺陈 + until结果状语 + 后置分词短语(held captive)升华感受

sentenceUpgrade.original: Galleries are useful for society.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age that prizes speed above all else, a gallery performs a quiet but priceless service: it teaches a restless generation the almost forgotten art of standing still and truly seeing. （议论文·艺术价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In an age that...时代背景状语 + 冒号引出核心论断 + quiet but priceless矛盾修辞 + the art of doing抽象升华

classPractice.question: 用 gallery / museum / exhibition 填空:①We spent the morning in the art ____ admiring the oil paintings. ②The dinosaur bones are kept in the natural history ____. ③Her photographs will be shown at a one-week ____ next month.
classPractice.note: gallery专展美术作品、museum综合藏品、exhibition指展览活动本身,三者按语境区分。

classPractice.question: 当我在国家美术馆里漫步时，眼前所有的画都让我惊叹不已。As I ____ in the ____ ____ , I was amazed to see all the paintings.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句;National Gallery专有名词首字母大写,wander过去式wandered。

classPractice.question: 真正的领袖凭良心说话，而不是为了片刻的掌声哗众取宠。
classPractice.answer: A true leader speaks his conscience rather than playing / plays to the gallery for a moment's applause.
classPractice.note: play to the gallery习语'哗众取宠';rather than后可接doing或与前谓语平行。

original_sentence: In the last three decades of his life he painted mostly scenes from his garden.
readingExamples: In the last three decades of his life he painted mostly scenes from his garden.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a period of ten years, especially a continuous period such as the years from 2010 to 2019
(2) n. a set or group of ten, especially ten years of a person's age or of a century

posExamples.sentence: For nearly a decade the old lighthouse keeper had lit the lamp alone, and now, as his trembling hands passed the matches to his grandson, he knew the flame — and something far greater — would live on. （读后续写·传承）
I am writing to invite our alumni back to campus, for it has been a full decade since our graduation, and the old classrooms are longing to hear our laughter once more. （应用文·邀请信）
Over the past decade, China's high-speed rail network has expanded at a breathtaking pace, transforming distances once measured in days into journeys of a few short hours. （议论文·社会发展）

It took her the better part of a decade — a decade of rejection letters, sleepless nights and quiet tears — but the day her first novel reached the shelves, every hardship suddenly felt worthwhile. （读后续写·励志）

collocations.translation: 在过去十年间(谓语常用现在完成时)
collocations.example: Over the past decade, our once-sleepy town has blossomed into a thriving hub of culture and commerce. （议论文·家乡变化）

collocations.translation: 过去三十年(呼应课文原句)
collocations.example: In the last three decades of his life he painted mostly scenes from his garden. （教材原句·莫奈晚年）

collocations.translation: 几十年来，随着岁月流逝
collocations.example: Over the decades the little seedling had grown into a mighty oak, sheltering three generations of the same family. （读后续写·时光）
For decades the two families had not exchanged a single word, and yet one small act of kindness melted a feud no one could remember starting. （读后续写·和解）
In the coming decade, the choices our generation makes about the planet will echo far beyond our own lifetimes. （议论文·环保）
Behind his calm, unhurried voice lay decades of experience, and every young doctor in the ward hung on his every word. （读后续写·人物）

collocations.translation: 过去几十年(谓语常用现在完成时)
collocations.example: The past few decades have witnessed astonishing progress in medicine, yet the simplest cure — human compassion — remains as precious as ever. （议论文·医学与人文）
A decade later, standing on the same windswept hilltop, she finally understood the words her grandfather had spoken to her as a child. （读后续写·时光）
The exhibition, spanning several decades of the artist's life, traced his slow journey from raw talent to true mastery. （应用文·展览介绍）

collocations.phrase: for the best part of a decade
collocations.translation: 近十年，十年的大部分时间
collocations.example: For the best part of a decade he had chased a dream everyone told him was impossible. （读后续写·坚持）

synonyms.example: The invention of the smartphone ushered in a new era, one in which the whole world could fit inside a single pocket. （议论文·科技）
synonyms.usage: 指以某重大特征界定的'时代/纪元',长度不定、意义重大,比 decade 更宏观、更有历史感

synonyms.example: For a generation, this quiet teacher shaped the minds of a whole village, and his lessons still ripple through lives he never lived to see. （读后续写·师德）
synonyms.usage: 既指'一代人',也指约二三十年的时间跨度,强调'人'的更替与传承,而 decade 是纯粹的十年时间单位

synonyms.example: That period of quiet struggle, though painful, turned out to be the soil in which her deepest strength took root. （读后续写·成长）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任意长度的一段时间,最笼统、最中性;decade 则精确指'十年'

advancedExpressions.expression: over the past decade(过去十年)｜the last three decades(过去三十年)｜over the decades(几十年来)｜in the decades to come(未来数十年)｜a decade later(十年后)
advancedExpressions.example: Over the past decade our city has been transformed, and in the decades to come the pace of change will only quicken. （decade 与现在完成时、将来时搭配，是描述发展变迁的黄金时间状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: over the past/last decade + 现在完成时(has/have done);数字 + decades 中 decade 用复数
advancedExpressions.example: Over the past two decades, China has witnessed astonishing change. （'over the past + 时间段'与现在完成时天然搭配;three decades 中 decade 加 -s）

advancedExpressions.expression: for the better part of a decade, sb. had ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the better part of a decade, he had carried her letter in his coat pocket, its edges soft with wear, its words known by heart long before he finally found the courage to reply. （for the better part of a decade时间铺垫 + past perfect叙旧 + 细节描写烘托深情）

advancedExpressions.expression: over the past decade, we have witnessed ...
advancedExpressions.example: Over the past decade, our club has witnessed remarkable growth, transforming a handful of enthusiasts into a family of over three hundred devoted members. （over the past decade时间状语 + witness拟人 + transforming分词短语展现成果）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the decades to come, ... will prove to be ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the decades to come, the ability to learn continuously will prove to be far more valuable than any single degree or diploma. （in the decades to come前瞻 + prove to be判断句 + far more...than比较，强化远见）

sentenceUpgrade.original: After ten years, they met again and were very happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A decade slipped by like a single turning page, and when at last the two old friends met beneath the same gingko tree, no words were needed — one look, one trembling embrace, and all the lost years came rushing warmly home. （读后续写·重逢）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(slipped by like a turning page) + when引导重逢时刻 + no words were needed留白 + 三短语渐进(one look, one embrace) + came rushing home拟人收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our city has developed a lot in ten years.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Within the span of a single decade, our once-drowsy city has been utterly transformed — glass towers now pierce a skyline that used to end at the church steeple, and opportunity beckons on streets where silence once reigned. （议论文·城市发展）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Within the span of...时间状语 + once-drowsy形容词前置 + 破折号引出具体对比 + pierce/beckon/reign拟人化动词 + 今昔对照结构

classPractice.question: Over the past three ____ (decade), our village has changed almost beyond recognition.
classPractice.note: three之后名词用复数decades;'over the past...'与现在完成时has changed搭配。

classPractice.question: 在生命的最后三十年里，他画的大多是自家花园里的景色。In the ____ ____ ____ of his life he painted mostly scenes from his garden.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句;decade表'十年',three decades即三十年,注意复数。

classPractice.question: 在未来十年，我们这一代人所做的选择将影响深远。
classPractice.answer: In the coming / next decade, the choices our generation makes will have a far-reaching impact.
classPractice.note: in the coming/next decade指未来十年,单数decade;主句可用一般将来时。

original_sentence: In the last three decades of his life he painted mostly scenes from his garden.
readingExamples: In the last three decades of his life he painted mostly scenes from his garden.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. in most cases; mainly or chiefly; as regards the greater part
(2) adv. generally; usually; on most occasions
(3) adv. for the most part; almost completely

posExamples.sentence: The village was quiet now, its young people mostly gone to distant cities, leaving behind grey-haired grandparents who waited, day after day, for a phone call that came too seldom. （读后续写·留守）
Our volunteer team is made up mostly of first-year students, yet their boundless energy and warm smiles have already brought new life to the lonely nursing home. （应用文·活动报告）
Success, contrary to popular belief, is built mostly not on rare bursts of genius but on the dull, daily discipline of showing up when no one is watching. （议论文·成功与坚持）
That summer we lived simply and happily: our days were spent mostly out of doors, chasing dragonflies by the stream and racing the sun home at dusk. （读后续写·夏日回忆）

wordForms.adverb: mostly (主要地,通常) / most (最;非常)
wordForms.other: 构词法·most + -ly:mostly ≠ most。★区别:most 是最高级(the most beautiful最……)或'大多数'(most students);mostly 是频度/程度副词,只表'主要地、大部分情况下'。别写混:most people(大多数人,most作限定词) 与 people are mostly friendly(人们大多友好,mostly作副词)。determiner: most;pronoun: most。

collocations.phrase: consist / be made up mostly of
collocations.example: The audience consisted mostly of parents, whose proud, anxious faces made every young performer stand a little taller. （读后续写·演出）
He failed the final round, mostly because nerves got the better of him at the very moment his talent should have shone. （读后续写·失利）
At that early hour the streets were mostly empty, and the town seemed to belong entirely to the runner and the rising sun. （读后续写·晨跑）

collocations.phrase: spend one's time mostly doing sth
collocations.translation: 大部分时间用来做某事
collocations.example: During the holidays she spent her time mostly reading in the attic, discovering the wide world she had not yet been able to visit. （读后续写·成长）
The feedback we received was mostly positive, though a few thoughtful suggestions helped us improve the event. （应用文·总结报告）
Whether the plan succeeds depends mostly on how willing we are to set aside our small differences. （议论文·合作）

collocations.translation: 大部分多云/晴朗/干燥(天气)
collocations.example: The forecast promised a mostly sunny weekend, so the whole class agreed our long-awaited hiking trip would go ahead. （应用文·通知）

synonyms.example: The charity sale was organised mainly to raise funds for the flooded village. （应用文·活动介绍）
synonyms.usage: 强调'主要目的/主要原因',指最重要的部分;与 mostly 常可互换,但更侧重'首要性'而非'数量占比'

synonyms.example: On weekdays he usually walks to school, but when it rains he takes the bus. （应用文·日常）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'时间上的惯常、多数场合如此',强调频率;mostly 侧重'大部分、多数情况'的比例意味,两者义项在'通常'处相通

synonyms.example: Her recovery was largely due to the tireless care of the nurses, who treated her like their own daughter. （读后续写·感恩）
synonyms.usage: 偏书面、正式,多用于说明某结果'在很大程度上'由某原因造成,常见于议论文,比 mostly 更庄重

synonyms.example: The award was given chiefly in recognition of his decades of quiet, selfless service. （应用文·颁奖）
synonyms.usage: 非常正式、书面,强调'首要的、居首位的'因素,语气比 mostly 更庄重,日常口语中少用

synonyms.example: Generally, those who dare to fail early and often are the very ones who go on to achieve the most. （议论文·观点）
synonyms.usage: 指'一般情况下、总体而言',强调普遍规律或惯常状态;mostly 更强调'大部分、多数情况'的数量意味

advancedExpressions.expression: mostly ≈ mainly / chiefly(主要地) ≈ usually / generally(通常)——按'比例占多数'还是'惯常频率'择用
advancedExpressions.example: Our members are mostly / mainly volunteers, and they usually meet on Sundays. （mostly 侧重比例、usually 侧重频率，功能相近但语义微差）

advancedExpressions.expression: mostly 多置于实义动词前、be动词及助动词后:sb. mostly does ... / are mostly ...
advancedExpressions.example: We mostly relied on public transport, and the roads were mostly empty at dawn. （修饰动词放动词前;修饰形容词/be动词后置）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s days were spent mostly doing ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that faraway mountain school, his days were spent mostly teaching by candlelight, yet the light in the children's eyes burned brighter than any lamp he had ever known. （days were spent mostly doing白描生活 + yet转折 + 光的隐喻升华奉献）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... is / are mostly made up of ..., who ...
advancedExpressions.example: The rescue team is mostly made up of ordinary villagers, who, without a moment's hesitation, laid down their tools and rushed towards the danger. （be mostly made up of说明构成 + who非限定从句 + without hesitation凸显精神）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., mostly not because ..., but because ...
advancedExpressions.example: Great achievements come, mostly not because a person is more gifted than others, but because he refuses to quit long after others have walked away. （mostly not...but...对比纠偏 + refuse to quit + long after对照，凸显毅力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: In summer, we mostly played outside.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Those endless summers were spent mostly out of doors — barefoot on warm grass, knee-deep in the cool of the stream, our laughter chasing the dragonflies until the very last of the daylight melted into gold. （读后续写·童年夏日）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: were spent mostly白描 + 破折号引出细节排比(barefoot..., knee-deep...) + 拟人(laughter chasing) + until时间收束 + melted into gold通感

sentenceUpgrade.original: People succeed mostly because they work hard, not because they are clever.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History suggests that lasting success springs mostly not from a rare gift of intelligence but from the humble, unglamorous habit of trying once more after every fall. （议论文·成功本质）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: History suggests that...权威开篇 + spring from生动动词 + mostly not...but...对比结构 + humble, unglamorous贬词褒用 + after every fall收束点题

classPractice.question: ____ (Most / Mostly) of the volunteers are students, and they are ____ (most / mostly) here on weekends.
classPractice.note: Most of + 名词表'大多数'(限定词/代词);mostly是副词修饰系表'大部分时候在此'。词性不同,不可混用。

classPractice.question: In the last decades of his life he painted ____ (most) scenes from his own garden.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句;此处需副词修饰painted,意为'主要、大多',由most加-ly构成mostly。

classPractice.question: 我们的志愿队主要由高一学生组成，他们通常在周末活动。
classPractice.answer: Our volunteer team is made up mostly of first-year students, who usually work at weekends.
classPractice.note: be made up mostly of主要由……组成;mostly表比例、usually表频率,各得其所。

original_sentence: Reading 5 10 15 30 The art of painting of the same water lily pond, all in different colours and styles.
readingExamples: Reading 5 10 15 30 The art of painting of the same water lily pond, all in different colours and styles.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a small area of still water, especially one that is artificial or is smaller than a lake
(2) n. (informal, the pond) the Atlantic Ocean, considered as separating Britain and America
(3) n. a small pool of any liquid

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （口语，the pond）大西洋（尤指英美之间）
uncommonMeanings.example: "You've come all the way across the pond just to see me?" Grandma murmured, reaching out a wrinkled hand towards the grandson she had not embraced in twenty years. （读后续写·久别重逢·跨洋亲情）

posExamples.sentence: At dawn a thin mist still clung to the surface of the pond, and as the boy crept closer, a single heron rose from the reeds, its wings slicing the silver silence into a hundred trembling ripples. （读后续写·清晨自然·画面感）

I am writing to propose that our class adopt the neglected pond behind the library, clearing its litter and planting water lilies so that it may once again become a haven for frogs, dragonflies and weary students alike. （应用文·倡议书）

A stagnant pond breeds nothing but mosquitoes, whereas a flowing stream nourishes all it touches; in much the same way, a mind closed to new ideas can only decay, while one open to challenge grows ever richer. （议论文·开放心态·类比论证）

Every summer evening the children of our village would gather at the pond, skimming flat stones across its glassy face and counting the leaps until darkness swallowed the last ring of light. （读后续写·童年记忆·集体活动）

collocations.phrase: a fish pond / a duck pond
collocations.translation: 养鱼的池塘/鸭子戏水的池塘
collocations.example: Behind the old farmhouse lay a small fish pond, where at dusk the carp would rise to snatch at falling insects. （读后续写·田园）

collocations.phrase: a lily pond / a water lily pond
collocations.example: Monet spent his final decades painting the same lily pond over and over, chasing the fleeting way light danced upon its surface. （读后续写·艺术家专注）

collocations.phrase: a big fish in a small pond
collocations.translation: 小池塘里的大鱼(在小圈子里出众的人)
collocations.example: In his village school he had been a big fish in a small pond, but the moment he entered the city university, he realised how much he still had to learn. （读后续写·成长顿悟）

collocations.phrase: on the surface of the pond
collocations.example: Golden autumn leaves drifted lazily on the surface of the pond, each one a tiny boat carrying away another day of my fading childhood. （读后续写·季节·感伤）

collocations.phrase: the edge / bank of the pond
collocations.example: He sat quietly at the edge of the pond, letting the ripples of the evening breeze smooth away the day's worries. （读后续写·独处·平静）
Without a second thought, she waded into the freezing pond, determined to reach the struggling puppy before the current pulled it under. （读后续写·见义勇为）
The ancient willow was reflected in the pond so perfectly that, for a heartbeat, I could not tell which world was real. （读后续写·景物·哲思）

synonyms.example: A shallow pool of rainwater had gathered in the courtyard, mirroring the drifting clouds above. （读后续写·雨后）
synonyms.usage: 泛指一小片积水或人工水池,比 pond 更小、更临时;也指游泳池 swimming pool

synonyms.example: Beyond the hills lay a vast lake whose far shore melted into the morning haze. （读后续写·壮阔风景）
synonyms.usage: 比 pond 大得多的天然水域,用于描写开阔壮丽的景致

synonyms.example: The toddler stamped joyfully in every puddle, sending sprays of muddy water flying. （读后续写·童趣）
synonyms.usage: 路面上很小、很浅的积水坑,多为雨后临时形成,带随意、微小之意

advancedExpressions.expression: a fish / duck / lily pond(鱼塘/鸭塘/睡莲池)｜at the edge of the pond(池塘边)｜a big fish in a small pond(小圈子里的能人)｜across the pond(在大西洋彼岸)
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than stay a big fish in a small pond, she crossed the pond to test herself in the wider world. （pond 从具体'池塘'到习语'圈子'再到口语'大西洋'，一词多境）

advancedExpressions.expression: the still surface of the pond mirrored ...
advancedExpressions.example: The still surface of the pond mirrored not only the pale moon but also the turmoil raging within her heart, as if nature itself had paused to share her sorrow. （借景抒情+拟人，续写心理外化）

advancedExpressions.expression: by restoring the pond, we can ...
advancedExpressions.example: By restoring the long-neglected pond, we can not only beautify the campus but also create a living classroom where students observe biodiversity first-hand. （倡议书递进论证：不仅……还……）

advancedExpressions.expression: like a stagnant pond, ... breeds decay
advancedExpressions.example: Like a stagnant pond that breeds decay, a society that resists reform inevitably sinks into corruption and stagnation. （明喻类比，抽象说理具象化）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was a pond near my home.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Nestled at the foot of the hill behind my home lay a small pond, its glassy waters fringed with reeds that whispered secrets to every passing breeze. （读后续写·环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语提前倒装(Nestled...lay) + 独立主格(its waters fringed) + 拟人(whispered secrets)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should clean the dirty pond.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that we rolled up our sleeves and restored this litter-choked pond to its former glory, transforming an eyesore into a source of communal pride. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 虚拟过去式(rolled) + 现在分词状语(transforming) + 对比(eyesore→pride)

classPractice.question: 用 pond / lake / puddle 填空:①The children fed the ducks by the village ____. ②A tiny ____ of rain shone on the pavement. ③We sailed across the vast ____ for two whole hours.
classPractice.note: pond小池塘、puddle路面小水洼、lake大湖,按水域大小与场景区分。

classPractice.question: 与其在小圈子里当能人，她选择去闯荡更广阔的世界。Rather than remain a ____ ____ in a ____ ____ , she chose to explore the wider world.
classPractice.note: a big fish in a small pond习语,喻'小圈子里出众的人';rather than后与chose平行。

classPractice.question: 黎明时分，一层薄雾仍笼罩在池塘水面上。
classPractice.answer: At dawn, a thin mist still clung to / hung over the surface of the pond.
classPractice.note: on/over the surface of the pond池塘水面上;cling to或hang over描写薄雾更生动。

original_sentence: It is amazing that every time Monet studied this simple scene, he brought the pond’s beauty to the canvas in a unique way.
readingExamples: It is amazing that every time Monet studied this simple scene, he brought the pond’s beauty to the canvas in a unique way.
definitionEn:
(1) n. strong, heavy cloth used for making tents, sails, bags and as a surface for oil painting
(2) n. a piece of this cloth, especially one on which an oil painting is done, or the painting itself
(3) n. (the canvas) the background or setting within which events develop

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 帆布(制作帐篷、船帆、背包的粗布)
uncommonMeanings.example: The tent was made of thick canvas that snapped and groaned in the mountain wind, yet inside the climbers felt strangely safe. （读后续写·野外·环境）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）（供施展、创作的）背景，天地，舞台
uncommonMeanings.example: The blank sheet of paper before her was not a burden but a canvas — a boundless white field onto which she could pour every dream. （读后续写·创作激情·比喻）

posExamples.sentence: With a trembling hand the old painter lifted his brush to the canvas one last time, and as the first stroke bled across the white, decades of silence seemed to find their voice at last. （读后续写·艺术家·临终创作）
I am writing to invite you to our school's charity art exhibition, where more than fifty canvases painted by local students will be sold to raise funds for children in mountainous regions. （应用文·邀请信）
A great leader treats a nation not as a finished portrait but as a living canvas, forever open to bold new strokes of reform and daring visions of what might yet be. （议论文·领导力·比喻论证）
The tent was made of thick canvas that snapped and groaned in the mountain wind, yet inside, huddled around a flickering lamp, the climbers felt strangely safe. （读后续写·野外·环境）

wordForms.other: ★易混拼写·必考:canvas(n.画布,帆布,单s) ≠ canvass(v.游说,拉票;详细讨论,双s)。记忆:多一个 s 就多一张'嘴'去游说(canvaSS)。例:The volunteers canvassed the neighbourhood, sketch pads and canvas bags in hand.（志愿者们挨家挨户游说，手里拿着素描本和帆布包。）

collocations.translation: 布面油画(画作说明的固定标注)
collocations.example: The label beneath the masterpiece read simply 'oil on canvas, 1876', yet those few words could never contain the storm of colour above them. （读后续写·观展）

collocations.translation: 画在油画布上的(形容作品)
collocations.example: The gallery's finest work on canvas was a stormy seascape so vivid that visitors instinctively braced against an imagined gale. （读后续写·观展感受）

collocations.translation: 空白画布；(比喻)待开创的天地
collocations.example: The new term stretched before us like a blank canvas, and I resolved that this time I would fill it with courage rather than regret. （读后续写·新学期·励志）

collocations.translation: 把……画在画布上，绘成油画
collocations.example: What words failed to express, she poured onto canvas, letting bold reds and bruised purples tell the story of her grief. （读后续写·以画抒情）

collocations.translation: 在画布上呈现出……(呼应课文原句)
collocations.example: Every time Monet studied the pond, he brought its shifting beauty to the canvas in a way no photograph could ever capture. （读后续写·艺术·教材原句化用）
Before dawn he would stretch a fresh canvas over its wooden frame, savouring the quiet ritual that prepared both cloth and mind for creation. （读后续写·匠人·仪式感）
She slung a battered canvas bag over her shoulder, its every stain a souvenir of the countless roads she had walked. （读后续写·旅人·细节）
Only when we step back and view our small struggles against the wider canvas of a whole life do they shrink to their proper size. （议论文·格局·比喻）

synonyms.example: The painting had hung in the hallway for years, yet that morning its colours seemed to glow with a warmth I had never noticed. （读后续写·熟悉之物新感）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任何画作(不限油画);canvas 特指画在帆布上的油画,或帆布这一材质

synonyms.example: Above the fireplace hung a portrait of her late grandfather, his painted eyes seeming to follow every step she took. （读后续写·家族·凝视感）
synonyms.usage: 专指人物肖像;canvas 是媒介/载体,portrait 是题材内容,二者角度不同

synonyms.example: Against the golden backdrop of a setting sun, the two figures embraced, their long shadows merging into one. （读后续写·电影感画面）
synonyms.usage: 指衬托事件的背景环境,与 canvas 的比喻义(供施展的天地)相近,但更强调静态陪衬

advancedExpressions.expression: oil on canvas(布面油画)｜on canvas(画在布上的)｜a blank canvas(空白画布/待开创的天地)｜paint sth on canvas / bring sth to the canvas(在画布上呈现)
advancedExpressions.example: Labelled simply 'oil on canvas', the work proved that a blank canvas can become a whole world. （oil on canvas 为画作规范标注，是本词最典型的固定搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: canvas(n.画布/帆布,单 s)｜canvass(v.游说、拉票;详细讨论,双 s)——一字母之差，词性词义全异
advancedExpressions.example: Before the election they canvassed every street, while the artist quietly stretched a fresh canvas. （canvass 是动词'挨家游说';canvas 是名词'画布'，切勿写混）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth was a canvas onto which sb painted ...
advancedExpressions.example: The empty stage was a canvas onto which the young dancer painted, with every leap and turn, the tale of a bird longing to break free. （延伸暗喻，化抽象为具象）

advancedExpressions.expression: on canvas, students give voice to ...
advancedExpressions.example: On canvas, our students give voice to hopes that words alone cannot carry; we sincerely invite you to witness their creativity at the exhibition. （邀请信升华，强调艺术表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: viewed against the wider canvas of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Viewed against the wider canvas of human history, a single failure is but one faint stroke that the passage of time can easily paint over. （宏观视角+比喻，弱化挫折）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She painted her feelings on the canvas.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Wordless and shaking, she let her brush speak for her, and slowly her nameless sorrow bled across the canvas in strokes of deepening blue. （读后续写·以画抒情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 形容词短语前置(Wordless and shaking) + 拟人(brush speak) + 通感/色彩象征(strokes of deepening blue)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Life is like a blank canvas we fill.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Life, I have come to believe, is a blank canvas handed to each of us at birth; whether it becomes a masterpiece or a mere blur of wasted colour depends entirely on the courage with which we lift the brush. （议论文·人生态度）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语(I have come to believe) + 延伸比喻 + whether...or 对比 + depends on 收束点题

classPractice.question: 每一次莫奈研究这个简单的场景，他都以独特的方式把池塘之美呈现在画布上。Every time Monet studied this scene, he brought the pond's beauty ____ ____ ____ in a unique way.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句bring sth to the canvas'在画布上呈现';介词to搭配。

classPractice.question: The museum plaque read 'oil on ____ (canvas / canvass)', and outside, campaigners were busy ____ (canvasing / canvassing) for votes.
classPractice.note: canvas名词'画布'(单s);canvass动词'游说、拉票'(双s),现在分词canvassing。一字母之差,义项全异。

classPractice.question: 新学期像一张空白的画布展现在我们面前，我决心用勇气而非悔恨去填满它。
classPractice.answer: The new term stretched before us like a blank canvas, and I was determined to fill it with courage rather than regret.
classPractice.note: a blank canvas空白画布/待开创的天地(比喻);like引导明喻,rather than表'而非'。

translation: 邻里，街区，邻近的地方（美式拼写 neighborhood）
original_sentence: For me, the most interesting of his paintings is his 1876 masterpiece Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette, which shows life in a busy neighbourhood of Paris on a Sunday afternoon.
readingExamples: For me, the most interesting of his paintings is his 1876 masterpiece Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette, which shows life in a busy neighbourhood of Paris on a Sunday afternoon.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a district or area of a town, or the people who live there
(2) n. the area surrounding a particular place, person or thing
(3) n. (in the neighbourhood of) approximately; roughly a particular amount

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （in the neighbourhood of）大约，接近（某数量）
uncommonMeanings.example: The charity sale raised something in the neighbourhood of five thousand yuan — far beyond what any of us had dared to hope. （应用文·活动总结·约数）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the ambulance sped away, the whole neighbourhood seemed to hold its breath; doors opened one by one, and neighbours who had never spoken drifted together on the pavement, bound by a sudden, silent worry. （读后续写·社区·突发事件）

I am writing to invite every family in our neighbourhood to join the tree-planting campaign this Saturday, so that together we may turn our shared streets into a greener, healthier place for all. （应用文·倡议书）
A safe and caring neighbourhood is not built by walls or cameras alone, but by the countless small kindnesses that neighbours quietly exchange day after day. （议论文·社区凝聚·观点句）
Renoir's painting shows life in a busy neighbourhood of Paris on a Sunday afternoon, where laughter, music and the clink of glasses seem to spill right out of the canvas. （读后续写·观画·教材情境化用）

wordForms.other: 拼写·英式 neighbourhood / 美式 neighborhood（同样 colour-color, favour-favor 的 -our/-or 差异，高考写作英美式统一即可）; neighbour (n. 邻居); neighbouring (adj. 邻近的); neighbourly (adj. 友好的，睦邻的); 构词法·neighbour + -hood（表示"身份/状态/群体"的名词后缀，同 childhood 童年, brotherhood 手足情, motherhood 母亲身份）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在同一个街区（长大）（= district）
collocations.example: We grew up in the same neighbourhood. 我们在同一个街区长大。

collocations.translation: 【课件】贫困的街区；安静的城区；居民区
collocations.example: They moved from a poor neighbourhood to a quiet, residential neighbourhood on the edge of town. 他们从贫困街区搬到了城郊安静的居民区。
Houses in the neighbourhood of Paris are extremely expensive. 巴黎附近一带的住房极其昂贵。

collocations.translation: 在这一带，在附近（课堂重点搭配）
collocations.example: Is there a good bookshop in the neighbourhood? 这一带有好的书店吗？

collocations.translation: 大约，接近（某数量）——熟词僻义
collocations.example: The repair will cost in the neighbourhood of 3,000 yuan. 这次维修大约要花3000元。

collocations.translation: 繁华的／安静的街区（课文原句同款用法）
collocations.example: The painting shows life in a busy neighbourhood of Paris. 这幅画描绘了巴黎一个繁华街区的生活。
The good news spread through the whole neighbourhood. 好消息传遍了整个街区。
The residents set up a neighbourhood watch after the break-ins. 入室盗窃案后居民成立了邻里联防。

collocations.translation: 安静的／治安差的／友好的街区
collocations.example: Having grown up in a rough neighbourhood, he understood how a single act of trust could change a boy's whole future. （读后续写·成长背景）
The volunteers transformed a run-down neighbourhood library into a bright, welcoming haven where children could lose themselves in books. （应用文·志愿服务）
The weekend market livened up the once-sleepy neighbourhood, filling the narrow lanes with colour, aroma and cheerful bargaining. （读后续写·市集·氛围）

synonyms.example: In times of hardship, it was the community that held us together, each family lending strength to the next. （议论文·团结）
synonyms.usage: 强调人与人的归属和联系（可抽象）；neighbourhood 更强调地理上的街区、地段

synonyms.example: The historic district was famous for its cobbled streets and centuries-old teahouses. （读后续写·古城）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，多指有明确划分的行政或功能区域，缺少 neighbourhood 的邻里人情味

synonyms.example: No hospital could be found in the vicinity, so the villagers carried the injured man for miles over the mountain. （读后续写·紧急·偏远）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面语，指某处周边一带，不含居民群体之意；in the vicinity of 也可表约数

advancedExpressions.expression: neighbour + -hood → neighbourhood（街区/邻里）
advancedExpressions.example: -hood 表"身份、状态或群体"：childhood（童年）、brotherhood（手足情）、motherhood（为人母）、likelihood（可能性）。记 neighbourhood = 邻居们所在的"那片地方/那群人"。

advancedExpressions.expression: in the neighbourhood（在附近）/ in the neighbourhood of + 数字（大约）
advancedExpressions.example: 同一短语两义要分清：Is there a park in the neighbourhood?（附近）vs It costs in the neighbourhood of 100 yuan.（约数，= about / around）。

advancedExpressions.expression: the whole neighbourhood came alive with ...
advancedExpressions.example: The whole neighbourhood came alive with the news, doors flung open and voices calling from window to window, as if a single joy had somehow become everyone's. （群像+夸张，渲染集体情绪）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us join hands to make our neighbourhood ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us join hands to make our neighbourhood not merely a place where we live, but a home where every resident truly belongs. （倡议句式 Let us + not merely...but 递进）

advancedExpressions.expression: a thriving neighbourhood rests on ..., not on ...
advancedExpressions.example: A thriving neighbourhood rests on mutual trust and small daily kindnesses, not on the height of its fences or the number of its cameras. （对比结构，突出人情胜于设施）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our neighbourhood is very friendly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In our neighbourhood, hardly a day passes without a bowl of hot soup left quietly on a lonely doorstep or a kind word offered across a garden fence. （读后续写·细节化温情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: hardly...without 双重否定表频繁 + 具体细节替代抽象形容(soup on doorstep) + 平行结构

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should make our neighbourhood better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my sincere hope that, through our collective efforts, we can transform our neighbourhood into a warmer, greener and more united community for generations to come. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my sincere hope that 正式主句 + 状语前置(through our efforts) + 三形容词递进(warmer, greener, more united)

classPractice.question: The painting by Renoir shows life in a busy ____ (neighbour) of Paris on a Sunday afternoon.
classPractice.note: 考 -hood 名词后缀；neighbour + hood = 街区，教材原句同款。

classPractice.question: 用 in the neighbourhood 或 in the neighbourhood of 填空：The whole repair will cost ____ 2,000 yuan.
classPractice.note: 接数字表"大约"（= about），熟词僻义；若表"在附近"则不接 of。

classPractice.question: 自从那些盗窃案后，居民们成立了邻里治安联防组织。（neighbourhood watch）
classPractice.answer: Since / After those break-ins (thefts), the residents (have) set up a neighbourhood watch.
classPractice.note: 考固定短语 neighbourhood watch 及英式拼写 -our-。

translation: vt. & vi. (struck, struck) 突然想到，撞，敲，罢工，划（火柴） | n. 罢工，袭击，打击
definitionEn:
(1) v. to hit someone or something forcefully; (of a disaster, illness, etc.) to happen suddenly and cause harm
(2) v. (of a thought or idea) to come suddenly into someone's mind; to give someone a particular impression
(3) v. to stop working as a protest; to produce a sound by hitting (a clock); to light (a match) by rubbing it
(4) n. an occasion when workers refuse to work as a protest; a sudden military attack; the act of hitting something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】撞；碰；击打（hit with force）——strike a rock / strike sb in the face / strike at sb with a stick
uncommonMeanings.example: The ship struck a rock. 船撞上了一块礁石。 / He struck at me repeatedly with a stick. 他拿着棍子一再朝我打过来。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】罢工；袭击；击打——(out) on strike 罢工，go on strike 举行罢工，strike against 为反对……而罢工
uncommonMeanings.example: Half the workforce are now (out) on strike. 半数员工现正罢工。 / His spectacular strike in the second half made the score 2–0. 他下半场精彩的一击使比分变成 2 比 0。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （想法）突然出现在（某人）脑海；使（某人）觉得（strike sb as）
uncommonMeanings.example: It suddenly struck her that the stranger's gentle eyes were exactly like her father's, and the memory she had buried for years came flooding back in an instant. （读后续写·顿悟·情感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 给（某人）留下……印象
uncommonMeanings.example: The village struck me as oddly familiar, though I was certain I had never once set foot there before. （读后续写·似曾相识·悬念）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 划（火柴）；敲（钟）报时
uncommonMeanings.example: As the old clock struck midnight, she struck a single match, and its trembling flame threw dancing shadows across the abandoned hall. （读后续写·午夜·气氛渲染）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 罢工；（军事）袭击，空袭；（棒球）好球
uncommonMeanings.example: The transport strike left thousands of commuters stranded. 交通罢工使成千上万通勤者滞留。

posExamples.sentence: A brilliant idea suddenly struck him: if he could not climb the wall alone, perhaps the whole team, standing on one another's shoulders, could finally reach the top. （读后续写·灵光一现·转折）
When the earthquake struck without warning, the ground heaved beneath their feet, and in that terrifying instant every petty quarrel of the day was utterly forgotten. （读后续写·灾难·突发）
I am writing to inform all staff that, following the announced transport strike, tomorrow's morning meeting will be postponed until further notice. （应用文·通知）
What strikes me most about truly great people is not their talent, but the quiet persistence with which they rise, again and again, after every fall. （议论文·品质·观点句）

wordForms.noun: strike (罢工/袭击); striker (n. 罢工者；前锋)
wordForms.other: 不规则动词 strike-struck-struck（现在-过去-过去分词，切勿写成 striked）; 派生 striking 意为"惹眼的、显著的"（a striking resemblance 惊人的相似），与"打击"的字面义已引申

idioms.example: Every student must learn to strike a balance between diligent study and the rest their tired minds so badly need. （议论文·学习与休息）
The old teacher's words about never giving up struck a deep chord with the boy, and he silently vowed to prove her right. （读后续写·激励·共鸣）

idioms.idiom: strike while the iron is hot
idioms.example: Sensing the crowd's rising enthusiasm, the young speaker decided to strike while the iron was hot and call for volunteers on the spot. （应用文·演讲·号召）
Visitors to the memorial are invariably struck by the profound silence that seems to speak louder than any words. （读后续写·纪念馆·肃穆）

collocations.phrase: strike a rock / strike sb in the face
collocations.translation: 【课件】撞上岩石／打在某人脸上（strike v. 撞；击打 hit with force）
collocations.example: The ship struck a rock. 船撞上了一块礁石。 / She struck him in the face. 她打在他脸上。

collocations.phrase: an awful thought struck me / it suddenly struck me that ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】我突然想到一个可怕的念头／某人突然想到……（= It occurred to me that ...）
collocations.example: An awful thought has just struck me. 刚才我脑子里突然闪过一个可怕的念头。 / It suddenly struck me that we ought to make a new plan. 我突然想到我们该制订一个新计划。

collocations.phrase: the workers were striking / be on strike / go on strike
collocations.translation: 【课件】工人们在罢工／在罢工中／举行罢工
collocations.example: The workers were striking because they wanted more money. 工人们因为想要更多的钱而罢工。 / Half the workforce are now (out) on strike. 半数员工现正罢工。 / The bus drivers went on strike for higher pay. 公交司机为提高薪水举行了罢工。
The matches were damp and he couldn't make them strike. 火柴受潮了，他划不着。
The clock has just struck three. 时钟刚刚敲过三点。
The speaker had obviously struck a chord with his audience. 讲演者显然已引起了听众的共鸣。

collocations.phrase: strike a balance (between A and B)
collocations.translation: 【课件】在（A 与 B 之间）取得平衡
collocations.example: We must strike a balance between work and rest. 我们必须在工作与休息之间取得平衡。

collocations.phrase: strike sb down / be struck down by (a disease)
collocations.translation: 【课件】（疾病等）摧垮某人，使某人病倒
collocations.example: He was struck down by cancer at the age of thirty. 他三十岁那年被癌症夺去了性命。

collocations.translation: 【课件】惊呆了，一时什么也说不出
collocations.example: Its beauty seemed to strike the child dumb. 它的美丽似乎让孩子目瞪口呆。

collocations.phrase: the area was struck by (a disaster)
collocations.example: The area was struck by an outbreak of smallpox. 这个地区遭受了一次天花的侵袭。

collocations.translation: 给某人以……的印象（高频！struck me as）
collocations.example: The plan struck me as both bold and practical. 这个方案给我的印象是既大胆又可行。

collocations.translation: 某人突然想到……（it 作形式主语）
collocations.example: It suddenly struck her that she had left the keys at home. 她突然想到把钥匙落在家里了。
Visitors are always struck by the museum's silence. 参观者总是被博物馆的静谧所打动。

collocations.phrase: a disaster / an earthquake / a storm strikes
collocations.translation: 灾难／地震／风暴突然来袭（不及物）
collocations.example: The earthquake struck without warning. 地震毫无预兆地袭来。
The two sides finally struck a deal after long talks. 双方经过长谈终于达成协议。
The mere mention of the haunted mansion was enough to strike fear into the hearts of the boldest boys in the village. （读后续写·恐怖·渲染）
With the finish line now within striking distance, she summoned every last drop of strength and hurled herself forward. （读后续写·冲刺·励志）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】引人注目的，异乎寻常的（strike 的派生形容词）
synonyms.example: She bears a striking resemblance to her older sister. 她酷似她姐姐。 / In striking contrast to their brothers, the girls were both intelligent and charming. 姑娘们跟她们的兄弟形成鲜明的对照。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】striking = unusual enough to attract attention，常见 a striking resemblance（惊人的相似）、a striking contrast/feature；副词 strikingly（显著地）：The two polls produced strikingly different results.

synonyms.example: The wave hit the small boat with such force that everyone aboard was thrown to the deck. （读后续写·海难）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、最口语；strike 更正式、更书面，且有'突然想到''留下印象'等 hit 没有的引申义

synonyms.example: It never occurred to me that my careless words could wound her so deeply. （读后续写·懊悔）
synonyms.usage: 指念头'浮现'，语气平缓；strike (that) 更强调突然、强烈，如灵光一闪或恍然大悟

synonyms.example: Her calm courage in the face of danger deeply impressed everyone who witnessed it. （议论文·品质）
synonyms.usage: 多指留下'好'印象；strike sb as 中性，可褒可贬，仅陈述'给人某种印象'

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the way + 定语从句（课件·关系词用法）
advancedExpressions.expression: the way (that / in which) sb did sth —— 关系词在从句中作方式状语时用 that 或 in which（较正式），也可省略；作宾语时用 that/which，也可省略；先行词 way 表方向时不用任何关系词
advancedExpressions.example: I was impressed by the way (that / in which) she did it. 她做这件事的方式令我印象深刻。 / That's the way he did it. = That's how he did it.（way 后不用 how，可直接用 how 名词性从句）/ That was the way she went.（表方向，不用关系词）/ You speak to her in the way (that / which) I don't like.（关系词作宾语，可省略）

advancedExpressions.expression: strike sb as（给…印象）/ it strikes sb that（突然想到）/ be struck by（被打动）
advancedExpressions.example: 三个高考高频结构一起记：What strikes me most is his honesty.（印象）；It struck me that I was wrong.（想到）；I was deeply struck by her courage.（打动）。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·不规则动词与 it 形式主语
advancedExpressions.expression: strike-struck-struck；It struck sb that + 从句
advancedExpressions.example: It + struck + sb + that 从句，it 是形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句：It struck him that he had forgotten her birthday.（他突然想起忘了她的生日。）

advancedExpressions.expression: it struck sb, then and there, that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It struck her, then and there, that the treasure she had chased across half the world had been waiting, all along, in the quiet love of home. （插入语强调时刻 + all along 呼应，续写点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: in light of the strike, please be advised that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In light of the ongoing transport strike, please be advised that all after-school activities will be suspended until services resume. （正式通知句式，状语前置说明缘由）

advancedExpressions.expression: what strikes me most is not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What strikes me most about these unsung heroes is not the greatness of their deeds, but the humility with which they perform them. （主语从句强调 + not...but 对比，突出核心观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Suddenly he had an idea.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Just as despair began to settle over him, an idea struck like a bolt of lightning, and his weary eyes lit up with a fierce new hope. （读后续写·转折·灵感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Just as 时间状语营造转折 + 明喻(like a bolt of lightning) + 结果分句(eyes lit up)烘托情绪逆转

sentenceUpgrade.original: The workers stopped working to protest.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Refusing to endure the unsafe conditions any longer, the workers went on strike, their folded arms and unbroken silence speaking far more powerfully than any shouted demand. （议论文·劳工·画面化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语前置说明动机(Refusing to endure) + 独立主格(their arms...speaking) + 比较级 more powerfully 强化力量感

classPractice.type: 写出下列句子中划线单词的词性及中文释义（课件原题）
classPractice.question: 1) The boy struck the man with a stick. struck: ____ ____  2) The disease has struck the whole community, sometimes wiping out whole families. struck: ____ ____  3) The strike ended when the pay demands were met. strike: ____ ____  4) Her car went out of control and struck an oncoming vehicle. struck: ____ ____
classPractice.answer: 1) 动词；打，击  2) 动词；侵袭  3) 名词；罢工  4) 动词；碰撞
classPractice.note: 【课件】strike 一词多义辨识：1) hit 打击；2) （疾病/灾难）侵袭；3) n. 罢工；4) 碰撞。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空·the way + 定语从句（课件原题）
classPractice.question: 1) After a while, she apologized for the way ____ she behaved at the beginning. (2020 全国 III 完形)  2) Culture is the way in ____ a group of people solve problems.  3) We all approve of his way ____ has been proved to be practical.  4) Do you know the way ____ I can get access to the Internet?
classPractice.note: 【课件】the way 后定语从句：作方式状语用 that / in which 或省略（1 空、2 空 in which 已给 which）；作主语（3 空）用 which/that，不可省；作宾语（4 空）用 that/which 或省略，此处填 that。

classPractice.question: It suddenly ____ (strike) me that I had seen this painting somewhere before.
classPractice.note: 考不规则过去式 struck；it 形式主语 + that 从句表"突然想到"。

classPractice.question: 这个陌生人给我的印象是既友好又诚实。The stranger ____ ____ ____ both friendly and honest.
classPractice.note: 固定结构 strike sb as (being) + adj.，表"给某人…印象"，高频。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(strike / hit)：When the storm ____, the whole village lost power.
classPractice.note: 灾难/风暴来袭多用 strike（不及物，更书面）；hit 更口语，此处正式语境用 struck。

classPractice.question: 为争取更高工资，工人们举行了罢工。（go on strike）
classPractice.answer: The workers went on strike for / to demand higher pay (wages).
classPractice.note: 考短语 go on strike（举行罢工）及目的表达。

original_sentence: Although the paintings had very different settings, it was their similarities that stayed with me long after I left the Musée d’Orsay—similarities which can be seen throughout the Impressionists’ paintings.
readingExamples: Although the paintings had very different settings, it was their similarities that stayed with me long after I left the Musée d’Orsay—similarities which can be seen throughout the Impressionists’ paintings.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the place, time and social circumstances in which something happens; the surroundings of a place
(2) n. the place and time in which the action of a book, film or play takes place
(3) n. a position or level at which the controls of a machine are set
(4) n. a frame or mount in which a jewel is fixed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （书、电影、戏剧的）故事发生的时间地点，情节背景
uncommonMeanings.example: Although the paintings had very different settings, it was their similarities that stayed with me. （课文原句·义项举例）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （仪器、机器的）设定档位，调节位置
uncommonMeanings.example: She turned the oven to its highest setting, praying that this last batch of cakes would come out perfect for her mother's birthday. （读后续写·家庭·用心）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （镶嵌宝石的）底座，托架
uncommonMeanings.example: The diamond had lost its brilliance, but the worn gold setting, passed down through four generations, held a value no jeweller could ever appraise. （读后续写·传家宝·情感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （日、月）落下（the setting sun 落日，setting 作形容词/动名词）
uncommonMeanings.example: The setting sun painted the whole sky a deep, glowing orange. 落日把整片天空染成深沉炽热的橙色。

posExamples.sentence: Against the tranquil setting of rolling green hills and a sky washed clean by rain, the tiny stone cottage looked as though it had grown there naturally, a part of the earth itself. （读后续写·田园·环境描写）
I am writing to recommend the old lakeside pavilion as the setting for our graduation ceremony, for its peaceful beauty would make our farewell all the more unforgettable. （应用文·建议信）
A grand idea presented in the wrong setting will fall on deaf ears; timing and context, therefore, often matter as much as the merit of the idea itself. （议论文·时机与场合·论证）
Although the two paintings had very different settings, it was their haunting similarities that stayed with me long after I had left the gallery. （读后续写·观画·教材原句化用）

wordForms.other: setter (n. 设定者)

collocations.example: The old inn stood in a delightful setting beside the river. 那家古老的旅馆坐落在河边宜人的环境中。
It was the perfect setting for a wonderful Christmas. 环境气氛无可挑剔，正是一个美好的圣诞节所需要的。

collocations.phrase: short stories with a contemporary setting = short stories set in ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】以当代（生活）为背景的短篇小说（set v. 以……为背景）
collocations.example: short stories with a contemporary setting = short stories set in contemporary China 以当代中国为背景的短篇小说。

collocations.phrase: the setting of a story / novel / film
collocations.translation: 故事／小说／电影的（情节）背景（课堂重点）
collocations.example: The setting of the novel is a small fishing village. 这部小说的背景是一个小渔村。
The cottage sat in a peaceful rural setting. 这座小屋坐落在宁静的乡村环境中。
Against the setting of a blazing sunset, they said goodbye. 在燃烧般的落日背景下，他们道别了。
In a formal setting such as a job interview, even the firmness of one's handshake can quietly shape a first impression. （议论文·礼仪·场合）

collocations.translation: 调节设定，调整档位（僻义·仪器档位）
collocations.example: He carefully adjusted the setting on the microscope until, at last, the hidden world of the cell swam into focus. （读后续写·科学探索·细节）
The annual festival offers a wonderful setting for people of every background to celebrate their shared culture. （应用文·活动介绍）

synonyms.example: Against the background of towering mountains, the climbers looked no bigger than ants. （读后续写·壮阔）
synonyms.usage: 泛指衬托前景的背景（视觉或情境）；setting 更强调事件发生的完整时空环境和氛围

synonyms.example: New to the city, she gazed at her unfamiliar surroundings with a mixture of fear and wonder. （读后续写·陌生环境）
synonyms.usage: 侧重某人身边直接的物理环境；setting 更抽象，可含时间、社会背景乃至文学情节背景

synonyms.example: A supportive learning environment can awaken potential that harsh criticism would only crush. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 含义最广，尤指影响成长发展的自然或社会大环境；setting 更具体地指某一场景的时空布局

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the way + 定语从句（课件·可挂 strike/setting）
advancedExpressions.expression: the way (that / in which) sb did sth —— 关系词作方式状语用 that / in which（较正式）或省略；作宾语用 that / which 或省略；先行词 way 表方向时不用任何关系词；way 后不用 how，但可直接用 how 引导名词性从句
advancedExpressions.example: I was impressed by the way (that / in which) she did it. / That's the way he did it. = That's how he did it. / That was the way she went.（表方向，不用关系词）

advancedExpressions.expression: the setting of a story（情节背景）/ a rural setting（环境）/ the highest setting（档位）/ the setting sun（落日）
advancedExpressions.example: 四义分场景记：写文学谈"故事背景"，写景谈"环境/场景"，说仪器谈"档位"，写景色谈"落日 the setting sun"。

advancedExpressions.expression: against the ... setting of ..., sb did ...
advancedExpressions.example: Against the golden setting of an autumn dusk, she stood at the gate and watched the last carriage of her childhood roll slowly out of sight. （介词短语环境开篇 + 象征意象，画面感极强）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth would make an ideal setting for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The century-old library, with its hushed halls and towering shelves, would make an ideal setting for our poetry recital. （建议信句式，with 独立主格补充理由）

advancedExpressions.expression: the same idea, in a different setting, can ...
advancedExpressions.example: The same words of advice, offered in a different setting, can wound rather than help — proof that how and where we speak matters as much as what we say. （情境对比论证，破折号点题）
