sentenceUpgrade.original: The story happens in a small village.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The story unfolds in the tranquil setting of a mountain village, where time seemed to drift as lazily as the smoke curling from its chimneys. （读后续写·故事背景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: unfold 替代 happen 更文学 + in the setting of 固定表达 + where 定语从句 + 明喻(as lazily as smoke)

sentenceUpgrade.original: This place is good for the ceremony.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With its serene beauty and rich history, this lakeside pavilion would provide an unforgettable setting for our graduation ceremony. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With 独立主格前置理由 + would provide 委婉建议 + unforgettable 情感形容词收束

classPractice.type: 完成句子·set in（课件·以……为背景）
classPractice.question: 把 "short stories with a contemporary setting" 改写为用 set 的表达：short stories ____ ____ contemporary China（以当代中国为背景的短篇小说）
classPractice.note: 【课件】set v. 以……为背景，be set in + 时间/地点；a setting（名词·背景）= be set in（动词短语）。

classPractice.question: 用 background / setting 填空：The ____ of the novel — a remote lighthouse — mirrored the loneliness of its keeper.
classPractice.note: 指小说"情节背景（时间地点）"用 setting；background 多指视觉衬托的背景。

classPractice.question: 在落日的背景下，两位老友道别了。____ the ____ of a blazing sunset, the two old friends said goodbye.
classPractice.note: 考 against the setting of...（以…为背景）读后续写环境开篇句式。

classPractice.question: The old lakeside pavilion would make an ideal ____ (set) for our graduation ceremony.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词 setting（场所/背景），非动词 set；考名词形式辨析。

translation: 想法相同的，志趣相投的
original_sentence: What was it like?
readingExamples: What was it like?
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (of people) having similar interests, opinions, tastes or aims as one another
(2) adj. sharing the same way of thinking or set of values

posExamples.sentence: It was in that small, cluttered art room that she finally found her people — a handful of like-minded dreamers who, like her, believed a blank canvas could hold an entire universe. （读后续写·归属感·志同道合）
I am writing to invite all like-minded students who care about our environment to join the newly founded Green Earth Club and turn our shared concern into real action. （应用文·招募信）

Great movements throughout history have rarely begun with the multitude; more often, they were sparked by a mere handful of like-minded individuals who refused to accept the world as it was. （议论文·团结的力量·论证）
Surrounded by like-minded companions on that long march, he discovered that a burden shared among friends grows strangely light, however steep the road ahead. （读后续写·同行·励志）

wordForms.other: 合成词·like（相似的）+ mind（心思、想法）+ -ed → like-minded（想法一致的），连字符不可省。同构复合形容词：open-minded（思想开明的）、narrow-minded（心胸狭窄的）、absent-minded（心不在焉的）、strong-minded（意志坚定的）——记住 -minded 这一"…心态的"构词模块

collocations.translation: 志同道合的人（课堂核心搭配）
collocations.example: The club brought together like-minded people. 这个社团把志同道合的人聚到了一起。
She treasured her few like-minded friends. 她珍视自己那几个志趣相投的朋友。

collocations.translation: 结识／找到／聚集志同道合的……
collocations.example: Online forums make it easier than ever to find like-minded souls, yet nothing can quite replace the warmth of talking face to face. （议论文·网络社交）
What began as two friends sketching in a café grew, within a year, into a thriving community of like-minded young artists. （读后续写·从小到大·发展）

collocations.translation: 让自己身处志同道合者之中
collocations.example: If you wish to grow, surround yourself with like-minded people whose ambition kindles rather than dampens your own. （议论文·环境影响·建议）
A cause worth fighting for will always attract like-minded champions, however small its beginnings may seem. （议论文·信念）

synonyms.example: The moment their eyes met across the crowded hall, each recognised in the other a kindred spirit. （读后续写·一见如故）
synonyms.usage: kindred spirit 是固定搭配，文学色彩浓，强调心灵深处的默契；like-minded 更中性、更常用于观点/目标一致

synonyms.example: Working among congenial colleagues, she found that even the dullest tasks passed pleasantly. （应用文·工作氛围）
synonyms.usage: 较正式书面，侧重相处融洽、令人愉快；like-minded 侧重想法目标相同，不一定谈及相处感受

synonyms.example: On the question of protecting the old town, the whole committee was of the same mind. （议论文·共识）
synonyms.usage: 短语，强调在某具体问题上意见一致；like-minded 是形容词，可作定语修饰人，用法更灵活

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-minded 复合形容词群
advancedExpressions.expression: like-minded / open-minded / narrow-minded / absent-minded / strong-minded
advancedExpressions.example: -minded 表"具有…心态/想法的"：like-minded（志同道合）、open-minded（开明）、narrow-minded（狭隘）、absent-minded（心不在焉）。构词一记一串，写作瞬间高级。

advancedExpressions.expression: among like-minded ..., sb no longer felt ...
advancedExpressions.example: Among like-minded companions at last, he no longer felt like a stranger in his own life, but like a river that had finally found the sea. （比喻收束，续写归属感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: we warmly welcome all like-minded ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We warmly welcome all like-minded students who cherish traditional culture to join us in bringing our heritage back to life. （招募信句式，定语从句限定对象）

advancedExpressions.expression: when like-minded people unite, ...
advancedExpressions.example: When like-minded people unite behind a common purpose, no obstacle is too great and no dream too distant to be reached. （when 状语从句 + 双重否定强调力量）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She made some friends who thought like her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In that little club she found, for the first time in her life, a circle of like-minded friends who spoke the language of her dreams and asked for no explanations. （读后续写·友谊·归属）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语(for the first time in her life)强化情感 + like-minded 精准替换 who thought like her + 定语从句(who spoke...and asked)排比

sentenceUpgrade.original: We want people with the same ideas to join us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We sincerely hope that like-minded individuals, united by a shared love for our planet, will stand shoulder to shoulder with us in this meaningful cause. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: We sincerely hope that 正式主句 + 过去分词状语(united by)插入 + 习语 stand shoulder to shoulder 生动有力

classPractice.question: The new club soon attracted a group of like-____ (mind) students who all loved painting.
classPractice.note: 考合成词 like-minded 的构成，-ed 不可漏；连字符复合形容词作定语。

classPractice.question: 我写信邀请所有志同道合、关心环保的同学加入绿色地球社。（like-minded）
classPractice.answer: I am writing to invite all like-minded students who care about the environment to join the Green Earth Club.
classPractice.note: 考 like-minded 作定语 + who 定语从句限定招募对象，招募信句式。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(like-minded / open-minded)：To grow wiser, you should be ____ and listen to opinions you disagree with.
classPractice.note: "愿听不同意见"是思想开明 open-minded；like-minded 强调想法一致，此处不合。

original_sentence: Monet and Renoir, along with other like-minded artists, sought liberation from the rules of the old style.
readingExamples: Monet and Renoir, along with other like-minded artists, sought liberation from the rules of the old style.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the act of freeing a country, group, or people from control by another country, or from unfair social or political rules
(2) n. the act of freeing a prisoner, a captured city, etc. from confinement or occupation
(3) n. the feeling of being freed from restrictions on one's behaviour, thoughts, or way of life
(4) n. the process of gaining equal rights and freedoms for a group that has been treated unfairly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （化学等）（物质、能量的）释放
uncommonMeanings.example: The chemistry teacher explained that the sudden liberation of gas was what made the mixture hiss and foam over the beaker. （读后续写·科学课堂·实验瞬间）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the last brushstroke dried, a wave of liberation swept over the young painter — for the first time she had painted not what the masters demanded, but exactly what her own heart had seen. （读后续写·艺术追梦·挣脱束缚）
I am writing to invite you to our school forum on the liberation of women in modern history, an event we hope will inspire every student to reflect on the value of equality. （应用文·邀请信·历史主题）
True liberation, in my view, lies not in escaping every rule, but in gaining the wisdom to choose which rules are worth living by. （议论文·自由与自律）
When the town celebrated the anniversary of its liberation, veterans and children alike gathered in the square, and the old flags fluttered once more against a peaceful sky. （读后续写·历史纪念·和平）

wordForms.noun: liberation (解放); liberator (n. 解放者); liberty (n. 自由，与 freedom 近义，at liberty to do 有权做，take the liberty of doing 冒昧做)
wordForms.verb: liberate (vt. 解放，释放：liberate sb from sth)
wordForms.adjective: liberated (被解放的) / liberal (adj. 开明的，慷慨的，自由主义的)
wordForms.other: 词根 liber- = free（自由）：liberate（动词·解放）→ liberation（名词·解放）→ liberator（人·解放者）→ liberty（名词·自由）→ liberal（形容词·开明的）。同根一串记牢

collocations.translation: 寻求从……中解放／解脱（课文原句同款）
collocations.example: The artists sought liberation from the old rules. 这些艺术家寻求从旧规则中解放出来。
As she posted the letter, a sense of liberation swept over her. 寄出信的一刹那，一股解脱感涌上她心头。
The exhibition traced the long road of women's liberation. 这次展览追溯了妇女解放的漫长历程。

collocations.phrase: the liberation of a country / city
collocations.example: History textbooks devote whole chapters to the liberation of the nation, yet often forget the countless ordinary heroes who made it possible. （议论文·历史反思）
Education, more than any decree, can bring lasting liberation to those trapped by poverty and prejudice. （议论文·教育的力量）
Forgiving the man who had wronged her was less a gift to him than a spiritual liberation for herself. （读后续写·宽恕·自我救赎）
For the overworked clerk, the quiet weekend in the mountains felt like a long-awaited liberation from the endless noise of the city. （读后续写·都市生活·喘息）
Monet and his fellow painters sought liberation from the rigid rules that had governed European art for centuries. （议论文·艺术革新）

synonyms.example: After years behind a desk he craved nothing but the freedom to wander wherever his feet might carry him. （读后续写·追寻自由）
synonyms.usage: 指自由这一状态或权利，静态、常用；liberation 强调从束缚中被"解放"的动态过程和转变的那一刻

synonyms.example: The emancipation of the enslaved people marked a turning point in the nation's conscience. （议论文·社会正义）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、书面，多指法律或制度上正式赋予自由（如废奴、妇女解放）；liberation 使用范围更广，也可指个人情感的解脱

synonyms.example: The news of his release from prison brought his aging mother to tears of relief. （读后续写·团圆）
synonyms.usage: 既可指从关押/义务中"放出"，也指情绪、能量的"释放"，语气较轻；liberation 更宏大、更带有"打破压迫"的意味

advancedExpressions.expression: liberate (v.) → liberation (n.) → liberator (n.) → liberty (n.) → liberal (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 liber = 自由。动词 liberate 解放 → 名词 liberation 解放 / liberty 自由 → 人 liberator 解放者 → 形容词 liberal 开明的。一条链把词族串起来。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表"解放/自由"
advancedExpressions.expression: liberation / freedom / emancipation / release
advancedExpressions.example: freedom 是"自由"这一静态状态；liberation 强调"挣脱束缚"的动态过程与转变时刻；emancipation 侧重法律制度上的解放（如废奴）；release 语气较轻，指"放出/释放"。

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time, ... felt a liberation ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the first time in her life, she felt a liberation so complete that even the air seemed to taste of possibility. （"for the first time"强调转变时刻 + 通感"taste of possibility"，续写结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us work towards the liberation of ... from ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us work together towards the liberation of our minds from prejudice, so that every voice, however faint, may finally be heard. （倡议书结尾，用"liberation of ... from ..."发出号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true liberation lies not in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True liberation lies not in the absence of rules, but in the courage to question the ones that no longer serve us. （"not in ..., but in ..."对比句式，辩证展开观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She felt free after making the decision.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant the decision left her lips, a strange liberation flooded through her — as though a cage she had carried invisibly for years had, at last, swung silently open. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 以"liberation flooded through her"名词化情绪 + as though 虚拟比喻(invisible cage) + 破折号制造顿挫，画面化"解脱"的瞬间

sentenceUpgrade.original: The country was finally free.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the long-awaited liberation of the nation finally came, it was written not only in treaties and speeches, but in the quiet tears of mothers who could at last sleep without fear. （议论文/记叙·历史）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 名词化"liberation of the nation"作主语 + not only ... but ... 递进 + 以"mothers' tears"以小见大，化抽象为具体

classPractice.question: Monet and Renoir sought ____ (liberate) from the rules of the old painting style.
classPractice.note: seek 后接名词，liberate → liberation；考动名词族转换，教材原句同款。

classPractice.question: 用 liberate / liberation / liberty 填空：The whole town celebrated the anniversary of its ____ from occupation.
classPractice.note: 介词 of 后 + the anniversary 需名词"解放"，选 liberation。

classPractice.question: 寄出辞职信的一刹那，一股解脱感涌上她心头。The instant she posted the letter, a ____ ____ ____ swept over her.
classPractice.note: 考搭配 a sense/feeling of liberation（一种解脱感），读后续写心理描写。

original_sentence: as Describing differences: as opposed to, in contrast to, be different from, than, unlike The Louvre Museum is located in Paris.
readingExamples: as Describing differences: as opposed to, in contrast to, be different from, than, unlike The Louvre Museum is located in Paris.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. disagreeing with something such as a plan, policy, or action, and wanting to prevent it
(2) adj. (of two things) being in conflict with each other, or completely different in nature
(3) adj. (as opposed to) used to compare or contrast two things, showing that you mean the first, not the second

posExamples.sentence: Her father was firmly opposed to her studying art, yet the more he objected, the more determined she became to prove that a paintbrush could shape a future too. （读后续写·梦想与家庭·抗争）
I am writing on behalf of the students who are strongly opposed to the plan of cutting down the old plane trees on our campus. （应用文·建议信/反对信）
Those opposed to change often forget that the customs they cherish today were once radical ideas fiercely resisted by their own ancestors. （议论文·传统与革新）
The two brothers held diametrically opposed views on how to run the family workshop, and every dinner ended in a heated but loving argument. （读后续写·家庭·分歧）

wordForms.noun: opposition (n. 反对，反对派) / opponent (n. 对手，反对者)
wordForms.verb: oppose (vt. 反对：oppose sth / oppose doing sth，注意 oppose 后直接接宾语，不加 to)
wordForms.adjective: opposing (对立的，相反的) / opposite (相反的，对面的)
wordForms.other: 辨析·be opposed to（反对，to 是介词+名词/动名词）vs oppose sth（直接及物，无 to）; opposite（在…对面/相反的，反义词概念）vs opposed（反对的/对立的立场）——opposite 强"位置/方向相反"，opposed 强"立场反对"; opposite (prep./adv. 在……对面)

collocations.phrase: be opposed to sth / doing sth
collocations.translation: 反对某事／做某事（核心！to 是介词，后接名词/动名词）
collocations.example: My father was strongly opposed to my studying art. 我父亲强烈反对我学艺术。
They painted everyday scenes, as opposed to grand historical ones. 他们画日常场景，而不是宏大的历史场景。
The whole village was fiercely opposed to the polluting factory. 整个村子都强烈反对这家污染工厂。
Their views were diametrically opposed, yet they stayed friends. 他们的观点截然对立，却依然是朋友。
A good debate is not about crushing opposed opinions, but about understanding why reasonable people can disagree. （议论文·理性辩论）
Even after hours of persuasion, the stubborn old craftsman remained opposed to using any machine in his workshop. （读后续写·匠心·坚守）

synonyms.example: Almost the entire class was against holding the exam on a Saturday. （应用文·反映意见）
synonyms.usage: 最口语化，语气直白，常作介词或表语；be opposed to 更正式、书面，且强调经过思考的坚定立场

synonyms.example: The newcomer was met with hostile stares from the villagers who distrusted all strangers. （读后续写·陌生环境·排斥）
synonyms.usage: 带有强烈的敌意和攻击性，程度更重；opposed 只表示"不赞成、对立"，未必含敌意

synonyms.example: Contrary to everyone's expectations, the quiet boy won the speech contest. （议论文/记叙·出人意料）
synonyms.usage: 强调方向或内容"正相反"，常见于 contrary to（与……相反）；opposed 更强调主观上的"反对态度"或立场的对立

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be opposed to 中 to 是介词
advancedExpressions.expression: be opposed to + n. / doing（to 后必须名词或动名词，不能接原形）
advancedExpressions.example: 对比 oppose（及物，oppose the plan）与 be opposed to（be opposed to the plan / to changing it）。同类 to 为介词的短语：object to, look forward to, be used to, devote oneself to。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·辨析 opposed / opposite / opposing
advancedExpressions.expression: opposed（反对的/对立的立场）vs opposite（对面的/正相反的）vs opposing（相对的）
advancedExpressions.example: be opposed to the plan（反对计划）；the house opposite mine（我对面的房子）；opposite directions（相反方向）；the opposing team（对方队伍）。写作最易混，务必分清。

advancedExpressions.expression: though once fiercely opposed to ..., sb. gradually came to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though once fiercely opposed to her decision, her father gradually came to see the quiet strength behind it. （"though once opposed ... gradually came to"刻画立场松动，适合续写和解段）

advancedExpressions.expression: while I fully respect ..., I am afraid I must remain opposed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: While I fully respect the committee's good intentions, I am afraid I must remain opposed to relocating the school library. （建议信中礼貌而坚定地表达反对）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being opposed, ... and ... are in fact ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being opposed, discipline and creativity are in fact two sides of the same coin. （"far from being opposed"打破二元对立，辩证深化观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her parents were against her plan.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Her parents, opposed to the very idea from the start, folded their arms and shook their heads — yet in their worried eyes she glimpsed a love that simply feared to see her hurt. （读后续写·亲情·理解冲突）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 后置形容词短语"opposed to ... from the start"作插入 + 动作细节(folded arms, shook heads) + 转折"yet"揭示反对背后的爱

sentenceUpgrade.original: Some people are against new technology.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Those who stand firmly opposed to every new technology would do well to remember that the printing press, too, was once condemned as a threat to human memory. （议论文·科技与进步）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 定语从句"those who stand ... opposed"作主语 + would do well to remember 委婉劝诫 + 历史类比(the printing press)增强说服力

classPractice.question: Her parents were firmly opposed to ____ (let) her travel abroad alone.
classPractice.note: be opposed to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 letting，非原形——高频陷阱。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(opposed / opposite)：The bookshop is just ____ our school gate.
classPractice.note: 表"在…对面"用 opposite（介词）；opposed 表"反对的"，位置不合。

classPractice.question: 把 "Many people oppose the new plan." 用 be opposed to 改写：Many people ____ ____ ____ the new plan.
classPractice.note: oppose sth（及物无 to）= be opposed to sth；考主动到"be + 过去分词"表态语的转换。

original_sentence: as Describing differences: as opposed to, in contrast to, be different from, than, unlike The Louvre Museum is located in Paris.
readingExamples: as Describing differences: as opposed to, in contrast to, be different from, than, unlike The Louvre Museum is located in Paris.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. used to compare two things and show that you mean the first one, not the second
(2) phr. used to contrast one thing with another, emphasising the difference between them
(3) phr. rather than; instead of (something else that has just been mentioned)

posExamples.sentence: Standing before the canvas, she realised she wanted to capture the fleeting light of a real morning, as opposed to the frozen grandeur of the history paintings hanging in every museum. （读后续写·艺术觉醒·真实之美）
We hope the school will offer more practical workshops, as opposed to endless theory lessons, so that students can truly learn by doing. （应用文·建议信）
Genuine success should be measured by the lives we touch, as opposed to the wealth we accumulate. （议论文·成功的定义）
He chose to walk the long coastal path, as opposed to taking the crowded bus, and that quiet hour by the sea changed the whole course of his day. （读后续写·选择·意外收获）

idioms.translation: （习语）与……相对；而不是（= rather than，后接 n./v-ing）
idioms.example: The Impressionists painted everyday life, as opposed to grand historical subjects. 印象派画家画的是日常生活，而不是宏大的历史题材。（课文原句同款用法）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（表示对比）是A，而不是B；相对于B而言（=unlike / in contrast to，用于比较两者、强调差异，后接名词/动名词）
collocations.example: Everyday subject matter was the main focus of their works, as opposed to the history paintings that had traditionally dominated European art. 印象派的作品主要关注日常主题，这与传统上占据欧洲艺术主流的历史题材画作大相径庭。（课件·Reading 原句）

collocations.phrase: attend as opposed to（数量/情况对照）
collocations.example: 200 people attended, as opposed to 300 the previous year. 有200人出席，而前一年是300人。（课件·Reading 例句）

collocations.phrase: be (strongly) opposed to sth / doing sth
collocations.example: He was strongly opposed to modernism in art. 他强烈反对艺术中的现代主义。／She is very much opposed to your going abroad. 她非常反对你出国。（课件·Reading slide 27）

collocations.translation: 【课件】截然不同的，互相对立的
collocations.example: The two sets of values seemed mutually opposed. 这两套价值观似乎截然对立。（课件·Reading slide 27）

collocations.phrase: opposing views / force（opposing 仅用于名词前）
collocations.translation: 【课件】对立的观点／相反的力量
collocations.example: Throughout the negotiations, Hurst and Jevon took opposing views. 整个谈判过程中，赫斯特与杰翁各持对立观点。（课件·Reading slide 28）

collocations.translation: 【课件】反对（某人）做某事（oppose v. 反对计划、政策等；抵制，阻挠）
collocations.example: The parents strongly opposed their daughter going there alone. 父母强烈反对女儿独自去那里。（课件·Reading slide 29 原题同款）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在……的对面；与……相反（opposite adj. 相反的；对立的 / n. 对立面）
collocations.example: The bank is opposite to the museum. 银行在博物馆对面。（课件·Reading slide 28 词族）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……的反对（opposition un. 反对，敌对）
collocations.example: Much of the opposition to this plan has come from the media. 该计划的反对声音大多来自媒体。（课件·Reading slide 28）
In her small bakery she cared for quality as opposed to quantity, and each loaf carried the warmth of unhurried hands. （读后续写·匠心·慢生活）
Wise leaders pursue long-term benefits, as opposed to short-term applause. （议论文·远见）
The counsellor helped him separate real dangers as opposed to imagined ones, and slowly his anxiety loosened its grip. （读后续写·心理成长·战胜恐惧）
The coach urged the young players to fall in love with the process, as opposed to fixating on the result. （读后续写·体育·成长心态）

synonyms.example: Unlike the traditional painters, the Impressionists worked outdoors, chasing the changing light. （议论文·艺术流派）
synonyms.usage: 【课件 Reading slide 26 直接给出 as opposed to = unlike / in contrast to】unlike 作介词直接引出"与……不同"的对象，语气简洁；as opposed to 更适合在句中做精确的"是……而非……"的区分

synonyms.example: In contrast to his noisy brother, Tom preferred to sit quietly with a book. （读后续写·人物对比）
synonyms.usage: 【课件 Reading slide 26 明确 as opposed to = in contrast to】强调两者放在一起"对照"后的鲜明差异，多用于句首；as opposed to 更强调"选此非彼"的取舍或界定

synonyms.example: She chose to speak the truth rather than protect her own comfort. （议论文·诚实的勇气）
synonyms.usage: 最通用的"而不是"，可连接名词、动名词或从句，强调二者取一；as opposed to 更书面，突出"两相对照"的意味，多接名词/动名词

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·oppose 词族一网打尽（课件 Reading slide 27-28）
advancedExpressions.expression: oppose v. 反对：oppose (sb) doing sth｜opposed adj. 反对的/截然不同的：be (strongly) opposed to sth/doing、mutually opposed｜opposing adj.（仅名词前）对立的：opposing views｜opposite adj./n. 相反的、对面：be opposite to｜opposition n. 反对：opposition to sth｜短语 as opposed to（表对照）
advancedExpressions.example: He was opposed to the plan (opposed=形容词表语); the two sides held opposing views (opposing 只作定语); his opposition to it was firm (opposition 名词); the outcome was opposite to what he expected. 一句串起 oppose 家族词性差异。（课件语法点卡）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·as opposed to 后接名词/动名词
advancedExpressions.expression: A as opposed to B（B 为 n. 或 v-ing，作"而非"对照）
advancedExpressions.example: 注意 to 是介词：value effort as opposed to talent（重努力而非天赋）；choose to walk as opposed to driving（选择走路而非开车）。不可接动词原形。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表"而不是/相对于"
advancedExpressions.expression: as opposed to / rather than / instead of / in contrast to / unlike
advancedExpressions.example: rather than 最通用可接从句；as opposed to 更书面，突出"两相对照"多接名词；in contrast to 强对照多用句首；unlike 作介词直接引出不同对象。功能同、语域侧重不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. chose ..., as opposed to ..., and ...
advancedExpressions.example: She chose to stay and fight for the little school, as opposed to fleeing to an easier life in the city, and that single choice defined the woman she would become. （用"as opposed to"凸显抉择的分量，续写升华人物弧光）

advancedExpressions.expression: we would prefer ..., as opposed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We would prefer regular outdoor activities, as opposed to being confined to the classroom all day, for fresh air sharpens both body and mind. （建议信中对照式提出诉求）

advancedExpressions.expression: what truly matters is ..., as opposed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: What truly matters is the character we build, as opposed to the reputation we chase; the one is ours, the other belongs to the crowd. （"as opposed to"精准区分核心概念，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He wanted the truth, not comforting lies.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What he longed for was the plain, unvarnished truth, as opposed to the comforting lies everyone else kept offering — for only truth, however bitter, could set him free. （议论文/记叙·诚实）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 强调结构"What he longed for was ..." + as opposed to 精准对照 + however 让步 + 以"set him free"收束，情理兼备

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should focus on learning, not just grades.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A healthy classroom should celebrate the joy of genuine learning, as opposed to the cold pursuit of grades, so that curiosity, rather than fear, becomes the engine of every young mind. （议论文·教育理念）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as opposed to 对照"学习vs分数" + so that 引出目的 + rather than 二次对比 + 隐喻"engine of every young mind"提升说服力

classPractice.question: The parents strongly opposed their daughter ____ (go) there alone.
classPractice.note: 【课件·Reading slide 29 原题】oppose (sb) doing sth 反对（某人）做某事，其后用 v-ing，故填 going。

classPractice.question: ____ opposed to last year, his income of this year is small.
classPractice.note: 【课件·Reading slide 29 原题】As opposed to 置于句首表对照"与……相比"，为固定短语。

classPractice.question: At first he was ____ (oppose) to the idea, but later he came round to it.
classPractice.note: 【课件·Reading slide 29 原题】be opposed to sth 反对某事，用形容词 opposed。

classPractice.question: He spent five years in prison for his ____ (oppose) to the government.
classPractice.note: 【课件·Reading slide 29 原题】his 后接名词，作介词 for 的宾语，opposition to sth 对……的反对。

classPractice.question: The Impressionists focused on everyday scenes, as opposed to ____ (paint) grand historical subjects.
classPractice.note: as opposed to 中 to 为介词，后接动名词 painting；考"介词+v-ing"。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(as opposed to / rather than)：She spoke the truth ____ protect her own comfort. (后接动词原形)
classPractice.note: rather than 可接动词原形；as opposed to 只接名词/动名词，此处后为原形只能用 rather than。

classPractice.question: 真正的成功应以我们帮助过的人来衡量，而不是以积累的财富来衡量。（as opposed to）
classPractice.answer: Genuine success should be measured by the lives we touch, as opposed to the wealth we accumulate.
classPractice.note: 考 as opposed to 引出对照"而非"，后接名词短语，议论文界定句式。

translation: 在……中占有最重要（或支配）的地位，控制，占有优势，俯视
original_sentence: Everyday subject matter was the main focus of their works, as opposed to the history paintings that had traditionally dominated European art.
readingExamples: Everyday subject matter was the main focus of their works, as opposed to the history paintings that had traditionally dominated European art.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to control or have a lot of influence over someone or something, often in an unpleasant way
(2) vt. & vi. to be the most important or noticeable feature of something
(3) vt. & vi. to be the strongest or most successful in a competition, field, or activity
(4) vt. (of a building, hill, etc.) to be much higher and larger than the surroundings; to tower over

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （建筑、山峰等）高高耸立俯瞰、俯视
uncommonMeanings.example: A ruined castle dominated the tiny fishing village, its grey towers keeping silent watch over the boats that came and went with the tide. （读后续写·环境描写·古堡俯瞰）

posExamples.sentence: For years a single fear had dominated her every waking thought, until the day she finally stood on the stage and heard her own voice ring out, clear and unafraid. （读后续写·战胜恐惧·蜕变）
I am writing to suggest that a few loud voices should not be allowed to dominate our class meetings, so that every quieter student may also be heard. （应用文·建议信）
Everyday scenes became the heart of the Impressionists' art, as opposed to the grand history paintings that had traditionally dominated European galleries. （议论文·艺术革新）
The young chess champion dominated the tournament from the very first round, her calm, calculating eyes seeing ten moves where others saw only one. （读后续写·天才少女·赛场）

wordForms.noun: domination (n. 支配，统治) / dominance (n. 优势，支配地位)
wordForms.adjective: dominant (adj. 占主导的，显著的：the dominant force) / dominating / dominated (被支配的)
wordForms.other: predominate (v. 占主导) / predominant (adj. 占主导的) / domain (n. 领域，同 domin- 词根表"主宰"); 词根 domin- = master/lord（主人）：dominate（主宰）→ dominant（占主导的）→ dominance（优势）→ domination（统治）

collocations.translation: 【课件】占据新闻头条（在……中具有最重要的特色 be the most important or noticeable feature of sth）
collocations.example: The train crash dominated the headlines. 火车相撞事故占据了头条新闻。

collocations.translation: 【课件】支配／左右谈话（支配，控制，左右，影响）
collocations.example: He tended to dominate the conversation. 他往往左右着交谈的内容。 / She always says a lot in meetings, but she doesn't dominate. 她在会上总是滔滔不绝，但她的话没什么影响。 / A few loud voices should not dominate the meeting. 不该让几个大嗓门主导整场会议。
As a child he was dominated by his father. 他小时候受父亲的支配。 / For years his life had been dominated by the fear of failure. 多年来他的生活一直被对失败的恐惧所支配。

collocations.phrase: dominate the first half (of the game)
collocations.translation: 【课件】（比赛中）占有优势，压制对手（to play much better than your opponent）
collocations.example: United completely dominated the first half of the game. 联队在上半场比赛中占尽优势。

collocations.translation: 【课件】俯视，高高耸立于（to be larger and more noticeable than anything else in a place）
collocations.example: The cathedral dominates the city. 大教堂俯视着全城。

collocations.translation: 主导市场／行业（课堂重点搭配）
collocations.example: One company dominated the entire smartphone market. 一家公司主导了整个智能手机市场。
As the exam drew near, one question dominated his mind. 考试临近，一个问题占据了他的心头。
Screens have come to dominate our daily lives, quietly stealing the hours we once gave to conversation and rest. （议论文·科技反思）

collocations.translation: 主宰整个场景／景观（僻义·耸立俯瞰）
collocations.example: A single ancient oak dominated the meadow, its sprawling branches sheltering generations of picnics. （读后续写·环境·怀旧）

collocations.translation: 由男性／女性主导的（合成形容词）
collocations.example: She fought her way into a male-dominated profession, proving with quiet excellence that skill knows no gender. （议论文·性别平等）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】占支配地位的，占主导的（dominate 的派生形容词）
synonyms.example: companies fighting for domination of the software market 争取控制软件市场的各家公司；the dominant force 占主导地位的力量。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】词族：dominate (v. 支配) → dominant (adj. 占支配地位的) → domination (n. 支配，管辖，控制) → dominator (n. 统治者)。

synonyms.example: He forced himself to control his trembling hands before he opened the crucial letter. （读后续写·紧张·克制）
synonyms.usage: 指对人、物或局面的直接掌控，中性且常见；dominate 更强调"占据支配/优势地位"，常带压制或压倒性的意味

synonyms.example: In the end, reason prevailed over anger, and the two friends shook hands. （议论文·理性战胜情绪）
synonyms.usage: 偏文雅，指某种力量、观念最终"占上风"或"普遍存在"；dominate 更强调持续、明显地"主宰"某个领域或场面

synonyms.example: Her brilliant elder sister's fame overshadowed every small success she managed to win. （读后续写·被比较·失落）
synonyms.usage: 强调因太过突出而使他者"相形见绌"，含比较意味；dominate 强调掌控与主导，不一定使他物"失色"

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·domin- (master) 词族全家桶
advancedExpressions.expression: dominate (v.) → dominant (adj.) → dominance (n.) → domination (n.) → predominate/predominant
advancedExpressions.example: 词根 domin = 主人、主宰。动词 dominate 支配 → 形容词 dominant 占主导的 → 名词 dominance/domination 优势/统治 → 加 pre- 得 predominant（占绝大多数的）。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·dominate 主动/被动两面
advancedExpressions.expression: A dominates B（A 主宰 B）↔ B is dominated by A（B 被 A 支配）
advancedExpressions.example: History paintings dominated European art.（主动）= European art was dominated by history paintings.（被动）。写作视角切换常考。

advancedExpressions.expression: for years, a single ... had dominated ...
advancedExpressions.example: For years, a single doubt had dominated her heart; but as the crowd rose to applaud, that shadow finally dissolved into light. （"had dominated"过去完成时铺垫长期压抑 + 前后光影对比，续写高潮释放）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... should not be allowed to dominate ...
advancedExpressions.example: Entertainment should not be allowed to dominate our reading lists at the expense of books that truly nourish the mind. （倡议书中呼吁平衡，句式简洁有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: when ... comes to dominate ..., ... inevitably ...
advancedExpressions.example: When the pursuit of profit comes to dominate every corner of society, genuine human warmth inevitably grows scarce. （"when ... comes to dominate"引出条件，inevitably 强化因果，警示式论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Fear controlled her for a long time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: For as long as she could remember, fear had dominated her like a cruel master, dictating where she went, what she dared, and how small she chose to make herself. （读后续写·心理描写+拟人）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去完成时"had dominated" + 明喻"like a cruel master" + 三个动名词/从句排比(dictating where ... what ... how ...)层层压迫

sentenceUpgrade.original: One company controls the whole market.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That a single corporation should come to dominate the entire market is not merely an economic matter, but a warning that unchecked power, left to grow, will always swallow fair competition. （议论文·市场垄断）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That 引导主语从句(前置) + not merely ... but ... 递进 + 插入语"left to grow" + 隐喻"swallow fair competition"深化警示

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件原句同款）
classPractice.question: Everyday subjects became their focus, as opposed to the history paintings that had traditionally ____ (dominate) European art.
classPractice.note: 【课件】过去完成时 had + 过去分词 dominated；及物动词直接接宾语 European art，教材原句同款。

classPractice.question: 用 dominate 的适当形式填空：For years the timid boy's life had been ____ by the fear of failure.
classPractice.note: be dominated by（被…支配）被动结构，had been + 过去分词。

classPractice.question: 不该让几个大嗓门主导整场班会。A few loud voices should not ____ ____ ____ to dominate the whole class meeting.
classPractice.note: 考 should not be allowed to do（不该被允许做），应用文呼吁均衡句式。

classPractice.question: 她凭借安静的卓越挤进了一个由男性主导的行业。（male-dominated）
classPractice.answer: She fought / made her way into a male-dominated profession (industry) with quiet excellence.
classPractice.note: 考合成形容词 male-dominated（由…主导的），dominate 的过去分词作构词成分。

original_sentence: There are a lot of poetic devices employed in poems, such as rhyme and metaphor.
readingExamples: There are a lot of poetic devices employed in poems, such as rhyme and metaphor.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to pay someone to work for you, giving them a regular job
(2) vt. to use a particular skill, method, means, or object in order to achieve a purpose
(3) vt. (formal) to spend or use time or energy on a particular activity
(4) n. (formal, in the employ of) the state of being paid to work for someone

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 运用，使用（方法、技巧、手段）——核心义，高考高频（employ techniques / a method / a strategy）
uncommonMeanings.example: To capture the shimmer of water, the Impressionists employed short, broken strokes of pure colour rather than smooth, blended tones. （议论文·艺术手法）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 雇用，聘用（give sb a paid job）——employ sb (as / to do)
uncommonMeanings.example: The workshop employed a dozen villagers, offering them not only wages but a renewed sense of purpose. （读后续写·善举）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）花费、投入（时间、精力）于某事（employ time / energy in doing）
uncommonMeanings.example: Rather than idling away his holidays, he employed his time in caring for the stray animals at the shelter. （应用文·假期计划）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）受雇，被雇用（常用于 in the employ of）
uncommonMeanings.example: For thirty faithful years the old gardener had been in the employ of the manor, and every rose in that vast garden seemed to know his gentle hands. （读后续写·忠仆·岁月）

posExamples.sentence: To breathe life into her poem, the young writer employed vivid metaphors and a haunting rhythm, until the words seemed to rise off the page and sing. （读后续写·文学创作·灵感迸发）
I would like to suggest that our club employ a wider range of activities, from workshops to field trips, to keep every member fully engaged. （应用文·建议信）
The methods a society employs to educate its young ultimately reveal what that society truly values. （议论文·教育与价值观）
After the flood, the kind-hearted factory owner employed dozens of displaced villagers, offering them not only wages but the dignity of honest work. （读后续写·善举·雪中送炭）

wordForms.other: unemployment (n. 失业)

collocations.phrase: employ sb to do sth / employ sb as ... / be employed as ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】雇用某人做某事／雇用某人担任……／受雇当……
collocations.example: A number of people have been employed to deal with the backlog of work. 已雇来一些人处理积压的工作。 / For the past three years he has been employed as a firefighter. 三年来他一直受雇当消防员。

collocations.phrase: employ methods / approaches / techniques / equipment; the vocabulary that she employs
collocations.translation: 【课件】采用方法／技巧／设备；她使用的词汇（employ = 应用；运用；使用）
collocations.example: employ methods, approaches, techniques, equipment 采用方法、技巧、设备 / the vocabulary that she employs 她使用的词汇。

collocations.phrase: employ oneself in (doing) sth = be employed in (doing) sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】忙于（做）某事；从事某活动（= keep busy / occupied with）
collocations.example: She was employed in making a list of all the jobs to be done. 她忙着把要做的所有工作列一个清单。

collocations.translation: 【课件】失业（employment n. 使用；职业；雇用；unemployment n. 失业）
collocations.example: The couple were out of employment and they led a hard life. 这对夫妇失业了，过着艰难的生活。
The struggling farm employed him as a seasonal picker, and those long days under the sun taught him more than any classroom ever had. （读后续写·打工·磨砺）

collocations.translation: 运用某种方法/策略/技巧
collocations.example: The Impressionists employed a bold new technique, laying down quick strokes of pure colour to capture the trembling of light. （议论文·艺术手法）
In the debate final she employed every rhetorical skill she had, weaving logic and passion into one unanswerable argument. （读后续写·辩论·闪光时刻）
Proudly, he told his mother that he had at last been employed by the very company he had dreamed of joining. （读后续写·求职成功·圆梦）
Unless we employ stricter measures to protect our rivers, future generations may know clean water only from photographs. （议论文·环境保护）

collocations.translation: 有正当职业的，有酬就业的
collocations.example: By the age of twenty she was gainfully employed and, for the first time, able to send a little money home each month. （读后续写·独立·成长）
Rather than idling away his holidays, he employed his time in volunteering at the local shelter. （应用文·假期计划）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】雇员／雇主，老板／使用，职业，雇用（employ 的核心词族）
synonyms.example: employee n. 雇员；受雇者 / employer n. 雇主，老板 / employment n. 使用；职业；雇用；out of employment 失业 / unemployment n. 失业 / the unemployed 失业的人。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】employ (v.) → employer (雇主) / employee (雇员) / employment (就业) ↔ unemployment (失业) / unemployed (失业的)；unemployed capital 闲置的资金。

synonyms.example: The café owner hired three students to help through the busy summer season. （应用文·招聘/记叙）
synonyms.usage: 更口语、更日常，尤指美式英语中"雇人"，也可指"租用"；employ 更正式，且额外有"运用（方法、技能）"的重要含义

synonyms.example: The clever team utilised every scrap of material to build their winning model. （议论文/记叙·资源利用）
synonyms.usage: 非常正式、书面，指"充分利用"现有资源；employ 表"运用"时语域相近，但更自然、搭配更广

synonyms.example: She applied everything she had learned in class to solve the real problem before her. （议论文·学以致用）
synonyms.usage: 强调把知识、规则、方法"应用于"具体情境；employ 更强调"调用、使用"某种手段本身，二者常可互换但侧重略异

advancedExpressions.expression: employ a technique / method（运用手法）｜employ sb as（雇用某人做）｜employ time / energy in（把时间精力用于）
advancedExpressions.example: The novelist employed flashbacks to build suspense; the studio employed him as a screenwriter; and he employed every spare hour in perfecting the plot. （一句串联"运用/雇用/花费"三义，考场易混务必分清）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"运用/采用"高级替换
advancedExpressions.expression: employ / adopt / make use of / draw on / resort to（后者为无奈之下"诉诸"）
advancedExpressions.example: When gentle persuasion failed, the coach resorted to sterner methods, but he still preferred to employ encouragement wherever he could. （议论文·方法选择，employ 中性、resort to 含被迫意味）

advancedExpressions.expression: employ(v.) → employer(雇主) / employee(雇员) / employment(就业) ↔ unemployment(失业) / unemployed(失业的) / employable(有就业能力的)；重音在第二音节 em·PLOY
advancedExpressions.example: Rising unemployment forced many a skilled employee to accept work far beneath his qualifications. （议论文·就业话题，一句涵盖词族）

advancedExpressions.expression: to do sth, sb. employed ..., until ...
advancedExpressions.example: To calm the frightened child, she employed the oldest magic she knew — a soft, wandering lullaby — until his sobs melted into steady, trusting breaths. （不定式目的状语前置 + employed 引出手段 + until 收束效果，续写温情场面）

advancedExpressions.expression: I suggest we employ ... so as to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I suggest we employ a rota system for cleaning the classroom, so as to share the duty fairly among all classmates. （建议信中提出方案，employ + so as to 结构规范）

advancedExpressions.expression: the means a society employs ... ultimately reveal ...
advancedExpressions.example: The means a society employs to treat its weakest members ultimately reveal the true depth of its conscience. （"the means ... employs ... reveal"以"手段见本质"，论证有高度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She used many skills to write the poem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To give her verses a heartbeat of their own, she employed rhyme, rhythm and daring metaphor, until each line pulsed with a music that words alone could never explain. （读后续写·文学创作·升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 不定式目的状语前置 + employed 三项并列宾语(rhyme, rhythm, metaphor) + until 结果状语 + 隐喻"heartbeat / pulsed with music"

sentenceUpgrade.original: The company gave many villagers jobs.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By employing dozens of villagers who had lost everything in the flood, the modest workshop restored to them not merely a wage, but the quiet dignity of standing on their own feet again. （议论文/记叙·企业责任）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By + 动名词状语开头 + employing 引出善举 + not merely ... but ... 递进 + 抽象名词"dignity"化情为理，升华意义

classPractice.type: 根据汉语提示补全句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: 1) 别打扰他，他正忙着写作文呢。Don't trouble him. He ____ ____ ____ writing a composition.  2) 这对夫妇失业了，过着艰难的生活。The couple were ____ ____ ____ and they led a hard life.
classPractice.answer: 1) is employed in  2) out of employment
classPractice.note: 【课件】1) be employed in (doing) sth 忙于做某事；2) out of employment 失业（employment 名词，不加冠词）。

classPractice.question: In his essay he ____ (employ / hire) a series of vivid metaphors to make the argument unforgettable.
classPractice.note: "运用（修辞手法）"只能用 employ；hire 仅表"雇用/租用"，不能表"运用方法"

classPractice.question: The old master had been in the ____ (employ) of the royal court for over forty years.
classPractice.note: in the employ of 受雇于……，此处 employ 作名词，不加后缀

classPractice.question: 洪灾过后，那位善良的厂主雇用了几十位无家可归的村民。After the flood, the kind factory owner ____ ____ ____ homeless villagers.
classPractice.note: employ sb 雇用某人；dozens of 几十个

original_sentence: I observed the brushwork they used to enhance their works.
readingExamples: I observed the brushwork they used to enhance their works.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the particular way in which a painter uses a brush, seen as a distinctive feature of an artist's style
(2) n. the technique or manner of applying paint, and the visible marks or strokes this produces on a painting
(3) n. (broadly) the skill and craftsmanship shown in painting with a brush

posExamples.sentence: Leaning close to the canvas, she studied the master's brushwork — quick, fearless strokes that seemed to trap sunlight itself within the swirling paint. （读后续写·美术馆·艺术震撼）
In our upcoming exhibition, visitors will be able to admire the delicate brushwork of traditional Chinese ink painting up close. （应用文·展览通知）
Bold, expressive brushwork was precisely what set the Impressionists apart, for they cared less about smooth perfection than about capturing a fleeting, living moment. （议论文·艺术风格）
Under the old teacher's patient guidance, the boy's clumsy strokes slowly gave way to confident brushwork, and with every lesson a little more of the artist within him awoke. （读后续写·师徒·技艺精进）

wordForms.other: paintwork (n. 油漆面/漆工)

collocations.example: The fan was decorated with such delicate brushwork that each tiny plum blossom seemed ready to release its scent. （读后续写·传统工艺·惊叹）
His bold brushwork broke every rule his teachers had taught him, yet it was exactly this freedom that made the painting unforgettable. （议论文·艺术创新）
For hours he observed the brushwork of the old masters, hoping to steal, stroke by stroke, the secret of their genius. （读后续写·勤学·痴迷）
Through her expressive brushwork alone, the artist conveyed a grief that no title or caption could ever put into words. （议论文·艺术表达）
Even from across the crowded hall, she recognised the brushwork of her late grandfather, and her eyes brimmed at once. （读后续写·睹物思人·感动）
It took decades of quiet practice for the calligrapher to master a brushwork so effortless that it looked like breathing. （读后续写·匠心·苦练）

synonyms.example: The young painter spent years perfecting a technique that could make still water seem to move. （议论文·技艺）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任何艺术或技艺的"技法"，范围广；brushwork 专指用画笔作画的"笔法"，更具体、更视觉化

synonyms.example: With a single confident stroke, the master completed the crane's outstretched wing. （读后续写·作画瞬间·利落）
synonyms.usage: 指画笔留下的"单个笔触"或"一笔"，可数、具体；brushwork 是不可数的整体概念，指画家运笔的整体风格与手法

synonyms.example: The exquisite craftsmanship of the carved screen left every visitor speechless. （议论文·工匠精神）
synonyms.usage: 强调手工制作的精湛"工艺"，适用范围极广（木工、雕刻等）；brushwork 只限于"运笔作画"这一具体领域

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词 brush + work
advancedExpressions.expression: brush(画笔) + work(活儿/功夫) = brushwork(笔法)，不可数；同理 needlework(针线活) / handiwork(手工) / paintwork(漆面)
advancedExpressions.example: Her needlework showed the same patient brushwork of attention she gave to everything she loved. （合成词构词规律：具体名词 + work 表"某类工艺/活计"）

advancedExpressions.expression: delicate / fine brushwork（精细）｜bold / free / loose brushwork（奔放）｜expressive brushwork（有表现力）｜study / observe / master the brushwork
advancedExpressions.example: The Impressionists' loose, expressive brushwork stood in vivid contrast to the delicate, fine brushwork of classical portraits. （读后续写/议论文·两种笔法对照，一句串联核心搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"笔法/技法"辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: brushwork（运笔整体风格，不可数）｜stroke（单个笔触，可数）｜technique（泛指技法）｜craftsmanship（工艺）
advancedExpressions.example: It was not any single stroke but the overall brushwork — the fruit of a lifetime's craftsmanship — that revealed the master's technique. （由小及大：stroke→brushwork→technique，层次分明）

advancedExpressions.expression: the brushwork ... as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The brushwork was so alive that the painted river seemed to ripple, as if a breeze had somehow slipped between the frame and the wall. （"as if"虚拟比喻赋予画作生命感，续写美术馆场景增强画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: visitors will be struck by the ... brushwork of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Visitors will be struck by the exquisite brushwork of these ink paintings, each stroke telling a story centuries old. （展览通知中吸引读者，句式生动）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is in the brushwork, not the subject, that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is in the brushwork, not the subject, that a true artist's soul is laid bare. （强调句"it is ... that" + not the subject 对比，凸显个性与灵魂）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The painting had good brushwork.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every inch of the canvas breathed with a brushwork so bold and tender that visitors instinctively lowered their voices, as though standing before something sacred. （读后续写·美术馆·敬畏）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人"breathed with brushwork" + 形容词对照(bold and tender) + 结果状语"so ... that" + as though 比喻(something sacred)营造敬畏感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Impressionist painters used loose brushwork.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What truly distinguished the Impressionists was their loose, luminous brushwork — a deliberate roughness through which they chased the very trembling of light. （议论文·艺术流派）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 强调结构"What truly distinguished ... was ..." + 形容词并列(loose, luminous) + 破折号补充说明 + 通过定语从句"through which they chased"点明艺术追求

classPractice.question: 从 brushwork / stroke / technique 中选词填空：Leaning close, she admired the master's delicate ____, in which every single ____ seemed placed by breath alone.
classPractice.note: 第一空指整体运笔风格用不可数 brushwork；第二空指"单个笔触"用可数 stroke

classPractice.question: 正是这大胆的笔法，而非题材，使这幅画令人难忘。(用强调句 + brushwork)
classPractice.answer: It was the bold brushwork, not the subject, that made the painting unforgettable.
classPractice.note: It is/was ... that ... 强调句；brushwork 不可数不加 s

translation: 逼真的，栩栩如生的，现实的，实际的，现实主义的
original_sentence: Using ink on silk, he creates realistic images of scenery, buildings and people, and displays a remarkable mastery of perspective.
readingExamples: Using ink on silk, he creates realistic images of scenery, buildings and people, and displays a remarkable mastery of perspective.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. representing things in a way that is accurate and true to life
(2) adj. having a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected
(3) adj. based on facts and what is actually likely to happen, rather than on hopes or wishes

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①逼真的，栩栩如生的（true to life，指画作/影像/描写像真的一样）
uncommonMeanings.example: The figures on the mural were so realistic that the child reached out to touch the shepherd's staff. （读后续写·参观惊叹）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②现实的，务实的，切合实际的（sensible about what can be achieved）——a realistic goal / expectation
uncommonMeanings.example: Instead of chasing an impossible dream, she set herself a realistic goal she could actually reach. （议论文·理想与现实）

posExamples.sentence: As dawn crept through the studio window, the old painter added a final stroke, and suddenly the eyes on the canvas grew so realistic that the boy could have sworn they blinked back at him. （读后续写·艺术/人物）
In planning our charity fair, I would suggest setting realistic goals, for a modest yet achievable target is far more encouraging to volunteers than an ambitious one doomed to fail. （应用文·建议信）
While dreams give us direction, it is a realistic assessment of our own limitations that ultimately keeps us grounded and steers our efforts toward genuine progress. （议论文·理想与现实）
Standing before the mural, I marvelled at how realistic the figures were, their faces lit with an inner glow that seemed to breathe warmth into the cold stone wall. （读后续写·参观/惊叹）

wordForms.noun: reality (n. 现实) / realism (n. 现实主义) / realist (n. 现实主义者)
wordForms.adjective: real (真实的) / realistic (逼真的/务实的) ↔ unrealistic (不切实际的)
wordForms.adverb: really (真正地) / realistically (逼真地；实际地)
wordForms.other: 反义 unrealistic；易混：realistic(逼真/务实) vs realist(名词，现实主义者)；辨析 real(客观真实) vs realistic(看起来像真的/务实的)

collocations.example: Rather than aiming for perfection overnight, she broke her dream into a series of realistic goals, ticking off each one with quiet satisfaction. （读后续写·励志成长）

collocations.translation: 对某事有清醒/务实的认识
collocations.example: We must be realistic about the challenges ahead, yet remain hopeful that persistence will eventually see us through. （议论文·态度论证）
The documentary offered a realistic portrayal of rural life, sparing no detail of both its hardships and its quiet joys. （应用文·影评）
Setting realistic expectations for freshmen helps them adjust to campus life without being crushed by needless anxiety. （议论文·教育话题）
With three weeks of intensive rehearsal, our drama club now stands a realistic chance of winning the regional competition. （读后续写·团队奋斗）
The report painted a realistic picture of the city's traffic problems, refusing to gloss over the inconvenient truths. （应用文·报告）
Being realistic in his approach, the coach focused first on the basics before demanding anything spectacular from the young players. （读后续写·师徒）
The special effects looked so realistic that the audience gasped, momentarily forgetting they were watching a film. （应用文·观后感）

synonyms.example: The wax figure was so lifelike that visitors instinctively lowered their voices, half expecting it to draw breath. （读后续写·参观惊叹）
synonyms.usage: 专指形象/画像/雕塑「像真的一样」,侧重视觉逼真;realistic 除此外还可指「务实、切合实际」

synonyms.example: Her advice was refreshingly practical: start small, stay consistent, and let results speak for themselves. （应用文·建议信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「实用、可操作」,强调解决问题的方法;realistic 侧重「符合客观实际、不脱离现实」

synonyms.example: His vivid account of the storm made us feel the wind lashing against our own faces. （读后续写·描写）
synonyms.usage: 侧重描写/记忆「鲜明生动、给人强烈印象」;realistic 强调「与真实相符、不失真」

advancedExpressions.expression: 【逼真】a realistic image / portrayal / depiction；look / sound realistic｜【务实】a realistic goal / target / expectation；be realistic about sth
advancedExpressions.example: The film was praised both for its realistic special effects and for its realistic view of ordinary family life. （一句展现"逼真"与"务实"两义，考场需据语境判断）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"逼真/务实"替换
advancedExpressions.expression: 【逼真】realistic / lifelike / true to life / vivid｜【务实】realistic / practical / down-to-earth / sensible
advancedExpressions.example: Her advice was refreshingly practical, and the example she painted was so lifelike that we could picture every detail. （lifelike 只表逼真、practical 只表务实，realistic 两义兼有）

advancedExpressions.expression: real → really / reality / realistic ↔ unrealistic / realism / realist / realize；形容词后缀 -istic 表"……主义/性质的"
advancedExpressions.example: In reality, setting unrealistic targets only breeds despair, whereas realistic ones turn a distant dream into a workable plan. （一句嵌入 reality / unrealistic / realistic 词族对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: so realistic that sb. could have sworn ...
advancedExpressions.example: The portrait was so realistic that she could have sworn the sitter's chest rose and fell with each passing breath. （结果状语从句+虚拟语气could have sworn,渲染逼真到以假乱真）

advancedExpressions.expression: it would be wise / advisable to set realistic ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we launch the campaign, it would be wise to set realistic targets so that early success can build the confidence we need to carry on. （建议信中提出务实规划）

advancedExpressions.expression: while ... , a realistic view of ... reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While ambition fuels our progress, a realistic view of human limits reminds us that lasting achievement is built one steady step at a time.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The painting looked very real.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: So realistic was the painting that, for one suspended heartbeat, I forgot it was mere pigment on canvas — the shepherd seemed poised to step down from the frame, his flock murmuring softly at his heels. （读后续写·艺术惊叹）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: So + adj. 倒装强调 + for one suspended heartbeat 时间状语渲染 + seemed poised to 拟人 + 破折号补充画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should have realistic goals.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that we should temper our lofty aspirations with realistic, step-by-step goals, for only when a dream is broken into attainable stages does it cease to be a fantasy and become a plan. （议论文·理想与实践）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + temper A with B 搭配 + only when 引导的倒装强调 + cease to be...and become 对比升华

classPractice.question: It is important to be ____ (real) about how much we can achieve in a single week.
classPractice.note: be realistic about sth 对……有务实认识；real 加后缀 -istic 变形容词

classPractice.question: Setting ____ (realistic / unrealistic) goals only sets us up for disappointment and burnout.
classPractice.note: 语境"only ... disappointment"表明目标不切实际，用反义词 unrealistic

classPractice.question: 那些特效如此逼真，观众都倒吸一口气。The special effects ____ ____ ____ that the audience gasped.
classPractice.note: look realistic 看起来逼真；so ... that 如此……以至于

original_sentence: To me, these techniques are the essence of the Impressionist view of art.
readingExamples: To me, these techniques are the essence of the Impressionist view of art.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the most basic and important quality of something, which makes it what it is
(2) n. a concentrated liquid taken from a plant or drug and used to add flavour or scent
(3) n. (in essence / of the essence) the central or fundamental point of a matter

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①本质，实质，精髓（the most important quality）——the essence of sth，最核心义
uncommonMeanings.example: The old craftsman spent a lifetime distilling the essence of his art into a single, effortless brushstroke. （读后续写·匠人精神）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②香精，浓缩精华液（concentrated liquid）——vanilla / almond essence
uncommonMeanings.example: The kitchen was thick with the sweetness of vanilla essence as Grandma folded it into the batter, and the fragrance alone could summon my childhood back in a single breath. （读后续写·亲情/嗅觉记忆）

posExamples.sentence: Watching my grandmother knead the dough with practised, patient hands, I finally grasped the essence of her cooking — it was never about the recipe, but about the love pressed into every fold. （读后续写·亲情感悟）
I am writing to remind fellow students that the essence of volunteering lies not in the hours we log, but in the genuine care we bring to those we serve. （应用文·倡议书）
In essence, true education is not the mere transfer of knowledge but the awakening of a curious, independent mind capable of questioning the world. （议论文·教育本质）
As the coach reminded us before the final, speed and strength matter, but the essence of teamwork is trusting the teammate beside you enough to pass the ball. （读后续写·体育团队）

idioms.translation: 本质上，大体上（=basically，点题/下结论高频）
idioms.example: In essence, the two proposals share the same noble aim; they differ only in the paths they choose to reach it. （议论文·比较论证）

idioms.translation: 至关重要的，必不可少的（尤指 time is of the essence 时间紧迫）
idioms.example: With the deadline looming, time was of the essence, and the whole team worked through the night without a word of complaint. （读后续写·紧张情节）
In a rescue operation, everyone understands that the essence of time can mean the difference between life and death. （应用文·报道）

collocations.example: The old craftsman spent a lifetime distilling the essence of his art into a single, effortless brushstroke. （读后续写·匠人精神）
In just a few lines of poetry, she captured the essence of that fleeting autumn afternoon better than any photograph ever could. （读后续写·抒情）
Honesty is the very essence of friendship; without it, even the warmest bond slowly hollows out. （议论文·品格论证）

collocations.phrase: distil / boil sth down to its essence
collocations.example: When you boil the argument down to its essence, it comes to a single question: do we value comfort or growth more? （议论文·归纳论证）
A few drops of almond essence transformed the plain sponge cake into something worthy of a bakery window. （应用文·美食描写）
Only after months of practice did the young apprentice truly grasp the essence of the master's technique. （读后续写·学艺）
In its essence, courage is not the absence of fear but the decision to act in spite of it. （议论文·勇气话题）
Let us not be distracted by minor disagreements and instead focus on the essence of the matter. （应用文·会议发言）

synonyms.example: At the core of every great story lies a character we cannot help but care about. （议论文·文学话题）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「中心、最内在的部分」,可具体可抽象;essence 更强调「使事物成其为该事物的根本特质」

synonyms.example: It is in the nature of youth to dream boldly and fear little. （议论文·青春话题）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「与生俱来的性质/天性」;essence 侧重「提炼后最核心、最纯粹的精华」

synonyms.example: The heart of the problem was not a lack of money but a lack of trust. （议论文·分析）
synonyms.usage: 口语化、比喻性强,指「最关键处、症结」;essence 更书面、更抽象

advancedExpressions.expression: the (very) essence of sth（……的精髓）｜capture / grasp the essence of（抓住/领会精髓）｜in essence（本质上）｜time is of the essence（时间紧迫）
advancedExpressions.example: In essence, a good teacher captures the essence of a subject and passes it on before time, always of the essence, runs out. （一句串联 in essence / capture the essence / of the essence 三大结构）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"本质/核心"辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: essence（提炼后最纯粹的根本特质，最书面）｜core（中心、最内在部分）｜nature（与生俱来的本性）｜heart（口语化的"症结、要害"）
advancedExpressions.example: At its core the dispute was about money, but the essence of the matter — the heart of it — was a long-buried mistrust. （由 core→essence→heart 递进，语域由具体到抽象再到口语）

advancedExpressions.expression: essence(n.) → essential(adj. 本质的/必不可少的) → essentially(adv. 本质上，≈in essence)；essential 还可作名词复数 essentials(要素/必需品)
advancedExpressions.example: Water is essential to life; essentially, without it every living essence would wither. （一句嵌入 essential / essentially / essence，展现词族与拼写关联）

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. grasp the essence of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did I grasp the essence of my father's silence — it was not indifference, but a love too deep and too proud for words. （倒装+破折号揭示真意,续写点题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: the essence of ... lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The essence of true charity lies not in the amount we give, but in the compassion with which we give it. （倡议书中提炼核心精神,not...but 对比句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: in essence, ... is nothing more / less than ...
advancedExpressions.example: In essence, perseverance is nothing more than the quiet refusal to give up on a day when giving up would be so much easier.

sentenceUpgrade.original: I finally understood what her cooking was really about.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was only as the steam curled up from the bowl and the familiar aroma wrapped around me that I finally grasped the essence of my grandmother's cooking — every dish was a wordless letter, seasoned with a love she never knew how to speak aloud. （读后续写·亲情+嗅觉）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It was only as...that 强调时间点 + 环境描写(steam curled up) + grasp the essence of 高级搭配 + wordless letter 隐喻升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Education is really about teaching people to think.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In essence, education is not the pouring of facts into an empty vessel, but the kindling of a flame — a lasting curiosity that will keep a mind alight long after the classroom is left behind. （议论文·教育本质）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In essence 点题 + not...but 否定对比 + pouring into a vessel / kindling a flame 双重隐喻 + long after 时间从句延伸意境

classPractice.question: In ____, the two plans are the same; only the wording differs.
classPractice.note: in essence 本质上，点题/下结论常用

classPractice.question: With the storm approaching, speed was of the ____ (essential) as we loaded the last of the supplies.
classPractice.note: of the essence 至关重要的；此处需名词 essence，不是形容词 essential

classPractice.question: 只有几行诗，她就抓住了那个秋日午后的精髓。In just a few lines, she ____ ____ ____ ____ that autumn afternoon.
classPractice.note: capture the essence of 抓住……的精髓

translation: 生动的，逼真的，鲜艳的，明亮的
original_sentence: Is your description vivid enough?
readingExamples: Is your description vivid enough?
definitionEn:
(1) adj. producing very clear, powerful and detailed images in the mind
(2) adj. (of light, colours) very bright and strong
(3) adj. (of a description, memory or imagination) full of life, energy and detail

posExamples.sentence: Even after twenty years, the memory remained vivid — the salt spray on my lips, the gulls wheeling overhead, and my father's laughter rolling across the water like distant thunder. （读后续写·回忆/父爱）
To make your travel article more engaging, I would suggest replacing flat statements with vivid details that let readers taste the street food and hear the bustling market for themselves. （应用文·建议信）
A vivid imagination, far from being a childish indulgence, is in fact the wellspring of every scientific breakthrough and artistic masterpiece humanity has ever produced. （议论文·想象力）
As we rounded the hill, the valley burst into view, a vivid patchwork of golden wheat and crimson poppies stretching all the way to the shimmering horizon. （读后续写·风景描写）

collocations.translation: 生动的描写/叙述（课文原句同款搭配，Is your description vivid enough?）
collocations.example: His vivid description of the earthquake made the whole class fall silent, as if the ground beneath us had begun to tremble. （读后续写·叙事）
Blessed with a vivid imagination, the little girl could turn a cardboard box into a pirate ship bound for uncharted seas. （读后续写·童趣）
The day she first held the trophy remains a vivid memory, etched into her heart with a clarity that time has never dulled. （读后续写·难忘时刻）
The festival lanterns glowed in vivid colours, painting the night sky with streaks of scarlet, gold and jade. （读后续写·节日描写）
In her diary, she painted a vivid picture of village life, so lively that readers could almost smell the woodsmoke drifting from the chimneys. （应用文·日记/文学）

collocations.translation: 把……生动地展现出来（副词 vividly）
collocations.example: Through masterful storytelling, the author brought the ancient city vividly to life, its streets teeming with merchants, poets and dreamers. （议论文·文学评论）
There was a vivid contrast between the deserted winter beach and the crowded, sun-baked shore I remembered from summer. （读后续写·今昔对比）
For weeks after the trip, she was haunted by vivid dreams of towering waves and a lighthouse blinking through the fog. （读后续写·心理）

synonyms.example: The war veteran gave such a graphic account of the battle that some listeners could hardly bear to hear it. （读后续写·叙述）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「细节详尽、画面清晰(有时甚至过于露骨)」;vivid 更中性,强调「鲜明生动、给人强烈印象」

synonyms.example: The most striking feature of the old house was its bright blue door, defiant against the grey stone walls. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「因不寻常而引人注意」;vivid 侧重「色彩/印象鲜明生动」

synonyms.example: The peacock spread its tail in a fan of brilliant blues and greens that shimmered in the sun. （读后续写·描写）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「光亮夺目、极其明亮」;vivid 兼指颜色鲜艳与印象鲜明,适用面更广

translation: 眼界，见识，视力，视野，想象
original_sentence: employ display decade lay eyes on gallery vision vivid as opposed to B2 The travel journal uses some words created from the same root word.
readingExamples: employ display decade lay eyes on gallery vision vivid as opposed to B2 The travel journal uses some words created from the same root word.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position
(2) n. an idea or a mental picture of what the future could be like, especially one that is inspiring
(3) n. the ability to think about the future with imagination, wisdom and foresight
(4) n. an experience in which you see things in your mind, often of a religious or supernatural kind

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】眼力；远见卓识（the ability to think about or plan the future with great imagination and intelligence = foresight）——a leader of vision, a lack of vision, have a clear vision of the future
uncommonMeanings.example: a leader of vision 有远见的领袖 / a lack of vision 缺乏远见 / have a clear vision of the future 对未来有清晰的设想。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】视力；视野（the ability to see）——have good / poor / blurred vision；field of vision 视野；on the edge of one's vision 在视野边缘
uncommonMeanings.example: have good / poor / blurred vision 视力好／差／模糊 / The couple moved outside her field of vision. 这对夫妇离开了她的视野。 / He glimpsed something on the edge of his vision. 他斜眼瞥见了点什么。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①视力，视野，视界（the ability to see / area you can see）——blurred / clear vision, field of vision
uncommonMeanings.example: Tears blurred her vision as she watched the train pull away, carrying her best friend to a distant city. （读后续写·离别）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②愿景，蓝图，对未来的展望（inspiring picture of the future）——a vision of the future, share a vision
uncommonMeanings.example: In his closing speech, the young captain painted a stirring vision of the future, and even the most doubtful teammates felt their hearts quicken. （应用文·演讲）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③远见，眼界，见识（imagination and foresight）——a man/woman of vision, have vision
uncommonMeanings.example: What distinguishes a true leader from a mere manager is vision: the rare capacity to see beyond present difficulties. （议论文·领导力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④幻象，幻觉；脑海中/梦中出现的景象（experience seen in the mind）
uncommonMeanings.example: Exhausted and half-frozen on the mountainside, the climber was visited by a vision of his warm kitchen at home, so real that he could almost smell the bread rising in the oven. （读后续写·极限情境·幻象）

posExamples.sentence: As the mist lifted, the temple rose slowly into my vision, its golden roof catching the first light of dawn like a promise long awaited. （读后续写·景物出现）
I am writing to share my vision for our student community — a campus where every voice is heard and every talent, however small, is given room to grow. （应用文·竞选演讲/倡议）
What distinguishes a true leader from a mere manager is vision: the rare capacity to see beyond present difficulties and chart a course toward a better tomorrow. （议论文·领导力/远见）
Years later, standing where she had once stood as a penniless student, she realised that her wild teenage vision of a free library in every village had quietly become reality. （读后续写·梦想成真）

wordForms.other: visualize (v. 想象,使形象化)

idioms.example: It takes a woman of vision to plant trees whose shade she knows she will never sit in. （议论文·奉献与远见）
Obsessed only with grades, he fell into a tunnel vision that blinded him to the wider joys of learning. （议论文·教育反思）

idioms.idiom: within / in one's field of vision
idioms.example: The moment the finish line came within his field of vision, a fresh surge of strength flooded his aching legs. （读后续写·比赛冲刺）

collocations.phrase: a leader / man / woman of vision
collocations.example: She is a leader of great vision. 她是一位极有远见的领袖。

collocations.phrase: have a clear vision of the future / a lack of vision
collocations.translation: 【课件】对未来有清晰的设想／缺乏远见
collocations.example: A good manager must have a clear vision of the future. 一个好的管理者必须对未来有清晰的设想。 / The plan failed for a lack of vision. 这个计划因缺乏远见而失败。
Tears blurred her vision as she watched the train pull away, carrying her best friend to a distant city. （读后续写·离别）
A sudden flash at the edge of his field of vision made him spin around, heart pounding. （读后续写·惊悚/悬念）
In his closing speech, the young captain painted a stirring vision of the future, and even the most doubtful teammates felt their hearts quicken. （应用文·演讲）
The two founders shared a bold vision: to bring clean water to every remote village within a decade. （议论文·理想）
As the boat rounded the cape, a lonely lighthouse came into vision, blinking steadily through the evening haze. （读后续写·航行）
History remembers people of vision — those who dared to imagine a world different from the one they inherited. （议论文·历史人物）
Before the club's first meeting, we spent an evening clarifying our vision and mission so that no member would ever feel lost. （应用文·社团介绍）
Though illness had cost him his vision, it had done nothing to dim the light of hope in his heart. （读后续写·励志/残障）
Travel gave her a broad vision of the world, teaching her that home was only one of countless ways to live. （议论文·成长）
Tears blurred her vision as she watched the train pull away, carrying her best friend to a distant city. （读后续写·离别）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】可见的／不可见的，隐形的（vis- 词根："看"）
synonyms.example: Most stars are not visible to the naked eye. 大多数星星肉眼看不见。 / The warning lights were clearly visible. 警示信号灯清晰可见。 / invisible adj. 不可见的，隐形的。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】be visible to the naked eye 肉眼可见；反义 invisible。同根 vision / visual / visible / invisible 共享 vis- "看"。

synonyms.example: It was her foresight in saving through the good years that carried the family safely through the hard ones. （议论文·远见）

synonyms.example: The old man's sight was failing, yet his memory of the sea remained crystal clear. （读后续写·老人）
synonyms.usage: 中性地指「看的能力/所见景象」;vision 作「视力」义时更书面,且专有「远见、愿景」的比喻义

synonyms.example: Her lifelong dream was to open a school for children who had none. （议论文·理想）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「渴望实现的愿望」,情感色彩浓;vision 更强调「清晰、可付诸行动的未来图景与远见」

advancedExpressions.expression: 【视力】blurred / clear vision；field of vision（视野）｜【愿景】a vision of the future；share / have a vision｜【远见】a person of vision；tunnel vision（目光短浅）｜【幻象】a vision of sth
advancedExpressions.example: Though age had dimmed his vision, it never dimmed his vision — a woman of true vision, his mother had taught him to see far beyond what the eyes alone could reach. （同一词"视力/愿景/远见"并置，考场靠语境定义项）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"远见/视力"辨析

advancedExpressions.expression: 词根 vis-/vid- 表"看"：vision → visual(视觉的) / visible(可见的) ↔ invisible / visionary(有远见的；空想的) / visualize(想象) / visibly(明显地)；同根 supervise / evident

advancedExpressions.expression: as ... lifted / cleared, ... rose slowly into my vision
advancedExpressions.example: As the fog cleared, the ancient bridge rose slowly into my vision, its worn arches whispering of centuries no living soul remembered. （环境+拟人,画面缓缓展开的续写场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to share my vision for ... — a ... where ...

advancedExpressions.expression: what distinguishes ... from ... is vision: the capacity to ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: She had a dream to help poor children.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From the cramped attic of her childhood, she nursed a quiet vision of a world in which no child was ever turned away from a book, and that vision, stubborn as a weed through concrete, would one day reshape the fate of an entire village. （读后续写·梦想升华）

translation: vt. 陈列，展示，显示，表现 | n. 陈列，展览，表现，展示
original_sentence: Because of this, it is not often displayed to the public.
readingExamples: Because of this, it is not often displayed to the public.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to put something in a place where people can see it easily; to arrange something so that it can be seen
(2) vt. to show a quality, feeling or ability by your behaviour
(3) n. an arrangement of things in a public place for people to look at
(4) n. a performance, event, or an occasion of showing a particular quality or skill

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①陈列，展示（把物品摆出供人看）——display sth to the public, put sth on display
uncommonMeanings.example: For the first time in a century, the fragile silk scroll was displayed to the public, and people queued for hours just to glimpse it. （议论文·文物保护）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②表现出，流露（品质、情感、能力）——display courage / determination / emotion
uncommonMeanings.example: In the face of unrelenting criticism, she displayed a composure and grace that ultimately won over even her fiercest opponents. （议论文·品格）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③陈列，展览，表演（an arrangement / performance shown in public）——an art / fireworks display, on display
uncommonMeanings.example: The fireworks display over the harbour was a breathtaking spectacle, each burst of colour drawing a chorus of gasps. （读后续写·节日）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（计算机、仪器的）显示屏，显示装置
uncommonMeanings.example: The pilot's eyes flicked to the flickering display, where a single red warning light had begun to blink with quiet menace. （读后续写·科技/悬疑）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤（动物的）炫耀/求偶展示行为
uncommonMeanings.example: In a dazzling courtship display, the male bird fanned his iridescent feathers and danced in trembling circles before his would-be mate. （读后续写·自然纪录）

posExamples.sentence: Trembling yet determined, the boy displayed his clumsy clay pot to the whole class, and to his astonishment, the room broke into warm, generous applause. （读后续写·成长/自信）
You are warmly invited to visit our school art display next Friday, where the finest paintings and calligraphy of the graduating class will be exhibited in the main hall. （应用文·通知/邀请）

idioms.translation: 展出中，陈列着（=being shown to the public，高频）
idioms.example: The champion's medals were proudly on display in the school lobby, a silent reminder to every student of what dedication could achieve. （应用文·校园/记叙）

collocations.translation: 【课件】陈列，展出；展示（把东西摆出供人看）

collocations.translation: 【课件】展出，陈列（=being shown to the public，介词 on 不可省）
collocations.example: Designs for the new sports hall are on display in the library. 新体育馆的设计图展示在图书馆里。（课件·Reading slide 40）

collocations.translation: 【课件】把某物展出（可加 temporary/permanent 表临时／长期展出）
collocations.example: The museum put its rarest jade carvings on display. 博物馆把最珍稀的玉雕展了出来。（课件·Reading slide 40 语块）

collocations.translation: 【课件】令人印象深刻的（力量/勇气等）展示

Our community will hold a spectacular firework display to welcome the New Year. 我们社区将举办一场盛大的烟花表演以迎接新年。（课件·Reading slide 39）

The shopkeeper displayed the freshest fruit at the front, its bright colours luring passers-by inside. （读后续写·市井生活）
Her performance was a dazzling display of skill and passion that left the judges searching for words. （读后续写·表演）
The new app displays real-time air quality data, helping citizens plan their outdoor activities wisely. （应用文·科普介绍）
For the first time in a century, the fragile silk scroll was displayed to the public, and people queued for hours just to glimpse it. （议论文·文物保护）
Our community will hold a spectacular fireworks display to welcome the New Year, and all residents are cordially invited. （应用文·公告）

synonyms.example: The gallery will exhibit works by young local artists throughout the summer. （应用文·展览通知）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·display 动名同形＋on display（课件 Reading slide 39-40）

advancedExpressions.expression: you are warmly invited to ... , where ... will be on display

advancedExpressions.expression: true ... is not ... but the quiet display of ...
