translation: 值得（做）……的，值得钦佩的，值得赞扬的，值得注意的
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (worthy of sth / to do sth) deserving something, especially respect, admiration or support
(2) adj. having good qualities that deserve respect, praise or attention
(3) adj. (of a cause, aim or effort) good enough to justify time, money or effort; morally right

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】①值得（或应得）……的（be worthy of sth / of doing）——be worthy of note / notice / attention 值得注意；be worthy of the honour 荣誉当之无愧（Reading slide 42-43）
uncommonMeanings.example: It is also worthy of note that Post-Impressionist painters were not the only ones to be influenced by Impressionism. 值得注意的是，后印象派画家并非唯一受印象派影响的群体。（课件·Reading slide 42 原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】②（用于名词前）值得尊敬的，崇高的（deserving）——a worthy cause 崇高的事业（Reading slide 43）
uncommonMeanings.example: The money we raise will be going to a very worthy cause. 我们筹集的钱款将用于非常崇高的事业。（课件·Reading slide 43）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (常带戏谑或反讽)显要人物,大人物
uncommonMeanings.example: All the local worthies gathered on the platform in their Sunday best, each hoping the visiting official might remember his name. （读后续写·乡镇讽刺）

posExamples.sentence: After years of quiet sacrifice for her students, the old teacher was finally honoured on stage, and not a soul in the hall doubted that she was worthy of every word of praise. （读后续写·师恩/致敬）
I firmly believe that protecting our river is a cause worthy of everyone's support, and I sincerely hope you will join our clean-up campaign this weekend. （应用文·倡议书）
A goal is worthy not because it is easy to reach, but because the struggle it demands transforms us into better versions of ourselves. （议论文·目标与奋斗）
Though his rival was faster and stronger, Tom proved himself a worthy opponent, refusing to yield an inch until the very last whistle. （读后续写·体育竞技）

wordForms.other: worth (n./prep. 价值;值……的)

collocations.phrase: be worthy of note / notice / attention
collocations.translation: 【课件】值得注意（worthy 后必须加 of，接名词或动名词）
collocations.example: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note. 这份报告的一些发现值得注意。（课件·Reading slide 43）

collocations.translation: 【课件】当之无愧，配得上这份荣誉
collocations.example: After years of quiet dedication, she was truly worthy of the honour. 多年默默奉献之后，她当之无愧地配得上这份荣誉。（课件·Reading slide 43）

collocations.translation: 【课件】崇高的／值得支持的事业（worthy 作定语，表"值得尊敬的"）
collocations.example: The money we raise will be going to a very worthy cause. 我们筹集的钱款将用于非常崇高的事业。（课件·Reading slide 43）

collocations.phrase: It is worthy of note that ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】值得注意的是……（课文原句同款句型）
collocations.example: It is also worthy of note that the movement has had a lasting influence on modern art. 值得注意的是，这场运动对现代艺术产生了持久的影响。（课件·Reading slide 42 原句改编）

collocations.translation: 值得（尊敬、支持、注意）；配得上（核心结构，可接名词或动名词）
collocations.example: By risking his own safety to warn the villagers, the shepherd boy proved himself worthy of their lasting gratitude. （读后续写·英雄）
She bowed to her defeated opponent, acknowledging a worthy rival who had pushed her to the very limits of her ability. （读后续写·竞技）
It is not his wealth but his humility that makes him truly worthy of respect. （议论文·品格论证）
The young captain led the team to victory, proving himself a worthy successor to the legend who had retired the year before. （读后续写·传承）

collocations.phrase: worthy to be ... / worthy to do sth
collocations.example: After all he had endured, he felt at last worthy to stand among the champions he had once only admired from afar. （读后续写·自我认可）
Lifting his family out of poverty was a worthy goal that fuelled him through every sleepless night of study. （议论文·奋斗）

synonyms.example: It is worthwhile to include really high-quality illustrations. 加入真正高质量的插图是值得的。（课件·Reading slide 44）
synonyms.usage: 【课件 slide 44-45 用法表】专指"值得投入时间、金钱或精力"，可作表语、定语、宾补，It is worthwhile to do / doing sth；不能指人。worthy 可修饰人(worthy of respect)与事业(worthy cause)，且须接 of。

synonyms.translation: 【课件】值得的；有……价值（adj. 作表语 / n. 价值）
synonyms.example: How much is this painting worth? 这幅画值多少钱？／The museum is certainly worth a visit (= worth visiting). 这家博物馆很值得一游。（课件·Reading slide 44）
synonyms.usage: 【课件 slide 44-46 用法表】一般作表语，其前可用 well 修饰、不用 very；be worth + 名词 / doing（doing 用主动表被动）。与 worthy(带 of)、worthwhile(修饰事)句法各异，不可混用。

synonyms.example: The scholarship should go to a deserving student who has overcome real hardship. （应用文·推荐信）
synonyms.usage: 常作后置或表语,强调「因努力/处境而应获得(帮助、奖励)」;worthy 更正式,可指「配得上尊敬」也可指「事业崇高」

synonyms.example: Her admirable devotion to her ailing mother moved the entire neighbourhood. （议论文·品德）
synonyms.usage: 侧重「品行/行为令人赞叹」;worthy 侧重「配得上、够格获得某种评价或支持」

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·worth / worthy / worthwhile 三词辨析（课件 Reading slide 44-45 用法表）
advancedExpressions.expression: worth：一般作表语，前可用 well 修饰、不用 very；sb./sth. is worth + 名词 / doing（用主动表被动，如 worth a visit = worth visiting）｜worthy：sb./sth. is worthy + of + 名词 / of being done / to be done（需 of，如 worthy of note）；作定语时表"值得尊敬的"（a worthy cause）｜worthwhile：值得花时间/钱/努力，作表语、定语、宾补，It is worthwhile to do / doing sth
advancedExpressions.example: How much is this painting worth? — The museum is certainly worth a visit (= worth visiting); the cause is worthy of our support; and it is worthwhile to include high-quality illustrations. worth 无 of、worthy 带 of、worthwhile 修饰事，三者句法各异。（课件用法表卡）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·worth 词族（课件 Reading slide 44）
advancedExpressions.expression: worth(n./prep. 价值) → worthy(值得的) / worthwhile(值得花精力的) / worthless(毫无价值的) / unworthy(不配的) / trustworthy(值得信任的) / noteworthy(值得注意的) / worthiness(n.) / worthily(adv.)；-y 表"具有……性质"，-less 表"无"
advancedExpressions.example: What the cynics dismissed as worthless he quietly proved to be worthy of the highest praise — a trustworthy, noteworthy example for us all. （worthless ↔ worthy 反义对照，凸显 -less / -y 后缀）（课件 slide 44 词族）

advancedExpressions.expression: be worthy of sth / doing（值得/配得上）｜a worthy cause / goal（崇高的事业/目标）｜a worthy opponent（可敬的对手）｜worthy of note / respect（值得注意/尊敬）
advancedExpressions.example: A worthy opponent is worthy of respect, and defeating one is a goal truly worthy of every drop of sweat it demands. （一句串联 worthy of / a worthy opponent / worthy goal 核心搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: prove oneself worthy of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only after the long, thankless months of training did he finally prove himself worthy of the captain's armband he had once thought forever out of reach. （Only after 倒装 + prove oneself worthy of 高级搭配,续写中体现自我证明）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is a cause worthy of everyone's support
advancedExpressions.example: Preserving our fading local dialect is a cause worthy of everyone's support, for a language lost is a piece of our very soul erased. （倡议书中拔高事业意义,for 引导理由）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth is worthy not because ... but because ...
advancedExpressions.example: A dream is worthy not because the world applauds it, but because pursuing it, day after quiet day, makes us braver than we ever knew we could be.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old teacher deserved everyone's respect.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As she stood at the podium, silver-haired and trembling slightly, thirty years of chalk dust and selfless devotion behind her, no one in that crowded hall could doubt that she was worthy of every tear and every thunderous round of applause. （读后续写·致敬师恩）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 时间状语 + silver-haired and trembling 外貌细节 + 独立主格(thirty years...behind her) + worthy of 搭配 + every tear and every applause 排比收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should all support this good cause.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my sincere hope that each of you will lend a hand to this worthy cause, for saving even a single stray life is not a small deed but a quiet triumph of compassion over indifference. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my sincere hope that 正式主句 + lend a hand to 搭配 + a worthy cause + for 引导理由 + not...but 对比升华 + triumph of A over B 抽象名词对照

classPractice.note: 【课件·Reading slide 44-45 用法表】worth+名词/doing（无 of，作表语）；worthy+of+名词（带 of）；worthwhile+to do/doing（多修饰事，作表语/定语）。

original_sentence: As he began to (3) _________________ a talent for painting, he realized that art was his true calling.
readingExamples: As he began to (3) _________________ a talent for painting, he realized that art was his true calling.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a strong urge or inner conviction that one ought to follow a particular career or course of action
(2) n. a profession or occupation, especially one regarded as worthy or requiring dedication
(3) n. the act of shouting or naming aloud; the sound of an animal or bird
(4) n. (the ~ of) the formal act of summoning people together (e.g. a meeting, an election)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （内心的）召唤，使命感（熟词僻义，高考爱考）
uncommonMeanings.example: Standing alone in the silent ward at midnight, the young nurse felt, for the first time, that medicine was not merely a job but a calling that had chosen her long before she had chosen it. （读后续写·职业觉醒·使命感）

posExamples.sentence: As the last note faded and the audience rose to their feet, tears blurring their eyes, the deaf boy finally understood that music, against all odds, was his true calling — a voice no silence could ever mute. （读后续写·追梦·情感升华）

I am writing to encourage every one of you not to treat teaching in the mountain villages as a mere assignment, but to embrace it as a noble calling that can reshape the destinies of countless children. （应用文·倡议书）

Those who regard their work as a calling rather than a means of survival tend to persevere through hardship, for they are sustained not by wages but by a sense of purpose that no setback can extinguish. （议论文·职业与人生价值）
Years later, he would trace the beginning of his lifelong calling to that rainy afternoon in the museum, when a single painting seemed to whisper his name across the crowded gallery. （读后续写·艺术启蒙·回忆倒叙）

wordForms.other: 构词法·call (动/名) + -ing → calling（"使命/天职"这一名词义已固化，不再是单纯的动名词）; call 词族全家桶：call n./v. 呼叫/打电话/称呼, caller n. 打电话/来访者, calling n. 使命/职业; 短语辨析·a call (一次电话/呼喊/号召) ≠ a calling (使命/天职)，如 a call for help 求救呼声 vs. a calling to teach 教书的使命

idioms.translation: 响应内心的召唤，投身使命
idioms.example: Turning down a lucrative offer in the city, she quietly answered her calling and returned to teach in the very village school that had once given her hope. （读后续写·奉献·抉择）

collocations.translation: 找到自己的使命／天职（课堂必背）
collocations.example: It took her years to find her calling as a village doctor. 她花了多年才找到当乡村医生这个天职。
He realized that art was his true calling. 他意识到艺术才是他真正的使命。
What sets great teachers apart is a sense of calling. 优秀教师的与众不同在于一种使命感。
She had the courage to follow her calling. 她有勇气追随内心的召唤。
For these rescue workers, wading through the flood was not simply duty but a higher calling that demanded everything they had. （议论文·奉献精神）

collocations.phrase: feel a calling to do sth
collocations.translation: 感到有一种使命去做某事
collocations.example: Ever since witnessing the wildfire, she had felt a calling to devote her life to protecting the country's shrinking forests. （读后续写·环保·立志）
Watching him mend the broken toy so tenderly, his mother joked that he had missed his calling as an inventor. （读后续写·亲情·幽默）
The old doctor regarded medicine not as a trade to profit from but as a calling to serve. （应用文·人物介绍）

synonyms.translation: 天职，使命；（有奉献意味的）职业
synonyms.example: For her, nursing was less a job than a vocation, one that summoned her from a warm bed to a cold ward night after night without complaint. （读后续写·奉献）
synonyms.usage: 书面、正式，与 calling 几乎同义,都强调内心召唤与奉献,但 vocation 更常见于教育、宗教、医护语境,议论文中显得更学术

synonyms.example: Rescuing the stranded climbers before nightfall became the team's single, all-consuming mission. （读后续写·救援·紧迫）
synonyms.usage: 侧重被赋予或自我设定的具体任务与目标,可以是一次性的;calling 更强调贯穿一生的内在志向

synonyms.example: Law is a demanding profession that rewards patience and punishes carelessness. （议论文·职业）
synonyms.usage: 中性,泛指需专业训练的职业,不含使命感的情感色彩;calling 带有强烈的精神与情感召唤意味

advancedExpressions.expression: find / discover / follow / answer one's (true / noble / higher) calling; a sense of calling; regard sth as a calling; miss one's calling
advancedExpressions.example: She finally found her true calling and answered it without hesitation. 她终于找到并毫不犹豫地追随了自己真正的使命。（一组"使命"搭配，写立志/职业选择必备）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"这不是工作而是使命"
advancedExpressions.expression: not (just / merely) a job but a calling; more than a profession — a vocation; a labour of love
advancedExpressions.example: For her, nursing was not merely a job but a calling. 对她而言，护理不只是工作，而是一种使命。（用 not ... but ... 拔高情感，续写与议论皆宜）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was then that sb. realised ... was not a job but a calling
advancedExpressions.example: It was then, kneeling in the mud beside the trembling child, that she realised rescue work was not a job but a calling written into the very core of who she was. （强调句+抽象具象化,续写结尾点明主旨）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us answer this calling and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us answer this calling and devote our youthful energy to the villages that need us most, so that no child's dream is dimmed for want of a teacher. （倡议信结尾,let us 号召+目的状语升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: when work becomes a calling, ...
advancedExpressions.example: When work becomes a calling, exhaustion gives way to fulfilment, and the ordinary labour of each day is quietly transfigured into a source of lasting meaning. （when 状语从句+对比,论证工作意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He knew painting was his job.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Somewhere between the first hesitant brushstroke and the last, it dawned on him that painting was no mere pastime but a calling — a quiet, insistent voice that had been guiding his hand all along. （读后续写·顿悟+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: it dawned on sb. that 心理觉醒 + no mere ... but ... 对比强调 + 破折号补充 + 拟人(insistent voice)将抽象召唤具象化

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should choose a job we love.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that young people ought to pursue not the highest salary but the deepest calling, for a career embraced with passion will sustain the soul long after the novelty of a paycheque has faded. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that 正式主句 + not ... but ... 对比 + for 引导原因状语 + long after 时间对比升华

classPractice.question: 多年的迷茫之后，他终于找到了自己真正的使命。After years of wandering, he finally ____ ____ ____ ____ (找到了自己真正的使命).
classPractice.note: 考 find one's calling 固定搭配；calling 此处为"使命/天职"熟词僻义。

classPractice.question: Those who regard their work as a ____ (call) rather than a means of survival tend to persevere through hardship.
classPractice.note: call + -ing 名词化，意为"使命"；由 regard ... as a 和语义定唯一答案。

classPractice.question: 对她来说，教书不只是一份工作，而是一种崇高的使命。（not ... but ...）
classPractice.answer: For her, teaching is not just a job but a noble calling. / To her, teaching was not merely a job but a noble calling.
classPractice.note: 考 not ... but ... 对比结构 + a noble calling，写职业立志主题的高分句。

original_sentence: I wondered at the skill of the artists, their use of colour and how they played with light and shade.
readingExamples: I wondered at the skill of the artists, their use of colour and how they played with light and shade.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an area of comparative darkness sheltered from direct sunlight
(2) n. a colour, especially with regard to how light or dark it is; a slight variation of a colour
(3) n. a covering that reduces or blocks light, such as a lampshade or window blind
(4) vt. to shelter or screen something from light or heat; to darken parts of a drawing to give depth

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 细微差别（多用复数 shades of meaning）
uncommonMeanings.example: A skilful writer conveys the finest shades of emotion, so that a single glance on the page can carry both longing and reproach. （议论文·语言与写作·细腻）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一点点，稍微（a shade = 略微）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her voice, a shade softer than usual, betrayed the anxiety she was fighting so hard to conceal. （读后续写·人物心理·细节）

posExamples.sentence: Exhausted from the long climb, the two hikers collapsed gratefully into the cool shade of an ancient oak, where the dappled light danced across their sweat-streaked faces like scattered coins. （读后续写·徒步·环境描写）

I wandered from gallery to gallery, marvelling at how the old masters had used light and shade to breathe life into flat canvas, until a portrait of a weeping girl stopped me in my tracks. （读后续写·参观·艺术感悟）
On behalf of the art club, I would like to remind participants to bring pencils of various shades of grey, as the sketching workshop will focus on capturing subtle gradations of light. （应用文·通知）
Raising one hand to shade her eyes against the blinding glare, she scanned the endless dunes for any sign of the caravan that should have arrived hours ago. （读后续写·沙漠·动作描写）

wordForms.other: 易混辨析·shade（成片、无固定形状的阴凉/色度）≠ shadow（某物投下的、有轮廓的影子）：sit in the shade 坐在阴凉处 vs. my shadow on the wall 墙上我的影子; shades（复数）口语指"太阳镜"(= sunglasses)，也指 shades of meaning 细微差别; shady adj. 成荫的/可疑的(a shady deal)，shadowy adj. 朦胧的/模糊的

idioms.idiom: put / leave sb. / sth. in the shade
idioms.example: I tried hard, but her work puts mine in the shade. 我费了很大力气，但她的成果让我相形见绌。（课件原句作 put / leave，主语 her work 为第三人称单数，规范作 puts / leaves；另比较 put sb/sth to shame 使……羞愧/相形见绌）

idioms.idiom: put sb. / sth. in the shade
idioms.example: Her breathtaking final performance put every other contestant in the shade, and even the judges rose to applaud. （读后续写·比赛·惊艳）
The boy's fearless dive from the cliff had shades of his late grandfather, a fisherman who had never once flinched at the sea. （读后续写·传承·联想）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在阴凉处，在……的树荫下（n. 阴凉处、树荫）
collocations.example: We sat down in the shade of the wall. 我们坐在墙的阴凉处。 / The temperature can reach 40°C in the shade. 阴凉处气温可高达40摄氏度。
The trees provide shade for the animals in the summer. 夏天这些树为动物提供阴凉。

collocations.translation: 【课件】明暗层次，光影（n. 阴影）
collocations.example: The painting needs more light and shade. 这幅画需要更多的明暗层次。

collocations.phrase: a shade of blue / a shade of + 颜色
collocations.translation: 【课件】一种（蓝）色调（n. 色度、色调）
collocations.example: a delicate / soft shade of blue 淡淡的柔和的蓝色 / His car was painted an unusual shade of blue. 他的车被漆成了一种不寻常的蓝色。

collocations.translation: 在阴凉处（课堂必背，注意 the）
collocations.example: The old men sat in the shade of a big tree. 老人们坐在大树的阴凉下。
The sky turned a deep shade of purple. 天空变成了深紫色。

collocations.translation: 意义上的细微差别（熟词僻义·shades of）
collocations.example: One word can carry many shades of meaning. 一个词能承载许多细微的意义差别。

collocations.translation: 略微，一点点（a shade = 稍微）
collocations.example: Her voice was a shade softer than usual. 她的声音比平时略微轻柔了些。

collocations.translation: 灰色的深浅；（引申）中间地带
collocations.example: Life, he had come to understand, was rarely black and white but composed of countless shades of grey. （议论文·辩证思考）
The trees we plant today will one day offer shade to strangers we shall never meet. （应用文·倡议·植树）
She shaded her eyes with a trembling hand and finally spotted her son's small figure among the returning crowd. （读后续写·团聚·动作）
He pulled down the window shade, and the harsh afternoon light dissolved into a soft amber hush. （读后续写·氛围营造）

collocations.translation: 明与暗，光影（课文原句同款）
collocations.example: I wondered at how they played with light and shade. 我惊叹于他们如何驾驭光与影。

synonyms.example: As the sun sank, the long shadow of the lighthouse stretched across the beach like a finger pointing home. （读后续写·风景·比喻）
synonyms.usage: shadow 指某物体投下的具体轮廓阴影(有形状);shade 指整片没有阳光的阴凉区域(无固定形状),两者不可混用

synonyms.example: A faint tint of pink crept into her pale cheeks as the compliment sank in. （读后续写·人物神态）
synonyms.usage: tint 侧重加入少量颜色形成的淡淡色彩,多指浅色;shade 侧重颜色的明暗深浅,可深可浅

synonyms.example: The autumn forest blazed in every hue of gold and crimson. （读后续写·秋景·文学化）
synonyms.usage: hue 为文学、正式用语,泛指某种颜色本身,常用于描写绚丽景色;shade 更强调同一颜色的深浅变化

advancedExpressions.expression: in the shade (of); light and shade; a shade of + colour; shades of grey / meaning; provide / offer shade; shade one's eyes
advancedExpressions.example: Under the tree's welcome shade, she studied the painter's play of light and shade. 在大树宜人的阴凉下，她端详着画家对光影的驾驭。（一词三义连成串：阴凉/光影/色度）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·a shade 作状语表"略微"
advancedExpressions.expression: a shade + 比较级/形容词/副词 = 稍微一点（= a little / slightly）
advancedExpressions.example: The second version is a shade better than the first. 第二版比第一版稍好一点。（a shade 修饰比较级，等于 a bit，写细腻程度差异很地道）

advancedExpressions.expression: sunlight and shade played across ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the breeze stirred the leaves overhead, sunlight and shade played across her upturned face, and for one weightless moment all her worries seemed to drift away. （光影动态描写+情绪烘托,续写过渡段）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a tree offers shade to others, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a tree offers shade to travellers it will never know, so too can a small act of kindness bring comfort to strangers far beyond our sight. （类比论证,倡议书升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: life is not black and white but a spectrum of shades
advancedExpressions.example: Life is not painted in black and white but in a spectrum of shades, and wisdom lies in recognising the grey that stretches between every extreme. （比喻+辩证,论证复杂性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They rested in the shade of a tree.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath the sprawling canopy of an old plane tree, the weary travellers sank into its welcoming shade, and the fierce noonday heat gave way to a coolness that felt almost like mercy. （读后续写·环境+感受）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 介词短语前置(Beneath ...)营造画面 + 拟人(welcoming shade)+ give way to 转折 + 明喻(like mercy)传递情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The painting used light and dark well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What struck me was how deftly the artist wove light and shade together, so that the dim corner of the room seemed to hold its breath while a single shaft of gold spilled across the sleeping child. （读后续写·艺术鉴赏）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What struck me was how ... 名词性从句强调 + weave together 动词升级 + 拟人(hold its breath)+ 意象(shaft of gold)营造画面

classPractice.question: 夏天这些树为动物提供阴凉。The trees ____ ____ ____ the animals in the summer.
classPractice.note: 【课件】provide shade for = 为……提供阴凉；shade 此处为不可数名词（阴凉处、树荫）。

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·明暗层次）
classPractice.question: 这幅画需要更多的明暗层次。The painting needs more ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 【课件】light and shade 明暗层次/光影，正是课文谈画时的固定表达。

classPractice.question: 用 shade 或 shadow 填空：Exhausted from the heat, we rested in the ____ of a tall tree, watching our long ____ stretch across the grass.
classPractice.note: shade 指成片阴凉（无形状），shadow 指有轮廓的影子；本词高考易混核心。

classPractice.question: A skilful writer can convey the finest ____ (shade) of emotion, so that a single glance carries both longing and reproach.
classPractice.note: shades of meaning/emotion 表"细微差别"，常用复数，熟词僻义。

classPractice.question: 她的声音比平时略微轻柔了些。Her voice was ____ ____ ____ than usual.
classPractice.note: a shade + 比较级 = 稍微……一点（= a little/slightly）。

translation: 以（光线）照射，沐浴，使浸满（在光线里），用水洗
original_sentence: I enjoyed the whole experience—to be able to bathe my senses in this palace of human creativity.
readingExamples: I enjoyed the whole experience—to be able to bathe my senses in this palace of human creativity.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to cover or surround something completely, especially with light, warmth, or colour
(2) vt./vi. to wash oneself or another person in water; to swim for pleasure (esp. British English)
(3) vt. to wash a wound or part of the body gently with liquid
(4) vt. (be bathed in) to be soaked or covered in something such as sweat, tears, or sunlight

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （光线、色彩）笼罩，沐浴（熟词僻义，读后续写描写常用）
uncommonMeanings.example: At dawn the whole valley was bathed in a soft golden light, and the frost on the rooftops glittered like a thousand tiny stars. （读后续写·晨景·环境描写）

posExamples.sentence: As the setting sun bathed the mountaintop in molten amber, the exhausted climbers stood in reverent silence, feeling that every drop of sweat had been worth this fleeting, breathtaking reward. （读后续写·登顶·景色升华）
I shall never forget how the great hall of the museum was bathed in light, and how I longed to bathe my senses in that boundless palace of human creativity. （读后续写·参观·感悟）
On behalf of the organising committee, I sincerely invite you to visit our lantern festival, where the ancient streets will be bathed in the warm glow of a thousand handmade lamps. （应用文·邀请信）

A room bathed in natural sunlight, researchers argue, can lift the human spirit far more effectively than any artificial lamp, reminding us how deeply our well-being is tied to the rhythms of nature. （议论文·健康与环境）

wordForms.other: 易混拼写与发音·bath n. /bɑːθ/ 洗澡（名词，词尾 -th 清音）≠ bathe v. /beɪð/ 沐浴/浸/照射（动词，加 -e 后元音变 /eɪ/、-the 浊音）; bather n. 洗浴者/游泳者; be bathed in 为最常考被动结构，主语是被光/汗/泪"覆盖"之物

idioms.example: By the time he crossed the finish line, bathed in sweat and gasping for breath, the roar of the crowd had melted into a single triumphant blur. （读后续写·比赛·拼搏）
Her face bathed in tears, the old woman clutched the faded photograph as if it were the last thread binding her to a vanished world. （读后续写·思念·悲伤）

collocations.phrase: bathe ... in a silver light / be bathed in sunlight
collocations.translation: 【课件】（光线）洒满，使沐浴在（光线中）（v. 熟词僻义）
collocations.example: The moon bathed the countryside in a silver light. 月光下的乡村沐浴在一片银辉中。 / The valley was bathed in sunlight. 山谷沐浴着阳光。
The lamp behind him seems to bathe him in warmth. 他身后的灯光似乎将他笼罩在一片温暖之中。
The athlete was bathed in sweat. 这名运动员汗流浃背。

collocations.translation: 【课件】把……浸泡在（盐水）中；清洗（v. 浸泡）
collocations.example: Bathe the infected area in a salt solution. 用盐水浸泡感染部位。

collocations.translation: 沐浴在（阳）光中（课堂王牌，读后续写高频）
collocations.example: The whole valley was bathed in golden light. 整个山谷沐浴在金色的阳光中。

collocations.translation: 让感官沉浸于……（课文原句同款）
collocations.example: I was able to bathe my senses in this palace of creativity. 我得以让感官沉浸在这座创造力的殿堂里。
The setting sun bathed the hills in amber. 落日将群山笼罩在琥珀色中。
He woke bathed in sweat, his heart still racing. 他满身是汗地醒来，心还在狂跳。
She gently bathed the child's grazed knee. 她轻轻清洗孩子擦破的膝盖。
Every summer dawn, the villagers would bathe in the cool river before the heat of the day set in. （读后续写·乡村生活）

collocations.phrase: be bathed in a warm glow
collocations.example: The little cottage, bathed in a warm glow from within, promised weary travellers the comfort of home. （读后续写·归途·温情）

synonyms.example: She immersed herself so completely in the novel that the ringing of the school bell startled her back into reality. （读后续写·专注）
synonyms.usage: immerse 侧重(把某物/自己)整个浸入液体或某种状态,常搭配 in;bathe 更诗意,尤指被光、色、情绪温柔笼罩

synonyms.example: As she opened the curtains, sunlight flooded the room and, with it, a sudden, inexplicable surge of hope. （读后续写·情绪转折）
synonyms.usage: flood 强调大量迅速地涌入、充满,动感强、气势大;bathe 更柔和,强调温柔而均匀地覆盖

synonyms.example: The sudden downpour drenched them to the skin, yet they laughed like children splashing through the puddles. （读后续写·雨中·情绪）
synonyms.usage: drench 专指被水/汗完全浸湿,程度重、偏具象;bathe 可具象(水)也可抽象(光、情绪),用法更雅

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·光影沐浴（读后续写景物模板）
advancedExpressions.expression: be bathed in light / sunlight / a warm glow; bathe sth in gold / crimson; bathe one's senses in sth
advancedExpressions.example: At dusk the meadow was bathed in a soft golden light. 黄昏时分，草地沐浴在柔和的金光中。（一组"沐浴"表达，景物升华万能句）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"被光/情绪笼罩"
advancedExpressions.expression: be bathed in ≈ be flooded with ≈ be steeped in ≈ be drenched in ≈ be immersed in
advancedExpressions.example: The room was bathed in / flooded with morning sunlight. 房间沐浴在／充满了晨光。（bathe 最柔和诗意，flood 更有气势，写景可换用避免重复）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb./sth. was bathed in ..., as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The whole meadow was bathed in the tender light of dusk, as if the day were reluctant to let go of its final, golden breath. （被动+as if 拟人,续写景物升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: come and let ... be bathed in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Come and let your evening be bathed in the glow of paper lanterns and the laughter of old friends — an experience no photograph could ever capture. （邀请信,let 祈使+破折号升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as sunlight bathes and nourishes, so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as sunlight bathes and nourishes every living thing without discrimination, so genuine kindness ought to be extended to all, regardless of how little we know them. （类比论证,升华主旨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The room was full of sunlight.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The little attic was bathed in the honeyed light of late afternoon, and dust motes drifted through the golden air like tiny weightless dreams, unhurried and content. （读后续写·环境+意象）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be bathed in 被动升级 + 通感(honeyed light)+ 明喻(like tiny weightless dreams)+ 形容词后置(unhurried and content)

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was covered in sweat after the race.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As he staggered across the line, bathed in sweat and trembling in every limb, a wave of fierce, tearful pride washed over him — he had, against everyone's doubts, finished. （读后续写·拼搏+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: bathed in sweat 分词状语 + 并列描写(trembling in every limb)+ 隐喻(a wave ... washed over)+ 破折号插入强调

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·光线洒满）
classPractice.question: 月光下的乡村沐浴在一片银辉中。The moon ____ the countryside ____ a silver light.
classPractice.note: 【课件】bathe ... in ... =（光线）洒满、笼罩；主动结构主语是光源（月亮）。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·汗流浃背）
classPractice.question: The athlete ____ (bathe) in sweat after the race, but a proud smile spread across his face.
classPractice.note: 【课件】be bathed in sweat 汗流浃背；主语（运动员）被汗"覆盖"，用被动。

classPractice.question: At dawn the whole valley ____ (bathe) in a soft golden light, and the frost on the rooftops glittered like tiny stars.
classPractice.note: be bathed in 被动结构（山谷被光"沐浴"）；主句时态用一般过去时。

classPractice.question: 过了终点线时，他满身是汗，气喘吁吁。As he crossed the line, he ____ ____ ____ ____ and gasping for breath.
classPractice.note: be bathed in sweat/tears 固定表达；此处也可作 bathed in sweat 分词状语。

classPractice.question: 选 bath 或 bathe：After the long hike, all I wanted was a hot ____; then I could ____ my aching feet in warm water.
classPractice.note: bath 名词/bɑːθ/（一次洗澡），bathe 动词/beɪð/（浸洗）；拼写+词性双考。

original_sentence: How was it possible, I wondered, to truly appreciate the human touch of a great painting when it was reduced to a few million pixels?
readingExamples: How was it possible, I wondered, to truly appreciate the human touch of a great painting when it was reduced to a few million pixels?
definitionEn:
(1) n. the smallest unit of a digital image or display screen, one of the many tiny dots that together make up a picture
(2) n. (in imaging technology) a single point of colour information used to measure the resolution or clarity of a screen or photograph

posExamples.sentence: Staring at the reproduction on his phone, he wondered how anyone could truly feel the human warmth of a great painting once it had been flattened into a few million cold, lifeless pixels. （读后续写·科技反思·艺术）

As she zoomed in on the old family photo, the beloved faces dissolved into a blur of pixels, and with them, it seemed, dissolved a little more of the past she was desperate to hold on to. （读后续写·怀旧·情感）
In our poster we hope to remind visitors that no matter how many pixels a screen boasts, a digital copy can never replace the trembling brushstroke of a real painting. （应用文·倡议/说明）

However dazzling the resolution, an image built from pixels remains a pale imitation of reality; technology can multiply the dots on a screen, yet it cannot manufacture the soul that a human hand leaves behind. （议论文·科技与艺术）

wordForms.other: 构词法·pixel 是混成词(blend)，由 pix(= pictures 图片) + el(= element 元素) 拼合而成，意为"图像元素"，即数字图像的最小单位; megapixel n. 百万像素(mega- 百万); pixelate v. 使马赛克化/使呈像素状

collocations.translation: 数百万像素（课文原句同款）
collocations.example: The painting was reduced to a few million pixels on the screen. 那幅画在屏幕上被简化成几百万像素。
A masterpiece cannot be reduced to mere pixels. 一件杰作无法被简化为区区像素。
They scanned the old mural pixel by pixel. 他们一个像素一个像素地扫描那幅古壁画。
Zoom in far enough and even the most breathtaking photograph collapses into a meaningless grid of pixels. （议论文·科技·论证）
Higher pixel resolution may sharpen an image, but it cannot deepen the emotion behind it. （议论文·科技局限）
Even the crispest high-resolution pixels fail to convey the faint scent of oil paint and the texture that greets you inches from the canvas. （应用文·展览说明）

synonyms.example: Up close, the newspaper photograph revealed itself as thousands of tiny black dots. （议论文·印刷·说明）
synonyms.usage: dot 是日常、通俗的“点”,泛指任何小圆点;pixel 专指数字图像/屏幕的最小成像单位,是科技术语

synonyms.example: The mosaic was assembled from countless points of colour, each meaningless alone yet magnificent together. （读后续写·艺术·哲思）
synonyms.usage: 描述性短语,强调“彩色的点”,可用于铺垫“整体大于部分”的哲理;pixel 更技术化、无情感色彩

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·像素·数字图像（科技反思主题）
advancedExpressions.expression: millions of pixels; be reduced to (mere) pixels; a blur / grid of pixels; pixel by pixel; pixel resolution
advancedExpressions.example: On a screen, the great canvas was reduced to a few million cold pixels. 在屏幕上，那幅巨作被简化成几百万个冰冷的像素。（数字复制 vs 真迹主题串联）

advancedExpressions.expression: reduced to mere pixels, ... lost ...
advancedExpressions.example: Reduced to mere pixels on a glowing screen, the ancient portrait lost the very presence that had made his heart race in the hushed gallery. （分词短语前置+对比,续写反思段）

advancedExpressions.expression: no number of pixels can replace ...
advancedExpressions.example: No number of pixels, however dazzling, can replace the quiet thrill of standing before a real masterpiece, so I warmly urge you to put down your phones and simply look. （倡议信,让步+呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: a screen may multiply pixels, but it cannot ...
advancedExpressions.example: A screen may multiply its pixels endlessly, but it cannot multiply meaning; genuine art speaks to the soul, and the soul has never been measured in dots. （转折+格言式收尾,论证科技局限）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The picture became blurry when I zoomed in.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment I zoomed in, the cherished image splintered into a chaos of pixels, and the smiling face I had loved for years dissolved, quite literally, before my eyes. （读后续写·怀旧+失落）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment ... 时间状语 + 动词升级(splinter, dissolve)+ quite literally 插入强调 + 情感与画面结合

sentenceUpgrade.original: A digital copy is not as good as the real painting.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: However many pixels a digital copy may boast, it remains a hollow echo of the original, for no screen has yet learned to reproduce the living breath of a painter's hand. （议论文·科技与艺术）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: However + 形容词/名词 让步状语 + 比喻(hollow echo)+ for 引导原因 + 拟人(learned to reproduce)

classPractice.question: 无论屏幕吹嘘有多少像素，数字复制品都无法取代真正的画作。However many ____ a screen boasts, a digital copy can never ____ a real painting.
classPractice.note: pixel 为可数名词，此处用复数 pixels；replace 表"取代"（若要四个空可用 take the place of）。

classPractice.question: The restorer scanned the damaged mural pixel by ____ (pixel), determined not to lose a single fleck of the original colour.
classPractice.note: pixel by pixel 固定搭配，名词重复无冠词，意为"一个像素一个像素地"。

classPractice.question: 再高的分辨率也无法传达一位画家笔触所留下的鲜活气息。（no ... resolution / pixels）
classPractice.answer: No resolution / No number of pixels, however high, can convey the living breath left by a painter's brushstroke.
classPractice.note: 考 pixel/resolution 语境 + however + 形容词让步，科技与艺术议论文金句。

translation: vt. 开始，发动 | n. （通常指按周领的）工资，工钱
original_sentence: Amsterdam’s Rijksmuseum, for example, has waged the Big Draw campaign, where visitors are encouraged to keep their smartphones in their pockets or bags and pick up paper and pencils instead.
readingExamples: Amsterdam’s Rijksmuseum, for example, has waged the Big Draw campaign, where visitors are encouraged to keep their smartphones in their pockets or bags and pick up paper and pencils instead.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a regular payment made to an employee, especially a manual or unskilled worker, usually paid weekly for work done
(2) n. (wages) the amount of money earned for labour, often used in the plural
(3) vt. to begin and carry on a war, campaign, or struggle over a period of time
(4) n. (figurative) the outcome or consequence that something inevitably brings about

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 发动，开展（战争、运动、斗争）（熟词僻义，高考爱考）
uncommonMeanings.example: Refusing to surrender to despair, the small mountain village waged a quiet but relentless campaign against poverty, one road and one school at a time. （读后续写·脱贫·奋斗）

posExamples.sentence: For three long years the young doctor waged a lonely war against an epidemic everyone else had chosen to ignore, and when the last patient finally walked free, she wept for the first time. （读后续写·抗争·奉献）
The old miner had spent forty years underground for a meagre weekly wage, yet he carried himself with a dignity that no fortune could have bought. （读后续写·人物·尊严）
On behalf of the workers, I am writing to appeal for a fairer wage, one that reflects the long hours and genuine dedication our staff pour into their work each day. （应用文·申诉信）
Governments across the world are now waging an urgent campaign against plastic pollution, for the battle to save our oceans is one that no single nation can win alone. （议论文·环保·论证）

wordForms.other: 一词两义·wage n. 工资(按周/时，多蓝领) / v. 发动、开展(war/campaign/battle)，两义拼写相同; wages 复数=(某人的)工资总额; wage-earner n. 工薪阶层; 辨析·wage(周薪/时薪·蓝领·体力) vs. salary(月薪/年薪·白领·脑力) vs. pay(泛指报酬) vs. income(总收入)

idioms.example: The community waged war on the litter that had choked its once-beautiful river, and within a year the fish had begun to return. （读后续写·环保·成效）
Every honest worker, the pamphlet argued, deserves at the very least a living wage. （议论文·社会公平）

collocations.translation: 向……开战；发起斗争（熟词僻义·动词，高考爱考）
collocations.example: The country waged war on poverty. 这个国家向贫困宣战。

collocations.translation: 对……发起运动（课文原句同款）
collocations.example: The museum has waged the Big Draw campaign. 该博物馆发起了"大绘画"运动。

collocations.translation: 最低工资（名词，注意 the）
collocations.example: The government raised the minimum wage last year. 政府去年上调了最低工资。

collocations.translation: 体面的／公平的／能维持生活的工资
collocations.example: Every honest worker deserves a living wage. 每一个诚实的劳动者都应得一份能维持生活的工资。

collocations.translation: 周薪／月薪（工资常用复数 wages）
collocations.example: Her weekly wages barely lasted to month's end. 她的周薪勉强撑到月底。
Long after her diagnosis, she went on waging a courageous battle against the illness, refusing to let it define who she was. （读后续写·抗病·坚韧）
He worked two jobs simply to earn a wage large enough to keep his younger sister in school. （读后续写·亲情·牺牲）
News of the sudden wage cuts spread through the factory like a cold wind, silencing even the cheeriest of the workers. （读后续写·困境·氛围）

collocations.translation: 打口水仗，展开激烈争论
collocations.example: The two candidates waged a bitter war of words that shed far more heat than light. （议论文·辩论）

synonyms.translation: 薪水（通常按月发放，多指白领）
synonyms.example: Turning down a handsome salary in the city, he chose instead to teach for a modest wage in the mountains. （读后续写·抉择·奉献）
synonyms.usage: salary 通常按月/年支付,多指脑力/白领工作,较正式;wage 通常按周/时支付,多指体力/蓝领劳动,续写中用 wage 更能刻画底层劳动者

synonyms.example: The school launched a campaign to encourage students to read a book a week. （应用文·活动·发起）
synonyms.usage: 作动词与 wage 近义时,launch 侧重“启动、开始”一个活动/运动,中性;wage 强调“持续进行”一场战争或斗争,更有对抗、艰苦意味

synonyms.example: The organisation conducted a nationwide campaign to raise awareness of ocean pollution. （议论文·正式）
synonyms.usage: conduct 为正式书面语,指有组织地开展某活动,中性客观;wage 带有斗争、对抗的情感色彩,多搭配 war/battle/campaign against

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·发动斗争（动词义，熟词僻义）
advancedExpressions.expression: wage war / a campaign / a battle / a struggle (on / against sth); wage a war of words
advancedExpressions.example: The whole town waged a relentless campaign against pollution. 全镇发起了一场坚持不懈的反污染运动。（wage 后接 war/campaign/battle，写抗争主题必备）

advancedExpressions.expression: the minimum / a living / a fair / a decent wage; earn / pay a wage; weekly wages; wage cuts / rises
advancedExpressions.example: He labours from dawn to dusk for a meagre weekly wage. 他从早到晚辛劳，只为微薄的周薪。（写底层劳动者用 wage 比 salary 更贴切）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. waged a quiet / lonely war against ...
advancedExpressions.example: Long after others had given up, she went on waging a quiet war against her own doubts, and it was this invisible battle, more than any medal, that made her a champion. （比喻内心斗争+对比,续写升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us wage a campaign against ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us wage a determined campaign against waste on campus, so that every drop of water and every grain of rice is treated with the respect it deserves. （倡议书,let us 号召+目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: the war we wage against ... is ultimately a war for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The war we wage against pollution is, in the end, a war for the very future of our children — and it is a war we simply cannot afford to lose. （同源结构+破折号升华,论证紧迫性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The village tried hard to fight poverty.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Against overwhelming odds, the tiny village waged a stubborn, decades-long war on poverty, and though progress came drop by drop, not one family was left behind. （读后续写·脱贫·坚韧）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Against overwhelming odds 状语前置 + wage war on 升级动词短语 + 形容词叠加(stubborn, decades-long)+ drop by drop 副词性短语+ 情感收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: Workers should be paid a fair wage.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is only just that those who toil from dawn to dusk should receive a wage worthy of their effort, for no society can call itself civilised while it rewards honest labour with hardship. （议论文·社会公平）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is only just that 正式主句 + from dawn to dusk 对仗时间状语 + worthy of 高级搭配 + for 引导原因 + 反讽收尾(civilised ... hardship)

classPractice.question: For three long years the young doctor ____ (wage) a lonely war against an epidemic everyone else had chosen to ignore.
classPractice.note: wage war/a campaign against 表"发动、开展"，熟词僻义动词，用过去时。

classPractice.question: 选 wage 或 salary：Turning down a handsome ____ in the city, he chose to teach in the mountains for a modest ____.
classPractice.note: salary 按月/年、白领、较正式；wage 按周/时、蓝领；写抉择对比。

classPractice.question: 支持者认为，提高最低工资会立刻让无数家庭摆脱困境。（the minimum wage）
classPractice.answer: Supporters argue that raising the minimum wage would (immediately) lift countless families out of hardship (overnight).
classPractice.note: 考 the minimum wage 固定搭配 + would 虚拟语气，社会话题议论文句。

translation: n. （政治或商业性）活动，运动，战役 | vt. & vi. 发起运动，参加活动
original_sentence: Amsterdam’s Rijksmuseum, for example, has waged the Big Draw campaign, where visitors are encouraged to keep their smartphones in their pockets or bags and pick up paper and pencils instead.
readingExamples: Amsterdam’s Rijksmuseum, for example, has waged the Big Draw campaign, where visitors are encouraged to keep their smartphones in their pockets or bags and pick up paper and pencils instead.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a planned series of activities carried out over a period of time to achieve a particular social, political, or commercial aim
(2) n. a series of military operations intended to achieve a large-scale objective during a war
(3) vi. to take part in or lead a series of organised actions in order to achieve a goal, especially a social or political one
(4) vi. to seek election or public support by campaigning

posExamples.sentence: Inspired by the flooded streets of her hometown, the girl launched a one-person campaign to plant trees along the riverbank, never dreaming that within a year the whole town would join her. （读后续写·环保·感召）
The museum's Big Draw campaign, which urged visitors to swap their smartphones for paper and pencils, quietly reminded us all how much we lose when we experience beauty through a screen. （读后续写·科技反思）
On behalf of the student union, I am writing to invite you to join our campaign against food waste, an initiative that has already saved our canteen tonnes of perfectly good food. （应用文·倡议信）
Those who campaign tirelessly for a cause greater than themselves remind us that real change is rarely handed down from above; more often, it is fought for, inch by inch, from below. （议论文·社会变革）

wordForms.other: 拼写提醒·campaign 中间的 -aig- 不发音的 g 是易错点(同 foreign, sign, design 的"哑音 g"家族); campaigner n. 活动家/参加运动者; campaign for/against 介词搭配是高考填空点：for 表"为了争取"，against 表"反对"

collocations.translation: 发起一场运动（课堂必背）
collocations.example: The students launched a campaign to save water. 学生们发起了一场节水运动。

collocations.translation: 开展／组织一场运动（课文原句同款 wage）
collocations.example: The museum has waged the Big Draw campaign. 该博物馆发起了"大绘画"运动。
They started a campaign against littering. 他们发起了一场反对乱扔垃圾的运动。

collocations.phrase: a campaign for / to do sth
collocations.example: She joined a campaign for cleaner air. 她加入了一场争取更清洁空气的运动。
A clever publicity campaign drew hundreds of first-time visitors to the small-town gallery. （应用文·活动·宣传）
I warmly encourage every classmate to join this campaign, for even the smallest hand can help lift a heavy load. （应用文·倡议·呼吁）
What began as a handful of volunteers soon gained such momentum that the campaign spread to a dozen neighbouring towns. （读后续写·壮大）
The senator's election campaign hinged entirely on his promise to protect the region's vanishing forests. （议论文·政治）

synonyms.example: What had started as a single protest gradually swelled into a nationwide movement for cleaner air. （议论文·社会变革）
synonyms.usage: movement 指规模大、持续久、参与者众多的自发社会思潮或运动,较抽象;campaign 更强调有组织、有明确目标和期限的具体活动

synonyms.example: The school's recycling drive collected over a tonne of paper in a single week. （应用文·活动）
synonyms.usage: drive 指为达成某具体目标而集中开展的短期活动(常搭配 recycling/charity/fund-raising),较口语;campaign 规模更大、更正式,时间跨度更长

synonyms.example: He turned his personal grief into a lifelong crusade against drink-driving. （读后续写·信念·升华）
synonyms.usage: crusade 带有强烈道德使命感和个人激情,常指为正义事业奋不顾身地长期奋斗;campaign 更中性,可指商业、政治或公益等各类活动

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·运动/活动（发起→加入→壮大）
advancedExpressions.expression: launch / start / wage / run a campaign; a campaign for / against / to do sth; join / support a campaign; a campaign gains momentum
advancedExpressions.example: What began as a one-person campaign soon gained momentum across the whole town. 起初一个人的运动很快在全镇形成声势。（一整套"运动"动词，环保/公益作文核心）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·发起一场活动
advancedExpressions.expression: launch / start / wage / mount / spearhead a campaign; set a movement in motion
advancedExpressions.example: The school mounted a campaign to cut food waste. 学校发起了一场减少食物浪费的运动。（launch 最常用，wage 更有斗争色彩，避免重复可换 mount/spearhead）

advancedExpressions.expression: what began as ... soon grew into a campaign that ...
advancedExpressions.example: What began as one girl sweeping a single beach soon grew into a campaign that swept an entire coastline clean — and swept away, too, the town's long indifference. （对比+一词双关(swept),续写壮大升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: I sincerely call on you to join our campaign to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely call on every one of you to join our campaign to protect the campus's ancient trees, for they are living witnesses to the memories of generations. （倡议信,call on sb. to do+原因升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: no campaign, however well-funded, can succeed unless ...
advancedExpressions.example: No campaign, however well-funded or well-publicised, can truly succeed unless it first wins the hearts of ordinary people, for lasting change is built not on slogans but on conviction. （让步+条件,论证核心）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The students started a campaign to save water.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Alarmed by the dwindling reservoir, a handful of determined students launched a campaign to save every precious drop, and their quiet persistence soon shamed the whole school into action. （读后续写·环保·感召）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Alarmed by ... 过去分词状语交代动因 + launch a campaign 升级动词 + 拟人(shamed ... into action)+ 情感递进

sentenceUpgrade.original: This campaign is important and everyone should help.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This campaign is far too vital to be left to a devoted few; it deserves, and indeed demands, the wholehearted support of every member of our community. （议论文/应用文·呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: too ... to be left to ... 结构强调重要性 + 分号连接两分句 + and indeed 递进插入 + wholehearted 高级修饰增强号召力

classPractice.question: 用 for 或 against 填空：They launched a campaign ____ food waste and a separate campaign ____ cleaner drinking water.
classPractice.note: campaign against 反对某事；campaign for 为争取某事，介词搭配定语义。

classPractice.question: Fired up by the documentary, the students ____ (launch) a campaign to rid their school of single-use plastics.
classPractice.note: launch a campaign 固定搭配；由 fired up（过去分词状语）定过去时。

classPractice.question: 我真诚地呼吁每一位同学加入我们保护古树的运动。I sincerely call on every classmate to ____ ____ ____ to protect the ancient trees.
classPractice.note: join a campaign + 不定式表目的；倡议信高频句式。

translation: 建筑设计，建筑，建筑风格，建筑学
original_sentence: The national museum is hoping to help visitors discover and appreciate the beauty of art, architecture and history through drawing.
readingExamples: The national museum is hoping to help visitors discover and appreciate the beauty of art, architecture and history through drawing.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the art or science of designing and constructing buildings
(2) n. the style or manner in which buildings are designed and built, especially as characteristic of a period or place
(3) n. the complex or carefully designed structure of something (e.g. a system, an organism, a piece of software)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (系统、计算机等的)体系结构，架构
uncommonMeanings.example: As she traced the intricate architecture of the ancient computer, the young engineer marvelled at how a design conceived decades ago still governed the machine's every heartbeat. （读后续写·科技探索·致敬前人）

posExamples.sentence: As dawn broke over the old town, the crumbling architecture came alive — sunlight slid down weathered columns and pooled in courtyards where a hundred generations had once walked. （读后续写·古城探访·环境描写）

I am writing to recommend that our class visit the Suzhou Museum, whose award-winning architecture blends classical gardens with sleek modern lines and would surely deepen everyone's appreciation of design. （应用文·建议信）
Fine architecture is never mere decoration; it is a nation's memory cast in stone, silently telling later generations who we were and what we dared to dream. （议论文·文化传承）
Standing beneath the soaring dome, the exchange students fell silent, for the sheer grandeur of the architecture had swept away every word they had prepared. （读后续写·参观游览·情感）

wordForms.other: 词族·architecture n. 建筑/建筑学(不可数抽象概念) — architect n. 建筑师(可数，注意末尾 -ct，读 /ˈɑːkɪtekt/) — architectural adj. 建筑(上)的 — architecturally adv. 在建筑上; 辨析·architecture(不可数，指建筑艺术/风格) ≠ building(可数，指一栋具体的房子)，不可说 an architecture 表"一栋楼"; 构词法·archi-(总/主) + tect(建造，同 -tecture)

collocations.translation: 建筑之美（课文原句同款）
collocations.example: The museum helps visitors appreciate the beauty of architecture. 博物馆帮助参观者欣赏建筑之美。
The city blends modern architecture with classical facades. 这座城市把现代建筑与古典外墙融为一体。
The cathedral is a masterpiece of architecture. 这座大教堂是一件建筑杰作。
She dreams of majoring in architecture. 她梦想主修建筑学。
We must act now to preserve our ancient architecture. 我们必须现在就行动保护古建筑。
Thanks to thoughtful landscape architecture, the campus feels less like a cluster of buildings than a living garden that changes with every season. （应用文·校园介绍）
Each pavilion is a distinct piece of architecture, yet together they form a harmonious whole that rewards the patient observer. （议论文·艺术审美）
The city cleverly weaves gleaming modern architecture into streets lined with classical facades, so that the old and the new seem to converse across the centuries. （议论文·城市发展）
Wandering through the alleys, I was struck by how the traditional architecture — grey-tiled roofs and carved wooden eaves — carried the quiet dignity of a bygone age. （读后续写·文化体验）

synonyms.example: The building on the corner had stood empty for years, its shattered windows staring blankly at the passers-by. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: building 指具体的一栋房子(可数、实体);architecture 是不可数的抽象概念,指建筑的艺术、风格或学科,不能说 'an architecture' 表示一栋楼

synonyms.example: The bridge is an astonishing structure, its steel cables stretched like the strings of a giant harp across the river. （议论文·工程成就）
synonyms.usage: structure 泛指任何被建造出来的实体或抽象的结构体系;architecture 更强调设计的艺术性与风格

synonyms.example: The award went to a design so bold that even seasoned critics gasped when the model was unveiled. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: design 指设计的构思与方案(过程或成果);architecture 侧重建筑领域的整体艺术与实体成果

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·建筑（欣赏·类型·保护·专业）
advancedExpressions.expression: the beauty of architecture; modern / classical / traditional architecture; a masterpiece / piece of architecture; preserve ancient architecture; major in architecture
advancedExpressions.example: Wandering the old town, I marvelled at the beauty of its traditional architecture. 漫步古镇，我惊叹于其传统建筑之美。（艺术/文化/游记主题串联）

advancedExpressions.expression: architect(建筑师) → architecture(建筑/建筑学) → architectural(建筑的) → architecturally(建筑上)
advancedExpressions.example: The architect's boldest work is an architecturally stunning museum. 这位建筑师最大胆的作品是一座建筑上令人惊叹的博物馆。（一族四词，词形转换高频考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: the very architecture seemed to ... , as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The very architecture seemed to hold its breath, as if the silent halls were waiting for the wanderer to remember something long forgotten. （拟人+as if虚拟，营造静谧氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: renowned for its ... architecture, ... is well worth a visit
advancedExpressions.example: Renowned for its distinctive Hui-style architecture, the ancient village is well worth a visit for anyone eager to touch history with their own eyes. （推荐信开门见山点出亮点）

advancedExpressions.expression: architecture is more than ...; it is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Architecture is more than bricks and beams; it is the crystallised wisdom of a civilisation, a language that speaks long after its builders have fallen silent.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old building was beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old building rose before us like a poem written in stone, its weathered architecture — every carved eave and moss-softened step — whispering tales of the countless lives that had passed beneath its arches. （读后续写·环境描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 明喻(like a poem written in stone) + 破折号插入细节(carved eave, moss-softened step) + 拟人(whispering tales)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect old architecture because it is important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that safeguarding our ancient architecture is not an act of nostalgia but a duty to the future, for these silent monuments anchor a nation's identity in an age too easily swept along by change. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that...正式主句 + not...but...对比结构 + for引导原因状语 + 抽象升华(anchor a nation's identity)

classPractice.question: The award-winning museum was designed by a famous ____ (architecture) whose ____ (architecture) style blends the ancient with the modern.
classPractice.note: 第一空需"建筑师"名词 architect；第二空修饰 style 用形容词 architectural。

classPractice.question: 选 architecture 或 building：Fine ____ is a nation's memory cast in stone, while a single ____ on the corner may stand empty for years.
classPractice.note: architecture 不可数（建筑艺术/风格）；building 可数（一栋具体的房子），高考易混。

classPractice.question: 除非我们现在行动保护古建筑，否则后代将只能继承褪色的照片。（preserve ... architecture）
classPractice.answer: Unless we act now to preserve our ancient architecture, future generations will inherit nothing but faded photographs.
classPractice.note: 考 preserve ancient architecture 搭配 + unless 条件句，文物保护议论文句。

translation: n. 烤面包片，吐司，干杯，祝酒 | vt. 为……干杯，烤，烘
original_sentence: Step 3: Arrange the vegetables on the toast to create your portrait.
readingExamples: Step 3: Arrange the vegetables on the toast to create your portrait.
definitionEn:
(1) n. sliced bread that has been made brown and crisp by heating it near a fire or in a toaster
(2) n. an act of raising your glass and drinking with others in honour of a person or event; the words spoken at such a moment
(3) vt. to make bread or other food brown and crisp by heating it
(4) vt. to raise your glass and drink in honour of somebody or something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 深受赞誉、备受追捧的人(the toast of...:某地/某界的红人)
uncommonMeanings.example: Overnight, the shy village girl who had spent her life sketching in silence became the toast of the art world, her name whispered in galleries she had never dared to enter. （读后续写·一夜成名·逆袭）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使(自己)取暖，烘烤(身体)
uncommonMeanings.example: Numb with cold, the survivors crouched by the fire and toasted their trembling hands, watching the flames chase the shadows back into the forest. （读后续写·荒野求生·环境）

posExamples.sentence: The kitchen smelled of warm toast and honey, and for one golden moment the ordinary morning felt like the safest place on earth. （读后续写·温馨日常·嗅觉描写）
Follow Step 3 carefully: arrange the vegetables on the toast to create your portrait, then toast the slice until its edges turn a crisp golden brown. （应用文·操作说明·食谱）
Raising his glass, the old teacher toasted the graduating class: 'To every dream you dared to chase — may the world be kinder to it than it was to mine.' （读后续写·毕业祝福·对话）
On behalf of the whole team, I would like to propose a toast to our volunteers, whose quiet dedication turned an ordinary charity sale into an unforgettable success. （应用文·致辞）

wordForms.other: 一词多义·toast n. 吐司/烤面包片(不可数，one slice of toast) & 祝酒/干杯 | v. 烤(面包) & 为……干杯; toaster n. 烤面包机; toasty adj. 暖烘烘的; 注意·作"面包"讲不可数，作"一次祝酒"讲可数(propose a toast)

synonyms.usage: organise 侧重把人、事、活动系统地组织协调起来(规模较大);arrange 更强调把具体事项/物品有序摆放或提前安排妥当

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·arrange 的句法三态
advancedExpressions.expression: arrange to do sth（约定自己做）/ arrange for sb to do sth（安排别人做，for 不可省）/ arrange that + 从句（从句常用 (should) do 虚拟）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'安排/组织/准备'

advancedExpressions.expression: having arranged ... with care, sb. ...

advancedExpressions.expression: we have arranged ... so that ...

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to your enthusiastic suggestion, we have carefully arranged a guided visit to the national museum, complete with an expert docent, so that our members may not merely see the exhibits but truly understand them. （应用文·通知信）

translation: 未加工的，自然状态的，生的，未煮过的
original_sentence: Making pictures out of raw materials like seashells can be a fun challenge.
readingExamples: Making pictures out of raw materials like seashells can be a fun challenge.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (of food) not cooked
(2) adj. in its natural state; not yet processed, treated or refined
(3) adj. (of feelings, emotions or a performance) strong, natural and not controlled or trained
(4) adj. (of skin or a wound) red and painful, especially because the surface has come off
(5) adj. (of weather) unpleasantly cold and damp

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①未加工的，原始的，天然状态的（raw materials 原材料；raw data 原始数据；raw sugar 原糖）
uncommonMeanings.example: A nation blessed with abundant raw materials but starved of innovation will, in the long run, find itself selling stones while others sell diamonds. （议论文·发展与创新）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（食物）生的，未煮过的（raw meat / fish / vegetables 生肉/生鱼/生菜）
uncommonMeanings.example: In some cultures, thin slices of raw fish are prized as a delicacy few outsiders dare to try. （议论文·饮食文化）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（情感、力量、表演）原始而强烈的，未经雕琢的（raw talent 未经雕琢的天赋；raw emotion 强烈真实的情感）
uncommonMeanings.example: There was a raw honesty in the boy's singing — no polish, no technique, only a grief so pure that the whole silent hall felt it as their own. （读后续写·才华初现·情感冲击）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（皮肤、伤口）擦破的，红肿疼痛的；（天气）阴冷潮湿的（rub sth raw 磨破；a raw November morning 阴冷的十一月清晨）
uncommonMeanings.example: His hands were rubbed raw from gripping the rope, yet through the raw, biting wind he climbed on, refusing to let the storm claim his brother. （读后续写·荒野求生·意志）

posExamples.sentence: Making pictures out of raw materials like seashells and driftwood can be a fun challenge, one that turns an ordinary beach afternoon into an unforgettable act of creation. （应用文·活动介绍）
As she stepped onto the stage, the judges sensed the raw talent radiating from a girl who had never taken a single lesson, only listened and dreamed. （读后续写·选秀·人物出场）
A nation blessed with abundant raw materials but starved of innovation will, in the long run, find itself selling stones while others sell diamonds. （议论文·发展与创新）
The fishermen returned at dusk, their faces raw from the icy wind, yet their eyes shone with the quiet pride of a hard day's honest work. （读后续写·劳动·环境描写）

wordForms.noun: rawness (n. 生涩，原始状态，未加工)
wordForms.adjective: raw (adj. 生的；未加工的；原始强烈的；擦破的)
wordForms.other: 反义：raw（生的/未加工）↔ cooked（煮熟的）/ processed / refined（加工提炼过的）；易混：raw 生的 ≠ row /rəʊ/ 一排（拼写形近音不同）

idioms.example: Convinced he had been given a raw deal, the boy clenched his fists — but then, remembering his mother's words, he chose to prove himself rather than complain. （读后续写·逆境·心理转变）
Her innocent question about his father touched a raw nerve, and for a moment the cheerful room fell into an aching silence. （读后续写·情感·矛盾）

idioms.translation: 处于原始/未经修饰的状态
idioms.example: Only in the wilderness, where survival is life in the raw, did the pampered teenager finally learn what truly mattered. （读后续写·成长·顿悟）

collocations.example: The workshop invites students to fashion art from raw materials — shells, pebbles and twigs — proving that beauty needs no price tag. （应用文·活动倡议）
What the coach saw was not a finished player but raw talent waiting, like ore in the earth, to be refined into gold. （读后续写·伯乐识才·比喻）

collocations.translation: 生肉 / 生鱼 / 生菜
collocations.example: In some cultures, thin slices of raw fish are prized as a delicacy, a taste that rewards those brave enough to try. （议论文·饮食文化）
Her diary, scrawled in the dead of night, laid bare a raw emotion that no polished essay could ever have captured. （读后续写·内心独白）

collocations.translation: 原始数据，未处理的数据
collocations.example: The raw data alone tell us little; only careful analysis can turn a wall of numbers into a story worth acting on. （议论文·科学方法）

collocations.phrase: rub sth raw / be rubbed raw
collocations.example: His palms were rubbed raw by the coarse rope, yet he tightened his grip, for below him a life hung in the balance. （读后续写·求生·意志）
The raw November morning bit at their cheeks, but the volunteers pressed on, planting sapling after sapling along the barren hillside. （读后续写·奉献·环境）

collocations.translation: 未经处理的污水 / 粗糖(原糖)
collocations.example: The factory was fined heavily for discharging raw sewage into the once-clear river. （议论文·环境保护）

synonyms.example: The chef insisted that the meat be served slightly uncooked in the centre to keep it tender. （记叙·烹饪）
synonyms.usage: uncooked 仅指食物未经烹煮(中性、直白);raw 除'生的'外还有'未加工的''原始强烈的''磨破的'等丰富含义,表现力更强

synonyms.example: She preferred natural ingredients, believing that nothing man-made could rival what the earth freely gave. （议论文·健康）
synonyms.usage: natural 强调'天然、非人造'(褒义常见);raw 强调'未经加工/提炼'的原始状态,可指材料、情感或天赋

synonyms.example: The price of crude oil sent shockwaves through markets across the globe. （议论文·经济）
synonyms.usage: crude 侧重'粗糙、未精炼'(常带贬义或指工业原料);raw 更中性,可指原材料,也可褒义指未经雕琢的真实才华或情感

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·raw 的四大高频义
advancedExpressions.expression: raw materials 原材料 / raw data 原始数据 / raw talent 未经雕琢的天赋 / raw emotion 强烈真实的情感 / rub sth raw 把……磨破 / a raw deal 不公平的待遇
advancedExpressions.example: The coach saw not a polished star but raw talent, and he refused to let the boy be given a raw deal. （一词多义全枚举，续写与议论文都用得上）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'未加工/原始'辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: raw（中性，可指材料、情感、天赋，最灵活）≈ uncooked（仅指食物没煮）≈ natural（天然非人造，多褒义）≈ crude（粗糙未精炼，常带贬义或指工业原料如 crude oil）
advancedExpressions.example: The factory imports crude oil as its raw material and refines it, whereas the chef prefers natural, uncooked ingredients. （四词分工，辨析常考）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·raw + 比喻'未雕琢'

advancedExpressions.example: What he possessed was raw talent — like ore in the earth, waiting only for the patient hand that would refine it into gold. （raw 的抽象义，人物出场高分句）

advancedExpressions.expression: there was a raw ... about sb., something that ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was a raw magnetism about the newcomer, something no training could teach and no rival could imitate. （抽象名词+定语从句，刻画天赋，人物出场高分句）

advancedExpressions.expression: using nothing but raw materials such as ..., participants can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Using nothing but raw materials such as seashells and driftwood, participants can create striking works of art — and rediscover the joy of making with their own hands. （破折号补充升华活动意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: possessing raw ... is only half the battle; what matters is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Possessing raw resources is only half the battle; what truly determines a nation's fate is the wisdom to transform them into lasting value.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The girl had natural talent but no training.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath her clumsy movements lay a raw, untamed talent — like a diamond still buried in rock, waiting only for the patient hand that would one day set it free. （读后续写·才华·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Beneath...lay倒装引出隐藏特质 + raw熟词僻义(未经雕琢) + 明喻(diamond buried in rock) + 定语从句埋伏笔

sentenceUpgrade.original: We can make art from simple natural things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Armed with nothing more than the raw gifts of the shore — bleached shells, smooth pebbles, weather-worn wood — we discovered that imagination, not money, is the truest raw material of all. （议论文/应用文·创造力）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Armed with分词状语开头 + 破折号列举细节 + raw一词双关(原材料/最本真) + not...but...对比收束点题

original_sentence: The scroll consists of three main sections.
readingExamples: The scroll consists of three main sections.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a long roll of paper or parchment, often bearing writing or a painting, that is rolled up for storage
(2) n. a decorative spiral or curved ornament, as on a column or a piece of furniture
(3) v. to move text or images up, down, or across a computer or phone screen in order to view different parts
(4) v. to roll something up into the shape of a scroll

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （在屏幕上）滚动浏览
uncommonMeanings.example: For an hour she scrolled through the old messages on her phone, each faded emoji reopening a wound she had believed long healed. （读后续写·心理·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: As the museum guide carefully unrolled the ancient scroll, a collective gasp swept through the crowd, for the ink strokes seemed as fresh as the day the master had laid down his brush a thousand years ago. （读后续写·博物馆·惊叹）

I am writing to recommend our school's calligraphy exhibition, where a two-metre scroll bearing every student's brushwork will be displayed to celebrate the enduring beauty of Chinese characters. （应用文·推荐信）
A painted scroll is more than decoration; it is a silent chronicle in which a whole society, from bustling merchants to weary farmers, is preserved for future generations to read. （议论文·文化遗产）
Rather than mindlessly scrolling through social media, we would do well to devote those idle minutes to a good book that genuinely nourishes the mind. （议论文·媒介素养）

wordForms.verb: scroll (vi./vt. 滚动浏览；把……卷成筒)
wordForms.other: 一词两用：n. 古画卷轴（有文化意味）↔ v. 手机/电脑屏幕滚动（现代义）；搭配 scroll down/up（滚动）、scroll through（刷……）

With trembling hands the old scholar unrolled the scroll, and centuries of history spilled across the desk in a river of fading ink. （读后续写·细节描写）
The scroll painting captured the festival so vividly that one could almost hear the vendors calling out across the crowded bridge. （读后续写·画面感）

synonyms.example: The library's most treasured manuscript, penned by hand over three decades, is displayed behind glass in a dimly lit room. （议论文·文献价值）
synonyms.usage: 侧重手写的文稿或书稿,不强调'卷起来'的形态;scroll 特指卷成筒状的纸卷或画卷

synonyms.example: She carried a roll of blueprints under her arm as she hurried into the meeting. （应用文·场景）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任何卷成筒状的物体(布卷、纸卷),中性口语;scroll 多用于书画、古籍等有文化意味的卷轴

advancedExpressions.expression: 【名词·古】a silk scroll 丝绸画卷 / unroll a scroll 展开卷轴 / a scroll painting 卷轴画 ‖ 【动词·今】scroll down（up）向下（上）滚动 / scroll through sth 刷（浏览）……
advancedExpressions.example: She unrolled the ancient scroll with reverence, yet minutes later found herself mindlessly scrolling through her phone. （同一词从'古画卷'到'刷屏'，古今对照有张力）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'卷起的文书'
advancedExpressions.expression: scroll（书画古籍类卷轴，有文化意味）≈ roll（泛指任何卷成筒的东西，中性口语）≈ manuscript（手写文稿，不强调卷起形态）
advancedExpressions.example: The museum displays a silk scroll beside a modern roll of blueprints and a fragile handwritten manuscript. （三词形态与语域不同，辨析常考）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·scroll through 及物用法

advancedExpressions.expression: as the scroll unrolled, ... came to life before one's eyes

original_sentence: Painted on a five-metre-long silk scroll, it offers an important insight into life in China in the 12th century.

definitionEn:
(1) n. the ability to understand the true, often hidden, nature of a person or situation
(2) n. a sudden clear understanding of something, or a piece of such understanding
(3) n. an accurate and deep perception that gives one a fuller grasp of a complex subject

posExamples.sentence: It was only after burying his own father that the young doctor gained a painful insight into the grief his patients had carried in silence for years. （读后续写·成长·共情）

collocations.example: She is a leader of great insight. 她是一位极富洞察力的领袖。/ a person with considerable insight 富有洞察力的人（PPT原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】富有洞察力的，有见地的
collocations.example: If you find this video insightful, share it with someone who would benefit from it. 如果你觉得这个视频有见地，就分享给能从中受益的人。（PPT原句）
Painted on a five-metre silk scroll, the artwork offers a rare insight into life in a bustling twelfth-century city. （insight 后固定接介词 into，不用 of/about）

collocations.translation: 敏锐 / 犀利的洞察力
collocations.example: The old teacher's keen insight let him sense the boy's hidden talent long before anyone else did. （读后续写·师生·伯乐）
He wrote about ordinary lives with such insight and tenderness that readers felt he had somehow lived their sorrows himself. （议论文·作家评价）
Volunteering at the shelter gave the students both insight and understanding they could never have acquired from a classroom. （应用文·活动感悟）

synonyms.example: A month abroad deepened her understanding of a culture she had once found utterly foreign. （应用文·交流反思）
synonyms.usage: 泛指对事物的把握,程度可深可浅;insight 强调看穿表象、抓住本质的深刻'洞见',更有分量

synonyms.example: His unusual perception of people's unspoken feelings made him a natural counsellor. （读后续写·人物特质）
synonyms.usage: 侧重感知、觉察的能力,可指感官层面;insight 更偏向对复杂问题或人心的理性、深层领悟

synonyms.example: That her quiet mother had once been a fearless mountaineer came as a revelation to the whole family. （读后续写·真相揭示）
synonyms.usage: 指令人吃惊的'揭示'或'启示',常带戏剧性;insight 更强调持续、深入的理解,不一定伴随惊讶

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·insight into 固定搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: gain / gain insight into sth 获得对……的洞察 · offer（provide, give）(an) insight into sth 提供对……的深入了解 · a flash of insight 灵光一现 · with insight 有洞察力地
advancedExpressions.example: The trip gave us fresh insight into rural life, and in one flash of insight I finally grasped what my grandfather had meant. （insight 后永远接 into——高考搭配必背点）

advancedExpressions.expression: in-（向内、进入）+ sight（看、视力）→ insight 洞察力（'向内部看穿'）；类比 foresight 远见（fore- 向前看）、hindsight 事后聪明（hind- 向后看）
advancedExpressions.example: With foresight one plans ahead, with insight one sees beneath the surface, and only with hindsight does everything become clear. （三个 -sight 词一句串齐，记词根）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'理解/洞察/顿悟'
advancedExpressions.expression: insight（看穿表象、抓住本质的深刻洞见）≈ understanding（泛指把握，程度可深可浅）≈ perception（感知、觉察能力）≈ revelation（令人吃惊的揭示/顿悟，带戏剧性）
advancedExpressions.example: A month abroad deepened her understanding, sharpened her perception, and finally gave her real insight — the day it all fell into place felt like a revelation. （四词程度与色彩不同，辨析常考）

advancedExpressions.expression: in that moment of insight, sb. finally understood that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that moment of insight, she finally understood that her mother's silence had never been coldness, but a love too vast and too aching to be spoken aloud. （心理顿悟+对比反转,结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... gave me an insight into ... that I shall long treasure

advancedExpressions.expression: true insight lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True insight lies not in knowing more facts than others, but in grasping the meaning that binds those facts into wisdom. （对比句式,提炼观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The trip helped me understand rural life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Those few muddy days in the fields did more than any lecture ever could: they gave me a hard-won insight into the quiet dignity of a life bound to the land, and I returned home humbled and strangely richer. （读后续写·体验·成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: did more than... 比较句强调 + 冒号引出结果 + hard-won 形容词点睛 + humbled and richer 心理并列收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: This book gives readers insight into history.

original_sentence: The first section presents a peaceful scene of rural life near Bianjing, featuring crop fields, a river winding through the landscape, and farmers hard at work.
readingExamples: The first section presents a peaceful scene of rural life near Bianjing, featuring crop fields, a river winding through the landscape, and farmers hard at work.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a plant such as wheat, rice, or fruit that is grown by farmers and used as food
(2) n. the total amount of a plant that is gathered in a single season; a harvest or yield
(3) n. a group of people or things that appear at the same time
(4) v. to cut something very short, especially hair; to trim the edges of a picture

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①庄稼，作物；（某季的）收成，产量（a good/bumper crop 好收成；cash crops 经济作物）
uncommonMeanings.example: When a single failed crop can plunge an entire village into hunger, we grasp how fragile the line between plenty and famine has always been. （议论文·粮食安全）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②一批（同时出现的人或事物）（this year's crop of freshmen 今年这一批新生）
uncommonMeanings.example: This year's crop of freshmen was the most talented the old coach had seen in a decade, and quietly he allowed himself to hope again. （读后续写·团队·希望）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③剪短（头发）；裁剪（图片）（crop one's hair 剪短发；crop a photo 裁剪照片）
uncommonMeanings.example: She had cropped her long hair to the ears overnight, and in that reckless act her mother read a grief too deep for words. （读后续写·细节·心理暗示）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（问题、事情）突然出现（常用 crop up）
uncommonMeanings.example: Just as the rehearsal seemed perfect, a last-minute problem cropped up that threatened to ruin the whole performance. （读后续写·转折·危机）

posExamples.sentence: The first section of the scroll presents a peaceful scene of rural life, with golden crop fields stretching to the horizon and farmers bent low over the ripening grain. （读后续写·田园·画面感）
I am writing to invite you to our charity sale, where vegetables grown from the school garden's first crop will be sold to support children in the mountain areas. （应用文·邀请信）
When a single failed crop can plunge an entire village into hunger, we begin to grasp how fragile the line between plenty and famine has always been. （议论文·粮食安全）

wordForms.noun: crop (n. 庄稼，作物；收成；一批)
wordForms.verb: crop (v. 剪短，裁剪；(问题)突然出现)
wordForms.adjective: cropped (剪短的，裁剪过的；cropped hair 短发)
wordForms.other: 固定短语 crop up 突然出现；the cream of the crop 精华、最优秀者；易混：crop（作物/裁剪）≠ crap（俚语，别拼混）

idioms.example: Only the cream of the crop made it to the national finals, and even they trembled as the results were read aloud. （读后续写·竞赛·紧张）

collocations.example: For forty years the old man had planted the same crop on the same terraced fields, and the land seemed to know his footsteps. （读后续写·乡土·坚守）
After months of anxious waiting, the bumper crop finally arrived, and the whole village gathered to celebrate beneath the harvest moon. （读后续写·丰收·喜悦）
A sudden drought led to widespread crop failure, forcing many families to leave the land their ancestors had tilled for generations. （议论文·气候影响）
From the hilltop, the endless crop fields glowed amber in the setting sun, a patchwork quilt sewn by countless patient hands. （读后续写·风景·比喻）
By switching from grain to cash crops such as tea and herbs, the village slowly climbed out of poverty. （议论文·脱贫发展）
No matter how carefully we plan the trip, unexpected difficulties are bound to crop up along the way. （应用文·行程提醒）
Practising crop rotation keeps the soil fertile and reduces the need for harmful chemical fertilisers. （议论文·可持续农业）
She cropped the photo so that only the two of them remained, and everything else that day had held was quietly cut away. （读后续写·情感·取舍）

synonyms.example: The autumn harvest was so plentiful that the barns could scarcely hold it all. （读后续写·丰收）
synonyms.usage: 既指'收割'的动作,也指'收成'这一结果;crop 更侧重田里生长的'作物'本身或某季的产量

synonyms.example: The new farming technique doubled the yield within a single season. （议论文·农业技术）
synonyms.usage: 强调单位面积或投入所产出的'产量、收益',偏数据和成果;crop 更具体、更形象,指作物本身

synonyms.example: The market stalls overflowed with fresh produce brought in from the surrounding farms. （应用文·场景）
synonyms.usage: 不可数,泛指蔬菜水果等农产品的统称;crop 指某一种或某一季的作物,可数

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·crop 一词多义全枚举
advancedExpressions.expression: 【n.】a bumper crop 大丰收 / crop failure 歉收 / cash crops 经济作物 / crop rotation 轮作 / a crop of ...一批…… ‖ 【v.】crop up 突然出现 / crop a photo 裁剪照片 / crop one's hair 剪短发 ‖ 【习语】the cream of the crop 精华
advancedExpressions.example: A drought caused crop failure, yet a fresh crop of problems kept cropping up, and only the cream of the crop survived. （名词'作物/一批'、动词'突然出现'、习语一句全打通）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'作物/收成/产量'
advancedExpressions.expression: crop（田里生长的作物本身，或某季产量，可数）≈ harvest（收割动作，也指收成结果）≈ yield（单位面积/投入的产量、收益，偏数据）≈ produce（农产品统称，不可数）
advancedExpressions.example: The new technique doubled the yield, the autumn harvest overflowed the barns, and the fresh produce from that record crop sold out in a day. （四词分工，辨析高频）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·crop up 不及物短语

advancedExpressions.example: No matter how carefully we plan, unexpected difficulties are bound to crop up along the way. （crop up 无被动，'突然出现'续写与应用文都好用）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·丰收/努力有报
advancedExpressions.expression: the ... crop was a reward for every ... they had endured
advancedExpressions.example: The golden crop swaying before them was a reward for every drought, every doubt, and every backbreaking dawn they had endured together. （三个 every 排比+以景收束情感,续写高潮）
