translation: (wound, wound) 蜿蜒，曲折，上发条，缠绕
original_sentence: After one night of wind and showers, How many are the fallen flowers!
readingExamples: After one night of wind and showers, How many are the fallen flowers!
definitionEn:
(1) v. to follow a course that twists and turns; to move in a curving path
(2) v. to wrap or twist something around an object repeatedly
(3) v. to turn a key or handle in order to make a clock, toy, or machine work
(4) v. to bring something to a gradual end (usually wind up / wind down)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①蜿蜒，曲折延伸（读作 /waɪnd/，wound-wound；a river/road winds 河/路蜿蜒）
uncommonMeanings.example: The narrow path wound its way up the misty mountain, disappearing and reappearing among the pines until at last it delivered them to the ancient temple. （读后续写·登山·画面感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②缠绕，绕（wind sth around sth 把……缠在……上）
uncommonMeanings.example: She wound the woollen scarf twice around the shivering child's neck and pressed her own warm gloves into his hands. （读后续写·关爱·动作）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③给（钟表、发条玩具）上发条（wind up a clock/watch）
uncommonMeanings.example: Every night before bed his grandfather wound the old clock with the same slow, deliberate turns, as if winding up time itself. （读后续写·细节·怀旧）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④结束，使放松（wind up 结束/最终落得；wind down 逐渐平息/放松）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the festival wound down and the last lanterns flickered out, a comfortable weariness settled over the exhausted but joyful crowd. （读后续写·收尾·氛围）

posExamples.sentence: The narrow path wound its way up the misty mountain, disappearing and reappearing among the pines until at last it delivered them to the ancient temple at the summit. （读后续写·登山·画面感）

wordForms.noun: wind /wɪnd/ (n. 风) —— 与本词条动词 wind /waɪnd/ 拼写相同、读音不同
wordForms.verb: wind /waɪnd/ (v. 蜿蜒；缠绕；上发条) —— 过去式/过去分词 wound /waʊnd/

collocations.phrase: wind back / wind up / wind down【课件】

collocations.translation: 蜿蜒的路 / 河 / 小径

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·get wind of 风闻
advancedExpressions.expression: get wind of sth = 风闻、得知（尤指本不该知道的消息，用 n. wind 风）
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the students got wind of the surprise holiday, a wave of cheers swept through the classroom. （get wind of 地道口语，续写制造消息传开的场面）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'蜿蜒/曲折延伸'
advancedExpressions.expression: wind（中性，路/河/队伍等各种曲折延伸）≈ meander（河流缓慢悠然地曲折，带闲适味）≈ twist（急促突然的弯折）≈ coil（盘成一圈圈的螺旋缠绕）
advancedExpressions.example: The stream meandered lazily, the mountain trail twisted sharply, and the snake coiled on the rock, while the old road simply wound on into the dusk. （四词曲折方式不同，辨析常考）

advancedExpressions.expression: the path wound on, and so did ...
advancedExpressions.example: The mountain path wound endlessly upward, and so did her resolve, each hairpin bend teaching her that giving up was never the only way forward. （以路喻志+each 引导感悟,续写升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the ... winds down, let us not forget ...
advancedExpressions.example: As our volunteer week winds down, let us not forget the grateful smiles that reminded us why we started. （倡议/总结文情感句）

advancedExpressions.expression: the road to ... always winds; it rarely runs straight
advancedExpressions.example: The road to any worthy goal always winds; it rarely runs straight, and it is precisely the bends that test whether our commitment is real. （比喻论证,以路喻人生）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The road went up the mountain with many turns.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The road wound up the mountainside in patient loops, coiling higher and higher until the village below shrank to a scatter of glinting rooftops and the whole valley lay hushed beneath them. （读后续写·登高·画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: wound 生动动词替换 went + coiling 分词状语延伸动作 + until 结果从句 + shrank to a scatter 视觉收缩对比

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should end the term with an activity.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my sincere hope that we might wind the term down with a heartfelt farewell gathering, where laughter and gratitude, rather than dull routine, become our final memory of this classroom. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my sincere hope that... 委婉建议句 + wind down 地道短语 + where 定语从句 + rather than 对比突出情感价值

classPractice.question: I don't know why the thread is winding ____ the branches.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】wind around/round 缠绕、盘绕；线绕在树枝上

classPractice.question: We can see from the tower that the road winds ____ a small forest.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】wind through （使）贯穿其中；路蜿蜒穿过小树林

classPractice.question: Please wind the windows ____, as the wind is so strong outside.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】wind up 将（车窗）摇上去；外面风大故摇上车窗

classPractice.question: Would you please wind the film ____ to the part where the child comes in?
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】wind back 倒带、倒片；把影片倒回到某处

classPractice.question: The mountain path ____ (wind) its way up through the pines, and only at dusk did it lead them to the temple.
classPractice.note: wind 作'蜿蜒'解，读 /waɪnd/，过去式 wound /waʊnd/；由 did 定过去时

classPractice.question: The students cheered the moment they ____ ____ ____ the surprise holiday.
classPractice.note: get wind of sth 风闻、得知（消息）；此处用过去式 got

classPractice.question: 让我们用一场温馨的告别会为本学期收尾吧。Let us ____ ____ the term ____ a heartfelt farewell gathering.
classPractice.note: wind down （活动）逐渐收尾/放松；此处'以……收尾'搭 with

translation: vi. & vt. （驾驶）航行，起航，扬帆（航行），驾驶 | n. 帆，航行
original_sentence: The second section shows the riverbanks and the central bridge alive with activity as boats sail in and out of Bianjing.
readingExamples: The second section shows the riverbanks and the central bridge alive with activity as boats sail in and out of Bianjing.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to travel across water in a boat or ship
(2) v. to control or steer a boat or ship
(3) v. to begin a journey on water; to set off
(4) n. a large sheet of cloth fixed to a boat that catches the wind and moves it forward
(5) n. a trip or journey on water

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（云、鸟等）轻盈平稳地飘行、滑行（to move quickly and smoothly in a particular direction）——clouds sailing across the sky（Extended reading slide 9）
uncommonMeanings.example: A lone eagle sailed across the vast blue sky, motionless yet somehow full of unhurried power. 一只孤鹰滑过湛蓝的天空，一动不动却又满含从容的力量。（课件义项拓展·读后续写·自然·意象）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 轻松通过；顺利地移动（sail through / into）
uncommonMeanings.example: Having prepared for months, she sailed through the interview with a calm that surprised even herself. （读后续写·考试 / 面试·从容）

posExamples.sentence: As dawn broke, the little fishing boat sailed out of the misty harbour, its worn sail swelling with the first breath of the morning wind. （读后续写·出海·画面感）
In the scroll, countless boats sail in and out of the busy port, and one can almost hear the shouts of the boatmen echoing across the water. （议论文·艺术·历史场景）
I am writing to invite you to join our club's weekend sail along the coast, an experience that promises fresh air, teamwork, and unforgettable views. （应用文·邀请信）
Life, much like a voyage, rewards not those who wait for calm seas but those who dare to sail against the wind toward a distant shore. （议论文·人生·励志）

idioms.example: Everyone assumed the champion would sail through the first round, so his sudden defeat left the whole stadium in stunned silence. （读后续写·意外·反转）
At last the great ship set sail, and on the crowded deck a boy waved until the shore was nothing but a thin grey line. （读后续写·离别·画面）

idioms.translation: 冒险行事，游走于危险边缘
idioms.example: By skipping the safety checks to save time, the crew were sailing dangerously close to the wind. （读后续写·冒险·警示）

collocations.phrase: sail in and out of sw
collocations.translation: 【课件】（船）在……驶进驶出（vi. 乘船航行）
collocations.example: The second section shows the riverbanks and the central bridge alive with activity as boats sail in and out of Bianjing. 第二部分描绘熙熙攘攘的河岸与中心桥，往来京城的船只穿梭其间。（课件·Extended reading 原句）
The tired crew watched the lights grow brighter as their ship sailed into harbour at last. 疲惫的船员们望着灯火渐亮，船终于驶入了海港。（课件·Extended reading slide 8）
He was one of the first people to sail around the world. 他是最早进行环球航行的人之一。（课件·Extended reading slide 8）

collocations.translation: 【课件】驾驶船只（穿过……）（vt. 驾驶）
collocations.example: Blake sailed the ship safely through the narrow passage. 布莱克驾驶船只安全地穿过了那条狭窄的水道。（课件·Extended reading slide 9）

collocations.translation: 【课件】飘过天空的云彩（sail 表"轻盈平稳地移动、飘行"）
collocations.example: He lay on the grass, watching the clouds sailing across the sky. 他躺在草地上，望着云彩飘过天空。（课件·Extended reading slide 9）

collocations.translation: 【课件】我们明天下午两点起航（sail 表"起航、开船"）
collocations.example: We sail at 2 p.m. tomorrow, so please be at the dock an hour early. 我们明天下午两点起航，请提前一小时到码头。（课件·Extended reading slide 8）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（风）鼓起船帆（sail n. 帆）
collocations.example: As the boat moved down the river the wind began to fill the sails. 船顺流而下，风开始鼓起了船帆。（课件·Extended reading slide 9）

collocations.translation: 【课件】去乘船兜风（sail n. 一次航行）
collocations.example: We went for a sail. 我们乘船兜了一趟风。（课件·Extended reading slide 9）

collocations.translation: 起航，扬帆出发（前往某地）
collocations.example: At dawn the great ship set sail for the unknown, and the harbour rang with waving hands and hopeful tears. （读后续写·启程）

collocations.translation: 轻松通过，顺利完成（考试、面试等）
collocations.example: Thanks to months of preparation, she sailed through the interview with a smile. （议论文·勤能补拙）

collocations.translation: 航行穿过 / 环绕 / 沿着
collocations.example: Determined to prove herself, she resolved to sail around the treacherous cape that had defeated so many before her. （读后续写·挑战·决心）
The captain ordered the crew to hoist the sail, and the ship leapt forward as if suddenly given wings. （读后续写·出航·比喻）
The project was not smooth sailing at first, but persistence gradually turned every obstacle into a stepping stone. （议论文·坚持）
The bridge came alive with activity as boats sailed in and out of Bianjing. （课文原句改编·古画·繁华）

collocations.phrase: a sail / go for a sail
collocations.example: On calm summer evenings, the old man would take his grandson for a short sail and teach him to read the wind. （读后续写·亲情·传承）

synonyms.example: The voyage across the ocean lasted three long months, testing the endurance of every soul aboard. （读后续写·远航）
synonyms.usage: 多为名词,指较长的海上或太空旅程,正式且有史诗感;sail 更日常,可作动词表'航行'的动作

synonyms.example: They spent their holiday on a leisurely cruise among the sun-drenched islands. （应用文·旅行）
synonyms.usage: 多指以休闲游览为目的的乘船旅行,轻松惬意;sail 更强调'扬帆航行'的动作本身

synonyms.example: Skilfully the captain navigated the ship through the fog-shrouded reefs. （读后续写·惊险·技艺）
synonyms.usage: 强调在复杂或危险水域中'掌舵、辨向'的技术性;sail 更泛指航行,不一定突出难度

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·sail 兼作动词与名词（课件 Extended reading slide 8-9）
advancedExpressions.expression: sail v.：vi. 乘船航行（sail into harbour / sail around the world）；vt. 驾驶（sail the ship through sth）；起航（We sail at 2 p.m.）；轻盈飘行（clouds sailing across the sky）｜sail n.：帆（fill the sails）；一次航行（go for a sail）
advancedExpressions.example: As the wind filled the sails, the captain sailed the ship out of harbour; days later they went for a quiet sail under clouds sailing across the sky. 一句串起 sail 的动词/名词、及物/不及物用法。（课件语法点卡）

advancedExpressions.expression: set sail 起航 / sail through 轻松通过 / smooth sailing 一帆风顺 / sail against the wind 逆风而行 / hoist the sail 扬帆
advancedExpressions.example: They set sail against the wind, trusting that even rough seas could not stop a crew that refused to give up. （一组高频搭配连讲，兼顾字面航海与比喻义）

advancedExpressions.expression: one cannot ... yet one can always adjust the sails
advancedExpressions.example: One cannot command the wind, yet one can always adjust the sails — and in that small, stubborn freedom lies all the difference between drifting and arriving. （谚语化+对比,续写点题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us set sail together toward ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us set sail together toward a greener campus, each small action a gust of wind filling the same hopeful sail. （倡议信比喻号召句）

advancedExpressions.expression: life is less about waiting for fair winds than about learning to sail
advancedExpressions.example: Life is less about waiting for fair winds than about learning to sail through storms we did not choose. （比较句式,以航海喻人生态度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The boat sailed away from the shore.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Slowly the boat drew away from the shore, its white sail filling with wind, until it was no more than a fleck of light trembling on the horizon between sea and sky. （读后续写·离别·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Slowly 副词前置控制节奏 + its sail filling 分词状语补充画面 + until 结果延伸 + a fleck of light 比喻收束视线

sentenceUpgrade.original: Success is not always easy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Success rarely arrives on smooth waters; more often it is won by those willing to hoist their sails and steer straight into the wind, trusting that the storm itself will carry them forward. （议论文·励志·航海隐喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: rarely...more often 对比结构 + 航海隐喻贯穿(smooth waters / hoist sails / into the wind) + trusting 分词状语点明信念

classPractice.question: After weeks of loading supplies, the explorers finally ____ ____ for the distant, uncharted islands.
classPractice.note: 考 set sail「起航、扬帆出发」，固定搭配，sail 不加 -ed（set 过去式与原形同形）。

classPractice.question: Having reviewed every night, she ____ (sail) through the final exam without any panic.
classPractice.note: 考 sail through「轻松通过」比喻义；主句一般过去时，用 sailed。

classPractice.question:
画卷中，船只在汴京城驶进驶出，一派繁忙。（sail in and out of）
In the scroll, boats ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ Bianjing, full of activity.
classPractice.note: 考 sail in and out of「驶进驶出」，呼应课文；描述画面用一般现在时。

original_sentence: Civilians can also be seen walking through the city gate in both directions.
readingExamples: Civilians can also be seen walking through the city gate in both directions.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person who is not a member of the armed forces or the police
(2) n. an ordinary person, as distinct from those in a particular profession or organisation
(3) adj. relating to ordinary citizens rather than the military or police

posExamples.sentence: In the ancient painting, ordinary civilians can be seen streaming through the city gate in both directions, each face a small window into the everyday hopes of a distant age. （读后续写·古画·历史感）
I am writing to appeal for donations, for the flood has left thousands of innocent civilians without food, shelter, or a single dry blanket. （应用文·呼吁信）
History reminds us again and again that it is ordinary civilians, not generals, who pay the heaviest price whenever nations choose war over dialogue. （议论文·和平·反战）
After years in uniform, returning to civilian life felt strangely unfamiliar to him, as though the whole world had learned to walk a different pace. （读后续写·退伍·心理落差）

wordForms.noun: civilian（平民）/ civilisation（BrE）, civilization（AmE）（文明）/ civility（礼貌，彬彬有礼）
wordForms.adjective: civilian（平民的）/ civil（公民的；民用的；文明有礼的）/ civilised, civilized（文明的，开化的）
wordForms.other: civil 词族全家桶：civil war 内战 / civil rights 公民权利 / civil servant 公务员 / civil engineering 土木工程；辨析 civilian(名词,与军人相对) ≠ civil(形容词,公民的/民用的)

collocations.phrase: walk / pass through (a place) —— 课文场景
collocations.example: Civilians can also be seen walking through the city gate in both directions. （课文原句·古画·市井）

collocations.translation: 无辜的 / 普通的平民
collocations.example: The volunteers worked around the clock to bring clean water to the ordinary civilians trapped by the rising floodwaters. （应用文·救灾报道）
Adjusting to civilian life after the disaster relief mission took the young soldier far longer than he had expected. （读后续写·适应·心理）
Every effort must be made to protect the civilian population from the horrors that armed conflict inevitably brings. （议论文·人道主义）
Out of uniform and dressed in plain civilian clothes, the officer was just another face in the morning crowd. （读后续写·细节·反差）
International law exists precisely to protect civilians who have no part in the quarrels of the powerful. （议论文·国际法）
News of the mounting civilian casualties stirred a wave of grief and outrage across the entire nation. （议论文·战争代价）
After retiring from service, he took a quiet civilian job repairing bicycles in his hometown. （读后续写·退休·平淡）

synonyms.example: As responsible citizens, we should each do our part to keep our community clean and safe. （应用文·倡议书）
synonyms.usage: 强调法律身份、对国家的归属与权利义务;civilian 强调'非军事人员'的身份,与军人相对

synonyms.example: The local residents gathered at dusk to discuss how to protect their ancient trees. （应用文·社区）
synonyms.usage: 强调居住在某地的人,着眼'居住'这一事实;civilian 着眼'非军警'的职业属性

synonyms.example: The new policy was designed to serve the public rather than a privileged few. （议论文·公共政策）
synonyms.usage: 集合名词,泛指广大民众整体;civilian 多指具体的、与军人相对的个体或群体

advancedExpressions.expression: civil（公民的/民用的）→ civilian（平民）→ civilise（教化）→ civilisation（文明）→ civility（礼貌）
advancedExpressions.example: From the same root spring civil rights, a civilian population and an ancient civilisation — all reminders that people, not armies, build a society. （一根多词串讲，帮助记忆整族词）

advancedExpressions.expression: civilians 平民（与军警相对）/ ordinary citizens 普通公民 / the general public 公众 / people from all walks of life 各行各业的人
advancedExpressions.example: It is the civilians, the ordinary citizens and the general public — not the powerful few — who bear the true weight of every decision. （功能：泛指普通民众，据语境择用）

advancedExpressions.expression: among the crowd of civilians, ... , each carrying a story ...
advancedExpressions.example: Among the endless crowd of civilians pouring through the gate, there were merchants, mothers, and dreaming boys — each carrying a story the painter would preserve for a thousand years. （列举+each 从句,续写以小人物见时代）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is the innocent civilians who ... ; let us not turn away
advancedExpressions.example: It is the innocent civilians who suffer most in every disaster; let us not turn away, but reach out with whatever help we can offer. （呼吁信强调句+号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true cost of ... is measured not in ... but in the lives of ordinary civilians
advancedExpressions.example: The true cost of war is measured not in territory gained or lost, but in the shattered lives of ordinary civilians who never asked to fight. （not...but 对比,深化反战立场）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many civilians were hurt in the disaster.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the floodwaters finally receded, they left behind thousands of ordinary civilians clinging to rooftops — farmers, teachers, children — every one of them robbed overnight of a home they had spent a lifetime building. （读后续写·灾难·悲悯）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: When 时间状语从句设背景 + clinging to rooftops 分词状语具象化 + 破折号列举身份 + robbed overnight 强调突变的残酷

sentenceUpgrade.original: War hurts ordinary people the most.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Behind every headline about conflict lies a quieter, crueller truth: it is the nameless civilians — those who plant, teach, and love far from any battlefield — who bear the deepest wounds of wars they never chose. （议论文·反战·人文关怀）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Behind every... lies 倒装引出观点 + 冒号揭示真相 + it is...who 强调句 + 三动词并列(plant, teach, love)刻画普通人

classPractice.question: 选 civilian 或 civil 填空：After years in uniform, he found returning to ____ life strangely unfamiliar; meanwhile his brother worked as a ____ servant in the local government.
classPractice.note: 考 civilian(平民的,与军旅相对) 与 civil(公民的/政府的,如 civil servant 公务员) 的辨析。

classPractice.question: History reminds us that it is ordinary ____ (civilian), not generals, who pay the heaviest price in war.
classPractice.note: 考 civilian 作可数名词表「平民」，此处泛指用复数 civilians。

classPractice.question: 在这幅古画里，平民百姓正从两个方向穿过城门。（civilians, city gate）
classPractice.answer: In this ancient painting, civilians can be seen walking through the city gate in both directions. / In this ancient painting, ordinary civilians are walking through the city gate in both directions.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句，掌握 civilians walk through the city gate 的表达。

original_sentence: Zhang’s amazing artistic technique is apparent all across the scroll.
readingExamples: Zhang’s amazing artistic technique is apparent all across the scroll.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. people of many different types, from many different social backgrounds, occupations and levels of society
(2) phr. every kind of job, profession or position that people hold in a community
(3) phr. (used to stress diversity) the whole range of ordinary members of society, regardless of class, wealth or status

posExamples.sentence: As the old street artist began to sing, people from all walks of life — hurried clerks, laughing children, weary vendors — gradually slowed their steps and gathered into a quiet, spellbound circle. （读后续写·街头·人间温情）
On behalf of the organising committee, I sincerely invite volunteers from all walks of life to join our community clean-up, for a greener city is a dream we can only build together. （应用文·倡议书）
A truly great book speaks to all walks of life, offering the ploughman and the professor alike a mirror in which each may recognise his own quiet struggles. （议论文·文学的普世价值）

When the flood swept through the town, help poured in from all walks of life: fishermen lent their boats, doctors gave up their sleep, and even schoolchildren emptied their piggy banks. （读后续写·灾难·众志成城）

idioms.idiom: people / men and women from all walks of life
idioms.translation: 各行各业、社会各阶层的人
idioms.example: The exhibition drew men and women from all walks of life, all united by a single, simple love of beauty. （应用文·展览报道）

collocations.phrase: people / men and women from all walks of life
collocations.translation: 各行各业、社会各阶层的人
collocations.example: The exhibition drew people from all walks of life, all united by a single, simple love of beauty. （应用文·展览报道）

collocations.phrase: people from all walks of life
collocations.example: Along the bustling scroll of the ancient city, people from all walks of life went about their business, and history seemed to breathe within every tiny figure. （读后续写·画卷·历史画面）

collocations.phrase: attract / draw people from all walks of life
collocations.example: The free evening lectures attracted people from all walks of life, proving that a hunger for knowledge respects no boundary of trade or wealth. （议论文·教育公平）

collocations.phrase: bring together people from all walks of life
collocations.translation: 把各行各业的人聚集在一起
collocations.example: Music, more than any speech, can bring together people from all walks of life in a single shared heartbeat. （议论文·艺术的凝聚力）

collocations.phrase: unite people from all walks of life
collocations.example: The rescue effort united people from all walks of life, and for those unforgettable days no one asked another's rank or fortune. （读后续写·灾难·团结）

collocations.phrase: welcome sb from all walks of life
collocations.example: Our club warmly welcomes members from all walks of life, believing that difference, not sameness, is the true soil of friendship. （应用文·招新启事）

collocations.phrase: volunteers / participants from all walks of life
collocations.translation: 来自各行各业的志愿者/参与者
collocations.example: Participants from all walks of life signed up for the charity run, each pair of running shoes carrying its own quiet story of hope. （应用文·活动通知）

synonyms.example: In every walk of life there are unsung heroes whose small kindnesses hold the world together. （议论文·平凡英雄）
synonyms.usage: 与 all walks of life 意义相同，只是把复数 walks 换成单数 walk，语气略显文雅正式；日常写作中 all walks of life 更常用

synonyms.example: The reform won support from all sectors of society, from farmers to financiers. （议论文·社会共识）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、更书面，常见于新闻和政论，强调"各领域、各界别"；all walks of life 更口语化、更有人情味，侧重"各种职业身份的普通人"

synonyms.example: The festival celebrated people of all backgrounds, weaving many cultures into one joyful tapestry. （应用文·文化节介绍）
synonyms.usage: 强调出身、文化、种族等"背景"的多样；all walks of life 更侧重"职业与社会地位"的多样，二者可视语境替换

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·all walks of life 用法
advancedExpressions.expression: people from all walks of life 各行各业的人 / draw ... from all walks of life 吸引各阶层 / unite people from all walks of life 团结各界；单数变体 every walk of life
advancedExpressions.example: The festival drew people from all walks of life and, for one bright evening, united every walk of life under the same sky. （固定习语讲解：walk 意为「行业、社会地位」，勿写成 all works of life）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·各界各阶层
advancedExpressions.expression: people from all walks of life 各行各业（口语、有人情味）/ all sectors of society 社会各界（正式书面）/ people of all backgrounds 各种背景的人 / every corner of society 社会各个角落
advancedExpressions.example: Support poured in from all walks of life and every sector of society, proving the cause belonged to no single class. （功能：强调参与者多样广泛，据文体择用）

advancedExpressions.expression: people from all walks of life ..., each ...
advancedExpressions.example: People from all walks of life crowded the square that night, each face lit by the same trembling candlelight, each heart beating for the same fragile hope. （"each ..., each ..."排比 + 光影意象，续写群像场面渲染氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: we call on people from all walks of life to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We call on people from all walks of life to lend a hand, for a single drop may seem powerless, yet together countless drops can turn the tide. （倡议书号召 + 比喻收尾，感染力强）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... speaks to people from all walks of life
advancedExpressions.example: Genuine art speaks to people from all walks of life, dissolving the walls of class and wealth that daylight so carefully builds. （"speaks to ... from all walks of life"论证普世价值 + 隐喻"dissolving walls"深化观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many different kinds of people came to help.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From all walks of life they came — the doctor and the ditch-digger, the scholar and the street-sweeper — drawn together by a compassion that asked no one's name or rank. （读后续写·灾难·众志成城）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 介词短语"From all walks of life"前置倒装 + 对照式并列(doctor and ditch-digger)以小见大 + 定语从句"that asked no one's name"点明主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: The event was open to everyone in society.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Open to people from all walks of life, the festival became a rare meeting ground where the banker's laughter and the labourer's song rose, for one evening, into the very same sky. （应用文/记叙·社区活动）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 形容词短语"Open to ..."独立主格开头 + where 引导定语从句 + 对照意象(banker's laughter / labourer's song)以具体画面表达平等

classPractice.question: The charity concert brought together people from all ____ of life, from famous singers to humble street cleaners.
classPractice.note: 考习语 all walks of life「各行各业」，注意是 walks（不是 works），walk 指「行业、社会阶层」。

classPractice.question:
这场展览吸引了社会各阶层的人。（attract, all walks of life）
The exhibition ____ people ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.answer: attracted; from all walks of life
classPractice.note: 考 attract people from all walks of life 的整体搭配，from 不可少。

classPractice.question: 在这幅古画里，各行各业的人都在忙着自己的日常事务。（people from all walks of life, go about）
classPractice.answer: In this ancient painting, people from all walks of life are going about their daily business. / In this ancient painting, people from all walks of life go about their daily business.
classPractice.note: 把习语与画面场景结合，all walks of life 作后置定语修饰 people。

original_sentence: Here, hundreds of people from all walks of life, including butchers, hairdressers and government officials, can be seen going about their daily business.
readingExamples: Here, hundreds of people from all walks of life, including butchers, hairdressers and government officials, can be seen going about their daily business.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone whose job is to cut up and sell meat, or the shop where meat is sold
(2) n. a person who kills people brutally and in large numbers; a cruel murderer
(3) vt. to kill animals and prepare their meat to be sold as food
(4) vt. to kill people, or animals, cruelly and violently; (informal) to ruin something by doing it very badly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 肉铺，肉店（the butcher's = the butcher's shop）
uncommonMeanings.example: Fresh sausages hung in neat rows at the butcher's, and the whole street smelled of the coming feast. （读后续写·市井·气味记忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 屠宰（牲畜），宰杀
uncommonMeanings.example: Every autumn the family would butcher a pig, salting the meat to last through the long, hard winter. （读后续写·农家·储粮）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 残忍杀害众人的刽子手、屠夫（喻凶残之人）
uncommonMeanings.example: History would remember the tyrant not as a ruler but as a butcher, a name whispered with a shudder by every generation that followed. （议论文·暴政·历史评判）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （口语）把（工作、乐曲等）搞得一团糟、糟蹋
uncommonMeanings.example: The nervous newcomer completely butchered the famous aria, yet the kind old audience clapped all the same, moved by the courage in his trembling voice. （读后续写·舞台·善意）

posExamples.sentence: In the painted city, hundreds of ordinary figures came alive — the butcher weighing his meat, the hairdresser bent over a customer, the officials strolling by — as though the whole of daily life had been caught mid-breath. （读后续写·画卷·市井百态）
I am writing to recommend Mr Li, our neighbourhood butcher, for the Good Citizen Award, as he has quietly given free meat to the elderly poor for over twenty years. （应用文·推荐信）
A humble butcher may contribute as much to a healthy society as any scholar, for honest, everyday labour is the very foundation on which grand ideas are built. （议论文·平凡劳动的价值）
Every dawn the cheerful old butcher rolled up his shutters, greeting each early customer by name, and the warm scent of his shop seemed to wake the whole sleepy street. （读后续写·市井·温暖日常）

wordForms.noun: butcher / butchery (n. 屠宰业；大屠杀)
wordForms.other: butcher's (n. 肉铺)

idioms.idiom: have a go at the butcher's / go to the butcher's
idioms.example: On her way home she stopped at the butcher's, and the kindly owner slipped an extra bone into her bag 'for the dog', though she had no dog at all. （读后续写·市井·小善意）

collocations.example: On her way home she stopped at the butcher's to buy some pork for the family dinner. （读后续写·市井·日常）
The farmers gathered to butcher a pig for the coming winter feast. （读后续写·农村·节庆）
The village butcher knew every family's story, and behind his counter he heard more secrets than the priest himself. （读后续写·乡村·人情）
He gripped the heavy butcher's knife with the calm certainty of a man who had done this honest work for forty years. （读后续写·匠人·从容）
Though he worked as a butcher by day, at night he taught himself to read, dreaming of a world far beyond his little shop. （读后续写·底层·追梦）

collocations.phrase: the butcher, the baker and the candlestick maker
collocations.translation: 各行各业的手艺人（民谚）
collocations.example: In that lively market square, the butcher, the baker and the candlestick maker all played their small, essential part in the life of the town. （议论文·社会分工）
The farmers gathered to butcher a pig for the winter feast, and the whole village would share in the warmth of the coming days. （读后续写·农村·节庆）

synonyms.example: The slaughterer worked in silence, treating each animal with a rough, wordless respect. （读后续写·劳作·尊重）
synonyms.usage: 专指在屠宰场宰杀牲畜的工人，语域较专业、中性；butcher 既可指宰杀者，也指"卖肉的商人"，更日常、更有市井生活气息

synonyms.example: The murderer was finally brought to justice, and the frightened town breathed freely once more. （读后续写·正义·安宁）
synonyms.usage: 指杀人犯这一法律与道德概念，中性直白；butcher 作"刽子手"讲时带强烈的谴责与凶残意味，多指残忍地大规模杀戮

synonyms.example: Street vendors lined the ancient bridge, their cheerful cries mingling into the music of the market. （读后续写·集市·热闹）
synonyms.usage: 泛指街头或市场的"卖主、小贩"，卖什么皆可；butcher 特指"卖肉的商人"，行业单一而具体

advancedExpressions.expression: a butcher 屠夫/肉贩 / the butcher's 肉店 / butcher an animal 宰杀牲畜（v.）/ a butcher 刽子手（喻凶残之徒）/ butcher a song 把歌唱砸了（口语）
advancedExpressions.example: The kindly butcher at the butcher's would never harm a soul, unlike the ruthless butcher history remembers. （名词/动词、字面/比喻义一并串讲）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-er 表'从事某职业的人' + 's 表'店铺'
advancedExpressions.expression: butcher（切肉的人→肉贩）；名词所有格 the butcher's = the butcher's shop 肉店（类比 the baker's 面包店、the chemist's 药店）
advancedExpressions.example: In Britain you buy meat at the butcher's, bread at the baker's and medicine at the chemist's. （讲清 the +职业+'s 表店铺的构词规律）

advancedExpressions.expression: the butcher ..., the ... ..., the ... ... — all ...
advancedExpressions.example: The butcher weighing his cuts, the tailor threading his needle, the ferryman calling out across the water — all of them, unknowing, wove together the living tapestry of the town. （三组"名词+现在分词"排比 + 破折号总收"wove together the tapestry"，续写市井群像）

advancedExpressions.expression: our humble butcher has quietly ... for years
advancedExpressions.example: Our humble butcher has quietly donated meat to the lonely elderly for years, asking neither thanks nor reward. （推荐信中以"quietly ... for years"凸显默默奉献，朴实动人）

advancedExpressions.expression: a mere butcher may ... no less than ...
advancedExpressions.example: A mere butcher, honest and diligent, may serve his community no less nobly than the greatest statesman, for society rests on countless such unnoticed hands. （"no less ... than"抬高平凡劳动 + 隐喻"unnoticed hands"深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The butcher gave meat to poor old people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every winter, without a word of announcement, the old butcher wrapped the finest cuts for the lonely elderly of the lane, and in his rough, generous hands the whole street learned the meaning of quiet kindness. （读后续写·市井·善举）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语"Every winter"开头 + 插入语"without a word of announcement"凸显低调 + 具体动作(wrapped the finest cuts) + 抽象升华"the meaning of quiet kindness"

sentenceUpgrade.original: The cruel ruler killed many people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History would not grant the tyrant the dignity of a ruler's name; it would brand him forever a butcher, whose throne was built on the silent grief of a thousand homes. （议论文·暴政·历史评判）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化"History would grant / brand" + 分号并置形成对照 + 定语从句"whose throne was built on grief" + 以"a thousand homes"以具体见宏大

classPractice.question: 用 butcher 的适当形式填空：In the scroll, hundreds of people, including ____, hairdressers and officials, go about their daily business.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文，butcher 作可数名词「屠夫、肉贩」，与其他职业并列用复数。

classPractice.question: On her way home she stopped at the ____ (butcher) to buy some fresh beef.
classPractice.note: 考 the butcher's = 肉店，名词所有格表店铺，类比 the baker's / the chemist's。

classPractice.question: 根据句意选义项(A肉贩 B刽子手 C宰杀v.)：History remembers the cruel tyrant as a ____, whose throne was built on a thousand deaths. 此处 butcher 意为____。
classPractice.note: 考 butcher 的比喻义「残忍杀害众人的刽子手」，由语境 cruel tyrant / a thousand deaths 判断。

translation: 忙于做某事，继续做某事
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to start dealing with a task, problem or situation in a particular way; to set about doing something
(2) phr. to continue doing something as part of one's normal routine, especially one's ordinary daily activities
(3) phr. (of a rumour, illness, etc.) to spread or be passed around among people
(4) phr. to move around from place to place, often in a particular manner or condition

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （谣言、疾病等）流传，传播开来
uncommonMeanings.example: A strange rumour was going about the school that the shy new girl had once sung on national television. （读后续写·校园·传闻）

posExamples.sentence: Along the ancient bridge, hundreds of townsfolk could be seen going about their daily business, utterly unaware that a passing painter was quietly weaving them into a scroll destined to outlive them all. （读后续写·画卷·市井日常）
I would like to ask your advice on how best to go about organising a charity book sale, as I have never planned such a large event before. （应用文·询问信）
How we go about solving a problem often reveals far more about our character than whether we succeed in the end. （议论文·过程与品格）
Even as grief pressed heavily on her heart, she forced herself to go about her chores, for she had learned that ordinary routine can be a quiet raft in a sea of sorrow. （读后续写·哀伤·坚韧）

idioms.example: The market woke at dawn and everyone went about their business, so that no single voice was heard above the warm hum of the crowd. （读后续写·集市·生活气息）

collocations.translation: 忙自己的日常事务，各干各的
collocations.example: Here, hundreds of people from all walks of life can be seen going about their daily business. （课文原句改编·古画·市井日常）
I would like to ask your advice on how best to go about organising a charity book sale. （应用文·询问信）

collocations.phrase: go about one's daily business / life
collocations.translation: 忙于日常事务，过日常生活
collocations.example: The city went about its daily life below, while high on the rooftop she finally found the courage to speak the words she had rehearsed for years. （读后续写·抉择·俯瞰城市）
She went about restoring the crumbling old house room by room, and with every repaired window a little of her own broken spirit seemed to heal. （读后续写·修缮·自我疗愈）
The teacher never simply handed us answers; instead she showed us how to go about thinking, which proved a far more precious gift. （议论文·教育方法）
The nurse went about her duties with such gentle patience that even the most frightened patients felt strangely at peace. （读后续写·医护·温柔）

collocations.phrase: go about it the right / wrong way
collocations.translation: 以正确/错误的方式着手
collocations.example: He had the noblest of intentions, yet by going about it the wrong way, he only deepened the very misunderstanding he had hoped to mend. （读后续写·好心办坏事·懊悔）

collocations.translation: 冷静地/有条理地着手做某事
collocations.example: Rather than panic, she went about the rescue methodically, checking each rope, each knot, each breath before she began the long climb down. （读后续写·救援·沉着）

synonyms.example: The moment the bell rang, the pupils set about tidying the classroom without a word of complaint. （读后续写·校园·勤劳）
synonyms.usage: 指"开始动手做"某项任务，后接名词或动名词，强调"起步、着手"的动作；go about 更侧重"以某种方式"处理，也可指"照常进行、忙于"日常事务

synonyms.example: The way she approached failure — with curiosity rather than shame — set her apart from her peers. （议论文·面对失败）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、较书面，指"以某种态度/方法对待"问题；go about 更口语，且常特指"具体如何去做"某件事的操作层面

synonyms.example: Despite the storm outside, the actors carried on with the show as if nothing were amiss. （读后续写·敬业·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 强调"继续、不间断地进行"已在做的事；go about (one's business) 侧重"照常忙于"日常事务，二者在"如常度日"义上相近

advancedExpressions.expression: go about sth / doing sth 着手做（=set about）/ go about one's business 照常忙于日常 / (rumour, illness) go about 流传、传开
advancedExpressions.example: While the townsfolk went about their business, a strange rumour was quietly going about, and no one yet knew how to go about stopping it. （三层含义在一句中对比呈现，一网打尽）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·着手做某事
advancedExpressions.expression: go about (doing) sth / set about (doing) sth 着手 / get down to (doing) sth 开始认真做 / approach sth 处理、对待
advancedExpressions.example: Once the plan was clear, she set about the work, got down to the details and went about each task with quiet resolve. （功能：表示「开始/处理某事」，辨析后接动名词的用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·go about 后接动名词
advancedExpressions.expression: go about doing sth（着手做）后接 -ing；how to go about sth 用 how + 不定式；go about one's business 后接名词
advancedExpressions.example: Knowing how to go about solving a problem matters as much as going about it without delay. （区分 go about doing / how to go about / go about one's business 三种结构）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. went about ..., unaware that ...
advancedExpressions.example: She went about her ordinary morning — brewing tea, feeding the cat, watering the plants — unaware that a single letter waiting in the box would soon overturn her entire quiet world. （"went about ..., unaware that ..."以日常反衬即将到来的转折，续写悬念铺垫）

advancedExpressions.expression: could you advise me on how to go about ...
advancedExpressions.example: Could you kindly advise me on how to go about improving my spoken English before the coming exchange programme? （询问信中礼貌请教方法，句式规范得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: how we go about ... reveals ...
advancedExpressions.example: How we go about pursuing our goals reveals our true worth far more faithfully than whether we ultimately reach them. （"how we go about ... reveals ..."聚焦过程 + 比较结构深化"过程重于结果"的论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The people were doing their everyday work.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Below the arching bridge, ferrymen, pedlars and scholars all went about their daily business, each small figure a living thread in the vast, breathing tapestry of the ancient city. （读后续写·画卷·市井群像）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语"Below the arching bridge"前置 + 三类人物并列作主语 + 同位语"a living thread"隐喻 + "breathing tapestry"拟人，画面生动

sentenceUpgrade.original: You need to plan how to start this project.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before you rush into anything, it is worth pausing to consider how best to go about the project, for a wise beginning, thoughtfully chosen, is already half the journey done. （议论文/应用文·方法建议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句"Before you rush into anything"开头 + it is worth doing 句式 + "how best to go about"疑问词不定式 + 谚语式收尾深化道理

classPractice.question: The townsfolk simply went about ____ (do) their daily business, unaware of the painter watching them.
classPractice.note: 考 go about doing sth「着手/忙于做某事」，about 是介词，后接动名词。

classPractice.question: Since I have never planned such an event, could you advise me on how to ____ ____ organising it?
classPractice.note: 考 how to go about (doing) sth「如何着手处理某事」，常用于询问信请教方法。

classPractice.question: 尽管悲伤压在心头，她仍强迫自己照常做家务。（go about, chores）
classPractice.answer: Although grief pressed heavily on her heart, she forced herself to go about her chores. / Even though she was overwhelmed by grief, she made herself go about her daily chores.
classPractice.note: 考 go about one's chores「照常忙于/做家务」表「如常度日」义。

translation: 显而易见的，明显的，表面上的
original_sentence: Zhang’s amazing artistic technique is apparent all across the scroll.
readingExamples: Zhang’s amazing artistic technique is apparent all across the scroll.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. easy to see or understand; clearly visible or obvious to everyone
(2) adj. seeming to be true or real, although this may not actually be the case; appearing on the surface
(3) adj. (become apparent) gradually coming to be understood or recognised as a fact
(4) adj. (heir apparent) whose right or position is legally certain and cannot be taken away

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 表面上的，貌似的（实则未必如此）
uncommonMeanings.example: His apparent calm fooled everyone in the room, but the trembling of his clasped hands beneath the table told a very different story. （读后续写·强装镇定·内心波澜）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the last veil was drawn back, the painter's astonishing skill became apparent to all, and a hush of pure wonder settled over the crowded hall. （读后续写·揭幕·惊叹）
It is apparent from the survey that most students long for more outdoor activities, and I therefore urge the school to take their voices seriously. （应用文·建议信）
The benefits of reading are not always immediately apparent, yet over the years they shape the mind as quietly and surely as water shapes stone. （议论文·阅读的长远价值）
For all his apparent indifference, the old teacher secretly kept every letter his students had ever written, tied in faded ribbon at the bottom of his desk. （读后续写·师者·深情藏于冷漠）

wordForms.adverb: apparently（显然地；据说，看起来（未必真实））
wordForms.other: 近义形容词 evident / obvious / transparent；易混：apparent(明显的) ↔ transparent(透明的) ↔ appearance(名词,外表)；apparently 常表"看起来（但未必属实）"

idioms.translation: （王位、地位的）法定继承人，接班人
idioms.example: Groomed from childhood as the heir apparent to the family workshop, he secretly dreamed only of the open sea. （读后续写·继承·内心挣扎）

collocations.phrase: be apparent (all across / to sb) —— 课文原句
collocations.translation: （遍布……地）显而易见；对某人而言明显
collocations.example: Zhang's amazing artistic technique is apparent all across the scroll. （课文原句·古画·技艺）
It is apparent that no lasting change can be achieved without everyone's support. （议论文·集体力量）

collocations.translation: 没有明显原因，无缘无故
collocations.example: For no apparent reason, the old dog suddenly began to bark at the empty doorway. （读后续写·悬疑·预感）
As the days passed, it became apparent that the quiet boy at the back of the class possessed a talent the whole school had overlooked. （读后续写·被忽视的天才·崭露头角）
Her exhaustion was apparent to everyone but herself, for she had long forgotten how to ask for rest. （读后续写·操劳·忘我）
It is apparent that no lasting change can be achieved without the wholehearted support of every member of our community. （议论文·集体力量）
There is an apparent contradiction between freedom and discipline, yet the wise soon discover that one nourishes the other. （议论文·自由与自律）
It was apparent from her shining eyes that the news, long awaited, had finally arrived. （读后续写·喜讯·激动）
One sleepless night made apparent to him just how heavily his careless words had wounded his oldest friend. （读后续写·愧疚·顿悟）

synonyms.example: It was obvious to everyone that the frightened kitten had not eaten for days. （读后续写·怜悯·细节）
synonyms.usage: 指"一眼可见、毫无疑问"，语气直白、常用；apparent 除"明显"外，还常带"表面上（未必真实）"的言外之意，语域略正式

synonyms.example: Her devotion to the students was evident in every extra hour she spent after class. （议论文·师者奉献）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、书面，指"有证据可循、清楚可见"，多用于抽象事物；apparent 更常与"become / it is ... that"搭配，且可含"貌似"义

synonyms.example: The teacher's instructions were so clear that not a single hand went up to ask a question. （应用文/记叙·清晰）
synonyms.usage: 最通用，指"清晰、无混淆"，可修饰指令、思路、天空等；apparent 更强调"显现出来、被察觉到"，且带表里之别的微妙含义

advancedExpressions.expression: it is apparent that ... 很明显 / for no apparent reason 无缘无故 / become apparent 逐渐显现 / be apparent to sb 对某人显而易见 / apparently 显然/据说
advancedExpressions.example: For no apparent reason he fell silent, yet it soon became apparent to us all that something was deeply wrong. （几个高考高频结构串讲，覆盖形容词与副词）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·appear 词族 + 表里之别
advancedExpressions.expression: appear(v.显现/显得)→appearance(n.外表)→apparent(adj.明显的/表面的)→apparently(adv.显然/据说)；apparent 兼含"表面上（实则未必）"义
advancedExpressions.example: His apparent calm and his trembling hands told two different stories, and apparently he was far more afraid than he appeared. （同族词串讲，并点出 apparent「表面上」的言外之意）

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did it become apparent that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only then did it become apparent that the gruff old man had been secretly paying the boy's tuition all along. （倒装"only then did ... become apparent"制造揭晓时刻，续写反转升华人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is apparent from ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is apparent from the results of our survey that a growing number of students yearn for a quieter place to read. （建议信中引数据陈述，客观有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: the apparent ... often conceals ...
advancedExpressions.example: The apparent weakness of gentleness often conceals a strength far greater than force could ever muster. （"the apparent ... conceals ..."揭示表里反差 + 对比 gentleness/force，辩证深刻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone could clearly see how skilled he was.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the crowd pressed closer to the unrolled scroll, the master's breathtaking skill grew apparent in every delicate line, until admiration ripened, hush by hush, into open awe. （读后续写·画卷·惊叹）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句"As the crowd pressed closer"开头 + "grew apparent"渐进 + until 结果 + "hush by hush"节奏副词 + 情感递进(admiration→awe)

sentenceUpgrade.original: He looked calm but was actually very nervous.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath his apparent composure churned a storm of nerves, and though his face betrayed nothing, the white-knuckled grip on his notes gave the secret away. （读后续写·强装镇定·内心波澜）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 介词短语"Beneath his apparent composure"倒装开头 + 隐喻"a storm of nerves" + though 让步 + 细节"white-knuckled grip"以形传神

classPractice.question: The lights suddenly went out, and for no ____ reason the whole house fell into an uneasy silence.
classPractice.note: 考固定短语 for no apparent reason「无缘无故，没有明显原因」。

classPractice.question:
从调查结果可以明显看出，大多数学生渴望更多户外活动。（It is apparent from ... that ...）
____ ____ ____ ____ the survey ____ most students long for more outdoor activities.
classPractice.note: 考句型 It is apparent from ... that ...「从……可以明显看出」，from 引出依据。

classPractice.question: His ____ (apparent) calm fooled everyone, but the trembling of his hands told a different story.
classPractice.note: 考 apparent 作定语，此处取「表面上的（实则未必）」义，修饰 calm。

original_sentence: Using ink on silk, he creates realistic images of scenery, buildings and people, and displays a remarkable mastery of perspective.
readingExamples: Using ink on silk, he creates realistic images of scenery, buildings and people, and displays a remarkable mastery of perspective.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a coloured liquid used for writing, printing or drawing, especially the black liquid used with a brush in traditional painting
(2) n. the dark liquid that an octopus, squid or similar creature releases to defend itself
(3) vt. to cover, mark or fill something with ink; to sign a document or agreement (informal)
(4) n. (informal) writing, printing or tattoos regarded collectively

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）正式签署（合同、协议）
uncommonMeanings.example: The two schools finally inked the exchange agreement, and a bridge of friendship, long dreamed of, was at last built between them. （应用文·合作·签约）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （章鱼、乌贼等喷出的）墨汁
uncommonMeanings.example: Startled by the diver's shadow, the octopus released a dark cloud of ink and vanished, leaving only a swirling blur where it had been. （读后续写·海底·惊险）

posExamples.sentence: With a few strokes of ink on silk, the old master conjured whole mountains out of emptiness, until the blank scroll seemed to breathe with mist and morning light. （读后续写·作画·出神入化）
In our calligraphy workshop, participants will learn to grind ink the traditional way, discovering how much patience lies behind a single graceful line. （应用文·活动通知）
In an age of glowing screens, the quiet ritual of ink and paper still teaches us a patience and care that no keyboard can ever replace. （议论文·传统与科技）
The old scholar dipped his brush, and as the black ink kissed the white paper, years of loneliness seemed to flow, silent and dark, from his heart onto the page. （读后续写·书法·抒怀）

wordForms.other: inkwell / inkpot (n. 墨水瓶)

idioms.idiom: the ink is not yet dry / before the ink is dry
idioms.translation: 墨迹未干（喻协议、承诺刚定下）
idioms.example: Before the ink on the peace treaty was even dry, fresh quarrels had already begun to smoulder. （议论文·和平的脆弱）

collocations.phrase: ink on silk / paper —— 课文原句
collocations.example: Using ink on silk, he creates realistic images of scenery, buildings and people. （课文原句·国画·技艺）
Once his promise was set down in ink, there could be no turning back. （读后续写·承诺·决心）
Working with ink on silk, the artist captured the trembling of bamboo leaves so vividly that one almost heard them rustle. （读后续写·国画·传神）
Grinding the ink slowly against the stone, the boy learned that art, like life, begins with patience. （读后续写·习艺·耐心）
A single drop of ink spread through the water in delicate feathers, and the child watched, spellbound, as darkness bloomed like a flower. （读后续写·童趣·观察）

collocations.phrase: in black and white / in ink
collocations.example: Once his promise was set down in ink, there could be no turning back, and a strange calm settled over his restless heart. （读后续写·承诺·决心）
Halfway through the crucial exam his pen ran out of ink, and for one heart-stopping moment the whole room seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·考场·意外）
As children they had passed secret notes in invisible ink, giggling at a code no grown-up could ever crack. （读后续写·童年·秘密）
The gallery's finest treasure was an ancient ink-and-wash landscape, its faded mountains still whispering of a vanished world. （应用文·展览介绍）

synonyms.example: The cloth was steeped in a deep indigo dye until it glowed like a summer evening sky. （读后续写·工艺·色彩）
synonyms.usage: 指用于给织物、头发等"上色"的染料，重在着色；ink 专用于书写、印刷、绘画的液体，二者用途不同

synonyms.example: She squeezed bright blobs of paint onto her palette, ready to bring the empty canvas to life. （读后续写·作画·热情）
synonyms.usage: 指黏稠、可覆盖的颜料或油漆，色彩丰富、可堆叠；ink 更稀薄流动，尤指黑色墨汁，传统水墨画的核心材料

synonyms.example: The ancient mural's pigments had faded, yet a haunting beauty still lingered in every worn line. （议论文·古迹·岁月）
synonyms.usage: 偏专业术语，指构成颜料的"色素"成分本身；ink 是可直接使用的成品液体，日常与艺术语境都常见

advancedExpressions.expression: ink on silk 绢本墨画 / in ink 用墨写、白纸黑字 / grind ink 研墨 / ink and wash (painting) 水墨画 / run out of ink 墨水用完 / ink a deal 签署协议(v.)
advancedExpressions.example: Using ink on silk, and every promise set down in ink, the old master joined art and honour in a single black stroke. （名词、动词与文化词一并串讲）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·ink 派生与合成
advancedExpressions.expression: ink（墨水/墨汁）→ inky（adj. 墨黑的，沾墨的）→ inkwell / inkpot（墨水瓶）；vt. ink 表"签署（协议）"（非正式）
advancedExpressions.example: His inky fingers, the empty inkwell and the freshly inked contract all told the same long night's story. （派生词、合成词与动词义一并呈现）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the ink ..., ... seemed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the ink spread softly across the silk, mountains, rivers and clouds seemed to rise from nowhere, as though the painter were breathing a whole world into being. （"as the ink ..."引出动态 + as though 比喻"breathing a world into being"，续写作画场景神来之笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: participants will experience the art of ink ...
advancedExpressions.example: Participants will experience the ancient art of ink painting first-hand, and perhaps discover, in a single black stroke, the serenity our busy age has forgotten. （活动通知中兼具吸引力与文化深度）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the age of ..., ink still ...
advancedExpressions.example: In the age of the flickering screen, ink and paper still hold a quiet magic, reminding us that some beauty is worth slowing down for. （"in the age of ..., ink still ..."今昔对照 + 隐喻"quiet magic"，论证传统的当代意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He painted mountains with ink on silk.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With nothing but ink on silk and a lifetime of patience, the old master coaxed entire mountain ranges out of emptiness, until the blank scroll trembled with mist, distance and quiet longing. （读后续写·国画·出神入化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 介词短语"With nothing but ..."开头蓄势 + 动词"coaxed ... out of emptiness"拟人 + until 结果 + 三名词并列(mist, distance, longing)由实入虚

sentenceUpgrade.original: Once you sign the agreement, you cannot change it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Once the words are set down in ink, they can no longer be unsaid, and so wise hands hesitate before they write what a lifetime may be bound to honour. （议论文·承诺的重量）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Once 引导时间状语从句 + 被动"are set down in ink" + 谚语式主句 + 定语从句"what a lifetime may be bound to honour"深化承诺分量

classPractice.question:
他运用绢本墨画，创作出栩栩如生的山水人物。（using ink on silk）
____ ____ ____ ____, he creates realistic images of scenery, buildings and people.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文，考 ink on silk「在丝绸上作的墨画」及现在分词作状语。

classPractice.question: Once his solemn promise was set down ____ ____, there could be no turning back.
classPractice.note: 考 in ink「用墨水写、白纸黑字」，喻承诺一经写下便不可反悔。

classPractice.question: 在书法课上，学员们将学习用传统方式研墨。（grind ink）
classPractice.answer: In the calligraphy class, participants will learn to grind ink in the traditional way. / In the calligraphy workshop, students will learn how to grind ink the traditional way.
classPractice.note: 考 grind ink「研墨」，ink 作不可数名词表「墨汁」。

translation: 透视法，角度，观点，看法，洞察力，视角，视野
original_sentence: Experts provide interpretations of Du Fu’s works from different perspectives.
readingExamples: Experts provide interpretations of Du Fu’s works from different perspectives.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a particular way of thinking about something, especially one that is influenced by one's beliefs or experiences; a point of view
(2) n. the art of drawing solid objects on a flat surface so as to give the correct impression of depth, distance and relative size
(3) n. a sensible way of judging how important or serious things really are, in relation to one another
(4) n. a view or scene, especially one stretching away into the distance

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 观点，看法，视角（by one's beliefs/experience 塑造的看待方式）
uncommonMeanings.example: A month abroad gave her a fresh perspective on the small hometown she had once longed to leave. （读后续写·远行·重识家乡）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （绘画的）透视法，远近法
uncommonMeanings.example: By his masterly command of perspective, the painter made a flat sheet of silk open into a valley so deep that viewers instinctively leaned back from its edge. （读后续写·画作·透视之妙）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （权衡轻重的）客观态度，分寸感；正确的评估
uncommonMeanings.example: One quiet talk with the old fisherman put all her troubles into perspective. （读后续写·开解·豁然）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （伸向远方的）远景，景象
uncommonMeanings.example: From the tower a magnificent perspective of rolling hills and winding rivers opened before them. （读后续写·登高·远景）

posExamples.sentence: It was only after wandering alone through a foreign city for a month that she gained a fresh perspective on the small hometown she had once been so desperate to leave. （读后续写·远行·重新认识家乡）
I am writing to suggest that the school invite experts to share their perspectives on career planning, as many of us feel anxious and uncertain about the future. （应用文·建议信）
A problem that seems overwhelming from one perspective may reveal an unexpected solution the moment we have the courage to view it from another. （议论文·换位思考）
Standing at last on the mountain's summit, she saw her long, exhausting struggle from a wholly new perspective, and every hardship suddenly seemed a step that had lifted her here. （读后续写·登顶·顿悟）

wordForms.other: 易混词：prospect (n. 前景，展望) / perspective (n. 视角，透视法) / prospective (adj. 预期的，未来的)；辨析 perspective(看待角度) ≠ prospect(前景)

idioms.idiom: put / get sth in / into perspective
idioms.translation: 客观看待，正确评估（某事的轻重）
idioms.example: One quiet talk with the wise old fisherman put all her troubles into perspective, and the fears that had loomed so large by night shrank to nothing by morning. （读后续写·开解·豁然）
In the face of a single harsh grade, he struggled to keep things in perspective, reminding himself that one exam could never define an entire life. （读后续写·挫折·自我宽解）

collocations.example: From a teacher's perspective, a single moment of encouragement can quietly redirect the whole course of a young life. （议论文·教育的力量）

collocations.phrase: a fresh / new / different perspective (on sth)
collocations.translation: （对某事的）全新的/不同的视角
collocations.example: Volunteering at the shelter gave the boy a fresh perspective on how fortunate his own life had been. （读后续写·志愿·感恩）

collocations.phrase: mastery of perspective —— 课文语境
collocations.example: He displays a remarkable mastery of perspective, so that distant boats seem truly to shrink into the misty horizon. （课文原句改编·古画·技艺）
When she finally looked at the quarrel from her mother's perspective, the anger in her chest melted, drop by drop, into shame. （读后续写·和解·换位）

collocations.phrase: gain / gain a fresh perspective on sth
collocations.example: Volunteering at the shelter gave the pampered boy a fresh perspective on how fortunate his own quiet life had truly been. （读后续写·志愿·感恩）

collocations.translation: 宽广的/全球的/历史的视角
collocations.example: Viewed from a historical perspective, today's fiercest quarrels will one day seem no more than a ripple on a vast and patient river. （议论文·历史眼光）
The exchange student offered a perspective on friendship so warm and open that it gently reshaped how the whole class saw one another. （读后续写·跨文化·启发）

collocations.translation: 分寸感，权衡轻重的能力
collocations.example: Amid the storm of exam pressure, it is a sense of perspective, more than sheer effort, that keeps a student calm and whole. （议论文·心态平衡）
Whether the glass is half empty or half full is, in the end, purely a matter of perspective. （议论文·乐观与悲观）
The scroll displayed such a mastery of perspective that distant boats seemed truly to shrink into the misty horizon. （读后续写·画卷·技艺）

synonyms.example: Each member of the debate team defended a sharply different viewpoint, yet all listened with genuine respect. （议论文·理性辩论）
synonyms.usage: 指个人的"观点、立场"，较具体、常用；perspective 更侧重由经历或身份塑造的"整体看待方式"，语域略高，还可指绘画透视法

synonyms.example: The young reporter approached the tired old story from a completely fresh angle, and readers saw it as if for the first time. （读后续写·记者·创新）
synonyms.usage: 较口语，指"看待或处理事情的角度"，灵活生动；perspective 更正式、更宏观，强调背后的思维框架或立场

synonyms.example: A single encouraging teacher transformed his gloomy outlook into one brimming with hope. （读后续写·转变·希望）
synonyms.usage: 多指对生活、未来的"总体态度或展望"，偏向长期心态；perspective 更常指对具体事物的"看待角度"，二者在"看法"义上部分重叠

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·perspective 多义多搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: from a fresh / different perspective 从全新/不同角度 / put sth in perspective 客观看待 / a sense of perspective 分寸感 / mastery of perspective 透视法(绘画) / gain a new perspective on sth 对某事有新认识
advancedExpressions.example: Seen from a fresh perspective, and with a calm sense of perspective, the failure that once loomed so large fell neatly into place. （"视角/客观态度/透视法"三义搭配一并串讲）

advancedExpressions.expression: perspective（由经历/身份塑造的看待方式，可指透视法）/ viewpoint 观点立场 / angle 角度（口语）/ standpoint 立场 / outlook 人生观、总体态度
advancedExpressions.example: Each speaker brought a different perspective, a distinct viewpoint and a fresh angle, until the old question glowed with new light. （功能：表达「看法、角度」，辨析语域与侧重）

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. see ... from a new perspective
advancedExpressions.example: Only then, standing breathless on the summit, did she see her long ordeal from an entirely new perspective — not as suffering, but as the very staircase that had carried her to the sky. （倒装"only then did ... see" + from a new perspective + 破折号重定义"suffering→staircase"，续写结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: it would broaden our perspectives if ...
advancedExpressions.example: It would greatly broaden our perspectives if the school could invite people from different professions to share their experiences with us. （建议信中委婉提议，句式规范）

advancedExpressions.expression: seen from a different perspective, ... becomes ...
advancedExpressions.example: Seen from a different perspective, what looks like failure often becomes the disguised beginning of something far greater. （"seen from a different perspective"引导独立分词 + 隐喻"disguised beginning"，辩证深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: After travelling, she saw her hometown differently.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was distance, strangely, that brought her home closer: after a month among unfamiliar streets, she looked back on the little town from a wholly new perspective, and every once-dull rooftop now glowed with a tenderness she had never known to feel. （读后续写·远行·重识家乡）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 强调结构"It was distance that ..." + 冒号引出结果 + from a new perspective + 结尾以"glowed with tenderness"化寻常为动人

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should look at problems from other angles.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Whenever a difficulty seems insurmountable, we would do well to shift our perspective, for the wall that blocks us from one angle may, from another, reveal a door we never knew was there. （议论文·换位思考）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Whenever 引导条件状语从句 + would do well to 委婉劝诫 + 隐喻"wall / door"对照 + 从句"we never knew was there"点明视角转换之效

classPractice.question: One quiet talk with the wise old man put all her worries ____ ____, and by morning her fears had shrunk to nothing.
classPractice.note: 考习语 put sth in/into perspective「客观看待，正确评估轻重」。

classPractice.question:
站在山顶，她以全新的视角看待自己漫长的奋斗。（from a new perspective）
Standing on the summit, she saw her long struggle ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 考 from a (new) perspective「从（全新）视角」，perspective 此处取「看待角度」义。

classPractice.question: 选 perspective 或 prospect：The painter's mastery of ____ makes distant boats shrink into the horizon, while the young graduate looked forward to a bright ____.
classPractice.note: 考易混词辨析：perspective(透视法/视角) 与 prospect(前景，展望)。

translation: 精确的，准确的，明确的，恰好的
original_sentence: The most impressive aspect of the painting, however, is probably Zhang’s precise brushwork.
readingExamples: The most impressive aspect of the painting, however, is probably Zhang’s precise brushwork.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. exact, accurate, and careful about small details
(2) adj. used to emphasize that you are referring to one particular thing, moment, or place and no other (the precise moment / the precise reason)
(3) adj. (of a person) taking care to be exact and accurate, especially about details

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 恰好的，正是那个（强调时间/地点/原因的确切性）
uncommonMeanings.example: At the precise moment the clock struck midnight, the old lighthouse keeper lit the lamp one final time, unaware that this quiet ritual would never be his again. （读后续写·告别·时间点强调）

posExamples.sentence: With slow, precise movements, the surgeon threaded the needle through the trembling child's wound, his steady hands the only calm thing in that frantic emergency room. （读后续写·手术/救援场景）
I would be grateful if you could provide precise information about the registration deadline and the exact location of the summer camp, as several classmates intend to sign up together. （应用文·咨询信）
To be precise in one's reasoning is not merely a matter of style; it is the very foundation upon which persuasive argument and mutual understanding are built. （议论文·思维与表达）
The craftsman's precise brushwork, honed over four decades, transformed a blank silk scroll into a living street where every vendor seemed poised to call out. （读后续写·传统技艺）

wordForms.other: imprecise (adj. 不精确的)；构词法·前缀 im- 表否定加在辅音 p 前(im+precise)；precisely 可作强调答语 'Precisely!'(正是如此)；辨析: precise ≈ 精确到细节 vs accurate ≈ 与事实相符无误

collocations.translation: 确切地说，准确地说（插入语，进一步精确化前文）
collocations.example: The scroll dates from the Northern Song Dynasty — the early twelfth century, to be precise. 这幅长卷出自北宋，确切地说是十二世纪初。
At the precise moment she touched the trophy, tears filled her eyes. 就在她触到奖杯的那一刻，泪水盈眶。
My grandfather was always precise about time. 我爷爷对时间总是一丝不苟。
Zhang's precise brushwork gives the crowded market both order and life. 张择端精准的笔法让拥挤的集市既有序又生动。
Taking precise measurements of each ancient beam, the restoration team recreated the temple exactly as it had stood a thousand years ago. （读后续写·文物修复）
The precise moment her fingertips brushed the trophy, years of predawn training and silent sacrifice flashed before her eyes. （读后续写·夺冠瞬间）
A precise definition of 'success' varies from person to person, yet few pause to work out what the word truly means to them. （议论文·概念界定）
The volunteers followed the coordinator's precise instructions, and by noon the entire riverbank had been cleared of litter. （应用文·活动纪实）
The dancers moved with mathematical precision, each turn timed to the very beat of the drum. （读后续写·表演场景）

synonyms.example: The witness gave an accurate account of what she had seen. （议论文/记叙文·如实陈述）
synonyms.usage: 辨析 precise/accurate: accurate 强调'与事实/真相相符、没有错误'(答案对不对); precise 强调'具体、细致、精确到细节'(有多细)。一个测量结果可以 accurate(方向没错)却不够 precise(不够精细)。句法上二者都可作定语/表语。

synonyms.example: Could you tell me the exact time the ceremony begins? （应用文·询问）
synonyms.usage: exact 与 precise 常可互换,但 exact 更口语、强调'完全相符/一分不差'(the exact same); precise 更书面,且可形容人做事严谨(a precise person)。

synonyms.translation: 一丝不苟的，细致入微的
synonyms.example: Her meticulous notes, colour-coded and cross-referenced, left nothing to chance. （读后续写·学霸形象）
synonyms.usage: meticulous 只形容人或人的行为极其仔细认真,程度比 precise 更强、更褒扬; precise 可形容人、物、数据、语言,范围更广。

advancedExpressions.expression: to be precise / to put it precisely / more precisely
advancedExpressions.example: It happened last week — on Tuesday, to be precise. 事情发生在上周，确切地说是周二。（插入语精确化前文信息，书面口语皆宜）

advancedExpressions.expression: to be precise ≈ to be exact ≈ strictly speaking ≈ more accurately
advancedExpressions.example: There were about a hundred guests — ninety-eight, to be exact. 大约一百位客人，确切地说是九十八位。（三个插入语都可跟在破折号后进一步精确化）

advancedExpressions.expression: precise (adj.) → precision (n.) → precisely (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: The surgeon worked with great precision, cutting precisely where the diagram showed. 外科医生极其精准地操作，恰好在图示处下刀。（同根三态串记：形容词/名词/副词）

advancedExpressions.expression: with slow / deliberate / precise + n., sb. did ...
advancedExpressions.example: With deliberate, precise strokes, she signed her name beneath the letter she had waited a lifetime to send. （介词短语前置伴随状语,放大动作的分量与仪式感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would appreciate it if you could give me the precise details of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would appreciate it if you could give me the precise details of the exhibition schedule so that our class may plan the visit accordingly. （委婉请求句式,precise details 显得诉求具体、态度诚恳）

advancedExpressions.expression: to be precise about what we mean by ... is the first step towards ...
advancedExpressions.example: To be precise about what we mean by 'freedom' is the first step towards any honest debate on the subject. （以定义开篇,先立后论,提升论证严谨度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The painter's brushwork was very good.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The painter's precise brushwork — each line taut, each dot intentional — breathed life into a thousand tiny figures, so that the ancient river seemed to murmur once more beneath the silk. （读后续写·艺术描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 以 precise 替换 very good 精准化 + 破折号插入语并列细节(each line taut, each dot intentional) + 拟人(the river seemed to murmur) + so that 结果状语延展画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Please tell me the exact time and place.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I would be most grateful if you could let me know the precise time and venue of the event, as several of us wish to attend together and would hate to arrive late. （应用文·咨询信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I would be most grateful if 委婉正式主句 + precise 替 exact 提升书面感 + as 引导原因说明诉求合理 + would hate to 情态动词软化语气

classPractice.question: The manuscript dates from the twelfth century — to be ____ (precise), from around 1120.
classPractice.note: 固定插入语 to be precise「确切地说」，破折号后进一步精确化，用形容词原级。

classPractice.question: 选 precise / accurate 填空：A clock can be ____ to the second yet not ____ if it is set five minutes fast. (第一空/第二空)
classPractice.note: precise 指精细程度(精确到秒)，accurate 指是否与事实相符(快了五分钟就不准)；这句正是二者对比的经典例证。

classPractice.question: 把握好这一刻的精确时机，她按下了快门。（用 the precise moment）
classPractice.answer: At the precise moment, she pressed the shutter. / She pressed the shutter at the precise moment.
classPractice.note: the precise moment「恰恰那一刻」；at 引导时间点状语。

translation: 有雄心的，有抱负的，有野心的
original_sentence: This well-developed ability, as well as the scroll’s ambitious size, allows Zhang to show an enormous amount of detail— you could study the painting for hours and still discover something new.
readingExamples: This well-developed ability, as well as the scroll’s ambitious size, allows Zhang to show an enormous amount of detail— you could study the painting for hours and still discover something new.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having a strong desire to be successful, powerful, or rich
(2) adj. (of a plan, project, or goal) needing great effort, ability, and determination to succeed; large in scope and difficult to achieve
(3) adj. showing or requiring great ambition

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（计划/规模/目标）宏大的、耗资巨大的、庞大而有难度的（非贬义，形容事物）：ambitious size 宏大的画幅；the government's ambitious plans 政府耗资巨大的计划
uncommonMeanings.example: The scroll's ambitious size — over five metres of unbroken silk — allowed the master to capture an entire city in a single sweep. 长卷宏大的画幅——五米多的整幅绢帛——让大师得以在一气呵成中容纳整座城市。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 野心勃勃的（贬义，指过度追求权力/成功）
uncommonMeanings.example: The ambitious minister would stop at nothing to seize the throne. 那个野心勃勃的大臣为夺取王位不择手段。（含贬义色彩，语境决定褒贬）

posExamples.sentence: Poor yet fiercely ambitious, the village girl pinned a hand-drawn map of the world above her bed, vowing that one day her name would travel further than any road she had ever walked. （读后续写·励志·人物志向）
We are launching an ambitious plan to plant ten thousand trees along the river this spring, and we sincerely hope every student will lend a hand in this meaningful project. （应用文·倡议书）
Being ambitious is not a flaw to be ashamed of; rather, it is the quiet engine that drives ordinary people to attempt extraordinary things. （议论文·成长/理想主题）
The ambitious young architect unrolled her blueprint on the dusty table, her eyes shining with a vision far larger than the small town could yet imagine. （读后续写·追梦者形象）

wordForms.noun: ambition (n. 雄心，抱负；渴望实现的目标)
wordForms.other: over-ambitious (adj. 野心过大的)；构词法·-tion(名词)→-tious(形容词): ambition→ambitious；搭配记: have / fulfil / achieve one's ambition, an ambition to do sth；a burning ambition 强烈的抱负

collocations.translation: 【课件】宏大的画幅／规模（ambitious 形容事物、宏大而有难度，非贬义；本课 the scroll's ambitious size）
collocations.example: The scroll's ambitious size allows Zhang to show an enormous amount of detail. 长卷宏大的画幅使张择端得以展现海量细节。

collocations.translation: 【课件】政府耗资巨大／雄心勃勃的……计划
collocations.example: The government's ambitious plans for social reform will take decades to complete. 政府耗资巨大的社会改革计划将需要几十年才能完成。

collocations.phrase: have an ambition (n.) to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】有做某事的抱负／志向（ambition n. 抱负）
collocations.example: She had always had an ambition to travel further than any road she had ever walked. 她一直怀有走得比自己踏过的任何路都远的抱负。
His ambition of becoming a painter never faded, however hard the years grew. 无论岁月多么艰难，他成为画家的抱负从未消退。
After years of quiet effort, she finally achieved her ambition of holding her own exhibition. 经过多年默默努力，她终于实现了办个人画展的抱负。
However ambitious the goal, the team broke it into small daily tasks. 无论目标多宏大，团队都把它拆成每天的小任务。
Ambitious to prove herself, she stayed after class every evening. 一心想证明自己，她每晚都留下自习。
His parents were quietly ambitious for him, yet they never once pushed him beyond what his own heart desired. （读后续写·亲情）
Critics dismissed the young director's overly ambitious film, but time proved that his so-called excess was in fact vision. （议论文·评价与反转）
The company was eager to recruit ambitious young graduates who dared to challenge the way things had always been done. （应用文·招聘启事）
Ambitious in scope, the restoration of the ancient temple would take a full decade and the devotion of three generations of craftsmen. （说明文·工程规模）
Mapping every street of the medieval capital was a highly ambitious undertaking, and yet the painter completed it stroke by patient stroke. （说明文·壮举）

synonyms.translation: 【课件·词族】雄心，抱负；渴望实现的目标
synonyms.example: Driven by a burning ambition, he refused to let his hometown become the limit of his dreams. 怀着炽热的抱负，他不肯让家乡成为自己梦想的边界。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】ambition n. 抱负 → ambitious adj. 有抱负的/宏大的。高频搭配：have an ambition to do sth；one's ambition of doing sth；achieve / fulfil / realize one's ambition。名词用 ambition，形容词用 ambitious，勿混。

synonyms.example: The workshop welcomed aspiring writers of every age. （应用文·活动介绍）
synonyms.usage: aspiring 侧重'渴望成为某种人/达到某目标',常直接修饰身份(aspiring writer/singer),语气温和积极; ambitious 语气更强,可含中性甚至略带野心的色彩,既可修饰人也可修饰计划(an ambitious plan)。

synonyms.example: Determined not to let poverty define her future, she read by candlelight long after the village had fallen asleep. （读后续写·意志刻画）
synonyms.usage: determined 强调'决心已定、不动摇',是意志层面,常接 to do / that 从句; ambitious 强调'有远大的目标/欲望',是志向层面。

synonyms.translation: 有进取心的，有开拓精神的
synonyms.example: The enterprising students set up a small charity stall and raised enough to fund a new library corner. （应用文·活动/议论）
synonyms.usage: enterprising 侧重'敢想敢干、善于创新和把握机会',偏行动力; ambitious 侧重内心的志向和欲望,不必然付诸创新行动。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·抱负与目标（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: an ambitious size / plan / goal ; have an ambition to do sth ; one's ambition of doing sth ; achieve / fulfil / realize one's ambition
advancedExpressions.example: Fired by an ambition to fulfil his lifelong ambition of mapping a whole city, he took on a project ambitious in size and never once looked back. 怀着实现毕生抱负——描绘整座城市——的雄心，他接下这项规模宏大的工程，从未回头。（ambition 名词搭配 + ambitious 形容事物一句串）

advancedExpressions.expression: an ambitious plan / goal / target ; be ambitious to do sth ; have the ambition to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: We have set ourselves an ambitious target: to plant ten thousand trees before spring ends. 我们定下一个宏大目标——春末前种一万棵树。（ambitious 修饰 plan/goal/target 是高考写作黄金搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: ambition (n.) → ambitious (adj.) → ambitiously (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: Driven by ambition, the ambitious young engineer worked ambitiously through every setback. 出于雄心，这位有抱负的年轻工程师在每次挫折中都干劲十足。（一句串起名/形/副三态）

advancedExpressions.expression: poor / young yet fiercely ambitious, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Poor yet fiercely ambitious, he refused to let the boundaries of his hometown become the boundaries of his dreams. （'A yet B' 让步结构塑造反差人物,凸显志向的可贵）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are launching an ambitious plan to ..., and we sincerely hope that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are launching an ambitious plan to restore the old campus garden, and we sincerely hope that every one of you will contribute your energy and ideas. （倡议信主体句,ambitious plan 提升号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: being ambitious is not ...; rather, it is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Being ambitious is not a sign of greed; rather, it is the courage to imagine a self greater than one's present circumstances. （'not ...; rather ...' 纠偏句式,先破后立,深化观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She wanted to be successful and worked hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Fiercely ambitious, she poured every spare hour into her craft, until the calluses on her hands and the fire in her eyes told the same silent story of a girl chasing something the world had told her she could never reach. （读后续写·奋斗刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 形容词短语 Fiercely ambitious 前置作状语 + until 引导结果 + 并列意象(calluses on hands / fire in eyes) + told the same story 拟人化细节 + 定语从句收束情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our plan is big and we hope people will join.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This is an ambitious undertaking, one that no single hand could accomplish alone, and it is precisely for this reason that we warmly invite every member of our community to become a part of it. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: an ambitious undertaking 名词化提升正式度 + one that 同位语从句补充 + it is precisely for this reason that 强调句式 + warmly invite 情感化号召

classPractice.question: Driven by ____ (ambitious), the young man vowed to travel further than any road he had ever walked.
classPractice.note: 介词 by 后需名词，ambitious 的名词形式为 ambition「雄心，抱负」。

classPractice.question: 【课件】政府雄心勃勃的社会改革计划将需要几十年才能完成。The government's ____ ____ for social reform will take decades to complete.
classPractice.note: ambitious plans「宏大的／耗资巨大的计划」是 PPT 给出的核心搭配，ambitious 形容 plans、非贬义。

classPractice.question: 我们正在启动一项宏大的计划，去绿化整条河岸。We are launching ____ ____ ____ to green the whole riverbank.
classPractice.note: an ambitious plan「一项宏大的计划」是写作高频搭配，ambitious 此处形容事物、非贬义。

classPractice.question: 选 ambitious / determined：Not only was she ____ enough to set a huge goal, she was also ____ enough never to give it up. (第一空/第二空)
classPractice.note: ambitious 侧重'有远大目标'(定目标)，determined 侧重'决心不动摇'(不放弃)，两词层次互补。

original_sentence: This well-developed ability, as well as the scroll’s ambitious size, allows Zhang to show an enormous amount of detail— you could study the painting for hours and still discover something new.
readingExamples: This well-developed ability, as well as the scroll’s ambitious size, allows Zhang to show an enormous amount of detail— you could study the painting for hours and still discover something new.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. extremely large in size, amount, or degree
(2) adj. (of a feeling, effort, or effect) very great; considerable in importance or intensity

posExamples.sentence: As the fog lifted, an enormous mountain reared up before them, its snow-capped peak piercing the clouds like the spear of some sleeping giant. （读后续写·壮景描写）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to express our enormous gratitude for the time and patience you have devoted to us throughout this unforgettable year. （应用文·感谢信）
The enormous influence of a single act of kindness should never be underestimated, for ripples, once set in motion, travel far beyond what the eye can follow. （议论文·善行的力量）
He heaved the enormous suitcase up five flights of stairs, sweat streaming down his face, all for the chance to surprise his mother on her birthday. （读后续写·亲情/付出）

wordForms.other: 构词法·e-(ex- 向外)+norm(标准/规范)+-ous → '超出常规的'即'巨大的'；注意 enormity 常指'（罪行/错误的）严重性'而非单纯'大小'，勿与 enormousness 混；enormously 常修饰形容词/动词(enormously popular, help enormously)
