collocations.translation: 【课件】大量的……（large in size, quantity or extent 在大小/数量/程度上巨大）
collocations.example: Using ink on silk, Zhang creates realistic images and shows an enormous amount of detail. 他施墨于绢，落笔逼真传神，展现出海量的细节。（Extended·课件原义项）
The newly unrolled scroll aroused enormous interest among visitors. 新展开的长卷在参观者中引发了浓厚的兴趣。（Extended·课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（某人面临的）问题非常巨大/棘手
collocations.example: The problems facing the President are enormous. 总统所面临的问题非常巨大。（Extended·课件原句）

collocations.translation: 大量的，海量的（后接不可数名词）
collocations.example: The scroll contains an enormous amount of detail. 这幅长卷包含海量细节。

collocations.translation: 大量的（后接可数名词复数）
collocations.example: An enormous number of visitors gathered before the painting. 大量参观者聚在这幅画前。
Under enormous pressure, she drew a long breath and let training take over. 巨大压力下，她深吸一口气，任训练成果自然发挥。
The invention of printing had an enormous impact on the spread of knowledge across the ancient world. （议论文/说明文·历史影响）
Only through the enormous efforts of countless volunteers was the flooded village finally restored to life. （议论文/应用文·集体努力）

collocations.translation: 极大的……感（成就感/责任感等）
collocations.example: Crossing the finish line, he was flooded with an enormous sense of achievement that no medal could ever fully measure. （读后续写·成就感）
The exchange programme holds enormous potential for broadening students' horizons and deepening cross-cultural friendship. （应用文·倡议）
A few words of genuine encouragement can make an enormous difference to a child who has all but given up. （议论文·鼓励的意义）
Words can hardly convey the enormous gratitude I feel towards the stranger who guided me home that stormy night. （读后续写/应用文·感恩）

synonyms.example: Standing at the edge of the immense desert, she felt her troubles shrink to a grain of sand. （读后续写·景物+心理）
synonyms.usage: 辨析 enormous/immense/vast: immense 偏书面、文学化,常形容抽象的宏大(immense pleasure/space); enormous 更通用,具体体积/数量和抽象程度都可用,口语书面皆宜。

synonyms.example: There was a huge crowd waiting outside the gallery. 画廊外等着一大群人。
synonyms.usage: 辨析 enormous/huge: huge 最口语、最普通,大小/数量/程度皆可; enormous 语气略强于 huge,更强调'大得惊人'; 二者常可互换,写作中用 enormous 更显正式。

synonyms.example: A vast expanse of golden fields stretched to the horizon. 一大片金色的田野一直铺到天边。
synonyms.usage: 辨析 enormous/vast: vast 侧重面积/范围的辽阔无边(vast ocean/knowledge),多用于空间与抽象领域; enormous 侧重体积、数量、程度之大,更强调'尺寸'。

synonyms.translation: 巨大的，惊人的（多含赞叹）
synonyms.example: The young pianist received tremendous applause. （读后续写·成功场景）
synonyms.usage: tremendous 常带强烈情感色彩(极好、惊人),多形容程度/反响; enormous 更中性,单纯强调'大',褒贬皆可。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·such/so 置句首倒装（课件 Extended 语法）
advancedExpressions.expression: such 作代词、用作表语时可置句首产生倒装：Such is / was + 真正主语 + that ...（如此……以至于……，be 动词与后面真正主语的单复数一致）。The damage was such that ... = Such was the damage that ... ；Such were the expectations that ...（真正主语复数则用 were）。
advancedExpressions.example: Such is its worth that several later emperors even asked the most talented artists of their day to make copies of the scroll. 其价值之高，以至于后世多位皇帝令当时最有才华的画家加以临摹。（课件原句）｜Such was the flood that many people became homeless. 洪灾如此严重，以致许多人无家可归。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·so / such + 成分置句首主句倒装（课件 Extended 语法）
advancedExpressions.expression: so / such 连同其所修饰的成分共同置于句首时，主句部分倒装、从句不倒装，起强调作用：So + adj./adv. + 助动词/be + 主语 + that ...；Such + a(n) + adj. + n. + be + 主语 + that ...。
advancedExpressions.example: So angry was he that he couldn't speak. 他如此生气以至于说不出话。｜Such a hard-working student is she that everyone likes her. = She is such a hard-working student that everyone likes her. = So hard-working is she that everyone likes her.（三句同义，课件对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: an enormous amount of + 不可数 / an enormous number of + 可数复数
advancedExpressions.example: Recording an enormous amount of detail took an enormous number of hours. 记录海量细节耗费了极多时间。（amount of 接不可数、number of 接可数，高考语法填空高频考点）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'巨大的' 程度递进
advancedExpressions.expression: big < large < huge < enormous / immense / vast / tremendous
advancedExpressions.example: The task was not merely big but truly enormous, almost impossible for one person. 这项任务不只是大，而是极其庞大，几乎非一人能及。（写作时用 enormous 替 big/large 立即升级）

advancedExpressions.expression: e(向外)+norm(规范)+ous → enormous；同根 normal / abnormal / norm
advancedExpressions.example: What began as a normal project grew to enormous scale beyond anyone's imagination. 起初一个普通项目，规模膨胀到超乎想象的巨大。（借词根记'超出常规=巨大'）

advancedExpressions.expression: an enormous + n. reared up / loomed before sb., its ...
advancedExpressions.example: An enormous wave loomed before the tiny boat, its crest white and cruel against the bruised evening sky. （用巨大意象制造压迫感,烘托人物处境）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would like to express our enormous gratitude for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to express our enormous gratitude for the selfless dedication you have shown to every one of us. （感谢信核心句,enormous gratitude 情感浓度高）

advancedExpressions.expression: the enormous impact of ... should never be underestimated
advancedExpressions.example: The enormous impact of early reading habits on a child's future should never be underestimated. （'should never be underestimated' 提醒句式,凸显重要性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was a very big mountain in front of them.

translation: 全面的，综合的；综合性的
original_sentence: 5 10 15 20 Extended reading 39 Unit 3 25 30 35 40 45 Thanks to all this fine detail, the Qingming Scroll provides a comprehensive look at life during the Northern Song Dynasty.
readingExamples: 5 10 15 20 Extended reading 39 Unit 3 25 30 35 40 45 Thanks to all this fine detail, the Qingming Scroll provides a comprehensive look at life during the Northern Song Dynasty.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. including all, or almost all, the items, details, facts, or information that may be concerned; complete and thorough
(2) adj. (of a study, report, or understanding) covering a subject fully and from all angles
(3) adj. (British education) of a system in which children of all abilities are taught together in the same school

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式教育）综合性的（不按能力分班、面向所有学生的学校）；a comprehensive school 综合中学
uncommonMeanings.example: She had taught at the local comprehensive school for thirty years, believing every child deserved the same open door to knowledge. （读后续写·教师情怀·英式综合学校）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式）综合中学（a comprehensive 可直接作名词，指该类学校）
uncommonMeanings.example: Most of the neighbourhood children attended the comprehensive down the road. 街区大多数孩子都上路那头的综合中学。

posExamples.sentence: Thanks to all its fine detail, the ancient scroll offers a comprehensive look at daily life during the dynasty, from bustling markets to quiet riverside temples. （说明文·文物价值）
Before setting out, the guide handed each of us a comprehensive map that marked not only the trails but every spring, shelter, and hidden viewpoint along the way. （读后续写·旅行/探险）
I am writing to propose a comprehensive plan for our school's recycling programme, one that covers collection, sorting, and public education in equal measure. （应用文·建议信）
A truly comprehensive education should nurture not only the intellect but also the character, the body, and the capacity for compassion. （议论文·教育理念）

wordForms.noun: comprehension (n. 理解；理解力；(英语)阅读理解题)
wordForms.adjective: comprehensive (adj. 全面的) / comprehensible (adj. 可理解的)
wordForms.adverb: comprehensively (adv. 全面地) / comprehensibly (adv. 易懂地)
wordForms.other: incomprehensible (adj. 无法理解的)；易混辨析: comprehensive 全面的(涵盖广) ≠ comprehensible 可理解的(能懂)——同根不同义,高考爱设陷阱；comprehend = com-(全部)+ prehend(抓住) → '全部抓住' 即'理解'

collocations.phrase: provide a comprehensive look at sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】详尽／全面地展现……（课文原句核心搭配）
collocations.example: Thanks to all this fine detail, the Qingming Scroll provides a comprehensive look at life during the Northern Song Dynasty. 得益于这些精细的细节，《清明上河图》详尽地展现了北宋时期的生活。
She drew up a comprehensive list of everything the trip would require. 她列出了这次旅行所需一切的详尽清单。
New volunteers receive comprehensive training before they start work. 新志愿者在上岗前接受全方面的培训。
The library offers a comprehensive range of books on ancient art. 这家图书馆藏有种类齐全的古代艺术书籍。
A comprehensive study of the scroll revealed hundreds of tiny figures. 一项对长卷的全面研究揭示了数百个小人物。

collocations.translation: 综合中学（英式，不分能力招收所有学生）
collocations.example: He went to the local comprehensive school before winning a place at university. 他上了本地综合中学，后来考入大学。

collocations.phrase: a comprehensive look / view at sth
collocations.example: The documentary offers a comprehensive view of how the city has transformed over a single generation. （说明文·纪录片介绍）
Only a comprehensive plan, addressing both prevention and treatment, can hope to solve so complex a problem. （议论文·方案论证）
Travelling through the countryside gave her a comprehensive understanding of hardships she had only read about in books. （读后续写·感悟）
His comprehensive knowledge of local history turned an ordinary walk into an unforgettable journey through time. （读后续写·人物）
The volunteers compiled a comprehensive guide for newcomers, covering everything from campus routes to library rules. （应用文·指南编写）

collocations.phrase: provide / offer a comprehensive picture of
collocations.example: Together, these letters, diaries, and paintings provide a comprehensive picture of ordinary life a thousand years ago. （说明文·史料）

synonyms.example: The scroll is so rich in detail that it is hard to comprehend it all at a single glance. 这幅长卷细节繁多，很难一眼就全部领会。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】comprehend v. 理解，领会 = understand；派生 comprehension n. 理解力（It's beyond (one's) comprehension. 令人无法理解）；形容词 comprehensive「全面的」由此而来，勿与 comprehensible「可理解的」混淆。

synonyms.example: The sheer scale of the painting is almost beyond comprehension. 这幅画之宏大几乎令人无法想象。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】comprehension n. 理解力；固定搭配 beyond (one's) comprehension「超出（某人）理解范围，难以理解」。comprehend → comprehension → comprehensive 同族串记。

synonyms.example: After a thorough inspection of every joint, the engineer declared the bridge safe. （读后续写/说明文·仔细检查）
synonyms.usage: 辨析 comprehensive/thorough: thorough 强调'做得彻底、不遗漏、深入到位',侧重过程的仔细程度; comprehensive 强调'覆盖面广、面面俱到',侧重范围的完整。

synonyms.translation: 全面的，多方面的（多形容人/发展）
synonyms.example: The school prides itself on nurturing all-round students. （议论文/应用文·教育）
synonyms.usage: all-round 多形容人的全面发展或综合能力(all-round athlete/development); comprehensive 多形容事物内容的完整(report/plan/knowledge),二者搭配对象不同。

synonyms.example: Her extensive travels filled a dozen notebooks with sketches and stories. （读后续写·阅历）
synonyms.usage: extensive 强调'范围大、数量多、涉及面广',但不一定'样样都包含'; comprehensive 强调'完整、无遗漏地涵盖全部',更突出'全'。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·comprehend 词族一句串（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: comprehend (v. 理解 = understand) → comprehension (n. 理解力，beyond comprehension) → comprehensive (adj. 全面的) vs comprehensible (adj. 可懂的)
advancedExpressions.example: To fully comprehend the scroll takes comprehensive attention, for its detail is almost beyond comprehension — yet the painter kept every scene comprehensible at a glance. 要完全读懂这幅长卷需要全面的专注，因为它的细节几乎令人无法想象——但画家让每个场景一眼可解。（一句串 comprehend/comprehension/comprehensive/comprehensible）

advancedExpressions.expression: a comprehensive study / survey / plan / understanding of sth
advancedExpressions.example: This comprehensive study offers a comprehensive picture of Song-dynasty city life. 这项全面研究呈现了宋代城市生活的全貌。（comprehensive + 抽象名词是说明文/议论文高分搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能'覆盖全面'
advancedExpressions.expression: comprehensive ≈ all-inclusive ≈ wide-ranging ≈ covering every aspect
advancedExpressions.example: The report is comprehensive, covering every aspect of the problem from cause to cure. 这份报告很全面，从起因到对策每个方面都涉及。（用同位短语解释 comprehensive 的内涵）

advancedExpressions.expression: comprehend (v.) → comprehension (n.) → comprehensive (adj. 全面) vs comprehensible (adj. 可懂)
advancedExpressions.example: To comprehend the whole scroll demands comprehensive attention, yet the artist made every scene comprehensible at a glance. 读懂整幅长卷需要全面的关注，但画家让每个场景一眼可解。（一句区分两个易混形容词）

advancedExpressions.expression: the experience gave sb. a comprehensive understanding of ...

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to propose a comprehensive plan for ..., one that covers ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to propose a comprehensive plan for reducing waste on campus, one that covers sorting, recycling, and daily education alike. （提案句式,comprehensive plan + 同位语列举维度,显得周全）

advancedExpressions.expression: a truly comprehensive ... should embrace not only ... but also ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The scroll shows a lot about life at that time.

original_sentence: It reveals a great deal about the 12th-century Chinese customs, clothing, transportation methods, business practices, and a wide range of buildings, such as temples, teahouses and government structures.
readingExamples: It reveals a great deal about the 12th-century Chinese customs, clothing, transportation methods, business practices, and a wide range of buildings, such as temples, teahouses and government structures.
definitionEn:
(1) n. clothes in general; the things that people wear to cover their bodies (an uncountable collective noun)
(2) n. (often in compounds) garments of a particular type or for a particular purpose (protective clothing, winter clothing)

posExamples.sentence: The scroll reveals a great deal about ancient customs — the clothing people wore, the goods they traded, and the temples where they gathered to pray. （说明文·文物研究）
Shivering in his thin, worn clothing, the little match girl pressed her face against the frosted window, watching a warmth she could only imagine. （读后续写·困境刻画）
We are collecting warm clothing for the children of the mountain village, and even a single coat you no longer need could bring real comfort this winter. （应用文·募捐倡议）
It is often said that clothing reflects the soul of an age; indeed, what a people choose to wear reveals as much about their values as any written record. （议论文·文化与服饰）

wordForms.noun: clothing (n. 服装，衣物·不可数集合名词) / clothes (n. 衣服·恒复数) / cloth (n. 布料·不可数；一块布·可数)
wordForms.other: clothed (adj. 穿着衣服的)；unclothed (adj. 未穿衣的)；三词辨析·拼写记: clothing 总称不可数(a piece of clothing) / clothes 恒复数无单数(× a clothes) / cloth 布料;读音 cloth /klɒθ/、clothe /kləʊð/、clothes /kləʊðz/ 三者音不同勿混

idioms.translation: 披着羊皮的狼；伪善的危险人物

Wrapped in protective clothing from head to toe, the doctors worked through the night. （读后续写·致敬）
In helping the flood victims, the volunteers saw to their food, clothing and shelter before anything else. （议论文/应用文·基本需求）
The charity shop sold second-hand clothing at gentle prices, and every coin earned went straight to the children's fund. （应用文·公益）
On festival mornings, the whole town blossomed with traditional clothing, each embroidered pattern a thread of memory. （读后续写·民俗）

The temple fair burst with colour and noise — sugar-figures, paper lanterns, and the laughter of children weaving through the crowd. （读后续写·节庆场景）
It took three generations of craftsmen to restore the crumbling temple to its former glory. （说明文·文物保护）
In the temple courtyard, an ancient gingko tree scattered golden leaves over pilgrims young and old. （读后续写·景物）
A hundred feet the temple towers, so lofty that I dare not raise my voice, for fear of disturbing the stars overhead. （文学化·仿古意境·呼应课文原句）

synonyms.example: At the roadside shrine, an old woman placed a single wildflower. （读后续写·信仰细节）
synonyms.usage: shrine 指供奉圣物/神灵的小型祭祀处(神龛)或朝圣圣地,规模通常小于 temple; temple 指较完整的宗教建筑(寺/庙/殿)。

synonyms.translation: 修道院，寺院（僧侣居住修行之所）
synonyms.example: High in the mountains, the monastery had sheltered generations of monks. （读后续写·遁世）
synonyms.usage: monastery 强调'僧侣/修士居住修行的场所',侧重生活功能; temple 强调'供奉与祭拜的宗教建筑',侧重礼拜功能。中式寺院可两义兼有。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·一词多义(熟词僻义)
advancedExpressions.expression: temple = 庙宇 / 太阳穴（temples）——同形异义，靠语境区分
advancedExpressions.example: As he stepped out of the temple, he pressed his throbbing temples, weary from the long climb. 走出寺庙时，他按住突突直跳的太阳穴，长途攀登让他精疲力竭。（一句同现两义，高考熟词僻义常考）

advancedExpressions.expression: an ancient / Buddhist temple ; a temple fair ; visit / worship at a temple ; restore a temple
advancedExpressions.example: During the temple fair, crowds gathered to worship at the ancient temple on the hill. 庙会期间，人群聚到山上的古庙前祭拜。（旅游/民俗/文化遗产类写作词群）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ancient temple towered against ..., its ... seeming to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The ancient temple towered against the crimson dusk, its weathered eaves seeming to whisper the secrets of a thousand vanished years. （拟人+环境色彩,营造厚重历史感）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are organizing a guided tour of ..., and we sincerely invite ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are organizing a guided tour of the ancient temple this weekend, and we sincerely invite everyone with a love of history to take part. （通知句式,清晰交代活动+诚挚邀约）

advancedExpressions.expression: a temple is far more than ...; it is ...
advancedExpressions.example: An ancient temple is far more than a tourist attraction; it is the living memory of a civilization, carved in stone and kept alive in silence. （'far more than...; it is...' 升华定义,拔高立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was an old temple on the mountain and it was very tall.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: High on the misty mountain, an ancient temple towered against the dawn, its curved eaves reaching, it seemed, for the very stars that lingered in the paling sky. （读后续写·古迹晨景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语前置(High on the misty mountain) + towered 动词化替 very tall + its...reaching 独立主格补充细节 + it seemed 插入语软化拟人 + for the very stars 呼应课文原句意境

sentenceUpgrade.original: Old temples are important and we should protect them.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Ancient temples are not mere relics of the past; they are vessels of a nation's memory, and to preserve them is, in truth, to preserve who we are. （议论文·文化遗产）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not mere...; they are... 递进强调 + vessels of memory 隐喻 + to preserve...is to preserve... 排比式定义句 + in truth 插入语强化论断

classPractice.question: 根据语境判断 temple 的词义(A 庙宇 / B 太阳穴)：(1) They lit incense at the ancient ____ on the hill. (2) A dull ache throbbed at his ____ after the sleepless night.
classPractice.answer: (1) temple——A 庙宇 / (2) temples——B 太阳穴
classPractice.note: temple 一词多义，山上上香=庙宇，隐隐作痛+按压=太阳穴(常用复数)；熟词僻义高考高频。

classPractice.question: 深山之中矗立着一座古庙，钟声轻轻回荡在山谷间。An ancient ____ stood deep in the mountains, its bell tolling softly across the valleys.
classPractice.note: an ancient temple「一座古庙」，续写景物描写常用意象。

classPractice.question: 疲惫不堪，他揉了揉太阳穴，努力集中精神。Exhausted, he ____ ____ ____ and tried to focus.（用 temple 的熟词僻义）
classPractice.note: rub one's temples「揉太阳穴」，temple=太阳穴时常用复数，动作细节刻画疲惫。

original_sentence: 1 What is the structure of the article?
readingExamples: 1 What is the structure of the article?
definitionEn:
(1) n. the way in which the parts of something are connected together, arranged, or organized
(2) n. something that has been built or put together from many parts, especially a large building
(3) n. a set of rules, plans, or systems that organize the way something operates
(4) vt. to arrange or organize the different parts of something into a clear pattern or order

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】建筑物，构筑物（尤指大型建筑）：a stone / wooden structure 石／木结构建筑物
uncommonMeanings.example: The temple was a magnificent wooden structure with carved beams and sweeping eaves. 这座寺庙是一座梁柱雕花、飞檐舒展的宏伟木结构建筑。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】精心组织，系统安排（arrange sth into a system）：structure the lessons / be structured around the themes
uncommonMeanings.example: She structured the whole course around a single, guiding question. 她围绕一个核心问题来组织整门课程。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （动词）精心安排、组织（时间/生活/文章/论点）
uncommonMeanings.example: She structured her days around her mother's failing memory. 她围绕母亲日渐衰退的记忆来安排每一天。（读后续写·亲情·照护）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 建筑物，构筑物（尤指大型建筑）
uncommonMeanings.example: The ancient wooden structure emerged from the mist like a slumbering giant. 那座古老的木结构建筑从雾中显现，宛如沉睡的巨人。

posExamples.sentence: As dawn broke over the valley, the ancient wooden structure emerged from the mist like a slumbering giant, its carved beams whispering the stories of a hundred forgotten winters. （读后续写·环境描写·古建筑）

I am writing to propose that our student union adopt a clearer organizational structure, so that responsibilities are fairly distributed and every volunteer knows exactly where his or her efforts are most needed. （应用文·建议信）
A well-reasoned argument, much like a sturdy bridge, depends entirely on its underlying structure: remove one supporting premise, and the whole edifice of logic comes crashing down. （议论文·逻辑与论证）

The teacher taught us to structure every essay around a single controlling idea, weaving each paragraph into the next until the reader is carried, almost unknowingly, to an inevitable conclusion. （议论文·写作方法）

wordForms.other: restructure (vt. 重组，改组)；unstructured (adj. 无组织的)；infrastructure (n. 基础设施)；construct (v. 建造) / construction (n. 建筑)；构词法·前缀 re-(重新)+structure → restructure；in-(否定)+structural 等词根 struct=build(建造)

collocations.translation: 【课件】石／木结构建筑物（structure n. 建筑物、构筑物，尤指大型建筑）
collocations.example: The bridge was an ancient stone structure that had stood for centuries. 这座桥是一座矗立了几个世纪的古老石结构建筑。

collocations.translation: 【课件】精心组织课程（structure v. arrange sth into a system 精心组织，系统安排）
collocations.example: How well does the teacher structure the lessons? 这位老师把课程安排得怎么样？

collocations.translation: 【课件】精心安排的分组活动（structured adj. 有组织的）
collocations.example: Make use of the toys in structured group activities. 在精心安排的分组活动中利用这些玩具。

collocations.phrase: be structured around the themes of ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】围绕……的主题来布置／组织
collocations.example: The exhibition is structured around the themes of work and leisure. 展览是围绕工作与休闲的主题来布置的。

collocations.translation: ……的结构（本课: the structure of the article 文章结构）
collocations.example: What is the structure of the article? 这篇文章的结构是怎样的？（课文原句·分析文本框架）
The novel lays bare the rigid social structure of a small town where everyone knows his place. （读后续写·社会背景）
Varying your sentence structure keeps the reader engaged from start to finish. （应用文·写作指导）
A flat organizational structure, in which decisions are shared rather than dictated, often fosters greater creativity. （议论文·管理）
Keeping a daily journal gave structure to the long, aimless days of the summer holiday. （读后续写·成长）
In biology class we learned how the structure of a leaf is perfectly matched to its function of capturing sunlight. （应用文·学习总结）
Only a plan built on a sound structure of goals, deadlines, and rewards is likely to survive contact with real life. （议论文·目标管理）
How you structure an argument matters as much as the evidence itself. （议论文·论证）

synonyms.example: The teacher offered us a clear framework for the debate, dividing the topic into causes, consequences, and solutions. （应用文·活动方案）
synonyms.usage: framework 侧重抽象的支撑性框架、思路或制度骨架,多用于计划、理论、论证; structure 既可指抽象结构也可指具体建筑物,含义更广。

synonyms.example: The bridge was a marvel of construction, its steel cables shimmering against the evening sky. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: construction 侧重建造的过程或建成的实体,强调'建'这一动作; structure 更侧重各部分的组织方式与整体结果。

synonyms.example: The clear organization of her speech made the complex issue surprisingly easy to follow. （议论文·演讲）
synonyms.usage: organization 侧重内容或事物被安排得有条理的状态; structure 更强调各部分之间固定的关系与骨架。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·structure 名动同形（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: structure n. 建筑物/结构（a stone structure；the structure of...）｜structure vt. 精心组织（structure the lessons；be structured around the themes）
advancedExpressions.example: The old stone structure survived because its builders knew how to structure weight around a central arch. 这座古老的石建筑得以留存，因为建造者懂得如何围绕中央拱券来组织受力。（一句展示名词'建筑物'与动词'组织'两用）

advancedExpressions.expression: structure 既是名词(the structure of...)又是及物动词(structure sth around...)
advancedExpressions.example: He studied the structure of the essay, then learned to structure his own around one clear idea. 他研究了文章的结构，随后学会围绕一个清晰的观点来组织自己的文章。（同词名/动两用，语法填空常考词性转换）

advancedExpressions.expression: the structure of sth ; sentence / social / organizational structure ; give structure to sth
advancedExpressions.example: By varying sentence structure, you give structure and rhythm to the whole passage. 通过变换句式，你为整段赋予结构与节奏。（写作指导与文本分析高频词群）

advancedExpressions.expression: structure → structural (adj.) → restructure (v.) → infrastructure (n.)
advancedExpressions.example: After the earthquake, engineers checked the structural safety before they restructured the city's whole infrastructure. 震后工程师先检查结构安全，再重建了整座城市的基础设施。（一句串起词族，struct=建造）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... structure stood there, as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: The crumbling stone structure stood there against the blood-red sunset, as if it had been waiting a century for someone to return and remember. （明喻+拟人，续写开头段渲染氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest structuring ... so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would suggest structuring the volunteer schedule around students' free periods, so that participation places no extra burden on their studies. （委婉建议句式，动名词+目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a building relies on its structure, so ... depends on ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a skyscraper relies on the hidden strength of its steel structure, so a nation's prosperity depends on the invisible framework of trust and law. （比喻类比，增强说服力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old house had a strange structure.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old house was strange in structure — corridors that led nowhere, staircases that spiralled up into darkness — as though the architect had designed it not for living, but for losing oneself. （读后续写·悬疑氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入具体细节（corridors/staircases）+ as though 虚拟从句渲染诡异 + 对比 not for...but for 收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should organize our essay well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore essential that we structure our essays with such care that every paragraph flows seamlessly into the next, guiding the reader, step by measured step, toward an inescapable conclusion. （议论文·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is essential that + 虚拟语气(structure原形) + such...that 结果状语从句 + 副词短语插入(step by measured step)控制节奏

classPractice.question: Our teacher taught us to ____ (structure) every essay around a single controlling idea.
classPractice.note: to 后接动词原形，structure 作及物动词「组织，建构」，此处名动同形要判断词性。

classPractice.question: 【课件】这次展览是围绕工作与休闲的主题来布置的。The exhibition ____ ____ ____ the themes of work and leisure.
classPractice.note: be structured around sth「围绕……来组织／布置」，structure 作动词的被动结构，PPT 原句搭配。

classPractice.question: 用 structure / structural / restructure 填空：After the flood, engineers found serious ____ damage, so the government decided to ____ the whole drainage ____ .
classPractice.note: 第一空形容词修饰 damage；第二空 to 后动词原形'重组'；第三空名词'系统结构'——词族三态考查。

classPractice.question: 写日记给她漫无目的的暑假带来了条理。Keeping a diary ____ ____ ____ her aimless summer days.（用 give structure to）
classPractice.note: give structure to sth「使……有条理」，此处用过去式 gave；名词 structure 的固定搭配。

translation: adj. 全面的，综合的 | adv. 全部，总计；一般来说，大体上
original_sentence: 8 How are you going to improve your overall performance?
readingExamples: 8 How are you going to improve your overall performance?
definitionEn:
(1) adj. considering or including everything, rather than only one part; general
(2) adv. considering everything; in general
(3) adv. as a total number; altogether
(4) n. (usually plural) a piece of loose-fitting protective clothing worn over ordinary clothes while working

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 工装裤，罩衣（复数 overalls，英式）；防护外套
uncommonMeanings.example: He came home each dusk in oil-stained overalls, the smell of engine grease clinging to him like a second skin. （读后续写·父爱·蓝领）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 总共，总计（表数量加总）
uncommonMeanings.example: Overall, more than three hundred students took part in the charity walk. 慈善徒步总共有三百多名学生参加。

posExamples.sentence: Standing on the podium, the young captain finally grasped that their overall success owed less to any single brilliant play than to the countless quiet sacrifices no spectator had ever seen. （读后续写·团队·顿悟）
To improve the overall efficiency of our recycling campaign, I would suggest placing clearly labelled bins on every floor and rewarding the class that collects the most each month. （应用文·建议信）
Overall, while short videos do offer bite-sized knowledge, their addictive design tends to erode the very patience and depth that genuine learning demands. （议论文·观点总结）
Overall, more than three hundred students took part in the charity walk, and together they raised enough to fund a small library for the mountain village school. （应用文·活动报道）

wordForms.noun: overalls (n. 工装裤，连体工作服·复数)
wordForms.adjective: overall (adj. 全面的，总体的·作定语)
wordForms.adverb: overall (adv. 总体上，总的来说；总共)
wordForms.other: 构词法·over(总括)+all(全部) → '把全部包括在内'即'总体的'；一词多性: adj.(the overall quality) / adv.(Overall, ... 句首总结) / n.复数(overalls 工装裤)；作形容词只作前置定语(an overall view)，不作表语

collocations.translation: 整体表现（本课: improve your overall performance 提升整体表现）
collocations.example: How are you going to improve your overall performance? 你打算如何提升自己的整体表现？（课文原句·反思提问）
Regular feedback from readers has steadily raised the overall quality of our school magazine. 读者的定期反馈稳步提升了校刊的整体质量。
The overall impression the exhibition left on visitors was one of quiet wonder at the ingenuity of ordinary craftsmen. （应用文·观展报道）
The overall effect of the volunteer programme went far beyond the hours logged: it stitched strangers into a community. （议论文·社会）
The overall aim of the reading club is not merely to finish books, but to cultivate minds that question and create. （应用文·社团介绍）
Only by stepping back can we see the overall picture, and only then do the individual struggles begin to make sense. （议论文·思辨）
Overall, the benefits of studying abroad, though hard-won, richly reward those brave enough to leave the familiar behind. （议论文·观点句）
Consistent exercise, she discovered, improved not only her fitness but her overall outlook on life. （读后续写·励志）

synonyms.example: The general feeling among the audience was one of pure delight. （读后续写·氛围）
synonyms.usage: general 侧重'普遍、非具体',与 particular 相对; overall 更强调把所有部分加在一起综合考虑后的整体(overall 常修饰 quality/aim/impression)。

synonyms.example: The total cost of the trip, once meals and tickets were counted, was within our budget. （应用文·计划）
synonyms.usage: total 侧重数量上的加总、完全; overall 既可指数量加总,也常用于抽象的'综合评价'。

synonyms.example: On the whole, the plan worked, though a few rough edges still needed smoothing. （议论文·让步）
synonyms.usage: on the whole 作副词短语,语气偏口语、带让步意味; overall 作副词更中性、更书面,常用于总结段开头(Overall, ...)。

advancedExpressions.expression: overall: adj.(整体的·作定语) / adv.(总的来说·句首) / overalls(工装裤·n.复数)
advancedExpressions.example: Overall, her overall performance improved, even on the days she wore her father's old overalls to the workshop. 总的来说，她的整体表现提高了，哪怕在她穿着父亲旧工装去车间的日子。（一句展示三种词性，高考熟词多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: overall performance / quality / impression / aim / picture
advancedExpressions.example: To raise the overall quality of the project, focus first on its overall aim, not the tiny details. 要提升项目整体质量，先聚焦总目标，而非琐碎细节。（作定语的黄金搭配群）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能'总结全文'
advancedExpressions.expression: Overall, ... ≈ On the whole, ... ≈ All in all, ... ≈ Taking everything into account, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Overall / All in all, the trip taught us more than any classroom ever could. 总的来说，这次旅行教给我们的比任何课堂都多。（议论文/续写总结段开头，可替换使用）

advancedExpressions.expression: overall, sb. came to understand that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Overall, she came to understand that victory was never the medal itself, but the person she had quietly become in the long climb toward it. （总结全文式升华，主题句收束续写）

advancedExpressions.expression: to enhance our overall ..., I strongly recommend that ...
advancedExpressions.example: To enhance our overall campus environment, I strongly recommend that we launch a 'green corner' scheme where each class tends its own patch of plants. （目的状语+强烈建议句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: overall, though ..., the ... ultimately outweighs ...
advancedExpressions.example: Overall, though technology inevitably brings distraction, its power to connect, inform, and empower ultimately outweighs the price we pay. （让步+权衡结构，总结全文观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: In general, the trip was good.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Overall, the trip proved to be far more than a change of scenery: it was a quiet awakening, teaching us that the world is vast, kind, and endlessly worth exploring. （读后续写·感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: far more than 否定微夸张 + 冒号引出同位阐释 + 三形容词并列(vast, kind, worth exploring)升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: The plan is good overall, but it has some problems.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Overall, the plan is sound; yet, as with any ambitious undertaking, a few practical obstacles remain to be ironed out before it can be put into full effect. （议论文·辩证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号连接对立分句 + as with any...插入语类比 + 短语动词(iron out, put into effect)提升正式度

classPractice.question: ____ , the trip was a success, though a few small problems remained.
classPractice.note: 句首作副词'总的来说'，后接逗号引出总结句；首字母大写。

classPractice.question: 选 overall / general 填空：Her ____ performance this term rose sharply, and the ____ mood in class grew far more positive. (第一空/第二空)
classPractice.note: overall 强调各部分综合后的'整体表现'；general 强调'普遍的'氛围；作定语搭配对象不同。

classPractice.question: 为提升我们的整体效率，我建议在每层楼放置贴好标签的回收箱。To improve our ____ ____ , I suggest placing labelled bins on every floor.（整体效率）
classPractice.note: overall 作形容词只作前置定语，overall efficiency「整体效率」，建议信常用搭配。

translation: 批评家，评论家；批评者，挑剔的人
original_sentence: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
readingExamples: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone whose job is to give their opinion about a book, play, film, work of art, etc.
(2) n. someone who expresses disapproval of someone or something and talks about their faults
(3) n. a person who finds fault or judges harshly

posExamples.sentence: The harshest critic she had ever faced was not the stern judge at the piano competition, but the small, doubting voice inside her own head that whispered she would never be good enough. （读后续写·心理·自我怀疑）
As a regular contributor to the school newspaper, I believe a good film critic should not merely condemn or praise, but help readers see a work through fresh and thoughtful eyes. （应用文·投稿信）
Critics of online education often argue that screens can never replace the warmth of a real classroom; yet they overlook how many rural children would otherwise have no teacher at all. （议论文·反驳）
Ignore your critics entirely and you grow blind to your faults; obey them slavishly and you lose your own voice — wisdom lies in the delicate space between. （议论文·思辨·批评的价值）

wordForms.noun: critic (评论家/批评者); criticism (批评/评论); critique (n. 评论文章)
wordForms.verb: criticize (批评/评论); critique (vt. 评论)
wordForms.other: ⚠三兄弟辨析：critic(n.评论家/批评者)｜critical(adj.批评的/关键的)｜critique(n./vt.评论文章)。记忆链：critic 批评 → criticize 去批评 → criticism 批评这件事 → critical 挑剔的/关键的。别把 critic 误当形容词（错：a critic remark→对：a critical remark）

collocations.example: A well-known literary critic praised the young author's first novel. 一位知名的文学评论家称赞了这位年轻作家的处女作。

collocations.phrase: be well received by the critics
collocations.translation: 【课件】受到评论家们的认可／好评
collocations.example: The novel was well received by the critics. 这部小说受到评论家们的认可。

collocations.translation: 【课件】受到广泛批评（criticism n. 批评；评论）
collocations.example: The company's decision attracted widespread criticism from the public. 公司的这一决定受到公众的广泛批评。

collocations.translation: 【课件】因……而批评某人（常与 strongly / sharply / heavily 连用）
collocations.example: Her parents heavily criticized her for wasting so much time online. 她的父母严厉批评她把大量时间浪费在网上。
The report has been criticized as incomplete. 这份报告被批评为不完整。

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……提出批评、持批评态度（critical adj.）
collocations.example: Tom's parents were highly critical of the school. 汤姆的父母对学校提出了强烈的批评。
A steady supply of clean water is critical to the survival of the whole village. 稳定的清洁水源对整个村庄的存活至关重要。
Schools should do more to develop students' critical thinking. 学校应更注重培养学生的批判性思维。

collocations.translation: 有些评论家认为……（课文原句）
collocations.example: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems. （课文原句·选择性必修一U3）
Her father, a harsh critic in her childhood, became, in his final years, her gentlest and most devoted admirer. （读后续写·亲情转变）

collocations.phrase: a fierce / outspoken critic of sth
collocations.example: As an outspoken critic of food waste, she persuaded the whole dormitory to finish every grain on their plates. （应用文·倡议）
The literary critic praised the young author's debut novel for its rare honesty and quiet courage. （应用文·书评）
With one flawless routine, the injured gymnast silenced the critics who had written her off months before. （读后续写·逆袭）
Critics argue that endless testing dulls curiosity, turning learning into a joyless race for marks. （议论文·教育）
The little independent play, warm and unpretentious, gradually won over even the sternest critics. （应用文·剧评）

collocations.translation: 某人自己最苛刻的批评者
collocations.example: Perfectionists are so often their own worst critics, magnifying tiny flaws until they blot out every triumph. （议论文·心理）
As a film critic, he never simply told you whether a movie was good; he taught you a whole new way to watch. （应用文·人物介绍）

synonyms.translation: 【课件·词族】批评；评论（critic 的名词同族词）
synonyms.example: The plan attracted widespread criticism as soon as it was made public. 计划一公布就招来广泛批评。
synonyms.usage: 【课件】critic(n. 评论家/批评者) → criticism(n. 批评/评论，attract/draw widespread criticism) → criticize(v. 批评，criticize sb for sth；be criticized as) → critical(adj. 批评的 be critical of／至关重要的 be critical to)。写作中'批评'名词用 criticism，非 critic。

synonyms.example: The reviewer devoted an entire column to a single, unforgettable scene in the film. （应用文·影评）
synonyms.usage: 侧重针对具体作品写评论的人，语气较中性；critic 既可指职业评论家，也含'挑剔、指责者'之意

synonyms.example: Even his fiercest opponents grudgingly admitted the courage of his decision. （议论文·社会）
synonyms.usage: 侧重立场上的对立、反对某主张的人；critic 侧重指出缺点、发表评判，不必然全盘反对

synonyms.example: Nothing ever pleased the old faultfinder, who could discover a flaw in a cloudless sky. （读后续写·人物刻画）
synonyms.usage: 带贬义，专指爱挑毛病的人；critic 中性偏中，视语境可褒可贬

advancedExpressions.type: 辨析·critic 词族一句串（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: critic (n. 评论家) → criticism (n. 批评) → criticize (v. 批评 sb for sth) → critical (adj. 批评的 be critical of／至关重要 be critical to)
advancedExpressions.example: The critic's sharp criticism, though it criticized the director for small flaws, was in fact critical of the whole industry — yet honest feedback is critical to any art form's growth. 那位评论家尖锐的批评虽因小缺点而指责导演，实则针对整个行业——而真诚的反馈对任何艺术形式的成长都至关重要。（一句区分四词词性与两义 be critical of / to）

advancedExpressions.expression: critic vs critical vs critique
advancedExpressions.example: The critic (n.评论家) wrote a sharp critique (n.评论文) of the film, whose critical (adj.批评的) tone silenced its makers. （一句区分三词的词性与含义）

advancedExpressions.expression: take issue with / find fault with / cast doubt on
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than bluntly attacking the plan, she gently took issue with two of its assumptions, as any thoughtful critic would. （用委婉'批评'表达替换 blunt criticism，考场更得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: the fiercest critic ... was ... within
advancedExpressions.example: The fiercest critic she would ever have to face was not on the stage below but within — a relentless voice demanding perfection she could never quite attain. （对比+隐喻，续写心理描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: a responsible critic should ... rather than merely ...
advancedExpressions.example: In my view, a responsible critic should illuminate a work's hidden merits rather than merely parade his own cleverness. （观点句式，rather than对比）

advancedExpressions.expression: critics may claim ..., but they fail to see that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Critics may claim that artificial intelligence will replace human teachers, but they fail to see that no algorithm can ever replicate a mentor's patient, loving gaze. （先让步后驳斥，标准驳论结构）

sentenceUpgrade.original: People criticized her, but she succeeded.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The very critics who had once dismissed her as a hopeless dreamer now sat, silent and abashed, watching the girl they had doubted take her rightful place upon the stage. （读后续写·逆袭高光）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The very...who定语从句强调 + 形容词并列(silent and abashed)刻画神态 + take one's rightful place升华收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Some people criticize this idea, but it has value.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Although its critics are neither few nor gentle, this proposal, once stripped of its imperfections, reveals a value too great to be lightly cast aside. （议论文·让步）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Although让步状语 + neither...nor双重否定强调 + once stripped of过去分词插入 + too...to结构收束

classPractice.question: However, some ____ (critic) suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious social problems.
classPractice.note: 课文原句改编：suggest 前主语为可数名词，some 修饰须用复数 critics

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (critic / critical / critique / criticize): (1) A famous art ____ once praised her early paintings. (2) He wrote a thoughtful ____ of the new novel. (3) Please don't ____ me before you understand the whole story.
classPractice.note: 考词性：(1)前有a/形容词→名词'评论家'；(2)a...of→名词'评论文'；(3)don't后接动词原形→动词'批评'

classPractice.question: 【课件·词族】Clean, safe water is ____ (critic) to the health of every child in the region, and its shortage has drawn widespread ____ (critic) of the local government.
classPractice.note: 第一空 be critical to sth「对……至关重要」(= vital/crucial) 用形容词 critical；第二空 draw widespread criticism「招致广泛批评」用名词 criticism。

classPractice.question: 凭借一场完美的表演，这位年轻歌手让曾经看轻她的批评者们哑口无言。（silence one's critics）
classPractice.answer: With a flawless performance, the young singer silenced the critics who had once looked down on her.
classPractice.note: 考固定搭配 silence one's critics 及 who 引导的定语从句

original_sentence: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
readingExamples: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the act of looking at something carefully in order to check its quality or condition
(2) n. an official visit to a school, factory, etc. to check that rules are being obeyed and standards are being met
(3) n. close and careful examination of something to learn more about it

posExamples.sentence: On closer inspection, the faded photograph revealed a detail she had missed for twenty years: in the corner, half hidden by shadow, her mother was smiling — truly smiling — for what seemed the only time. （读后续写·亲情·细节发现）
I would like to request a thorough inspection of the sports equipment before the annual games, so that no student is ever put at risk by a hidden defect. （应用文·请求信）
What appears, at first glance, to be a flawless argument often crumbles under close inspection, its hidden assumptions exposed like cracks beneath fresh paint. （议论文·思辨·批判性思考）
Regular safety inspections of the school laboratory are not bureaucratic nuisances but quiet guardians, standing between a moment's carelessness and a lifetime's regret. （议论文·安全）

wordForms.noun: inspection (检查/视察); inspector (检查员/巡视员/督学)
wordForms.other: 构词法：in-(向内)+spect(看,词根=to look)+-ion(名词后缀)→'往里细看'。同根词：respect(re-回头看→尊重)、suspect(sus-在下面看→怀疑)、prospect(pro-向前看→前景)、spectator(观看者)。动词 inspect + 名词 inspection + 施动者 inspector

collocations.translation: 仔细一看，经仔细检查（课文原句核心短语）
collocations.example: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems. （课文原句·选择性必修一U3）
The committee agreed to carry out a monthly inspection of the canteen to guarantee the freshness of every meal served. （应用文·倡议）
Only a thorough inspection of the evidence, free from prejudice, can lead us to a fair conclusion. （议论文·论证）
A routine inspection of the fire exits, dull as it sounds, may one day save a hundred lives. （议论文·安全）
Every claim in a scientific paper must hold firm under the inspection of peers before it earns the world's trust. （议论文·科学）
Before the expedition set out, each climber underwent a strict medical inspection to ensure the mountain would meet no unready body. （读后续写·冒险）
The little restaurant proudly passed its hygiene inspection, and the owner hung the certificate where every customer could see. （应用文·报道）

synonyms.example: A careful examination of the manuscript revealed corrections in a second, unfamiliar hand. （读后续写·悬疑）
synonyms.usage: 泛指细致的检查或考查，范围广（也含'考试'义）；inspection 更侧重为核查质量、安全、合规而进行的official检查

synonyms.example: A quick check of the schedule confirmed that the train would leave in ten minutes. （应用文·日常）
synonyms.usage: 口语常用，指快速核实、确认，程度较轻；inspection 更正式、更彻底，常带官方或系统性色彩

synonyms.example: Public figures live under constant scrutiny, their every word weighed and measured. （议论文·社会）
synonyms.usage: 强调严格、持续、挑剔式的审视，程度最重；inspection 侧重有目的、有标准的核查行为本身

advancedExpressions.expression: on closer inspection / on second thoughts / at second glance
advancedExpressions.example: At first the note seemed harmless; on closer inspection, however, every word carried a hidden warning. （'仔细一看'系列短语，读后续写制造发现感）

advancedExpressions.expression: stand up to / hold up under / withstand scrutiny (inspection)
advancedExpressions.example: A truly sound argument will stand up to the closest inspection, its logic unshaken by even the sharpest doubt. （议论文'经得起推敲'的高级说法）

advancedExpressions.expression: on closer inspection, ... turned out to be ...
advancedExpressions.example: On closer inspection, what she had taken for an ordinary stone turned out to be a tiny, hand-carved keepsake — her grandfather's last, silent message to her. （介词短语开头+turn out to be反转，制造发现感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would be grateful if a ... inspection could be arranged
advancedExpressions.example: I would be grateful if a full safety inspection of the playground could be arranged before term begins, so that younger pupils may play without danger. （委婉请求句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: under close inspection, ... reveals ...
advancedExpressions.example: Under close inspection, even the most dazzling promise of instant success reveals the same tired lie: that greatness can come without toil. （介词短语作状语+reveal揭示，用于揭穿观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She looked at the letter carefully and found something.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On closer inspection, the yellowed letter yielded a secret it had guarded for half a century — a single line, pressed faintly into the paper's edge, that changed everything she thought she knew. （读后续写·发现·悬念）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: On closer inspection状语开头 + yield a secret拟人 + 破折号引出关键细节 + that定语从句收尾制造悬念

sentenceUpgrade.original: If you examine the argument closely, it is weak.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Subjected to close inspection, the argument, for all its confident tone, soon betrays the fragile assumptions on which its every claim precariously rests. （议论文·驳论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语(Subjected to...)作状语前置 + for all its...让步插入 + betray拟人化 + on which定语从句

classPractice.question: 用本单元短语填空：At first the painting looked like a peaceful market scene, but ____ ____ ____ it revealed the city's hidden troubles.
classPractice.note: 考课文核心短语 on closer inspection'仔细一看'，用于前后语义转折

classPractice.question: Every fire exit must be checked in a monthly ____ (inspect), because one careless oversight could cost lives.
classPractice.note: 考词形转换：a monthly + 形容词性修饰后须填名词 inspection

classPractice.question: 我恳请学校在开学前对操场进行一次彻底的安全检查。（a thorough safety inspection）
classPractice.answer: I sincerely request that the school carry out a thorough safety inspection of the playground before the term begins.
classPractice.note: 考搭配 carry out a thorough safety inspection；request that 从句可用 (should) do 虚拟

translation: 揭露，揭发；暴露，显露；使暴露于；使接触
original_sentence: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
readingExamples: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make something visible that was previously hidden or covered
(2) vt. to reveal the truth about someone or something, especially something dishonest or immoral
(3) vt. to put someone in a situation where they are not protected from something harmful or unpleasant
(4) vt. to give someone the chance to experience or learn about new ideas, things, or ways of life

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】exposed adj. 暴露的，无遮掩的
uncommonMeanings.example: The house stands on an exposed hilltop, open to every wind. 房子立在毫无遮蔽的山顶，四面来风。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】exposure n. 暴露；揭露；（媒体的）曝光度、报道
uncommonMeanings.example: Her new movie has had a lot of exposure in the media. 她的新电影媒体有很多报道。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】exposure to sth 接触／暴露于……：long exposure to harmful radiation 长时间接触有害辐射；their first exposure to big city life 他们第一次接触大城市生活
uncommonMeanings.example: Long exposure to harmful radiation can seriously damage the body. 长时间接触有害辐射会严重损害身体。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使接触、使体验（新事物/文化/理念）
uncommonMeanings.example: The exchange year exposed her to a world she had never dared imagine — foreign tongues, unfamiliar streets, and, above all, the thrilling discovery that home was a place she could carry within. （读后续写·成长·文化冲击）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使感光，曝光（胶片/底片）
uncommonMeanings.example: He exposed the last frame of the roll just as the sun slipped behind the hills, capturing forever a light that would never fall quite that way again. （读后续写·摄影·瞬间永恒）

posExamples.sentence: As the flood waters slowly receded, they exposed a landscape of ruin — overturned carts, drowned fields, and, cradled in the mud, a child's single muddy shoe that no one dared to touch. （读后续写·灾难·环境）
Through our documentary, we hope to expose the hidden struggles of migrant workers and to remind our comfortable classmates just how much their daily lives depend on unseen hands. （应用文·倡议书）
Great literature does not merely entertain; it exposes the quiet cruelties and casual injustices of an age, forcing readers to confront what they would rather not see. （议论文·文学的价值）
Travelling alone exposed me, for the first time, to the discomfort of true independence — and it was precisely that discomfort, I now realize, that made me grow. （读后续写·独立·顿悟）

wordForms.other: 构词法：ex-(向外)+pose(放置)→'放到外面'→暴露/揭露。名词 exposure 是高频派生词：exposure to sunlight(受阳光照射)、media exposure(媒体曝光度)、exposure of the scandal(丑闻的揭露)。另 exposé(n. 揭发性报道，带重音符)

collocations.phrase: be exposed as a liar / be exposed as ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】被揭穿是骗子；被揭露为……（expose 义项①揭露、揭穿 show truth）
collocations.example: She was exposed as a liar and a fraud. 她说谎和欺骗的面目被揭穿了。
The report set out to expose the truth behind the scandal. 这篇报道旨在揭露丑闻背后的真相。

collocations.translation: 【课件】把（通常隐藏的东西）暴露、显露给某人（义项②暴露、显露）
collocations.example: He did not want to expose his fears and insecurity to anyone. 他不想向任何人显露他的恐惧与不安。

collocations.translation: 【课件】使某人遭受／接触……（义项③使遭受、使接触）
collocations.example: Do not expose babies to strong sunlight. 不要让婴孩受到强烈的阳光照射。

collocations.translation: 【课件】接触到、体验……（高频被动结构）
collocations.example: Some children are never exposed to classical music. 有些孩子从未接触过古典音乐。
Students on the exchange programme are exposed to diverse culture. 参加交换项目的学生接触到不同的文化。

collocations.translation: 揭露/暴露出……问题（课文原句）
collocations.example: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems. （课文原句·选择性必修一U3）
A good teacher exposes students to ideas far beyond the textbook, planting seeds that may take years to blossom. （议论文·教育）

collocations.phrase: expose the truth / a scandal / corruption
collocations.example: The young journalist risked everything to expose the corruption that had poisoned the town for decades. （读后续写·正义）
Sending untrained volunteers into the flood zone would only expose them to needless danger. （应用文·建议）
The final, punishing question exposed the weakness in his hastily prepared argument. （读后续写·辩论）
Left exposed to the elements for a hundred winters, the old shrine had weathered into something almost sacred. （读后续写·环境）
One honest question can expose a beautiful lie for what it truly is. （议论文·思辨）

collocations.translation: 接触到／暴露于……（高频被动结构）
collocations.example: Children who are exposed to a second language early tend to pick it up with astonishing ease. （议论文·教育）
Children who are regularly exposed to music from an early age often develop a lifelong sensitivity to beauty. （议论文·美育）

synonyms.example: The lifting fog slowly revealed a village nestled in the valley, its rooftops glowing in the first light of day. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: 中性词，指使原本看不见的显现出来，可褒可贬；expose 常含'揭穿丑恶'或'使处于风险'的负面或警示色彩

synonyms.example: Digging through the dusty archive, she uncovered a letter that rewrote her family's entire history. （读后续写·发现）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'掀开覆盖物、查明隐藏的事'，强调发现过程；expose 更强调把隐藏之物公之于众或使人受其影响

synonyms.example: The company finally disclosed the figures it had long kept from the public. （应用文·正式）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，指主动公开原本保密的信息；expose 语气更强，常暗示对方本想隐瞒而被强行揭发

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·expose 三大义项一句串（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: be exposed as ...（揭穿）｜expose ... to sb（显露）｜expose sb to sth / be exposed to sth（使接触、使遭受）
advancedExpressions.example: He was exposed as a fraud only after he had exposed his true face to a few close friends, having been exposed to greed for far too long. 他向几个密友显露真面目后终被揭穿是骗子——他接触贪欲已经太久了。（一句串起'揭穿/显露/使接触'三义）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·expose 词族串记（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: expose (v.) → exposed (adj. 暴露的) → exposure (n. 暴露/揭露/曝光度)
advancedExpressions.example: Long exposure to strong sunlight leaves exposed skin badly burnt, so cover up before you expose yourself to the midday sun. 长时间暴晒会灼伤裸露的皮肤，所以在正午晒太阳前先遮盖好。（一句串 expose/exposed/exposure 三态）

advancedExpressions.expression: be exposed to / come into contact with / be subjected to
advancedExpressions.example: The more we are exposed to diverse cultures, the harder it becomes to cling to our old, narrow prejudices. （'接触/暴露'系列，议论文写视野拓宽）

advancedExpressions.expression: expose / lay bare / bring to light / shed light on
advancedExpressions.example: One brave report laid bare the injustice that comfortable silence had long concealed. （'揭露真相'高级替换群，作文亮点句）

advancedExpressions.expression: as ... receded / lifted, it exposed ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the morning mist lifted, it exposed a scene of quiet devastation, and for a long moment no one among us could find a single word to say. （as时间状语从句+expose揭示场景，续写环境转场）

advancedExpressions.expression: we must expose ... in order to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must expose the hidden cost of fast fashion in order to awaken our fellow students to the true price of a cheap shirt. （目的状语句式，呼吁行动）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., stripped bare, exposes ...
advancedExpressions.example: The pursuit of endless growth, stripped bare, exposes a troubling truth: that we have mistaken having more for living well. （过去分词插入语stripped bare + expose a truth揭示本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The storm passed and we saw the damage.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When at last the storm spent its fury and moved on, it exposed a village laid low — roofs torn away, streets choked with mud, and, everywhere, the stunned silence of people counting what remained. （读后续写·灾后）

translation: 政治的，政府的，政权的；政党的，党派的
original_sentence: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
readingExamples: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. relating to the government, politics, and public affairs of a country
(2) adj. relating to the ways that power is achieved and used within a group or organization
(3) adj. interested in or active in politics; holding particular views about how a country should be governed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人）善于权术的、精于处理人际权力关系的
uncommonMeanings.example: She was far too political to voice her true feelings in that meeting; instead she smiled, nodded, and waited for the tide to turn in her favour. （读后续写·职场·人物城府）

posExamples.sentence: The old painting, dismissed for years as a quaint village scene, held a political meaning so sharp that, once explained, it made the whole gallery fall into an uneasy hush. （读后续写·艺术·发现）
As young citizens, we should take an active interest in political affairs, for the decisions made in distant halls will one day shape the very streets we walk. （应用文·倡议·青年责任）
Art and political power have always shared an uneasy relationship: the former dares to question, while the latter, uncomfortable with questions, too often seeks to silence it. （议论文·艺术与社会）
True political stability, history teaches us, rests not on force but on the quiet consent of a people who feel their voices genuinely heard. （议论文·社会治理）

wordForms.noun: politics (政治/政治学); politician (政治家/政客); policy (政策); polity (政体)
wordForms.adjective: political (政治的); apolitical (不关心政治的)
wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：politics(政治)→political(adj.政治的)→politician(政治家/政客)→policy(政策)→politically(adv.)。⚠易混：politics(政治)≠policy(政策)——politics 指政治活动/角力，policy 指具体方针/对策(如foreign policy外交政策)。politician 常含'政客'的贬义色彩，statesman(政治家)更褒

collocations.translation: 政治和社会问题（课文原句）
collocations.example: However, some critics suggest that on closer inspection, the painting actually exposes serious political and social problems. （课文原句·选择性必修一U3）
A single reckless decision plunged the small nation into a political crisis it had not seen in decades. （议论文·治理，联动本单元 crisis）
No political system, however grand, can endure long if it forgets the ordinary people it was built to serve. （议论文·治理）
Decades of political stability had allowed the small nation to invest patiently in its children's education. （议论文·发展）
Though their political views clashed sharply, the two old friends never let disagreement poison their affection. （读后续写·友情）
She began to take part in political activities on campus, drafting petitions and organizing debates late into the night. （读后续写·觉醒）
A single documentary awakened in him a political awareness that no textbook had ever managed to stir. （读后续写·成长）
The essay handled a politically sensitive topic with rare balance and grace. （应用文·评价）

synonyms.example: The new library was funded entirely by governmental support and a flood of local donations. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 专指与政府机构、行政相关；political范围更广，涵盖政治权力、党派、观点等一切与'政治'有关的事物

synonyms.example: The debate soon spilled beyond the classroom to become a matter of genuine public concern. （议论文·社会）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'与公众、大众相关'；political侧重'与国家治理、权力运作相关'，二者在'公共事务'语境中有交叉但重心不同

synonyms.example: Voting, he came to see, was not merely a right but a solemn civic duty. （议论文·公民责任）
synonyms.usage: 侧重公民身份、公民责任与城市事务；political更强调权力、政府与政策层面

advancedExpressions.expression: politics / political / politician / policy 一图记
advancedExpressions.example: A wise politician (人) shapes sound policy (政策) not for political (adj.) applause but for the lasting good of the people. （一句串起 politician / policy / political 的词性与含义）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·并列形容词修饰名词
advancedExpressions.expression: serious political and social problems
advancedExpressions.example: The mural exposes serious political and social problems, where two adjectives (political, social) jointly modify the plural noun problems. （两个adj.并列共同修饰同一名词，共用一个中心词）

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath ..., a deeper political meaning lay ...

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... may seem apolitical, yet ...

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What从句作主语制造对比 + on closer inspection插入 + 破折号引出indictment + 现在分词exposing延展 + 排比(every...every...)强化

original_sentence: Also in the painting are soldiers who appear to ignore their duties.
readingExamples: Also in the painting are soldiers who appear to ignore their duties.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a member of an army, especially one who is not an officer
(2) n. a person who works very hard for a particular cause or organization
(3) v. (soldier on) to continue with something despite difficulties

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (soldier on) 坚持干下去，顽强地继续（尽管困难重重）
uncommonMeanings.example: Long after the other volunteers had given up and gone home, she soldiered on through the driving rain, determined that not a single stray dog would be left shivering in the flooded shelter. （读后续写·坚持与善良）

posExamples.sentence: As the young soldier knelt beside the wounded stranger, sharing his last drop of water, I finally understood that true courage lay not in the battle he had fought, but in the compassion he refused to abandon. （读后续写·战争·人性光辉）
On behalf of our whole community, I am writing to invite you to a memorial ceremony honouring the soldiers who laid down their lives so that we might live in peace. （应用文·邀请信）

History teaches us that a nation's strength rests not merely on the number of its soldiers, but on whether ordinary citizens are willing to defend the values those soldiers fight to protect. （议论文·爱国与责任）
Though his legs ached and his confidence had all but collapsed, he soldiered on to the finish line, refusing to let the jeering crowd write the ending of his story. （读后续写·体育·永不放弃）

wordForms.noun: soldier (士兵); soldiery (士兵们/军人集体)
wordForms.verb: soldier (作动词，常用 soldier on 坚持)

idioms.translation: 顽强坚持，克服困难继续下去
idioms.example: When the rest of the team wanted to abandon the project, it was Grandpa's quiet voice in my memory that urged me to soldier on. （读后续写·亲情激励）

collocations.translation: 顽强坚持，克服困难继续下去（本词重点动词短语）
collocations.example: Though exhausted and soaked to the skin, the rescuers soldiered on, refusing to rest until every trapped villager was safe. （读后续写·坚持·永不放弃）

collocations.translation: 玩忽职守的士兵（课文原句）
collocations.example: Also in the painting are soldiers who appear to ignore their duties. （课文原句·选择性必修一U3）

collocations.translation: 勇敢的 / 受伤的士兵
collocations.example: The wounded soldier gripped my hand and whispered a single word — 'home' — before his eyes drifted shut. （读后续写·战争·生离死别）
Every Sunday, the retired soldier taught neighbourhood children how to fold the national flag with the reverence it deserved. （读后续写·社区·传承）

collocations.example: She never sought the spotlight; content to be a foot soldier of the environmental movement, she planted trees while others gave speeches. （议论文·实干精神）

The general believed that to train soldiers of character, one must first teach them to value the lives they are sworn to protect. （议论文·教育与品格）

collocations.phrase: fall as a soldier / die a soldier
collocations.example: His grandfather had fallen as a soldier at the age of nineteen, and the faded photograph on the mantelpiece had shaped every decision the boy would ever make. （读后续写·家族记忆）

synonyms.example: Though she wielded no sword, the young doctor was a warrior in her own right, battling the epidemic night after sleepless night. （读后续写·抗疫·比喻）
synonyms.usage: 文学色彩更浓,强调英勇善战或为某事奋斗的斗士形象,常用于比喻;soldier 更中性、写实,指军队成员

synonyms.example: As dawn broke, the exhausted troops received orders to withdraw, and for the first time in weeks the valley fell silent. （读后续写·战争·转折）
synonyms.usage: 集合名词,永远用复数,指成群的军人或部队整体;不能像 soldier 那样指单个个体

synonyms.translation: 老兵，退伍军人；经验丰富的人

synonyms.usage: 特指经历过战争、退役的老兵,或引申指某领域的资深人士;soldier 泛指现役或一般军人

advancedExpressions.expression: soldier on / carry on / press on / keep at it / persevere
advancedExpressions.example: Even when hope seemed lost, she chose to soldier on, and that stubborn refusal to quit finally carried her across the line. （'坚持'系列短语，读后续写高光动词）

advancedExpressions.expression: with the discipline of a soldier and the heart of a poet
advancedExpressions.example: He faced the crisis with the discipline of a soldier and the heart of a poet — unyielding in action, yet tender in every word he spoke to the frightened child. （对照修辞,一句写尽人物两面）

advancedExpressions.expression: we owe an immeasurable debt to the soldiers who ...

advancedExpressions.expression: not every hero wears a soldier's uniform

translation: (pl. crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/) 危机，危急关头；危险时刻，紧要关头
original_sentence: These sorts of details point to a crisis developing in the city.
readingExamples: These sorts of details point to a crisis developing in the city.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a time of great danger, difficulty or uncertainty when problems must be solved or important decisions made
(2) n. a time when a problem, a bad situation or an illness is at its worst point
(3) n. an emotional situation in which someone finds it hard to cope

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (疾病的)转折点，危象；(个人心理的)危机时刻
uncommonMeanings.example: The fever reached its crisis at midnight; the old doctor did not leave her bedside, watching for the single flicker of the eyelids that would tell him she had chosen, at last, to live. （读后续写·医疗·生死转折）

posExamples.sentence: When the flood swept away the only bridge, the whole village was plunged into crisis; yet it was in that darkest hour that neighbours who had quarrelled for years finally joined hands. （读后续写·灾难·团结）
I am writing to appeal for urgent donations, as the recent drought has thrown thousands of families in the region into a crisis they cannot possibly weather alone. （应用文·倡议/求助信）
Every crisis, though painful, carries within it the seeds of renewal: it forces a society to examine its weaknesses and, in doing so, to grow stronger than before. （议论文·危机与成长）
Facing a crisis of confidence after failing the audition, she locked herself away for days — until the sight of a lone violinist playing in the rain reminded her why she had ever begun. （读后续写·挫折·重燃）

wordForms.noun: crisis (单数) / crises (复数) — 复数拼写务必记牢
wordForms.adjective: critical (危急的，此义与 crisis 同源)
wordForms.other: ⚠拼写高频考点：单数 crisis /ˈkraɪsɪs/，复数 crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/（-is 变 -es，读音也变）。同类以 -is→-es 变复数的词：basis→bases、analysis→analyses、thesis→theses、oasis→oases。形容词形式借用同源的 critical(危急的)

idioms.example: The team's repeated failures triggered a crisis of confidence that no pep talk could easily cure. （议论文/读后续写·心理）
Torn between his parents' expectations and his own dreams, the teenager slid into an identity crisis that would take him a whole summer to resolve. （读后续写·成长）

collocations.phrase: a crisis developing in the city
collocations.translation: 城市中正在酝酿的危机（课文原句）
collocations.example: These sorts of details point to a crisis developing in the city. （课文原句·选择性必修一U3）
With its rivers drying up and its youth leaving, the town was clearly in crisis, though few dared to say so aloud. （议论文·社会）
During the economic crisis, the small bakery kept giving away its unsold bread, and that quiet generosity was never forgotten by the town. （读后续写·善良·温情）

collocations.phrase: face / deal with / tackle a crisis
collocations.translation: 面对 / 应对 / 解决危机
collocations.example: How a leader deals with a crisis reveals far more about her character than any speech she could ever deliver. （议论文·领导力）
In a crisis, it is not the strongest who survive, but those calm enough to think and kind enough to help one another. （读后续写·灾难·主题句）

collocations.phrase: overcome / weather / get through a crisis
collocations.example: Together they weathered the crisis, and when the storm at last subsided, they found their friendship forged into something unbreakable. （读后续写·友情·升华）
The scandal triggered a crisis of trust between the public and the institution, one that would take decades to repair. （议论文·信任）
A single act of honesty, offered at the right moment, was enough to defuse the crisis that had threatened to tear the family apart. （读后续写·家庭·转机）

collocations.phrase: at the height of the crisis
collocations.example: At the height of the crisis, when panic gripped the ward, the young nurse's steady voice became the anchor everyone clung to. （读后续写·抗疫·画面感）

collocations.phrase: a crisis point / turning point in the crisis
collocations.example: The rescue arrived at the very crisis point, moments before the rising water reached the children's shoulders. （读后续写·营救·紧张感）

synonyms.example: In an emergency, she dialled for help with trembling fingers, then knelt to keep the injured cyclist talking until the ambulance arrived. （读后续写·急救·动作）
synonyms.usage: 强调突发、需立即行动的具体紧急事件(如火灾、事故);crisis 更强调持续的、关乎全局的危难局面或重大转折

synonyms.example: Caught in a genuine predicament — honesty would cost him the prize, silence would cost him his conscience — the boy stood frozen at the crossroads. （读后续写·道德抉择）
synonyms.usage: 书面语,指进退两难、令人尴尬的处境,规模通常小于 crisis,不一定危及安全

synonyms.example: What began as a minor oversight spiralled, within hours, into a catastrophe that would reshape the entire coastline. （议论文/读后续写·灾难）
synonyms.usage: 语气最重,强调造成巨大破坏、几乎无法挽回的灾难性后果;crisis 侧重危险的关键时刻,结局未定

advancedExpressions.expression: crisis (sing.) → crises (pl.)

advancedExpressions.expression: in crisis / weather a crisis / defuse a crisis / at the height of the crisis
advancedExpressions.example: A country in crisis is not saved by panic but by leaders calm enough to weather the storm and wise enough to defuse it. （'危机'系列短语串用，议论文论证）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was in the very depths of the crisis that ...

advancedExpressions.expression: in the face of this crisis, I sincerely call on ... to ...
