advancedExpressions.expression: a crisis is not merely a threat but also an opportunity to ...
advancedExpressions.example: A crisis is not merely a threat to be feared, but also an opportunity to reflect, reform and rebuild on firmer ground. （not merely...but also 辩证结构,危中见机）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was a crisis in the city and everyone was afraid.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the crisis tightened its grip on the city, fear spread from street to street like a rising tide — yet in doorway after doorway, a candle flickered to life, each tiny flame a quiet act of defiance against the dark. （读后续写·灾难·希望）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人(tightened its grip) + 明喻(like a rising tide) + 对比反转(fear vs candle) + 象征(candle=希望)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We must solve the crisis quickly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The crisis before us admits of no delay; unless we act decisively and in concert, the window of opportunity will close, and with it, our chance to set things right. （议论文·正式·紧迫）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: admit of no delay 高级表达 + in concert 书面搭配 + unless 条件从句强化紧迫感 + with it 省略衔接

classPractice.question: Over just three years, the region was struck by a series of financial ____ (crisis), each one deeper than the last.
classPractice.note: 考不规则复数：a series of + 复数名词，crisis 的复数为 crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/

classPractice.question: 用介词短语填空：With its factories closing and its people leaving, the whole town was ____ ____ , yet no one dared admit it.
classPractice.note: 考固定搭配 in crisis'处于危机中'，此处 crisis 不加冠词作抽象概念

classPractice.question: 这些细节都表明城市中正在酝酿一场危机。（point to; a crisis developing）
classPractice.answer: These sorts of details point to a crisis developing in the city.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：point to'表明/指向' + a crisis developing 现在分词作后置定语

translation: n. 减少，减弱，衰退，下降 | vi. & vt. 减少，下降，衰退，衰落；谢绝
original_sentence: In fact, the Northern Song Dynasty was in decline by this stage.
readingExamples: In fact, the Northern Song Dynasty was in decline by this stage.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a continuous decrease in the number, value, quality or strength of something
(2) v. to become smaller, fewer, weaker or worse
(3) v. to politely refuse an invitation, offer or request
(4) v. (of a country, empire, etc.) to gradually lose power, importance or prosperity

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】减少，下降，衰退，衰落（a decrease in the quality, quantity, or importance of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: There has been a 5% decline in student numbers. 学生人数下降了5%。（PPT原句·名词义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】下降，衰退，衰落（to become smaller, fewer, weaker, etc.）
uncommonMeanings.example: Sales of whole milk declined by 4 per cent. 全脂牛奶的销量下降了4%。（PPT原句·decline by 下降了……）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】谢绝，礼貌地拒绝（to refuse politely to accept or to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Mary declined a hot drink and went to her room. 玛丽谢绝了热饮，回到了自己房间。（PPT原句·谢绝）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 婉言谢绝，礼貌地拒绝（decline an invitation / decline to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: She declined his generous offer with a gracious smile, explaining that some victories mean nothing unless they are earned by one's own hands. （读后续写·尊严·婉拒）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （数量/质量/势力）下降、衰退、衰落
uncommonMeanings.example: As screen time soars, the ability of young people to concentrate for long stretches has declined. （议论文·科技）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 减少，衰退，下降（a decline in sth；be in decline）
uncommonMeanings.example: In fact, the Northern Song Dynasty was in decline by this stage, its glory quietly fading. （课文语境·历史）

posExamples.sentence: Watching the once-bustling old street fall into gradual decline, Grandpa would sigh and murmur that a place, like a person, could die of loneliness. （读后续写·怀旧·衰败）
I am concerned to report that participation in our reading club has steadily declined this term, and I would like to propose a few measures to rekindle everyone's enthusiasm. （应用文·报告/建议信）
When the committee offered him the award, he politely declined, insisting that the credit belonged to the volunteers who had toiled unseen behind the scenes. （读后续写·谦逊·高尚）
As screen time soars, the ability of young people to concentrate for long stretches has declined — a trend that ought to give every educator serious pause. （议论文·科技与专注）

wordForms.noun: decline (衰退/下降) / declination (偏斜/婉拒·较正式罕用)
wordForms.adjective: declining (下降的/衰退的，如 declining birth rate 下降的出生率)
wordForms.other: 构词法：de-(向下)+cline(倾斜,词根=to lean/bend)→'向下倾斜'→下降/衰退。同根 cline 家族：incline(in-向内倾→倾向/斜坡)、recline(re-向后靠→斜躺)。⚠一词多义分工：数量下降(vi.)/衰退(n.)与'婉拒'(vt.)拼写全同，靠搭配区分——in decline 是衰退，decline an invitation 是婉拒

idioms.example: Handwritten letters may be on the decline, but the joy of finding one in the mailbox remains as sweet as ever. （议论文/读后续写·传统）

idioms.translation: 开始走下坡路，陷入衰退
idioms.example: After the factory closed, the whole town seemed to go into decline, its shop windows growing dustier with each passing season. （读后续写·小镇·萧条）

collocations.phrase: fall / go into (a) decline · in decline · economic decline【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】开始衰退/下降 · 在下降 · 经济衰退
collocations.example: There has been a 5% decline in student numbers, and the whole industry has fallen into decline. 学生人数下降了5%，整个行业开始走下坡路。（PPT语块积累）

collocations.phrase: decline by · decline to do sth · decline one's invitation【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】下降了…… · 拒绝做某事 · 拒绝某人的邀请
collocations.example: Sales declined by 4 per cent. 销量下降了4%。/ Mary declined a hot drink. 玛丽谢绝了热饮。（PPT语块积累·decline by / decline to do / decline one's invitation）

collocations.phrase: be in decline / on the decline
collocations.translation: 处于衰退中，日趋衰落（课文原句）
collocations.example: In fact, the Northern Song Dynasty was in decline by this stage. （课文原句·选择性必修一U3）

collocations.translation: ……方面的下降（decline 作名词的核心搭配，介词用 in）
collocations.example: A worrying decline in physical activity among teenagers has been linked to the endless allure of the smartphone. （议论文·健康）

collocations.translation: 谢绝邀请 / 提议 / 请求（decline 作'婉拒'的动词搭配）
collocations.example: Though flattered, she declined the invitation to the gala, choosing instead to spend the evening with the orphans who had no one else. （读后续写·善良·取舍）

collocations.translation: 急剧的 / 稳步的 / 逐渐的下降
collocations.example: The survey revealed a sharp decline in students' willingness to read for pleasure, prompting the school to rethink its whole library policy. （应用文·调查报告）

collocations.translation: 迅速 / 稳步 / 急剧地下降
collocations.example: As pollution worsened, the number of migrating birds returning each spring declined sharply, until the marsh fell eerily silent. （读后续写·环保·警示）

collocations.phrase: decline to do sth / decline to comment
collocations.translation: 拒绝做某事 / 拒绝置评
collocations.example: He declined to explain his sudden departure, and that silence would haunt her for years to come. （读后续写·悬念）
Only concerted community effort, the mayor argued, could halt the decline of the historic waterfront. （议论文·城市治理）

collocations.phrase: the rise and decline / fall of ...
collocations.example: The museum's final hall told, in silent portraits, the whole story of the dynasty's rise and decline. （读后续写·历史·厚重感）

synonyms.example: Complaints about the school canteen have noticeably decreased since the new menu was introduced. （应用文·报告·中性）
synonyms.usage: 最中性,单纯指数量、程度的减少,可用于任何可量化事物;decline 常暗含由盛转衰、质量或地位的下滑,带有负面色彩

synonyms.example: As the days dragged on without rescue, the old man's health began to deteriorate, yet his spirit refused to break. （读后续写·困境·意志）
synonyms.usage: 强调质量、状况变坏(健康、关系、局势),不用于"拒绝"义;decline 既可指衰退也可指婉拒

synonyms.example: He flatly refused to sign the unfair contract, come what may. （议论文/读后续写·原则）
synonyms.usage: 指"拒绝"时,refuse 语气直接、可能带情绪;decline 更委婉、正式、有礼,是 refuse 的高级替换。注意句法:refuse/decline to do sth(接不定式),但 refuse sb sth(双宾)不能说 decline sb sth

advancedExpressions.type: 一词多义·衰退 vs 婉拒
advancedExpressions.expression: be in decline（衰退）| decline an invitation（婉拒）
advancedExpressions.example: Even as her health went into decline, she graciously declined every offer of pity, insisting she needed strength, not sympathy. （同一词两义同句呈现，凸显搭配辨义）

advancedExpressions.expression: decline / turn down / say no to / respectfully decline
advancedExpressions.example: Much as he longed to accept, he had to decline the scholarship, for his ailing mother needed him more than any distant university did. （'婉拒'高级替换群，应用文得体表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: once ..., but now fallen into decline
advancedExpressions.example: Once the pride of the whole province, the theatre had now fallen into decline, its gilded ceiling flaking like the memory of applause long silenced. （today/then 对照 + 隐喻,渲染沧桑）

advancedExpressions.expression: I must respectfully decline ..., much as I would love to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Much as I would love to join the trip, I must respectfully decline, as prior commitments to my grandmother leave me no free weekend. （既守礼又给理由的婉拒句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: the steady decline in ... should serve as a wake-up call
advancedExpressions.example: The steady decline in outdoor play among children should serve as a wake-up call to parents and educators alike. （用趋势敲响警钟,提出论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old town became worse and worse over the years.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Year by year, the old town slid quietly into decline — its cobbled lanes overgrown with weeds, its lantern-lit evenings dimming into memory, until only the wind still wandered through its emptied courtyards. （读后续写·衰败·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: slid into decline 动态动词 + 破折号列举具象细节(cobbled lanes, lantern-lit evenings) + 拟人(only the wind wandered) 营造萧瑟

sentenceUpgrade.original: He said no to the reward because he was modest.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With quiet dignity he declined the reward, insisting that any recognition rightfully belonged to the countless unsung hands that had made the triumph possible. （读后续写·谦逊·升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With quiet dignity 状语提升气质 + decline 替换 say no + insisting 现在分词伴随 + unsung hands 借代修辞

classPractice.question: We asked her to the reception, but she ____ ____ ____ (谢绝了这个邀请).
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】decline one's invitation 谢绝某人的邀请（decline 作及物动词'婉拒'）

classPractice.question: He ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ (拒绝讨论他的计划) with us.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】decline to do sth 拒绝做某事（后接动词不定式）

classPractice.question: Thankfully, this is a disease that is now ____ ____ ____ (在衰退中).
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】on the decline = 在衰退/减少中（疾病发病率下降）

classPractice.question: As the economy was ____ ____ (在衰退), some people in the town had lost their jobs.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·语境应用】be in decline 处于衰退中（经济衰退）

classPractice.question: 根据语境判断 decline 的意义（填'衰退'或'婉拒'）：(1) The empire was in decline, its borders shrinking year by year. (2) She politely declined the invitation to the party.
classPractice.answer: (1) 衰退（be in decline，n.） (2) 婉拒（decline the invitation，vt.）
classPractice.note: 考 decline 一词多义：靠搭配定义——in decline=衰退；decline + invitation/offer=婉拒

classPractice.question: In fact, the Northern Song Dynasty was ____ decline by this stage, its former splendour quietly fading away.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：固定搭配 be in decline'处于衰退中'，介词用 in

classPractice.question: 尽管很想参加，我还是不得不婉拒这次邀请，因为那个周末我已另有安排。（decline the invitation）
classPractice.answer: Much as I would love to attend, I have to decline the invitation, because I already have other plans that weekend.
classPractice.note: 考 decline 作'婉拒'的及物用法（decline the invitation）+ Much as 引导让步

translation: vt. (overthrew, overthrown) 推翻，颠覆 | n. 推翻，颠覆
original_sentence: About twenty years after the painting was completed, it was overthrown.
readingExamples: About twenty years after the painting was completed, it was overthrown.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to remove a leader or government from power, especially by force
(2) v. to defeat or put an end to an existing system, idea or practice
(3) n. the act of removing a leader or government from power

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 推翻、颠覆（理论/观念/旧秩序）——不止用于政权，也可推翻'定论'
uncommonMeanings.example: Her groundbreaking experiment overthrew a theory that scientists had accepted for over a century. （议论文·科学·质疑精神）

posExamples.sentence: When the crowd finally surged through the palace gates to overthrow the tyrant, the young girl clutched her mother's hand, sensing that the whole world was about to be remade before her eyes. （读后续写·历史·变革）
I firmly believe that the tour will overthrow the tired stereotype that history museums are dull, revealing instead a past that pulses with life and wonder. （应用文·推介/邀请信）
The overthrow of an unjust regime may bring a moment of jubilation, yet history reminds us that tearing down is always easier than the patient work of building anew. （议论文·变革与建设）
Her groundbreaking experiment overthrew a theory that scientists had accepted for over a century — proof that no idea, however venerable, is beyond question. （议论文·科学·质疑精神）

wordForms.other: 构词法：over(在上/翻转)+throw(投掷/扔)→'把……掀翻/掀倒'→推翻。⚠不规则变化仿 throw：overthrow-overthrew-overthrown（对照 throw-threw-thrown）。同一 over+词根 家族：overcome(over+come 克服)、overlook(俯视/忽视)、overturn(翻倒/推翻判决)、overwhelm(压倒)。名词与动词同形，靠 the overthrow of / 冠词判断词性

collocations.translation: 推翻政府 / 政权 / 王朝（本词最核心搭配）
collocations.example: The rebels who rose to overthrow the corrupt dynasty little imagined how heavy the crown would feel once it was theirs. （读后续写·历史·反思）
Within a decade the empire, once thought invincible, was overthrown by the very forces it had long ignored. （读后续写·历史·盛衰）

collocations.translation: 推翻暴君 / 统治者 / 独裁者
collocations.example: It was not weapons but the united will of ordinary people that finally overthrew the tyrant. （议论文·民心）

collocations.translation: 推翻一种理论 / 信念 / 假设
collocations.example: A single careful observation was enough to overthrow the assumption that had misled generations of researchers. （议论文·科学）
The general was accused of plotting to overthrow the throne, though the truth, as ever, was buried beneath layers of rumour. （读后续写·历史·悬疑）
The overthrow of the old order left a power vacuum that would take a generation to fill. （议论文·历史）

collocations.translation: 颠覆现有秩序 / 制度
collocations.example: Great reformers rarely seek to overthrow the existing order overnight; they patiently reshape it from within. （议论文·改革方式）

synonyms.example: The scandal was enough to topple a minister who had seemed, only weeks before, utterly untouchable. （议论文/读后续写·权力）
synonyms.usage: 生动形象,原指"使倾倒",引申指使政权/人物突然垮台,常暗示由高处骤然跌落;overthrow 更正式、更强调经过斗争的推翻

synonyms.example: The higher court overturned the earlier verdict, and the wrongly accused man walked free at last. （读后续写·正义·反转）
synonyms.usage: 多用于推翻判决、决定、结果,或字面"翻倒";overthrow 特指推翻政权、统治者或根深蒂固的体系/理论

synonyms.example: The council voted to depose the aging king, whose grip on reality had slipped as surely as his grip on the realm. （读后续写·历史·正式）
synonyms.usage: 正式且具体,专指正式罢免君主或高位者;overthrow 范围更广,可指用武力推翻整个政权或颠覆抽象体系

advancedExpressions.expression: over(翻转)+throw(扔) → overthrow (overthrew, overthrown)
advancedExpressions.example: Just as you throw (threw, thrown) a ball, you overthrow (overthrew, overthrown) a king — same irregular pattern, one step bigger. （借 throw 记 overthrow 的不规则变化）

advancedExpressions.expression: overthrow / topple / bring down / put an end to
advancedExpressions.example: It took not a single hero but a whole people to bring down and finally overthrow the tyranny that had crushed them for generations. （'推翻'系列近义词递进，议论文增色）

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment the ... was overthrown, an era came to an end
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the old regime was overthrown, an era came to an end, and in the hush that followed, the crowd seemed to hold its breath before the unknown. （以政权更迭标记时代转折,渲染历史感）

advancedExpressions.expression: this ... will overthrow the misconception that ...
advancedExpressions.example: This exhibition will overthrow the misconception that science is cold and distant, showing instead its beauty and human warmth. （推介文中破除刻板印象）

advancedExpressions.expression: even the most established ... can be overthrown by ...
advancedExpressions.example: Even the most established theory can be overthrown by a single inconvenient fact — and therein lies the true spirit of science. （强调科学的可证伪性,论证质疑的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The people overthrew the cruel king.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rising as one after years of silent suffering, the people swept through the gates and overthrew the cruel king — not with hatred alone, but with a fierce, trembling hope for the dawn they had so long been denied. （读后续写·历史·变革）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rising as one 现在分词状语造声势 + not...but 揭示动机深层 + a fierce, trembling hope 矛盾修饰增张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: The experiment proved the old theory was wrong.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In a single elegant experiment, she overthrew a theory that had reigned unchallenged for a century, reminding the scientific world that certainty is often merely the absence of a better question. （议论文·科学·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: overthrow 替换 prove wrong + reign unchallenged 拟人化 + reminding 分词点题 + 格言式收尾(certainty is...) 提升思辨深度

classPractice.question: Within just twenty years, the dynasty had been ____ (overthrow), and a new era rose from the ruins of the old.
classPractice.note: 考不规则过去分词：had been + 过去分词构成过去完成时被动，overthrow-overthrew-overthrown

classPractice.question: 正是普通百姓团结一致的意志，最终推翻了那个暴君。It was the united will of ordinary people that finally ____ the tyrant. (用 overthrow 的正确形式)
classPractice.note: 考不规则过去式 overthrew；强调句 It was...that 中主句谓语用一般过去时

classPractice.question: 她那开创性的实验推翻了科学家们信奉了一个多世纪的理论。（overthrow a theory）
classPractice.answer: Her groundbreaking experiment overthrew a theory that scientists had accepted for over a century.
classPractice.note: 考 overthrow 的引申义'推翻理论'及过去式 overthrew + that 定语从句

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to be caused by or be the responsibility of a particular person or thing
(2) phr. to be the decision or choice of a particular person
(3) phr. to have only a small amount of something left

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 只剩下……(表示所剩无几)
uncommonMeanings.example: By the third day of the storm they were down to their last candle and a single tin of beans, yet the children's laughter never once flickered out. （读后续写·困境·乐观）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 取决于某人，由某人决定
uncommonMeanings.example: Whether we sink or swim now is down to you, the coach said quietly, and in that instant the whole team felt the weight of the final serve. （读后续写·体育·关键时刻）

posExamples.sentence: Looking back, I realized that our unlikely victory was down to nothing more glamorous than the countless dawns we had spent training while the rest of the city still slept. （读后续写·奋斗·顿悟）
The success of this charity sale will be down to every one of us, so I sincerely hope each classmate will contribute whatever time and effort they can spare. （应用文·倡议书）
Whether a student truly flourishes is not down to talent alone, but to the quiet, daily discipline that talent so often lacks. （议论文·努力vs天赋）
When the money was down to a few worn coins, Mother still managed, somehow, to set a warm meal before us — and only years later did I grasp the cost of that quiet miracle. （读后续写·亲情·牺牲）

idioms.idiom: when it comes / is down to it
idioms.example: He talked bravely for weeks, but when it came down to it, only she had the courage to speak the truth aloud. （读后续写·关键时刻·对比）

collocations.phrase: be down to sb / sth (= be caused by)
collocations.translation: 【课件】归因于；由……引起（to be caused by a particular person or thing）
collocations.example: She claimed her problems were down to the media. 她声称她的问题是由媒体造成的。（Extended·课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be down to sb (to do sth)
collocations.translation: 【课件】由某人决定；是某人的责任（拓展义）
collocations.example: After your father retires, it will be down to you to lead the company. 你父亲退休后，领导公司的重任就落到你身上了。（Extended·课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be down (not only) to A (but also to B)
collocations.translation: 【课件】（其价值/原因）在于……（课文原句结构，not only ... but also ... 各带一个 to）
collocations.example: Its value is down not only to its great scale, artistic quality and attention to detail, but also to its representation of daily life. 它的价值不仅在于画幅宏大、艺术性高、注重细节，更在于其对日常生活的再现。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 由……引起；是……的功劳(或过错)
collocations.example: The team's remarkable comeback was down to a captain who refused to let anyone lose faith. （读后续写·团队·归因）

collocations.phrase: be down to sb (to do sth)

advancedExpressions.example: She had always been introduced as the great painter's daughter, but that night she became an artist in her own right. 她一直被介绍为那位大画家的女儿，而那一晚她凭自身实力成了一名画家。（人）｜The pavilion is a masterpiece in its own right. 这座亭子本身就是一件杰作。（物，its own）

advancedExpressions.example: I want to succeed in my own right. 我想凭自己的本事成功。/ These sketches are valuable in their own right. 这些草图本身就很有价值。（复数物 → their）

advancedExpressions.expression: no longer merely ..., sb. had become ... in his/her own right

translation: 优秀的，杰出的；显著的，明显的

readingExamples: With the Qingming Scroll, Zhang made an outstanding contribution to Chinese art and greatly influenced generations of future artists.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. extremely good; excellent and clearly better than others of its kind
(2) adj. very obvious or important; remarkable enough to attract notice
(3) adj. (of a debt, payment or task) not yet paid, settled or dealt with

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (债务、款项)未付的,未偿清的;(问题)尚未解决的
uncommonMeanings.example: Long after the shop had closed, he sat beneath a single lamp, staring at the pile of outstanding bills — proof of a dream that had cost far more than he had ever imagined. （读后续写·创业受挫·经济压力）

posExamples.sentence: As the final note faded, an outstanding silence hung in the hall — then the audience rose as one, tears glistening on their cheeks, and thundered their applause for the boy who had once been told he would never play. （读后续写·演出成功·情感高潮）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua for the scholarship, as he has made an outstanding contribution to our community, tirelessly organizing charity events that have touched hundreds of lives. （应用文·推荐信）
What truly distinguishes an outstanding individual is not innate talent alone, but the discipline to keep refining one's craft long after others have given up. （议论文·成功的本质）
With the Qingming Scroll, the humble painter made an outstanding contribution to Chinese art, leaving behind a masterpiece that generations of scholars would strive in vain to equal. （读后续写·课文改写·历史成就）

collocations.example: By devoting her life to rural education, she made an outstanding contribution to the futures of children who had never before dared to dream. （应用文·颁奖词）

The teacher recognized the boy's outstanding talent the moment his brush first touched the paper. （读后续写·天赋初显）

collocations.translation: 未偿清的债务/款项/余额

synonyms.example: Her remarkable calm in the face of danger inspired everyone around her to keep going. （读后续写·危机中的镇定）

synonyms.example: The judges agreed that his essay showed exceptional insight for a boy his age. （议论文/记叙·超凡才智）

synonyms.example: A distinguished scholar, she had spent forty years quietly transforming her field. （议论文·人物评价）
synonyms.usage: 多形容人凭长期成就赢得的声誉与地位,较正式庄重;outstanding 可形容人、事、物,范围更广

advancedExpressions.expression: ①"杰出、卓越"义（褒义，最常考）：make an outstanding contribution to 对…作出杰出贡献；an outstanding achievement / performance 杰出成就/表现；an outstanding student / scholar / athlete 优秀的学生/学者/运动员；an outstanding example of …的杰出典范。②"未偿付、悬而未决"义（中性）：outstanding debt / payment / balance 未偿债务/款项/余额；outstanding issues / questions 悬而未决的问题。构词提醒：动词 stand out（脱颖而出）+ -ing → outstanding。
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：With the Qingming Scroll, Zhang made an outstanding contribution to Chinese art and greatly influenced generations of future artists. 凭借《清明上河图》，张择端对中国艺术作出了杰出贡献，并深深影响了后世一代代画家。（杰出义）｜课外：He worked hard to clear all his outstanding debts. 他努力还清了所有未偿债务。（未付义）

advancedExpressions.expression: 短语 stand out（from）= 脱颖而出、显眼 → 形容词 outstanding（把介副词 out 提前）= 杰出的、显著的 → outstandingly adv. 出色地。写作可"动词短语↔形容词"互换升级：sb stands out as outstanding。
advancedExpressions.example: Among a hundred candidates, her originality made her stand out — she was, in every judge's eyes, truly outstanding. 在上百名选手中，她的独创性让她脱颖而出——在每位评委眼中，她都堪称卓越。

advancedExpressions.expression: what had seemed impossible now stood as an outstanding testament to ...

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s outstanding ... makes him/her a most deserving candidate for ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: He gave an outstanding performance and everyone praised him.

sentenceUpgrade.original: This painting is an outstanding work of art.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: without exaggeration插入语增强可信度 + not merely ... but ... 递进对比 + and that并列定语从句延展 + 时间状语(centuries after ...)拉长历史纵深

definitionEn:

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (英式)助学金,奖学金(尤指颁给成绩优异学生的)

posExamples.sentence: The moment she stepped into the exhibition, the murmur of the crowd faded away, and her eyes locked onto a single canvas glowing softly in the far corner — the very painting she had travelled a thousand miles to see. （读后续写·画展·人物入场）

collocations.example: The last time it was on exhibition, crowds waited in line for hours for the rare chance to see the famous painting with their own eyes. 上次展出时，人们排了几个小时队，只为亲眼一睹这幅名画。（PPT原句；on exhibition = on display）

classPractice.question: 公众很高兴能免费参观这些展览。The public were pleased that they would have free ____ ____ these exhibitions.

translation: 稀少的，罕见的；稀罕的，难得的
original_sentence: The last time it was on exhibition, crowds waited in line for hours for the rare chance to see the famous painting with their own eyes.
readingExamples: The last time it was on exhibition, crowds waited in line for hours for the rare chance to see the famous painting with their own eyes.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. not happening or found very often; existing only in small numbers and therefore unusual
(2) adj. unusually good, valuable or precious; special because of its uncommon quality
(3) adj. (of meat, especially beef) cooked only briefly so that it is still red inside
(4) adj. (of air, especially at high altitude) thin; containing little oxygen

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 稀少的,罕见的;稀罕难得的(珍贵义)
uncommonMeanings.example: The last time it was on exhibition, crowds waited in line for hours for the rare chance to see the famous painting with their own eyes. （读后续写·课文改写·难得的机会）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (肉,尤指牛排)煎得半生的,三分熟的
uncommonMeanings.example: The waiter set down a steak so rare that a thin trickle of red still pooled on the plate. （读后续写·味觉·画面感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (空气,尤指高海拔)稀薄的
uncommonMeanings.example: As they climbed higher, the air grew rare and every breath became a small victory won from the thin mountain wind. （读后续写·登山·极限）

posExamples.sentence: The last time the scroll was on exhibition, crowds waited in line for hours for the rare chance to see the famous painting with their own eyes — a moment they knew might never come again. （读后续写·课文改写·难得的机会）
I am writing to invite you to a rare lecture by a world-renowned artist, an opportunity that our school may not be able to offer again for years. （应用文·邀请信）
In an age of instant gratification, the rare ability to wait patiently for a worthy goal has become one of the most valuable qualities a young person can possess. （议论文·耐心的可贵）
On that rare, cloudless morning, sunlight spilled across the frost-covered fields, and the boy paused, spellbound, as if the whole world had been made new overnight. （读后续写·环境描写·难得的晴日）

idioms.translation: 稀罕的人(或物),不寻常之人
idioms.example: A student who reads for pleasure rather than for grades is, sadly, a rare bird these days — and all the more precious for it. （议论文·独立思考的可贵）

collocations.example: Seizing this rare opportunity, she poured every ounce of her heart into the audition, knowing it might be her only door to a different life. （读后续写·抓住机会）
The old master saw in the quiet boy a rare talent that, if nurtured, might one day astonish the world. （读后续写·发现天赋）
Only on rare occasions did the stern general smile, and each time it felt like sunlight breaking through storm clouds. （读后续写·人物刻画）
True friendship, like a rare and precious gem, is not easily found and must be treasured once it is. （议论文·友谊）
The documentary offered a rare glimpse of life inside the ancient imperial court. （议论文/记叙·文化）
Deep in the untouched valley, the researchers stumbled upon a rare species long believed to be extinct. （读后续写·科考发现）

collocations.phrase: it is rare for sb to do / that ...
collocations.example: It is rare for him to praise anyone, so when he called her essay 'remarkable', the whole class fell silent. （记叙·出人意料）
She faced the raging flames with a rare courage that shamed the grown men frozen at her side. （读后续写·英勇救人）

synonyms.example: It is uncommon to find such honesty in one so young. （议论文/记叙·品质）
synonyms.usage: 较中性、平和地表示'不常见';rare 语气更强,常含'因稀少而珍贵'的褒义色彩

synonyms.example: As the drought dragged on, clean water grew scarce, and every drop was rationed with care. （读后续写·困境）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'供不应求、数量不足',多用于资源、物资;rare 侧重'本来就少见、罕有',可指机会、才能、品质等

synonyms.example: Her exceptional dedication set her apart from every other applicant. （议论文·人物评价）
synonyms.usage: 强调'罕见地好、超出寻常';当 rare 取'珍贵、非凡'义时二者相近,但 rare 更突出'数量上的稀少'

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·rare 高频搭配群
advancedExpressions.expression: a rare opportunity / chance 难得的机会；a rare talent / gift 罕见的才能；a rare species / animal / plant 稀有物种；a rare glimpse of 难得一见的一瞥；on rare occasions 偶尔、难得几次；rare and precious 稀有而珍贵的；it is rare for sb to do / that … 某人做某事很少见。副词 rarely = 很少（否定副词，置于句首要部分倒装）。
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：The last time it was on exhibition, crowds waited in line for hours for the rare chance to see the famous painting with their own eyes. 上次展出时，人们排了几个小时的队，只为亲眼一睹名画这难得的机会。｜课外：Rarely do we get such a rare opportunity. 我们很少能获得如此难得的机会。（rarely 居首，助动词 do 倒装）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·rarely 居首引起部分倒装
advancedExpressions.expression: rare adj. → rarely adv.（很少，含否定意味）。当否定/半否定副词 rarely, seldom, hardly, never, little 置于句首时，主句须部分倒装：Rarely + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 谓语。名词 rarity = 稀有之物/稀罕。
advancedExpressions.example: Rarely does he praise anyone, so his compliment meant a great deal. 他很少称赞人，所以他的夸奖意义非凡。（Rarely 居首 → does he praise 倒装）

advancedExpressions.expression: seizing the rare chance, sb. did ..., knowing it might never come again
advancedExpressions.example: Seizing the rare chance, he stepped forward and spoke his mind at last, knowing such courage might never visit him again. （分词状语 + knowing补充心理,强化'把握当下'的张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: this is a rare opportunity that you would not want to miss
advancedExpressions.example: This is a rare opportunity to learn directly from a master — one that you would truly not want to miss. （破折号补充 + 'would not want to miss'礼貌劝说，邀请信收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a world of ..., the rare quality of ... deserves to be cherished
advancedExpressions.example: In a world obsessed with speed, the rare quality of patience deserves to be cherished more than ever. （'in a world of ...'背景对比 + 'deserves to be cherished'点明价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: People rarely got the chance to see the painting, so many came.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Because such a chance came but once in a generation, people journeyed from distant provinces and stood shivering through the night, unwilling to surrender so rare a glimpse of the legendary scroll to anyone who might arrive before them. （读后续写·万人空巷·因果+画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: came but once in a generation夸张强调稀有 + journeyed / stood shivering连续动作 + unwilling to surrender独立主格 + so rare a glimpse倒装冠词结构提升文采

sentenceUpgrade.original: Patience is a rare and important quality.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Patience, increasingly rare in our restless age, is a quality worth cultivating above almost all others — for it is the quiet soil in which every great achievement silently takes root. （议论文·抽象说理·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: increasingly rare in our restless age插入语点明时代背景 + worth cultivating above almost all others比较级强调 + for引导原因 + 比喻(quiet soil ... takes root)升华

classPractice.question: 人们排了几个小时的队，只为亲眼一睹名画这难得的机会。Crowds waited in line for hours for the ____ ____ to see the famous painting with their own eyes.
classPractice.note: 仿课文；a rare chance / opportunity = 难得的机会

classPractice.question: ____ (rare) does he praise anyone, so when he called her essay 'remarkable', the class fell silent.
classPractice.note: rare → rarely（很少）；否定副词居首，主句部分倒装 does he praise

classPractice.question: As the drought dragged on, clean water grew ____ (rare / scarce), and every drop was rationed.
classPractice.note: scarce 侧重资源"供不应求、数量不足"；rare 侧重"本就罕见、难得"，此处指水不够用故用 scarce

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to reveal or express a great deal about someone or something, often without the use of words
(2) phr. to be a clear and convincing proof of a particular quality, situation or truth
(3) phr. (of a fact, action or object) to say much more than any explicit statement could

posExamples.sentence: She said nothing, but the way she gently wiped the dust from her father's old photograph spoke volumes about a love that years of silence had never dimmed. （读后续写·无声胜有声·亲情）
I believe Li Hua deserves this award, for the countless hours he has quietly devoted to helping struggling classmates speak volumes about his kindness and sense of responsibility. （应用文·推荐信）
How a society treats its elderly and its weakest members speaks volumes about the true depth of its civilization, far more than any monument or skyscraper ever could. （议论文·文明的标尺）
The tidy desk, the neatly stacked books, the single fresh flower in a jar — every small detail of the tiny room spoke volumes about the discipline of the woman who lived there. （读后续写·环境映射人物·细节暗示）

wordForms.other: 习语,固定结构 speak volumes (about sth):volume 此处取'大量、许多'之义(如 a volume of / volumes of 大量的),字面'说出一册册的话'→引申'不言而喻地说明许多';不可换成 *speak volume(须用复数 volumes);主语多为无生命细节/行动/沉默/眼神,谓语随时态变 spoke/spoken。

collocations.translation: 充分说明/清楚表明某人某事(无需言语却极有说服力)
collocations.example: The way you keep your promises speaks volumes about the kind of person you are. （议论文·守信见人品）

collocations.translation: 行动胜于言语,行动最能说明问题
collocations.example: He never once said he loved his students, but his tireless dedication proved that actions speak volumes. （议论文·身教重于言传）

collocations.phrase: a look / silence that speaks volumes
collocations.example: She gave him a single look that spoke volumes, and he understood at once that he had been forgiven. （读后续写·无声交流）
The way a person treats a waiter or a stranger speaks volumes about his character. （议论文·细节见人品）
In her painting, the details speak volumes — every worried face in the crowd tells a story of its own. （议论文/记叙·艺术鉴赏）

collocations.phrase: sth speaks volumes about the truth of ...
collocations.translation: 某事充分证明了……的真相
collocations.example: The empty chairs at the meeting spoke volumes about how little the plan had inspired anyone. （记叙/议论文·揭示实情）
Though she forced a smile, her eyes spoke volumes about the sorrow she was struggling to hide. （读后续写·强颜欢笑）

synonyms.example: The books on a person's shelf say a great deal about the way he sees the world. （议论文·由物见人）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:say a great deal about 中性直白,程度可强可弱;speak volumes about 语气最强、最书面,含'胜过千言万语'之意,主语常是无声的细节/行动/沉默。

synonyms.example: The books on a person's shelf say a lot about the way he sees the world. （议论文·由物见人）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:say a lot about 口语化、程度较弱;speak volumes about 语气更强、更书面,含'胜过千言万语'之意。

synonyms.example: His trembling hands revealed the fear he was so desperate to conceal. （读后续写·心理外露）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:reveal 是普通及物动词,直接表'揭示、显露',后接被揭示的内容;speak volumes about 更含蓄有力,强调'无声却极有说服力地说明',后须接 about+对象。

synonyms.translation: 很能说明问题的,意味深长的
synonyms.example: His long pause before answering was telling, and she knew he was hiding something. （记叙·察言观色）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:be telling 是形容词性表达,指'透露真相、耐人寻味',无宾语;speak volumes about 是动词短语,后接被说明的具体对象(about sth)。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·无声胜有声(用细节代替直白抒情)
advancedExpressions.expression: said not a word, yet ... spoke volumes about ... | a silence/look/glance that spoke volumes | actions speak volumes
advancedExpressions.example: She said not a word, yet the tremor in her hands spoke volumes about the storm raging within. （读后续写高分套路:让细节'开口说话'）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'很能说明/证明'一组梯度
advancedExpressions.expression: say a great deal about（中性）< be telling（耐人寻味）< speak volumes about（最强、书面）< bear eloquent witness to（最文学）
advancedExpressions.example: How a society treats its weakest members speaks volumes about the true depth of its civilization. （议论文由现象论本质,一句可替换升级）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主谓一致与时态
advancedExpressions.expression: actions speak / a detail speaks / one's eyes speak（主语单复数决定 speak 加不加 s）
advancedExpressions.example: The tidy desk and the single fresh flower spoke volumes about the discipline of the woman who lived there. （并列主语用复数 spoke,一般过去时叙事）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. said not a word, yet ... spoke volumes about ...
advancedExpressions.example: She said not a word, yet the tremor in her hands spoke volumes about the storm raging within. （'said not a word, yet ...'对比结构,以细节代替直白抒情）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., which speaks volumes about his/her ...
advancedExpressions.example: Li Hua gave up his own holiday to care for a sick neighbour, which speaks volumes about his compassion. （非限定定语从句嵌入短语,用事实佐证品质，推荐信高分句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: how ... treats ... speaks volumes about ...
advancedExpressions.example: How a nation treats its language and traditions speaks volumes about the depth of its cultural confidence. （'how ... speaks volumes about ...'主语从句结构,由现象论本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her silence showed how sad she was.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She uttered not a single complaint; yet the silence that hung between them, heavy and unbroken, spoke volumes about a grief too deep for any words to reach. （读后续写·无声抒情·细节暗示）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: uttered not a single complaint否定强调 + yet转折 + the silence that hung定语从句 + heavy and unbroken插入形容词 + too deep for ... to reach不定式补足语升华情感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The way people treat others shows what kind of people they are.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The manner in which we treat those who can do nothing for us in return speaks volumes about who we truly are, laying bare a character that fine words and public praise can so easily disguise. （议论文·抽象说理·正式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The manner in which ... 定语从句作主语 + those who ... in return限定对象 + laying bare分词状语延展 + that ... disguise定语从句形成对照,揭示表里差异

classPractice.question: She said nothing, but the way she gently held the old photograph ____ ____ ____ a love that had never faded.
classPractice.note: 考固定习语 speak volumes about;叙事语境用一般过去时 spoke。

classPractice.question: 一个人对待陌生人的方式充分说明了他的品格。（用 speak volumes about）
classPractice.answer: The way a person treats strangers speaks volumes about his character.
classPractice.note: 主语 The way... treats... 为单数第三人称,谓语用 speaks(加 s);后接 about+对象。

classPractice.question: His silent dedication clearly showed how kind he was. → His silent dedication ____ ____ ____ his kindness.
classPractice.note: 用 speak volumes about 替换 clearly showed,语气更强、更书面;时态与原句 showed 保持一致。

classPractice.note: 主句叙述过去、且从句用 had inspired,主句谓语须用一般过去时 spoke。

translation: 历史上重要的；有历史意义的
original_sentence: Li Bai’s romantic style was also deeply rooted in the social and historical context in which he lived.
readingExamples: Li Bai’s romantic style was also deeply rooted in the social and historical context in which he lived.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. important in history, or likely to be considered important at some time in the future
(2) adj. having a long history; connected with a period in the past
(3) adj. (of a moment or decision) marking a significant turning point that will be remembered

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】有历史意义的，历史性的（significant, remarkable）——修饰事件/建筑/场合/名画
uncommonMeanings.example: the historic piece of art 这幅历史名画 / a historic event 有历史意义的事件 / a historic building 有历史意义的建筑 / on this historic occasion 在这个有历史意义的场合（PPT原句·辨析核心）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （语法）历史时态的（指过去时、过去完成时等叙述过去的时态，如 historic tenses / the historic present 历史现在时）
uncommonMeanings.example: In narrating the legend, the old scholar slipped naturally into the historic tenses, and the crumbling temple seemed to rise once more before our eyes. （读后续写·老者讲述往事·时空交错）

posExamples.sentence: As the last stone was fitted into place, a historic silence settled over the crowd — everyone sensed that they were witnessing a moment their grandchildren would one day read about in textbooks. （读后续写·集体见证·重大时刻）
I am writing to invite you to our historic town, where cobbled streets and centuries-old bell towers whisper stories of a glorious past waiting to be rediscovered. （应用文·邀请信）
The signing of the climate agreement was a historic achievement, for it proved that nations divided by interest could still unite in the face of a common threat. （议论文·国际合作）
Standing before the historic city wall, weathered by a thousand years of wind and war, she felt her own troubles shrink into insignificance against the vast river of time. （读后续写·古迹感悟·渺小与永恒）

wordForms.other: ★易混辨析:historic(有历史意义的,褒义,a historic moment) vs historical(历史的、与历史有关的,中性,historical documents/figure)——考试必考。派生:history(历史;n.)→historian(历史学家)→historic/historical(adj.)→historically(adv.,从历史角度看)。注意 an historic 与 a historic 均可(现代英语多读出 h,用 a historic)。近义 prehistoric 史前的。

collocations.phrase: a historic event / building / occasion【课件】
collocations.translation: 【课件】有历史意义的事件 / 建筑 / 场合
collocations.example: a historic event 有历史意义的事件 / a historic building 有历史意义的建筑 / on this historic occasion 在这个有历史意义的场合（PPT原句）

collocations.phrase: a historic piece of art【课件】
collocations.example: The public's continued enthusiasm speaks volumes about the power of this historic piece of art. 公众持续的热情足以证明这幅历史名画的魅力。（PPT原句）
The first Chinese astronaut stepping onto the lunar surface would be a historic moment, one that generations to come would recall with unbridled pride. （议论文·科技与民族自豪）
We gathered in the square to commemorate a historic event that had, decades earlier, changed the destiny of our nation forever. （读后续写·纪念活动）
In a historic decision, the school board voted to open its doors to children from the neighbouring migrant community. （应用文·新闻报道）
Volunteers spent the weekend restoring the historic building, brushing away the dust of a hundred forgotten years. （应用文·志愿活动）
Xi'an, a historic city that once served as the eastern terminus of the Silk Road, still guards the secrets of thirteen dynasties. （议论文·文化遗产）
Their historic victory in the final was not merely a triumph of skill, but of a spirit that had refused to yield through years of quiet defeat. （读后续写·体育励志）
The manuscript, though yellowed and torn, was of immense historic significance to scholars of ancient poetry. （应用文·博物馆介绍）
The team's historic breakthrough in vaccine research offered a glimmer of hope to a world weary of waiting. （议论文·科技进步）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】历史的，与历史有关的（= relating to history）
synonyms.example: He is writing a historical novel about 19th-century Europe. 他正在写一部关于19世纪欧洲的历史小说。（PPT原句·辨析：historical=与历史有关的，中性；historic=有历史意义的，褒义）
synonyms.usage: 【课件辨析·高频易混】historical 指'与历史相关的、属于过去的'（中性：a historical novel 历史小说 / historical documents 历史文献）；historic 强调'有重大历史意义、将被铭记的'（褒义：a historic event/building/occasion）。记法：historic=有历史意义（有分量）、historical=历史上的（客观）。

synonyms.example: the historic piece of art = a significant, remarkable piece of art 这幅历史名画（PPT原句：historic ≈ significant, remarkable）
synonyms.usage: 【课件同义替换】PPT 明确 the historic piece of art 中 historic ≈ significant, remarkable；写作时可用 significant/remarkable 替换 historic 表'重大而值得铭记'。

synonyms.example: It was a monumental turning point in her life — the day she finally chose courage over comfort. （读后续写·人生转折）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:monumental 侧重规模宏大、影响深远得如纪念碑般不朽,语气更强、更文学化;historic 中性偏客观,强调其将被历史铭记。

synonyms.example: The landmark ruling set a precedent that would protect countless workers in the years to come. （议论文·社会公正）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:landmark 作形容词强调'开创先例、划时代的转折点',常搭配 decision/ruling/study;historic 更泛指'将载入史册的'。

synonyms.example: It was a memorable evening, though hardly one the history books would ever record. （读后续写·私人难忘时刻）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:memorable 指'对个人而言难忘',范围可大可小、偏主观;historic 特指'对历史/公众有重大意义',二者不可互换——一件事可 memorable 而不 historic。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·'有历史意义'表达升级
advancedExpressions.expression: a historic moment/occasion/turning point | of historic significance | make history | go down in history | be etched into history
advancedExpressions.example: That single decision would go down in history as the moment a nation dared to believe in itself. （议论文/读后续写,把 historic 名词化、动词化,句式更高级）

advancedExpressions.expression: history(n.历史) → historian(n.历史学家) → historic(adj.有历史意义) / historical(adj.历史的) → historically(adv.) → prehistoric(adj.史前的)
advancedExpressions.example: Historically, historians have long debated whether that historic treaty rested on any solid historical evidence. （一句串起词族,同时对照 historic/historical 用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·historic vs historical 的选词判断
advancedExpressions.expression: 有重大意义→historic(a historic victory);仅指过去/与历史相关→historical(a historical novel/figure/document)
advancedExpressions.example: A historical figure（历史人物,中性）is not always a historic figure（改变历史的人物,褒义）. （用同一名词对比,凸显词义差别,写作/单选皆考）

advancedExpressions.expression: little did they know that they were witnessing a historic ...
advancedExpressions.example: Little did they know that they were witnessing a historic turning point, one that would be etched forever into the memory of their small town. （倒装句 little did they know + 定语从句升华，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: steeped in history, ... stands as a historic testament to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Steeped in history, our ancient academy stands as a historic testament to the enduring value of learning. （过去分词短语作状语 steeped in + testament to 名词升级，宣传文体）

advancedExpressions.expression: what makes an event truly historic is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What makes an event truly historic is not the grandeur of the ceremony, but the profound and lasting change it sets in motion. （what 引导主语从句 + not...but 对比结构，深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was a historic day, and everyone was happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was a day destined to become historic — and as the first rays of dawn spilled over the rooftops, a wave of jubilation swept through the streets, strangers embracing strangers, tears and laughter mingling in the crisp morning air. （读后续写·集体欢庆·环境+群像描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: destined to become 预示未来意义 + 破折号补充 + 环境描写(dawn spilled over) + 群像动作细节(strangers embracing) + 通感(tears and laughter mingling)

sentenceUpgrade.original: This building is old and important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Weathered by centuries of storm and sun yet standing proudly still, this historic edifice is not merely a relic of stone and timber, but a living witness to every triumph and tragedy our city has endured. （应用文·古迹介绍）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语前置(Weathered by...) + yet 转折让步 + not merely...but 递进否定结构 + 隐喻(living witness) + 头韵(storm and sun / triumph and tragedy)

classPractice.question: The public's continued enthusiasm speaks volumes about the power of this ____ (historic / historical) piece of art.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】historic 强调'有重大历史意义、将被铭记'（≈ significant, remarkable）；historical 仅指'与历史相关的'。此处指'历史名画'故用 historic

classPractice.question: He is writing a ____ (historic / historical) novel about 19th-century Europe.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】historical = relating to history 与历史有关的（历史小说）；不含'重大意义'的褒义，故用 historical

classPractice.question: 在这个有历史意义的场合。____ this ____ occasion.
classPractice.note: 【课件原句】on this historic occasion 在这个有历史意义的场合；historic 表'有历史意义的'

classPractice.question: The signing of the peace treaty was a ____ (historic / historical) achievement that changed the region forever.
classPractice.note: 强调'有重大历史意义、将被铭记'用 historic;若仅指'历史上的、与历史相关的'才用 historical。

classPractice.question: The museum holds many ____ (historic / historical) documents dating back to the Tang Dynasty.
classPractice.note: documents 只是'历史的/与过去有关的'资料,属中性描述,用 historical;不含'重大意义'的褒义评价。

classPractice.question: 站在这座有着一千年历史的历史名城的城墙前，她感到自己的烦恼变得微不足道。（用 historic）
classPractice.answer: Standing before the wall of this thousand-year-old historic city, she felt her own troubles shrink into insignificance. / Standing before the historic city wall of a thousand years, she felt her troubles become insignificant.
classPractice.note: '历史名城'用 historic city(有历史分量的城);现在分词 Standing 作状语,主句主语须为 she。

classPractice.question: Little did they know that they were witnessing a ____ (history) turning point that would change everything.
classPractice.note: 填 history 的形容词,修饰 turning point 且强调'重大历史意义',用 historic 而非 historical。

original_sentence: What are the highlights of the singer’s or band’s music career?
readingExamples: What are the highlights of the singer’s or band’s music career?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a job or profession that you do for a long period of your life, especially one with opportunities for progress
(2) n. the period of time you spend doing a particular job or activity; the general course of a person's working life
(3) v. (of a vehicle or person) to move forward quickly and in an uncontrolled way
(4) adj. having chosen a particular occupation as a lifelong profession

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （车辆或人）飞奔，横冲直撞，失控疾行（=hurtle）
uncommonMeanings.example: The runaway carriage careered down the cobbled slope, sparks flying from its iron wheels, as onlookers scattered in terror. （读后续写·紧张动作场面·危机时刻）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 以某职业为终身事业的；职业性的（作定语，如 a career diplomat/soldier）
uncommonMeanings.example: Unlike the drifters who came and went, she was a career diplomat, and she wore that identity as naturally as her own name. （读后续写·人物刻画·坚定的职业者）

posExamples.sentence: At the crossroads of her life, she abandoned a promising career in law to chase the fragile, flickering dream of becoming a novelist — a choice her father would never forgive, yet one she would never regret. （读后续写·人生抉择·梦想与代价）
I am writing to seek your advice on choosing a career, for I stand bewildered before a future that offers too many roads and too little certainty. （应用文·咨询信）
A fulfilling career should be measured not by the salary it commands, but by the sense of purpose it awakens and the lives it quietly touches. （议论文·人生价值）
The sledge careered wildly down the icy hillside, and for one heart-stopping moment the boy was certain he would crash into the frozen pond below. （读后续写·冒险场面·失控下坡）

wordForms.other: 一词两义两性:①n. 事业/生涯(常用义);②v. (车辆/人)失控疾行、横冲直撞(=hurtle,读后续写紧张场面)。派生:careerist 野心家、一心谋求晋升者(常含贬义)。注意别与 carrier(运送者/搬运工/航母/载体) 拼写混淆,与 courier(信使、快递员) 也易混。构词记:car(能'跑')→career 疾驰→引申'一路奔向的人生轨迹'。

collocations.example: Encouraged by her mentor, she resolved to pursue a career in scientific research, undaunted by the long and lonely road ahead. （读后续写·励志追梦）

collocations.phrase: a career in music / medicine / teaching
collocations.translation: 音乐／医学／教学领域的事业
collocations.example: What are the highlights of a career in music, and what sacrifices lie hidden behind each dazzling performance? （议论文·艺术人生）

collocations.translation: 职业生涯的高光时刻／亮点
collocations.example: Looking back, she realized that the quiet act of mentoring a shy student was the true highlight of her career, dwarfing every award on the shelf. （读后续写·回望生涯·价值重估）
Fresh out of university and brimming with ambition, he embarked on a career that would take him to the farthest corners of the globe. （读后续写·青年出发）
When making a career choice, one should weigh not only prospects and pay, but also whether the work stirs genuine passion. （议论文·职业规划）
The internship offered invaluable career prospects, opening doors she had scarcely dared to imagine. （应用文·实习感想）

collocations.phrase: at the height / peak of one's career
collocations.example: At the very height of his career, the celebrated pianist stunned the world by retreating to a quiet village to teach children. （读后续写·急转直下·出人意料）
She took the demanding overseas assignment not for the money, but to further a career she had long dreamed of. （应用文·求职信）

collocations.translation: 决定事业走向的关键时刻
collocations.example: That single, flawless routine on the Olympic mat became the career-defining moment of her entire life. （读后续写·体育巅峰）
The job fair opened up a wealth of career opportunities for graduates uncertain of their next step. （应用文·活动报道）

synonyms.example: Teaching is a noble profession, one that shapes minds long before it earns applause. （议论文·职业价值）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:profession 特指需专业知识与训练的职业(如医生、律师、教师),偏正式、单次指称;career 指贯穿人生的整个职业生涯与发展轨迹,含'长期历程'之意。

synonyms.example: For her, medicine was not merely a job but a vocation, a calling she felt in the very marrow of her bones. （读后续写·使命感人物）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:vocation 强调内心召唤与奉献感,带崇高、精神性色彩;career 中性,侧重职业发展与成就。

synonyms.example: Please state your name, age and occupation clearly on the registration form. （应用文·表格填写）
synonyms.usage: 辨析:occupation 是最中性、最泛的'职业',常用于正式登记或问卷;career 强调发展性与长期规划,不能互换用于填表场景。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·'事业'动词搭配群
advancedExpressions.expression: pursue / embark on / launch a career(开启从事) → advance / further one's career(推进) → at the peak/height of one's career(巅峰) → a career-defining moment / career highlights(高光)
advancedExpressions.example: She embarked on a career in medicine, and years later that first night-shift became the highlight of her whole career. （一组动态短语勾勒完整职业弧线,议论文/读后续写通用）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·'职业'四词梯度
advancedExpressions.expression: occupation(最中性,填表用) — job(具体工作) — profession(需专业训练的职业) — vocation(有使命感的天职) — career(贯穿一生的职业生涯)
advancedExpressions.example: It began as just a job, grew into a profession, and finally became the vocation that defined her entire career. （一句排出梯度,写作可精准替换、避免重复用 job）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·一词多性(熟词僻义)
advancedExpressions.expression: career: n.事业/生涯（高频）｜v.失控疾行(careered down)｜作定语'终身职业的'(a career soldier)；派生 careerist 野心家
advancedExpressions.example: The car careered off the road just as he was reaching the peak of his racing career. （同一词的动词义与名词义在一句中同现,凸显熟词僻义考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: at a crossroads in her career, she chose ... over ...
advancedExpressions.example: At a crossroads in her career, she chose the uncertain path of passion over the well-trodden road of security. （crossroads 比喻人生抉择 + choose A over B 对比结构，续写转折段）

advancedExpressions.expression: when it comes to shaping one's career, it is essential to ...
advancedExpressions.example: When it comes to shaping one's career, it is essential to align your daily efforts with the person you aspire to become. （when it comes to 话题引入 + it is essential to 建议句式，建议信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: a successful career lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: A successful career lies not in the heights one climbs, but in the number of hands one lifts along the way. （not...but 对比 + 隐喻对照(heights vs hands)，升华论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She worked hard and had a good career.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Through years of quiet perseverance — the early mornings, the countless rejections, the small victories no one else noticed — she carved out a career so remarkable that even those who had once doubted her fell silent in admiration. （读后续写·励志历程·细节铺陈）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入细节排比(early mornings, rejections, victories) + carve out a career 生动动词短语 + so...that 结果状语 + 对比反衬(those who had once doubted)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Choosing a career is important, so think carefully.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Since the career we choose will, in large measure, determine the person we ultimately become, it is worth pausing to reflect deeply before committing ourselves to any single path. （议论文·职业规划）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Since 引导原因状语从句 + in large measure 程度状语插入 + 定语从句(the person we become) + it is worth doing 议论句式 + before 时间状语深化

classPractice.question: 选词填空(career / profession / occupation): On the form, please write your name, age and ____. Teaching, however, is more than that to her — it is the ____ she has devoted her whole ____ to.
classPractice.note: 填表最中性用 occupation;需专业训练的职业用 profession;贯穿一生的职业生涯用 career——三词不可互换。

classPractice.question: Encouraged by her mentor, she resolved to ____ a career ____ scientific research. （从事……领域的事业）
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 pursue/follow a career in+领域;介词用 in 不用 of/on。

classPractice.question: The runaway sledge ____ (career) wildly down the icy hillside as the terrified children screamed.
classPractice.note: career 作动词'失控疾行'(熟词僻义),叙事语境用一般过去时 careered。

classPractice.question: 在事业的巅峰时期，这位钢琴家却选择退隐乡村去教孩子们。（用 at the height of one's career）
classPractice.answer: At the height of his career, the pianist chose to retreat to the countryside to teach children.
classPractice.note: at the height/peak of one's career'在事业巅峰';转折的意外感可由 chose to retreat 体现。
